q: Which entities are required to apply IAS 33 Earnings per Share?
opt: All entities that prepare financial statements under IFRS Accounting Standards
Entities whose ordinary shares are publicly traded, or that are in the process of listing them
Only entities that have preference shares in issue
Only entities that have issued convertible instruments or share options
ex: IAS 33 faqat ordinary shares'i publicly traded (fond birjasida savdo qilinadigan) yoki listing jarayonidagi entity'larga majburiy. Oddiy private kompaniya IFRS bo'yicha hisobot bersa ham EPS ko'rsatishi shart emas. Convertible yoki preference shares borligi scope'ni belgilamaydi — ular faqat hisob-kitobga ta'sir qiladi.

q: True or false? A listed parent that presents both its own separate financial statements and consolidated financial statements is only required to present EPS based on the consolidated information.
ex: To'g'ri (True). IAS 33 bo'yicha parent ham separate, ham consolidated FS taqdim etsa, EPS faqat consolidated ma'lumot asosida ko'rsatilishi talab qilinadi (earnings = profit attributable to owners of the parent).

q: How should basic and diluted EPS be presented under IAS 33?
opt: Basic EPS on the face of the statement of profit or loss; diluted EPS only in the notes
Diluted EPS only, since it is the more prudent figure
In the directors' report, outside the audited financial statements
On the face of the statement of profit or loss, with basic and diluted EPS given equal prominence
ex: IAS 33 ikkala ko'rsatkichni ham — basic EPS va diluted EPS — statement of profit or loss'ning o'zida (face), teng darajada ko'rinadigan (equal prominence) qilib ko'rsatishni talab qiladi. Diluted EPS'ni faqat notes'ga yashirib bo'lmaydi va u directors' report'ga ko'chirilmaydi.

q: Which THREE of the following are ways in which IAS 33 improves the comparability of EPS figures?
opt: It defines the earnings figure to be used
It prescribes how the number of shares in the calculation is determined
It requires EPS to be calculated using operating cash flows rather than profit
It requires a standard presentation and disclosure of EPS
It requires EPS to be separately audited by a second firm of auditors
ex: To'g'ri javoblar: earnings ta'rifini berish, share'lar sonini aniqlash usulini belgilash va standart presentation/disclosure talab qilish. IAS 33 EPS'ni cash flow asosida hisoblashni talab qilmaydi (EPS — profit asosidagi ko'rsatkich) va EPS alohida audit qilinishi haqida qoida qo'ymaydi.

q: For a group, which figure is used as the numerator (earnings) in basic EPS?
opt: Total comprehensive income attributable to owners of the parent
Profit before tax, less ordinary dividends paid
Profit after tax attributable to owners of the parent, less irredeemable preference dividends
Profit after tax for the whole group, including the non-controlling interest share
ex: Basic EPS earnings = profit after tax − NCI ulushi − irredeemable preference dividends. OCI (masalan revaluation gain) kirmaydi, shuning uchun total comprehensive income ishlatilmaydi. Ordinary dividends ayirilmaydi — ular aynan ordinary shareholders'ga tegishli earnings'dan to'lanadi. Profit before tax ham emas, chunki soliq shareholders'ga tegishli emas.

q:
Olmaliq Group reports consolidated profit after tax of $4,850,000 for the year, of which $620,000 is attributable to the non-controlling interest. The parent has $2,000,000 of 6% irredeemable preference shares in issue (dividends recognised in equity) and paid an ordinary dividend of $900,000 during the year.
What earnings figure should be used in the basic EPS calculation? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Earnings = PAT − NCI − irredeemable preference dividend.
Preference dividend = $2,000,000 × 6% = $120,000.
Earnings = 4,850 − 620 − 120 = $4,110k.
Ordinary dividend ($900,000) ayirilmaydi — u ordinary shareholders'ning o'ziga taqsimlangan foyda.

q: Zarafshon Co is working out the earnings figure for its basic EPS, starting from profit for the year in its statement of profit or loss. Which TWO of the following items should it leave in that figure (that is, NOT deduct)?
opt: The ordinary dividend paid during the year
The dividend on irredeemable preference shares classified as equity
The share of profit belonging to the non-controlling interest
The dividend on redeemable preference shares classified as a financial liability
ex: Deduct qilinmaydiganlar: ordinary dividends (ular ordinary shareholders'ning o'z earnings'idan to'lanadi) va redeemable preference share dividends (bu shares liability deb tasniflanadi, dividend esa finance cost sifatida allaqachon P/L'da ayirilgan — ikkinchi marta ayirilmaydi). Irredeemable preference dividends (equity) va NCI ulushi esa albatta ayiriladi.

q: Chirchiq Co has 5% redeemable preference shares in issue which are classified as a financial liability. How are the dividends on these shares dealt with when calculating basic EPS?
opt: No further adjustment is needed, because the dividends have already been charged as a finance cost in arriving at profit
They must be added back to profit after tax, because they are not paid to ordinary shareholders
They are deducted from the number of shares rather than from earnings
They must be deducted from profit after tax, in the same way as irredeemable preference dividends
ex: Redeemable preference shares — financial liability. Ularning dividendi P/L'da finance cost sifatida tan olinadi, ya'ni profit after tax'da allaqachon ayirilgan. Shuning uchun EPS earnings'ga qo'shimcha tuzatish kerak emas. Faqat equity'da turgan irredeemable preference dividend alohida ayiriladi.

q:
Nurafshon Group's consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 March 20X6 includes:
$000
Profit for the year5,550
Other comprehensive income: revaluation gain900
Total comprehensive income6,450
Profit attributable to: owners of the parent4,980
Profit attributable to: non-controlling interest570
TCI attributable to: owners of the parent5,700
The parent paid an irredeemable preference dividend of $180,000 (recognised in equity). The parent had 12 million ordinary shares in issue throughout the year.
What is basic EPS? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.
ex:
Earnings = profit attributable to owners of the parent − irredeemable preference dividend = 4,980 − 180 = $4,800k.
OCI (revaluation gain) va TCI ishlatilmaydi — EPS profit asosida.
Basic EPS = 4,800,000 / 12,000,000 = 40.0¢.

q: True or false? Ordinary dividends paid during the year are deducted from profit after tax in arriving at the earnings figure for basic EPS.
ex: Noto'g'ri (False). EPS — ordinary shareholders'ga tegishli foyda. Ordinary dividend esa shu foydaning ularga taqsimlangan qismi, shuning uchun u ayirilmaydi. Faqat NCI ulushi va irredeemable preference dividends ayiriladi.

q:
Guliston Co had 6,000,000 ordinary shares in issue on 1 January 20X5. On 1 May 20X5 it issued a further 1,500,000 shares at full market price. Profit attributable to ordinary shareholders for the year ended 31 December 20X5 was $2,730,000.
What is basic EPS? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.
ex:
Full market price issue — yangi shares faqat chiqarilgan kundan boshlab vaqt bo'yicha (time-weighted) hisoblanadi.
Weighted average = 6,000,000 + 1,500,000 × 8/12 = 7,000,000.
EPS = 2,730,000 / 7,000,000 = 39.0¢.
subtopic: Weighted average shares - full price issues
topic: Weighted average shares - full price issues

q:
Termiz Co has a year end of 30 June. On 1 July 20X5 it had 10 million ordinary shares in issue. On 1 November 20X5 it issued 2.4 million shares at full market price, and on 1 April 20X6 it repurchased and cancelled 1.5 million shares. Earnings for the year ended 30 June 20X6 were $4,490,000.
What is basic EPS for the year ended 30 June 20X6?
ex:
Yangi issue ham, buyback ham vaqt bo'yicha weighting qilinadi:
1 Jul–31 Oct: 10.0m × 4/12 = 3.333m
1 Nov–31 Mar: 12.4m × 5/12 = 5.167m
1 Apr–30 Jun: 10.9m × 3/12 = 2.725m
Weighted average = 11.225m (yoki 10m + 2.4m × 8/12 − 1.5m × 3/12).
EPS = 4,490,000 / 11,225,000 = 40.0¢.
Yil oxiridagi 10.9m'ni ishlatish 41.2¢ beradi; buyback'ni e'tiborsiz qoldirish 38.7¢ beradi — ikkalasi xato.
subtopic: Weighted average shares - full price issues
topic: Weighted average shares - full price issues

q: True or false? When shares are issued at full market price during the current year, the prior year comparative EPS does not need to be restated.
ex: To'g'ri (True). Full market price issue kompaniyaga shunga mos yangi resurs (cash) olib keladi, bonus element yo'q. Shuning uchun shares faqat joriy yilda vaqt bo'yicha weighting qilinadi va o'tgan yil EPS'i o'zgarmaydi. Comparative faqat bonus issue va rights issue (bonus element) uchun restate qilinadi.
subtopic: Weighted average shares - full price issues
topic: Weighted average shares - full price issues

q: Why are shares issued at full market price during the year included in basic EPS only from the date of issue (time-weighted)?
opt: Because IAS 33 requires all share issues to be treated as if they occurred at the start of the year
Because the cash raised has only been available to generate earnings for part of the year
Because the shares were issued at a discount to market price
Because the new shares do not carry voting rights until the following year
ex: Full price issue yangi resurs keltiradi, lekin bu pul faqat chiqarilgan kundan boshlab foyda ishlab chiqarishga hissa qo'shadi. Earnings'ga moslik uchun shares ham shu qism uchungina hisobga olinadi (time-weighting). "Boshidan beri bor" deb hisoblash — bu bonus issue qoidasi.
subtopic: Weighted average shares - full price issues
topic: Weighted average shares - full price issues

q:
Buxoro Silk Co has a 30 September year end. It had 15,000,000 ordinary shares in issue on 1 October 20X4 and issued 3,600,000 shares at full market price on 1 February 20X5. There were no other share transactions.
What is the weighted average number of shares for basic EPS for the year ended 30 September 20X5? Enter in thousands of shares, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
1 Feb dan 30 Sep gacha = 8 oy.
Weighted average = 15,000 + 3,600 × 8/12 = 15,000 + 2,400 = 17,400 ming shares.
subtopic: Weighted average shares - full price issues
topic: Weighted average shares - full price issues

q: How is a bonus issue made during the current year treated in basic EPS?
opt: The bonus shares are time-weighted from the date of issue, with no change to the comparative
The bonus shares are ignored until the following year
The bonus shares are treated as if they had been in issue from the start of the earliest period presented, and comparative EPS is restated
The bonus shares are included only in diluted EPS
ex: Bonus issue kompaniyaga hech qanday yangi resurs keltirmaydi — har bir shareholder ulushi o'zgarmaydi. Shu sababli bonus shares eng erta taqdim etilgan davr boshidan bor deb hisoblanadi (time-weighting yo'q) va comparative EPS bonus fraction teskarisi bilan restate qilinadi.

q:
Andijon Motors Co had 8,000,000 ordinary shares in issue on 1 January 20X6. On 1 September 20X6 it made a 1 for 4 bonus issue. Earnings for the year ended 31 December 20X6 were $3,500,000.
What is basic EPS for 20X6? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.
ex:
Bonus issue: 8,000,000 × 1/4 = 2,000,000 yangi shares. Bonus shares yil boshidan bor deb olinadi (time-weighting qilinmaydi).
Shares = 8,000,000 × 5/4 = 10,000,000.
EPS = 3,500,000 / 10,000,000 = 35.0¢.

q:
Qarshi Co reported basic EPS of 42.0¢ for 20X4. During 20X5 it made a 2 for 5 bonus issue. There were no other share issues.
What is the restated comparative EPS for 20X4 that will appear in the 20X5 financial statements?
ex:
2 for 5 bonus: har 5 ta share 7 taga aylanadi, bonus fraction = 7/5.
Comparative = o'tgan yilgi EPS × teskari fraction = 42.0 × 5/7 = 30.0¢.
7/5 ga ko'paytirish EPS'ni oshirib yuboradi — bu xato yo'nalish.

q: True or false? A bonus issue provides the entity with additional resources, which is why the new shares are time-weighted from the date of issue.
ex: Noto'g'ri (False). Bonus (capitalisation / scrip) issue hech qanday yangi resurs keltirmaydi — reserves share capital'ga o'tkaziladi xolos. Shuning uchun bonus shares time-weighting qilinmaydi, yil boshidan bor deb hisoblanadi va comparative restate qilinadi.

q: Which THREE of the following statements about a bonus issue are correct?
opt: Each shareholder's percentage ownership is unchanged
The prior year comparative EPS is restated
The new shares are time-weighted from the date of the bonus issue
It may be funded by capitalising share premium or retained earnings
It increases the total equity of the entity
ex: To'g'ri: (1) shareholder'ning ulushi foizda o'zgarmaydi; (2) comparative EPS restate qilinadi; (3) bonus issue share premium yoki retained earnings hisobidan moliyalashtiriladi (Dr reserves, Cr share capital). Noto'g'ri: bonus shares issue sanasidan weighting qilinmaydi va umumiy equity o'zgarmaydi — faqat equity ichida qayta taqsimlanadi.

q:
Paxtakor Co has a 31 March year end. On 1 April 20X5 it had 12 million ordinary shares in issue. On 1 October 20X5 it made a 1 for 6 bonus issue. Earnings were $4,200,000 for the year ended 31 March 20X6 and $3,500,000 for the year ended 31 March 20X5.
What basic EPS figures will be shown in the financial statements for the year ended 31 March 20X6?
ex:
Bonus shares = 12m × 1/6 = 2m; jami 14m. Bonus issue ikkala yil uchun ham boshidan bor deb olinadi.
20X6 EPS = 4,200,000 / 14,000,000 = 30.0¢.
20X5 restated = 3,500,000 / 14,000,000 = 25.0¢ (yoki asl 29.2¢ × 6/7 = 25.0¢).
32.3¢ bonus shares'ni 6 oyga weighting qilishdan chiqadi (12m + 2m × 6/12 = 13m) — xato.

q:
Navoiy Metals Co had 5,000,000 ordinary shares in issue on 1 January 20X7. The following share transactions took place during the year ended 31 December 20X7:
  • 1 April: issue of 1,000,000 shares at full market price
  • 1 July: 1 for 3 bonus issue
  • 1 October: issue of 900,000 shares at full market price
Earnings for 20X7 were $2,850,000.
What is basic EPS for 20X7? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.

Farg'ona Foods Co makes a 1 for 4 rights issue at $2.00 per share. The market price of its shares immediately before the issue (cum rights) was $3.00.
What is the theoretical ex-rights price (TERP)? Enter in $, to two decimal places.
Urganch Co made a 2 for 5 rights issue at $1.30 per share when the cum-rights market price was $2.00. Which bonus fraction should be applied to the shares in issue before the rights issue?
ex:
TERP = (5 × 2.00 + 2 × 1.30) / 7 = 12.60 / 7 = $1.80.
Bonus fraction = cum-rights price / TERP = 2.00 / 1.80 (1 dan katta — shares sonini oshiradi).
7/5 — bu bonus issue fraction'i, rights uchun emas; 2.00/1.30 rights price'ni ishlatadi, TERP'ni emas.

q:
Jizzax Cement Co had 9,000,000 ordinary shares in issue on 1 January 20X8. On 1 May 20X8 it made a 1 for 3 rights issue at $1.60 per share; the cum-rights market price was $2.40. Earnings for the year ended 31 December 20X8 were $4,100,000.
What is basic EPS for 20X8? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.

Nukus Co reported basic EPS of 48.0¢ for 20X6. In 20X7 it made a 1 for 4 rights issue at $1.20 when the cum-rights price was $2.70, giving a TERP of $2.40.
What is the restated EPS for 20X6 shown as the comparative in the 20X7 financial statements?
ex:
Comparative = o'tgan yilgi EPS × teskari bonus fraction = 48.0 × TERP / cum price = 48.0 × 2.40/2.70 = 42.7¢.
Tekshiruv: TERP = (4 × 2.70 + 1.20)/5 = 12.00/5 = $2.40.
4/5 ga ko'paytirish rights issue'ni bonus issue kabi ko'rsatadi — xato, chunki pul olingan.

q: True or false? If a rights issue is priced at the full market price of the shares, no bonus fraction adjustment is needed and the new shares are simply time-weighted.
ex: To'g'ri (True). Rights price = market price bo'lsa, TERP ham market price'ga teng bo'ladi, bonus fraction = 1. Bunda bonus element yo'q, issue full market price issue kabi weighting qilinadi va comparative restate qilinmaydi.

q: Which THREE of the following statements about rights issues and EPS are correct?
opt: A rights issue below market price combines a full price issue with a bonus element
The bonus fraction is applied to shares in issue from the start of the year to the date of the rights issue
The bonus fraction is applied to all shares for the whole year, including after the rights issue
The prior year EPS is restated by multiplying it by TERP divided by the cum-rights price
The bonus fraction is the cum-rights price divided by the rights issue price
ex: To'g'ri: (1) rights issue odatda market price'dan past narxda bo'lgani uchun ichida bonus element bor; (2) bonus fraction yil boshidan rights issue sanasigacha qo'llanadi; (3) comparative EPS × TERP / cum-rights price. Noto'g'ri: bonus fraction rights'dan keyingi davrga qo'llanmaydi; va fraction = cum-rights price / TERP (rights price emas).

q:
Samarqand Glass Co has a 30 September year end. On 1 October 20X6 it had 20 million ordinary shares in issue. On 1 January 20X7 it made a 1 for 5 rights issue at $2.50 when the cum-rights price was $4.00. Earnings for the year ended 30 September 20X7 were $11,400,000.
What is basic EPS for the year ended 30 September 20X7?

Qo'ng'irot Co had 10,000,000 shares in issue when it made a 1 for 4 rights issue at $1.50 per share. The cum-rights price was $2.50.
How many of the new shares are, in effect, issued for no consideration (the bonus element)? Enter the number of shares, to the nearest whole number.
In a basic EPS calculation, to which shares is the rights issue bonus fraction applied?
opt: To all shares in issue at the year end, for the full year
Only to the new shares issued under the rights issue
Only to the shares in issue before the rights issue, for the period from the start of the year to the date of the rights issue
To the shares in issue after the rights issue, for the period from the rights issue to the year end
ex: Bonus fraction (cum price / TERP) faqat rights issue'dan oldingi davrga (yil boshi → rights sanasi) qo'llanadi. Rights sanasidan keyin yangi shares allaqachon jadvalda bor, shuning uchun fraction qayta qo'llanmaydi.

q: For diluted EPS, from what date are dilutive potential ordinary shares assumed to have been converted?
opt: The date on which conversion actually takes place
The start of the reporting period, or the date the instrument was issued if later
The reporting date, so they have no effect on the current year
The start of the earliest comparative period presented, in all cases
ex: IAS 33: dilutive potential ordinary shares davr boshida yoki, agar instrument davr ichida chiqarilgan bo'lsa, chiqarilgan sanada convert qilingan deb hisoblanadi. Shu sababli yil ichida chiqarilgan convertible uchun qo'shimcha shares time-apportion qilinadi.

q:
Toshkent Textiles Co had 20,000,000 ordinary shares in issue throughout the year ended 31 December 20X7 and earnings of $6,200,000. It has $5,000,000 of 6% convertible loan notes in issue (effective interest rate 6%), convertible in 20X9 into 30 ordinary shares per $100 of loan notes. The tax rate is 25%.
What is diluted EPS for 20X7? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.
ex:
Earnings tuzatish: interest tejaladi, lekin soliq imtiyozi yo'qoladi.
Interest = 5,000,000 × 6% = 300,000; soliqdan keyin = 300,000 × 75% = 225,000.
Adjusted earnings = 6,200,000 + 225,000 = 6,425,000.
Qo'shimcha shares = 5,000,000 / 100 × 30 = 1,500,000; jami 21,500,000.
DEPS = 6,425,000 / 21,500,000 = 29.9¢.

q:
Xiva Co had 16 million ordinary shares in issue throughout the year ended 31 December 20X5 and basic earnings of $5,000,000. On 1 April 20X5 it issued $4 million convertible loan notes. The finance cost recognised in profit or loss for the period 1 April to 31 December 20X5 was $270,000. Each $100 of loan notes can be converted into 25 shares in 20X8 or 22 shares in 20X9. The tax rate is 20%.
What is diluted EPS for 20X5?
ex:
Earnings: 5,000,000 + 270,000 × (1 − 20%) = 5,216,000.
Shares: eng ko'p konversiya stavkasi (25 per $100) olinadi: 4,000,000/100 × 25 = 1,000,000; notes 1 Aprelda chiqarilgan, shuning uchun × 9/12 = 750,000.
Jami shares = 16,000,000 + 750,000 = 16,750,000.
DEPS = 5,216,000 / 16,750,000 = 31.1¢.
Finance cost P/L'da allaqachon 9 oy uchun, shuning uchun uni qayta time-apportion qilmaymiz.

q: True or false? When calculating diluted EPS for convertible preference shares whose dividends are not tax deductible, the preference dividend is added back to earnings without any tax adjustment.
ex: To'g'ri (True). Convertible loan notes interest'i soliqdan chegiriladi, shuning uchun qo'shilganda (1 − tax rate) ga ko'paytiriladi. Preference dividend esa odatda tax relief bermaydi, shu sababli u to'liq summada, soliq tuzatishsiz qo'shiladi.

q: Which THREE adjustments are made when calculating diluted EPS for convertible loan notes that were in issue for the whole year?
opt: Add back the interest charged in profit or loss, net of tax relief
Add the maximum number of shares that could be issued on conversion
Add back the gross interest with no tax adjustment
Add the minimum number of shares that could be issued on conversion
Treat the additional shares as outstanding from the start of the year
ex: To'g'ri: (1) interest soliqdan keyingi summada qo'shiladi (interest tejaladi, lekin tax relief yo'qoladi); (2) mavjud konversiya variantlaridan eng ko'p shares beradigani olinadi; (3) qo'shimcha shares yil boshidan bor deb olinadi. Noto'g'ri: interest'ni soliqsiz yalpi qo'shish va eng kam shares sonini olish.

q:
Denov Co had 10,000,000 ordinary shares in issue throughout 20X6 and profit after tax of $3,000,000. It also has 2,000,000 $1 8% convertible irredeemable preference shares, whose dividends are recognised in equity and are not tax deductible. Each 2 preference shares can be converted into 1 ordinary share.
What is diluted EPS for 20X6? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.
ex:
Basic: earnings = 3,000,000 − 160,000 (2,000,000 × 8%) = 2,840,000; basic EPS = 28.4¢.
Diluted: konversiya bo'lsa preference dividend to'lanmaydi → 160,000 qaytariladi (soliq tuzatishi yo'q), earnings = 3,000,000.
Qo'shimcha shares = 2,000,000 / 2 = 1,000,000; jami 11,000,000.
DEPS = 3,000,000 / 11,000,000 = 27.3¢.

q: Which of the following is NOT a potential ordinary share for diluted EPS purposes?
opt: Irredeemable preference shares with no conversion rights
Share options granted to employees
Convertible loan notes
Warrants to subscribe for ordinary shares
ex: Potential ordinary share — kelajakda ordinary share'ga aylanishi mumkin bo'lgan instrument: convertible loan notes/bonds, convertible preference shares, options va warrants. Konversiya huquqi yo'q preference shares hech qachon ordinary share'ga aylanmaydi, shuning uchun diluted EPS'ga ta'sir qilmaydi (faqat basic earnings'dan dividend ayiriladi).

q: When calculating diluted EPS, how is the number of shares treated as issued for no consideration under share options calculated?
opt: Number of options × (average market price − exercise price) / average market price
Number of options × exercise price / average market price
Number of options × (year-end market price − exercise price) / exercise price
The full number of options, with no adjustment
ex: Options exercise bo'lganda kompaniya exercise price bo'yicha pul oladi. Shu pulga o'rtacha market price bo'yicha sotib olinadigan shares "to'liq narxdagi" qism; qolgani tekin (bonus) shares. Formula: N × (AMP − EP) / AMP. Yil oxiridagi narx emas, davr bo'yicha o'rtacha narx ishlatiladi. Options uchun earnings tuzatilmaydi.

q:
Chust Co had 25,000,000 ordinary shares in issue throughout the year and earnings of $9,000,000. Throughout the year there were options outstanding over 2,000,000 shares with an exercise price of $3.00. The average market price of Chust Co's shares during the year was $4.00.
What is diluted EPS? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.

Kattaqo'rg'on Co had 8,000,000 ordinary shares in issue throughout the year ended 31 December 20X6 and earnings of $2,400,000. On 1 July 20X6 it granted options over 1,200,000 shares at an exercise price of $2.50. The average market price of its shares for the period 1 July to 31 December 20X6 was $3.00.
What is diluted EPS for 20X6?
ex:
Tekin shares = 1,200,000 × (3.00 − 2.50) / 3.00 = 200,000.
Options 1 Iyulda berilgan → faqat 6 oy: 200,000 × 6/12 = 100,000.
DEPS = 2,400,000 / 8,100,000 = 29.6¢.
Time-apportion qilmasangiz 29.3¢; barcha 1,200,000 options'ni tekin deb olsangiz (8,000,000 + 1,200,000 × 6/12 = 8,600,000) 27.9¢; 30.0¢ — bu basic EPS.

q: True or false? Share options with an exercise price above the average market price of the shares for the period are ignored in calculating diluted EPS.
ex: To'g'ri (True). Exercise price > average market price bo'lsa (out of the money), formula N × (AMP − EP)/AMP manfiy bo'ladi — ya'ni tekin shares yo'q. Bunday options EPS'ni kamaytirmaydi (anti-dilutive), shuning uchun diluted EPS'ga kiritilmaydi.

q:
Marg'ilon Co had 40,000,000 ordinary shares in issue throughout 20X8 and earnings of $18,000,000. It has in issue:
  • $10,000,000 8% convertible bonds; the finance cost in profit or loss for 20X8 was $800,000. Each $100 of bonds converts into 40 ordinary shares.
  • Options over 5,000,000 shares at an exercise price of $1.80. The average market price for 20X8 was $3.00.
The tax rate is 30%. All instruments were outstanding for the whole year.
What is diluted EPS for 20X8? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.

Angren Co has options outstanding over 3,000,000 shares at an exercise price of $3.50. The average market price during the year was $5.00 and the year-end price was $6.00.
How many shares are treated as issued for no consideration when calculating diluted EPS?
ex:
Formula o'rtacha market price bilan: 3,000,000 × (5.00 − 3.50) / 5.00 = 900,000.
Yil oxiri narxi ($6.00) ishlatilmaydi — u 1,250,000 beradi. 2,100,000 — bu to'liq narxda sotib olingan qism, tekin qism emas.

q:
Shahrisabz Co's basic EPS for the year is 42.0¢ and its share price at the year end is $6.30.
What is its price/earnings (P/E) ratio? Enter as a number of times, to one decimal place.
ex:
P/E ratio = market price per share / EPS = $6.30 / $0.42 = 15.0 times.
EPS'ni dollarga o'tkazishni unutmang (42¢ = $0.42).

q: Which THREE of the following are limitations of EPS as a performance measure?
opt: The earnings figure depends on judgements and accounting policy choices
It cannot be used to compare companies, as the number of shares is not related to capital employed
It ignores the effect of new share issues during the year
Growth in EPS in times of rising prices may not reflect real growth
It is a forecast figure that is not based on historical results
ex: To'g'ri: (1) EPS earnings'ga bog'liq, earnings esa judgement va accounting policy tanlovlariga (provisions, depreciation) bog'liq; (2) shares soni capital employed bilan bog'liq emas, shuning uchun kompaniyalararo taqqoslash noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin; (3) inflyatsiya davrida EPS o'sishi real o'sish bo'lmasligi mumkin. Noto'g'ri: EPS yangi share issue'larni aynan hisobga oladi (weighted average), va u tarixiy (historical) ko'rsatkich — forecast emas.

q: True or false? Diluted EPS is a forecast of the entity's EPS for the next financial year.
ex: Noto'g'ri (False). Diluted EPS — bu o'tgan davr natijasining qo'shimcha o'lchovi: joriy yil earnings'i, agar barcha dilutive potential shares allaqachon ordinary share bo'lganida qanday bo'lardi. U shareholders'ga ogohlantirish vazifasini bajaradi, lekin prognoz emas (masalan, options uchun yil oxiri emas, o'rtacha narx ishlatiladi).

q: Sayram Co's profit after tax rose by 18% this year, but its basic EPS rose by only 3%. An analyst says the EPS trend gives a better picture of performance for an ordinary shareholder than the profit trend. Which of the following best supports the analyst's view?
opt: EPS excludes the effect of taxation
EPS is not affected by the entity's choice of accounting policies
EPS adjusts for the extra shares (and so the extra capital) used to generate the higher profit, for example shares issued for cash during the year
EPS is based on cash flows rather than accrual-based profit
ex: Profit 18% o'sgan, EPS esa atigi 3% — demak foydaning o'sishi asosan yangi shares (yangi kapital) hisobidan bo'lgan. Agar kompaniya yangi shares chiqarib pul yig'sa, profit o'sishi mumkin, lekin har bir share'ga to'g'ri keladigan foyda o'smasligi mumkin. EPS shares sonini hisobga oladi, shuning uchun investor nuqtai nazaridan aniqroq trend beradi. EPS accounting policies'ga bog'liq, soliqdan keyingi va accrual asosida — boshqa variantlar noto'g'ri.

q: Which TWO of the following statements about the usefulness of diluted EPS are correct?
opt: It shows what current year EPS would have been if dilutive potential ordinary shares had been converted
It is a forecast of next year's EPS
It warns shareholders that their return may fall because of commitments already in existence
It replaces basic EPS where the entity has convertible instruments
It shows how much higher EPS could have been
ex: To'g'ri: diluted EPS joriy yil EPS'i dilutive potential shares convert bo'lganda qanday bo'lishini ko'rsatadi va shareholders'ga kelajakda daromad kamayishi mumkinligi haqida ogohlantiradi. Noto'g'ri: u kelgusi yil EPS prognozi emas, basic EPS o'rniga emas, balki u bilan birga ko'rsatiladi, va u EPS yuqoriroq bo'lishi mumkinligini emas, pastroq bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rsatadi.

q: Two companies have identical earnings and identical capital employed, but reported EPS of 4.0¢ and 125.0¢ respectively. What is the most likely explanation?
opt: One of them has made an error in its EPS calculation
One of them uses the revaluation model for property
One of them has a much higher gearing ratio
They have different numbers of shares in issue, for example because of different nominal values per share
ex: Shares soni capital employed bilan bog'liq emas: bir kompaniya 5 million 50¢ lik shares, boshqasi 160,000 $1 lik shares + katta reserves bilan bir xil capital'ga ega bo'lishi mumkin. Earnings bir xil bo'lsa ham EPS keskin farq qiladi. Shuning uchun EPS kompaniyalararo taqqoslash uchun yaroqsiz.

q: Kogon Co issued a large number of shares at full market price halfway through the year to fund a new factory. Profit after tax increased by 5% compared with last year, but basic EPS fell. What is the most likely explanation?
opt: The new shares are weighted for half the year, but the new factory has not yet started generating normal returns
The share issue should have been treated as a bonus issue
The comparative EPS was not restated for the share issue
EPS must fall whenever new shares are issued
ex: Weighted average usuli yangi shares yarim yil davomida earnings'ga hissa qo'shadi deb taxmin qiladi. Amalda yangi loyiha (zavod) darhol normal daromad bermaydi, shuning uchun shares soni earnings'dan tezroq o'sadi va EPS vaqtincha tushadi. Bu EPS'ning limitation'laridan biri. Full price issue uchun comparative restate qilinmaydi.

q: Yangiyer Co's reporting date is 31 December 20X7. On 20 February 20X8, before the 20X7 financial statements were authorised for issue, it made a 1 for 2 bonus issue. How should this affect the EPS reported in the 20X7 financial statements?
opt: No adjustment, because the bonus issue took place after the reporting date
The bonus shares are time-weighted from 20 February 20X8
20X7 and comparative EPS are calculated as if the bonus issue had taken place at the start of the earliest period presented
It is disclosed as a non-adjusting event only, with no change to EPS
ex: IAS 33: agar bonus issue (yoki share split) reporting date'dan keyin, lekin FS authorised bo'lishidan oldin bo'lsa, joriy va comparative EPS retrospektiv ravishda yangi shares soni bilan hisoblanadi. Bu tuzatish resurs o'zgarmagani uchun ruxsat etilgan; bu fakt disclose ham qilinadi.

q:
Beruniy Co reported basic EPS of 27.5¢ for 20X5. During 20X6 it made a 1 for 10 bonus issue.
What is the restated 20X5 EPS shown as the comparative in the 20X6 financial statements? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.
ex:
1 for 10 bonus → har 10 share 11 ga aylanadi; bonus fraction = 11/10.
Restated = 27.5 × 10/11 = 25.0¢.

q: Which TWO of the following events during the current year require the prior year comparative EPS to be restated?
opt: A 1 for 5 bonus issue
A 1 for 3 rights issue below market price
An issue of shares at full market price
The conversion of convertible bonds into ordinary shares
ex: Comparative restate qilinadi faqat bonus element bo'lganda: bonus issue va market price'dan past narxdagi rights issue. Full market price issue va convertible bond konversiyasi resurs bilan bog'liq (pul yoki liability yopilishi), shuning uchun faqat joriy yilda vaqt bo'yicha weighting qilinadi.

q: When share options are included in diluted EPS, what adjustment is made to the earnings figure?
opt: The exercise proceeds are added to earnings
No adjustment is made to earnings
Notional interest on the exercise proceeds, net of tax, is added to earnings
The fair value of the options is deducted from earnings
ex: Options uchun faqat shares soni tuzatiladi (tekin shares qo'shiladi). Earnings o'zgarmaydi — options exercise bo'lganda hech qanday interest yoki dividend tejalmaydi. Earnings faqat convertible instruments uchun tuzatiladi (interest net of tax yoki preference dividend).

q:
Qo'qon Textiles Co — year ended 31 December 20X7.
On 1 January 20X7 Qo'qon Textiles Co had 12,000,000 ordinary shares of 50¢ in issue. On 1 April 20X7 it issued 3,000,000 shares at full market price. On 1 October 20X7 it made a 1 for 5 rights issue at $1.80 per share; the cum-rights market price was $2.40. Profit after tax for 20X7 was $8,300,000, and an irredeemable preference dividend of $260,000 was paid (recognised in equity). Basic EPS reported for 20X6 was 52.0¢.

What is the theoretical ex-rights price (TERP)?
ex:
TERP = (5 × 2.40 + 1 × 1.80) / 6 = 13.80 / 6 = $2.30.
Oddiy o'rtacha ($2.10) xato — har bir narxni shares soni bilan og'irlash kerak.

q:
Qo'qon Textiles Co — year ended 31 December 20X7.
On 1 January 20X7 Qo'qon Textiles Co had 12,000,000 ordinary shares of 50¢ in issue. On 1 April 20X7 it issued 3,000,000 shares at full market price. On 1 October 20X7 it made a 1 for 5 rights issue at $1.80 per share; the cum-rights market price was $2.40. Profit after tax for 20X7 was $8,300,000, and an irredeemable preference dividend of $260,000 was paid (recognised in equity). Basic EPS reported for 20X6 was 52.0¢.

What earnings figure should be used for basic EPS? Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex: Earnings = 8,300 − 260 (irredeemable preference dividend) = $8,040k.

q:

On 1 January 20X7 Qo'qon Textiles Co had 12,000,000 ordinary shares of 50¢ in issue. On 1 April 20X7 it issued 3,000,000 shares at full market price. On 1 October 20X7 it made a 1 for 5 rights issue at $1.80 per share; the cum-rights market price was $2.40. What is the weighted average number of shares for basic EPS for 20X7? Enter in thousands of shares, to the nearest whole number.

What is basic EPS for 20X7? Enter in cents, to one decimal place.
ex: EPS = earnings / weighted average shares = 8,040,000 / 15,456,522 = 52.0¢.

q:
Qo'qon Textiles Co — year ended 31 December 20X7.
On 1 January 20X7 Qo'qon Textiles Co had 12,000,000 ordinary shares of 50¢ in issue. On 1 April 20X7 it issued 3,000,000 shares at full market price. On 1 October 20X7 it made a 1 for 5 rights issue at $1.80 per share; the cum-rights market price was $2.40. Profit after tax for 20X7 was $8,300,000, and an irredeemable preference dividend of $260,000 was paid (recognised in equity). Basic EPS reported for 20X6 was 52.0¢.

What restated basic EPS for 20X6 will be shown as the comparative in the 20X7 financial statements?
ex:
Faqat rights issue'ning bonus elementi comparative'ni o'zgartiradi (full price issue emas).
Restated = 52.0 × TERP / cum price = 52.0 × 2.30/2.40 = 49.8¢.

q:
Bekobod Holdings Co — year ended 30 June 20X8.
Bekobod Holdings Co had 30,000,000 ordinary shares in issue throughout the year. Earnings attributable to ordinary shareholders were $12,600,000. On 1 July 20X6 it issued $6,000,000 convertible loan notes; the finance cost recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 30 June 20X8 was $540,000. Each $100 of loan notes may be converted into 20 ordinary shares on 30 June 20X9 or 18 ordinary shares on 30 June 20Y0. There are also options outstanding throughout the year over 3,000,000 shares at an exercise price of $2.10; the average market price for the year was $3.50. The tax rate is 25%.

What is basic EPS for the year ended 30 June 20X8?
ex: Basic EPS'da potential shares hisobga olinmaydi: 12,600,000 / 30,000,000 = 42.0¢.

q:
Bekobod Holdings Co — year ended 30 June 20X8.
Bekobod Holdings Co had 30,000,000 ordinary shares in issue throughout the year. Earnings attributable to ordinary shareholders were $12,600,000. On 1 July 20X6 it issued $6,000,000 convertible loan notes; the finance cost recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 30 June 20X8 was $540,000. Each $100 of loan notes may be converted into 20 ordinary shares on 30 June 20X9 or 18 ordinary shares on 30 June 20Y0. There are also options outstanding throughout the year over 3,000,000 shares at an exercise price of $2.10; the average market price for the year was $3.50. The tax rate is 25%.

What earnings figure should be used for diluted EPS? Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex: Earnings + finance cost × (1 − 25%) = 12,600,000 + 540,000 × 75% = 12,600,000 + 405,000 = $13,005k. Options earnings'ni o'zgartirmaydi.

q:

Bekobod Holdings Co had 30,000,000 ordinary shares in issue throughout the year. Earnings attributable to ordinary shareholders were $12,600,000. On 1 July 20X6 it issued $6,000,000 convertible loan notes; the finance cost recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 30 June 20X8 was $540,000. Each $100 of loan notes may be converted into 20 ordinary shares on 30 June 20X9 or 18 ordinary shares on 30 June 20Y0. There are also options outstanding throughout the year over 3,000,000 shares at an exercise price of $2.10; the average market price for the year was $3.50. The tax rate is 25%.

How many additional shares arising from the convertible loan notes are included in diluted EPS?
ex: Eng ko'p shares beradigan variant olinadi: 6,000,000 / 100 × 20 = 1,200,000. Notes yil boshidan bor, shuning uchun time-apportion kerak emas; shares soniga soliq tuzatishi qilinmaydi.

Each $100 of loan notes may be converted into 20 ordinary shares on 30 June 20X9 or 18 ordinary shares on 30 June 20Y0. Which of the following items held by Tallis Co is a financial asset as defined by IAS 32 Financial Instruments: Presentation?
opt: Raw materials held in inventory
An investment in the ordinary shares of a listed company
Insurance premiums paid in advance for the next year
Capitalised development expenditure
ex: IAS 32 bo'yicha financial asset = cash, boshqa entity'dan cash olish bo'yicha shartnomaviy huquq, yoki boshqa entity'ning equity instrumenti. Boshqa kompaniya ordinary shares'iga investitsiya — equity instrument of another entity, demak financial asset. Inventory — jismoniy aktiv (cash olish huquqi yo'q). Prepaid insurance — kelajakdagi foyda xizmat ko'rinishida, cash emas. Deferred development costs — nomoddiy aktiv (IAS 38). Javob: investment in ordinary shares.

q: Which THREE of the following are financial liabilities of Brenner Co under IAS 32?
opt: Deferred income for goods yet to be delivered
Current tax payable to the tax authority
Redeemable preference shares
Trade payables
5% loan notes repayable in 20X9
ex: Financial liability = boshqa entity'ga cash yoki financial asset berish bo'yicha shartnomaviy majburiyat. Trade payables — shartnoma bo'yicha cash to'lash (✔). Redeemable preference shares — belgilangan sanada qaytarish majburiyati (✔). Loan notes — foiz va asosiy summani to'lash majburiyati (✔). Income tax payable — majburiyat qonun (statutory) asosida, shartnoma emas (✘). Deferred income (oldindan olingan pul, tovar yetkazib berish kerak) — cash emas, tovar/xizmat berish majburiyati (✘).

q: A liability for income taxes payable to the government is a financial liability because it will be settled in cash.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Financial liability shartnomaviy (contractual) majburiyat bo'lishi kerak. Income tax majburiyati qonun (statute) tufayli yuzaga keladi, shartnoma tufayli emas — shuning uchun u financial instrument emas (cash bilan to'lansa ham).

q: Which accounting standard sets out the disclosure requirements for financial instruments, including the nature and extent of risks arising from them?
opt: IAS 32 Financial Instruments: Presentation
IFRS 9 Financial Instruments
IFRS 7 Financial Instruments: Disclosures
IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement
ex: Uch standart: IAS 32 — presentation/classification (liability yoki equity); IFRS 9 — recognition va measurement; IFRS 7 — disclosures (carrying amounts, income/expense, risklar). IFRS 13 fair value o'lchashni belgilaydi, financial instrument disclosure standarti emas. Javob: IFRS 7.

q: Which standard determines whether an instrument issued by an entity is presented as a financial liability or as equity?
opt: IAS 32 Financial Instruments: Presentation
IFRS 7 Financial Instruments: Disclosures
IFRS 9 Financial Instruments
IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements
ex: Liability vs equity tasnifi — IAS 32 Financial Instruments: Presentation vazifasi. IFRS 9 esa o'lchash (amortised cost, FVOCI, FVPL) bilan shug'ullanadi. IFRS 7 — disclosure. IAS 1 umumiy presentation standarti, lekin debt/equity tasnifi IAS 32 da. Javob: IAS 32.

q: Quorn Co has issued preference shares that require a fixed annual payment, but each payment needs approval from a foreign exchange regulator before it can be made. Because of this restriction, the shares should be classified as equity.
ex: Noto'g'ri. IAS 32: to'lovga cheklov (masalan, valyuta topish qiyinligi yoki regulyator ruxsati kerakligi) issuer'ning shartnomaviy majburiyatini bekor qilmaydi. Majburiyat bor ekan — instrument financial liability.

q: Which THREE of the following are required disclosures under IFRS 7 Financial Instruments: Disclosures?
opt: The carrying amount of each class of financial instrument
A forecast of the entity's own share price for the next year
Gains and losses for each class of financial instrument
The nature and extent of risks arising from financial instruments and how they are managed
The names of every counterparty to the entity's loan notes
ex: IFRS 7 asosiy talablari: (1) har bir class bo'yicha carrying amount (SOFP yuzida yoki notes'da); (2) har bir class bo'yicha income, expense, gains va losses; (3) risklarning nature and extent — risk exposure, management objectives va policies. Barcha counterparty'lar nomlari yoki kompaniyaning o'z share price prognozi talab qilinmaydi.

q: A financial asset and a financial liability may be offset and the net amount presented only when the entity has a legally enforceable right to set off the amounts and intends either to settle on a net basis or to realise the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.
ex: To'g'ri. Offsetting uchun ikkala shart kerak: (1) qonuniy kuchga ega set-off huquqi; (2) net asosda hisob-kitob qilish yoki bir vaqtda realizatsiya/to'lash niyati. Bittasi yetishmasa — gross ko'rsatiladi.

q: At 31 March 20X8, Pellow Co has a deposit of $300,000 and an overdraft of $500,000 with the same bank. The bank agreement gives Pellow Co a legally enforceable right of set-off, but Pellow Co manages the accounts separately and has no intention of settling them on a net basis. How should these be presented in the statement of financial position?
opt: A net overdraft of $200,000 in current liabilities
A net overdraft of $200,000 disclosed in the notes only
Cash of $300,000 in current assets and a net overdraft of $200,000 in current liabilities
Cash of $300,000 in current assets and an overdraft of $500,000 in current liabilities
ex: Offsetting uchun ikki shart: legally enforceable right va net settle qilish niyati. Pellow Co'da huquq bor, lekin niyat yo'q — demak offset mumkin emas. Current assets'da cash $300,000 va current liabilities'da overdraft $500,000 alohida (gross) ko'rsatiladi.

q: Dorrit Co has in issue $1 preference shares carrying a fixed 6% dividend which are mandatorily redeemable at par in 20X9. How should the shares and the dividends be presented?
opt: As equity, with the dividends shown as a finance cost in profit or loss
As equity, with the dividends shown in the statement of changes in equity
As a liability, with the dividends shown in the statement of changes in equity
As a liability, with the dividends shown as a finance cost in profit or loss
ex: Belgilangan sanada majburiy redemption = cash to'lash bo'yicha shartnomaviy majburiyat → financial liability. Liability sifatida tasniflangan instrument bo'yicha to'lovlar (dividend deb atalsa ham) SPL'da finance cost bo'ladi. Javob: liability, dividends P/L'da finance cost.

q: Grimsby Co has irredeemable preference shares in issue. Dividends are payable only if declared at the discretion of the directors and unpaid dividends do not accumulate. How should these shares and any dividends declared be treated?
opt: Liability, with dividends shown as a finance cost
Equity, with dividends shown as a finance cost
Equity, with dividends declared shown in the statement of changes in equity
Liability, with dividends shown in the statement of changes in equity
ex: Irredeemable + dividend faqat directors ixtiyorida (non-cumulative) → issuer'da cash to'lash bo'yicha shartnomaviy majburiyat yo'q → equity. Equity instrument bo'yicha e'lon qilingan dividendlar statement of changes in equity'da (retained earnings'dan) ko'rsatiladi, P/L'da emas.

q:
On 1 January 20X7, Hesketh Co issued 200,000 $1 redeemable preference shares at par, incurring issue costs of $8,000. A dividend of 5% of nominal value is paid annually in arrears and the shares are redeemable at a premium on 31 December 20Y1. The effective interest rate is 7.2%.
What is the carrying amount of the preference shares at 31 December 20X8? (Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.)
ex:
Initial = net proceeds = 200,000 − 8,000 = 192,000. Yillik dividend (cash) = 200,000 × 5% = 10,000.

2195,82414,099(10,000)199,923

31.12.20X8 carrying amount = 199,923.

q: An instrument that is legally described as a 'share' can be classified as a financial liability under IAS 32.
ex: To'g'ri. IAS 32 substance over legal form tamoyiliga asoslanadi. Masalan, redeemable preference shares huquqiy jihatdan 'share', lekin cash to'lash majburiyati bor — shuning uchun liability.

q: Which THREE of the following features would result in a preference share being classified as a financial liability by the issuer?
opt: A fixed cumulative dividend that the issuer is obliged to pay
Dividends are payable only at the discretion of the directors
Mandatory redemption for a fixed amount on a fixed future date
The holder has the right to require redemption for a fixed amount
The shares carry no voting rights
ex: Liability = issuer'ning cash berish bo'yicha shartnomaviy majburiyati. (1) Belgilangan sanada majburiy redemption ✔; (2) holder'ning redemption talab qilish huquqi ✔ (issuer undan qochib qutula olmaydi); (3) majburiy fixed cumulative dividend ✔. Dividend faqat directors ixtiyorida bo'lsa — majburiyat yo'q (equity belgisi). Ovoz berish huquqi yo'qligi tasnifga ta'sir qilmaydi.

q:
In the year ended 30 September 20X6, Kellet Co paid a dividend of $120,000 on its ordinary shares and paid the annual dividend on its $500,000 8% preference shares, which are redeemable at par. The preference shares were issued at par with no issue costs.
What amount should be recognised as a finance cost in profit or loss in respect of these dividends? (Enter in $.)
ex: Redeemable preference shares → liability, ularning dividendi → finance cost. Par'da chiqarilgan, par'da qaytariladi, issue cost yo'q → effective rate = coupon 8%. Finance cost = 500,000 × 8% = 40,000. Ordinary dividend 120,000 — equity bo'yicha taqsimot, SOCE'da, P/L'da emas.

q: At what amount should a financial liability such as a loan note, not held for trading, be initially recognised?
opt: Nominal value of the loan notes
Fair value, usually the net proceeds after deducting issue costs
The total amount repayable on redemption
Gross proceeds, with issue costs expensed immediately
ex: Financial liability boshlang'ichda fair value'da tan olinadi — odatda bu olingan cash minus issue costs (net proceeds). Keyin amortised cost bo'yicha o'lchanadi. Nominal value yoki redemption amount emas.

q: Fenwick Co's 5% loan notes are redeemable on 30 June 20X9. At its year end of 31 December 20X8 their amortised cost is $2,480,000. How should the loan notes be presented at 31 December 20X8?
opt: As a current liability of $2,480,000
As a current liability at the redemption amount
Split equally between current and non-current liabilities
As a non-current liability of $2,480,000
ex: Loan notes 30.06.20X9 da, ya'ni year end'dan 12 oy ichida qaytariladi → current liability. Summa — amortised cost 2,480,000 (redemption amount emas, chunki finance cost hali to'liq hisoblanmagan).

q: For a loan note measured at amortised cost, the finance cost recognised in profit or loss each year is always equal to the interest paid in cash.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Finance cost = opening carrying amount × effective rate. Issue costs, discount yoki premium bo'lsa, effective rate coupon rate'dan farq qiladi va finance cost cash interest'dan katta bo'ladi. Faqat par'da, xarajatsiz chiqarilib par'da qaytariladigan loanda ular teng.

q: How should the liability component of a convertible loan note be measured when the loan note is issued?
opt: Present value of the future cash flows discounted at the coupon rate on the convertible
Proceeds received less the fair value of the conversion option calculated by an option pricing model
Present value of the future interest and capital cash flows, discounted at the market rate for similar debt without a conversion option
Nominal value of the loan notes
ex: Split accounting: liability = kelajakdagi cash flows (interest + capital) ning PV, diskont stavkasi = conversion option'siz o'xshash qarz uchun market rate. Equity = proceeds − liability (qoldiq). Coupon rate bo'yicha diskontlash xato — u PV'ni ≈ nominal'ga tenglashtiradi.

Lanark Co issued $12 million 5% convertible loan notes at par on 1 July 20X4, redeemable at par after three years or convertible into equity shares. Similar non-convertible debt carries interest of 9%. Discount factors at 9% are: year 1 0.917, year 2 0.842, year 3 0.772. Discount factors at 5% are: year 1 0.952, year 2 0.907, year 3 0.864.
What amount should be recognised in equity in respect of the loan notes on 1 July 20X4?
opt: $Nil
ex:
Liability = PV at 9% ($000): 600 × 0.917 + 600 × 0.842 + 12,600 × 0.772 = 10,782.6.
Equity = 12,000 − 10,782.6 = 1,217.4 ($000) ≈ $1,217,400.
Tipik xatolar: 5% (coupon rate) bilan diskontlash liability'ni ≈ 12,001.8 ga (≈ nominal), equity'ni deyarli nolga olib keladi; 1-2 yil interest PV'sini unutish: 12,000 − 12,600 × 0.772 = 2,272.8 — equity oshib ketadi. Liability summasini equity deb tanlash ham keng tarqalgan xato.

q: The equity component of a convertible loan note is remeasured to fair value at each reporting date, with changes recognised in other comprehensive income.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Equity component boshlang'ich tan olishdan keyin qayta o'lchanmaydi — conversion yoki redemption'gacha o'zgarmay turadi. Faqat liability component amortised cost bo'yicha o'zgaradi.

q:
On 1 January 20X5, Tamsin Co issued $4 million 5% convertible loan notes at par, redeemable at par on 31 December 20X8. Interest is paid annually in arrears. The market rate for similar non-convertible debt is 8%. Discount factors at 8%: year 1 0.926, year 2 0.857, year 3 0.794, year 4 0.735.
What is the carrying amount of the liability component at 31 December 20X6? (Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.)
Which THREE of the following statements about a convertible loan note, from the issuer's perspective, are correct?
opt: The finance cost in profit or loss equals the coupon interest paid
At maturity the liability component equals the amount repayable
The equity component is the present value of the cash flows at the coupon rate
The liability component is measured at amortised cost using the market rate for non-convertible debt
The equity component is not remeasured after initial recognition
ex: ✔ Equity component qayta o'lchanmaydi. ✔ Liability amortised cost bo'yicha, market rate bilan (coupon emas). ✔ Muddat oxirida liability carrying amount redemption summasiga teng bo'ladi (amortised cost jadvali shunday qurilgan). ✘ Finance cost = coupon paid — noto'g'ri, finance cost market rate bo'yicha, shuning uchun couponʼdan katta. ✘ Equity = PV at coupon rate — noto'g'ri, equity qoldiq (proceeds − liability).

q: Bexley Co issued convertible loan notes at par for $5,000,000. The liability component was calculated as $4,620,000. Which journal entry records the issue?
opt: Dr Bank $5,000,000; Cr Financial liability $5,000,000
Dr Bank $5,000,000; Cr Financial liability $4,620,000; Cr Equity $380,000
Dr Bank $5,000,000; Cr Equity $4,620,000; Cr Financial liability $380,000
Dr Bank $5,000,000; Cr Financial liability $4,620,000; Cr Profit or loss $380,000
ex: Olingan cash to'liq Dr Bank 5,000,000. Liability component 4,620,000 Cr financial liability; qoldiq 5,000,000 − 4,620,000 = 380,000 Cr equity (masalan, 'other components of equity'). Equity P/L'ga o'tmaydi va nominal liability sifatida ko'rsatilmaydi.

q:
On 1 January 20X7, Oswin Co issued $6 million 2% convertible loan notes at par. Interest is paid annually in arrears. On 31 December 20X9 the notes will either be converted into equity shares or redeemed at a premium for $6.3 million. The market rate for similar non-convertible debt is 8%. Discount factors at 8%: year 1 0.926, year 2 0.857, year 3 0.794.
What is the equity component at 1 January 20X7? (Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.)
Why does a convertible loan note normally carry a coupon rate that is lower than the rate on similar debt without conversion rights?
opt: Interest on convertible loan notes is not tax deductible
The issuer has a better credit rating than other borrowers
Convertible loan notes are always secured on the issuer's assets
The holder accepts a lower return in exchange for the option to convert into shares
ex: Investor past foizni qabul qiladi, chunki u qo'shimcha qiymatga — kelajakda arzon share olish imkoniyatiga (conversion option) ega bo'ladi. Aynan shu option qiymati equity component sifatida tan olinadi.

q: Under IFRS 9 Financial Instruments, what is the default category for an investment in the equity shares of another entity?
opt: Fair value through other comprehensive income
Amortised cost
Fair value through profit or loss
Cost less impairment
ex: Equity investments uchun default — FVPL. FVOCI faqat boshlang'ich tan olishda qaytarilmas (irrevocable) tanlov bilan, held for trading bo'lmagan investitsiyalar uchun. Equity instrument'lar amortised cost'da bo'lolmaydi (contractual cash flows yo'q).

q:
On 1 March 20X6, Galloway Co purchased 50,000 shares in a listed company at $3.20 per share, paying transaction costs of $1,800. The investment is held for trading. At 31 December 20X6 the shares were quoted at $3.65.
What is the fair value gain to be recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X6? (Enter in $, excluding the transaction costs.)
ex: FVPL: transaction costs darhol expense (asset'ga kiritilmaydi). Initial = 50,000 × 3.20 = 160,000. Year end FV = 50,000 × 3.65 = 182,500. Gain = 182,500 − 160,000 = 22,500 (P/L). Transaction costs 1,800 alohida P/L expense.

q:
On 1 May 20X7, Hartfell Co purchased 40,000 shares in Moy Co at $5.10 per share, incurring transaction costs of $2,400. Hartfell Co made the irrevocable election to measure the investment at fair value through other comprehensive income. At 31 December 20X7 the shares were quoted at $5.30.
What gain should be recognised in other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 December 20X7? (Enter in $.)
ex: FVOCI: transaction costs capitalised. Initial = 40,000 × 5.10 + 2,400 = 206,400. FV = 40,000 × 5.30 = 212,000. OCI gain = 212,000 − 206,400 = 5,600. (Xato: 8,000 — costs'ni unutish.)

q: Ivel Co holds an equity investment designated at fair value through other comprehensive income. Its carrying amount was $450,000 and at the year end its fair value has fallen to $410,000. How is the fall in value accounted for?
opt: A loss of $40,000 is recognised in other comprehensive income
No loss is recognised because the investment is held for the long term
A loss of $40,000 is recognised in profit or loss
The loss is recognised in profit or loss to the extent it exceeds any previous gains
ex: FVOCI: FV o'zgarishi (gain yoki loss) OCI'da tan olinadi va investment reserve'ga o'tadi. IAS 16 revaluation'dan farqli ravishda investment reserve manfiy bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun loss P/L'ga o'tmaydi. Loss = 450,000 − 410,000 = 40,000 OCI'da.

q: An entity that has designated an equity investment at fair value through other comprehensive income can later reclassify it to fair value through profit or loss if its intentions change.
ex: Noto'g'ri. FVOCI tanlovi irrevocable — boshlang'ich tan olishda qilinadi va keyin o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.

q: Which THREE of the following are correct for an investment in equity shares designated at fair value through other comprehensive income?
opt: The investment must not be held for trading
The election is made on initial recognition and cannot be reversed
Transaction costs are included in the initial carrying amount
Dividends received are recognised in other comprehensive income
Cumulative gains are reclassified to profit or loss when the shares are sold
ex: ✔ Tanlov boshlang'ich tan olishda qilinadi va irrevocable. ✔ Held for trading bo'lmasligi kerak. ✔ Transaction costs capitalise qilinadi. ✘ Equity FVOCI bo'yicha cumulative gain sotilganda P/L'ga reclassify qilinmaydi (retained earnings'ga o'tkazilishi yoki equity'da qolishi mumkin). ✘ Dividendlar OCI'da emas, P/L'da tan olinadi.

q:
On 1 January 20X4, Kirkby Co purchased 25,000 shares at $8.00 each plus transaction costs of $3,000 and elected to hold them at fair value through other comprehensive income. The fair value per share was $8.60 at 31 December 20X4 and $7.90 at 31 December 20X5.
What is the loss recognised in other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 December 20X5? (Enter as a positive number, in $.)

Delph Co bought equity shares for $200,000 plus transaction costs of $3,000 and made the irrevocable election to hold them at fair value through other comprehensive income. The fair value of the shares was $215,000 at the end of year 1 and $197,500 at the end of year 2. What is the balance on the investment reserve in respect of these shares at the end of year 2?
opt: Nil, with $5,500 charged to profit or loss
A debit (negative) balance of $5,500
A debit (negative) balance of $2,500
A credit balance of $12,000
ex: Initial = 200,000 + 3,000 = 203,000. Year 2 oxirida FV 197,500. Investment reserve = FV − initial = 197,500 − 203,000 = (5,500) debit (manfiy). FVOCI reserve manfiy bo'lishi mumkin, qolgan loss P/L'ga o'tmaydi. Yil bo'yicha: +12,000 keyin −17,500.

q: On 1 January 20X7, Stroud Co bought 200,000 shares in a listed company for $6.00 each and classified them at fair value through profit or loss. At 31 December 20X7 the quoted price is $6.45 per share. Broker fees of $15,000 would be incurred if the shares were sold. At what amount should the investment be carried and what gain is recognised?
opt: $1,290,000 with a gain of $90,000 in profit or loss
$1,275,000 with a gain of $75,000 in profit or loss
$1,290,000 with a gain of $90,000 in other comprehensive income
$1,275,000 with a gain of $75,000 in other comprehensive income
ex: Fair value = bozor narxi, costs to sell ayirilmaydi (IFRS 13 — exit price, transaction costs hisobga olinmaydi). FV = 200,000 × 6.45 = 1,290,000. Gain = 1,290,000 − 1,200,000 = 90,000, FVPL bo'lgani uchun P/L'da.

q: Nidd Co has bought corporate bonds whose contractual cash flows are solely payments of principal and interest on the principal outstanding. Which further condition must be met for Nidd Co to measure the bonds at amortised cost under IFRS 9?
opt: The bonds were purchased at a discount to their nominal value
The bonds are quoted in an active market
The bonds are held within a business model whose objective is to collect the contractual cash flows
Nidd Co intends to sell the bonds whenever their market price rises
ex: Amortised cost uchun ikki test kerak: (1) contractual cash flow characteristics (SPPI) — shartda berilgan, cash flows faqat principal va interest; (2) business model test — aktiv contractual cash flows'ni yig'ish (hold to collect) uchun ushlab turiladi. Active market'da quote qilinishi yoki discount'da sotib olinishi tasnifga ta'sir qilmaydi. Narx oshganda sotish niyati — hold to collect emas (collect and sell → FVOCI yoki trading → FVPL). Javob: business model — hold to collect.

q: Rother Co invests in government bonds. Its business model is to hold the bonds to collect the contractual cash flows, but it will sell them if a higher-yielding investment becomes available. The cash flows are solely payments of principal and interest. How should the bonds be classified?
opt: Amortised cost
Fair value through profit or loss
Cost less impairment
Fair value through other comprehensive income
ex: Business model = 'hold to collect and sell' + SPPI testdan o'tadi → FVOCI (debt). Faqat hold to collect bo'lsa — amortised cost. SPPI testdan o'tmasa yoki trading — FVPL.

q: Tyne Co has invested in convertible bonds issued by another company, which it intends to hold until maturity. How should Tyne Co classify this financial asset?
opt: Amortised cost, as it is held to maturity
Fair value through profit or loss
Split into a debt asset at amortised cost and an equity asset at FVOCI
Fair value through other comprehensive income
ex: Convertible bond holder'ga faqat principal va interest emas, balki equity'ga konvertatsiya huquqini ham beradi → contractual cash flow characteristics (SPPI) testdan o'tmaydi → FVPL (business model qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar).

Axe Co intends to hold the notes to collect the contractual cash flows, which are solely principal and interest. The effective interest rate is 5.4%.

q:
On 1 July 20X7, Deben Co purchased a $1,000,000 5% bond for $950,000, incurring transaction costs of $8,000. Interest is received annually in arrears. The bond is held within a business model whose objective is achieved by both collecting contractual cash flows and selling, and it is classified at fair value through other comprehensive income. The effective interest rate is 6.2%. At 30 June 20X8 the fair value of the bond was $990,000.
What gain should be recognised in other comprehensive income for the year ended 30 June 20X8? (Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.)
ex:
FVOCI debt: avval amortised cost jadvali (interest P/L'ga), keyin FV'ga qayta baholash (OCI).
Initial = 950,000 + 8,000 = 958,000. Interest income (P/L) = 958,000 × 6.2% = 59,396. Cash = 1,000,000 × 5% = 50,000. Amortised cost = 958,000 + 59,396 − 50,000 = 967,396.
OCI gain = 990,000 − 967,396 = 22,604.

q: Transaction costs incurred on purchasing a debt instrument that will be measured at amortised cost are included in the initial carrying amount of the asset.
ex: To'g'ri. Transaction costs faqat FVPL aktivlarda expense qilinadi. Amortised cost va FVOCI aktivlarda initial carrying amount'ga qo'shiladi.

q: Which THREE of the following apply to a debt instrument classified at fair value through other comprehensive income?
opt: Interest income is calculated on the opening fair value of the asset
On disposal, cumulative gains in other comprehensive income are reclassified to profit or loss
Changes in fair value are recognised in other comprehensive income
Transaction costs are expensed immediately
Interest income is recognised in profit or loss using the effective interest rate
ex: ✔ Interest income amortised cost'dagi kabi effective rate bilan P/L'da. ✔ Reporting date'da FV'ga qayta baholanadi, farq OCI'da. ✔ Sotilganda cumulative OCI gain/loss P/L'ga reclassify qilinadi (equity FVOCI'dan farqli!). ✘ Transaction costs FVOCI'da capitalise qilinadi, expense emas. ✘ Interest fair value asosida emas, amortised cost asosida hisoblanadi.

q: Even if a debt instrument passes both the business model test and the contractual cash flow characteristics test, an entity may designate it at fair value through profit or loss if this eliminates or significantly reduces an accounting mismatch.
ex: To'g'ri. IFRS 9 bu imkoniyatni beradi: agar amortised cost/FVOCI o'lchovi boshqa aktiv yoki liability bilan accounting mismatch yaratsa, boshlang'ichda FVPL'ga designate qilish mumkin.

q: Which of the following financial assets would be measured at amortised cost?
opt: A strategic equity investment designated at FVOCI
Listed shares held for short-term trading
An investment in another company's convertible bonds
Trade receivables held to collect the contractual cash flows
ex: Amortised cost = hold to collect business model + SPPI. Trade receivables (kontrakt bo'yicha cash olish, yig'ish uchun ushlanadi) — amortised cost. Trading uchun shares — FVPL. Convertible bond — SPPI'dan o'tmaydi → FVPL. Strategik shares FVOCI tanlovi bilan — equity, amortised cost emas.

q: Wear Co factored trade receivables of $600,000 and received an advance of $480,000. Any receivables not collected by the factor within 90 days are transferred back to Wear Co. How should Wear Co account for the $480,000 received?
opt: Receivables are derecognised and a loss of $120,000 is recognised
Receivables are derecognised and the $120,000 difference is shown as a receivable from the factor
Receivables remain recognised and the $480,000 is shown as a liability
The $480,000 is recognised as revenue
ex: 'Collect qilinmasa qaytariladi' = with recourse → irrecoverable debt riski Wear Co'da qoladi → risk & rewards o'tmagan → bu receivables bilan ta'minlangan loan. Receivables SOFP'da qoladi (600,000), cash 480,000 esa liability sifatida: Dr Cash, Cr Loan (liability).

q:
On 1 November 20X5, Leven Co factored receivables of $4,000,000 with recourse. The factor advanced 75% of the gross receivables immediately and charges 1.5% per month on the amount advanced. No amounts had been collected by the factor by Leven Co's year end of 31 December 20X5.
What finance cost should be recognised for the year ended 31 December 20X5? (Enter in $.)
ex: With recourse → loan. Advance = 4,000,000 × 75% = 3,000,000 (liability). Finance cost = 3,000,000 × 1.5% × 2 oy (noyabr, dekabr) = 90,000. Receivables 4,000,000 SOFP'da qoladi.

q: Where receivables are factored without recourse, so that the factor bears the risk of irrecoverable debts, the receivables are normally derecognised by the seller.
ex: To'g'ri. Without recourse → irrecoverable debt riski factor'ga o'tadi → risk & rewards o'tgan → bu haqiqiy sotuv: receivables derecognise, farq (factor discount) P/L'da.

q: Ouse Co repurchased some of its own loan notes on the market for $1,010,000 when their amortised cost carrying amount was $1,040,000. How should the repurchase be accounted for?
opt: Derecognise the liability and recognise a gain of $30,000 in equity
Derecognise the liability and recognise a gain of $30,000 in profit or loss
Derecognise the liability and recognise a loss of $30,000 in profit or loss
Keep the liability until the original redemption date
ex: Liability derecognise bo'ladi (obligation discharged). Carrying amount va to'langan summa farqi P/L'da: 1,040,000 − 1,010,000 = 30,000 gain.

q: According to IFRS 9, when should a financial asset be derecognised?
opt: When the contractual rights to the cash flows expire, or the asset is transferred with substantially all the risks and rewards of ownership
When cash is received in respect of the asset from any party
Only when the asset reaches its contractual maturity date
When legal title passes to another party, regardless of risks retained
ex: Financial asset derecognise qilinadi: cash flows'ga shartnomaviy huquqlar tugaganda (expire) yoki aktiv o'tkazilib, substantially all risks and rewards xaridorga o'tganda. Cash olingani yoki yuridik egalik o'tgani o'zi yetarli emas (with recourse factoring misoli).

q: Which TWO of the following indicate that a factoring arrangement is, in substance, a loan secured on receivables rather than a sale?
opt: The factor charges a fee based on how long amounts remain outstanding
The factor has no recourse to the seller for unpaid debts
Uncollected debts can be returned to the seller after a set period
The factor pays a fixed price on transfer and bears all bad debts
ex: Loan belgilari: seller irrecoverable debt riskini saqlaydi (recourse) va factor to'lovi vaqtga bog'liq (yig'ilgunga qadar foiz kabi) — ya'ni slow payment riski seller'da. Agar to'lov o'tkazish vaqtida bir marta belgilansa va factor riskni o'z zimmasiga olsa — sale belgisi.

q: Which TWO of the following are not financial instruments?
opt: A share option giving another party the right to buy the entity's shares
A prepayment for rent
A deferred tax liability
A bank deposit account
ex: Prepayment — kelajakda xizmat/tovar olinadi, cash emas → financial instrument emas. Deferred tax — qonun (statutory) asosida → emas. Share option (entity'ning o'z shares'ini berish majburiyati) — financial instrument. Bank deposit — cash/financial asset.

q:
Moravia Co has a year end of 30 June 20X8. The following matters are under review:
(1) On 1 July 20X7, Moravia Co issued 2,000,000 $1 7% preference shares at par, incurring issue costs of $60,000. The dividend was paid on 30 June 20X8. The shares are mandatorily redeemable at a premium on 30 June 20Y2 and the effective interest rate is 9%.
(2) On 1 June 20X8, Moravia Co factored trade receivables of $1,200,000. The factor advanced 85% of the receivables immediately and charges 1% per month on the amount advanced. Any receivables not recovered within four months are transferred back to Moravia Co. Moravia Co's bookkeeper has removed the receivables from the ledger and charged the $180,000 difference to administrative expenses.

How should the preference shares and the $140,000 paid on them be presented in the financial statements for the year ended 30 June 20X8?
opt: Equity, with the dividend in the statement of changes in equity
Equity, with the dividend as a finance cost in profit or loss
Non-current liability, with the finance cost in profit or loss
Current liability, with the dividend in the statement of changes in equity
ex: Mandatory redemption → shartnomaviy majburiyat → non-current liability. Liability bo'yicha to'lovlar → finance cost P/L'da (effective rate bilan hisoblanadi; 140,000 — cash qismi).

(2) On 1 June 20X8, Moravia Co factored trade receivables of $1,200,000. The factor advanced 85% of the receivables immediately and charges 1% per month on the amount advanced. Any receivables not recovered within four months are transferred back to Moravia Co. Moravia Co has a year end of 30 June 20X8. The following matters are under review:
(1) On 1 July 20X7, Moravia Co issued 2,000,000 $1 7% preference shares at par, incurring issue costs of $60,000. The dividend was paid on 30 June 20X8. The shares are mandatorily redeemable at a premium on 30 June 20Y2 and the effective interest rate is 9%.
(2) On 1 June 20X8, Moravia Co factored trade receivables of $1,200,000. The factor advanced 85% of the receivables immediately and charges 1% per month on the amount advanced. Any receivables not recovered within four months are transferred back to Moravia Co. Moravia Co's bookkeeper has removed the receivables from the ledger and charged the $180,000 difference to administrative expenses.

Which TWO of the following adjustments are required to correct the accounting for the factoring arrangement?
opt: Recognise the $1,020,000 as revenue
Reinstate trade receivables of $1,200,000
Recognise a liability of $1,020,000 for the amount advanced by the factor
Leave the $180,000 in administrative expenses as a loss on sale

To'g'rilash: (1) receivables 1,200,000 ni qayta tiklash; (2) olingan 1,020,000 (85%) ni liability sifatida ko'rsatish; admin expense'dagi 180,000 ni bekor qilish. Faqat iyun uchun finance cost (1%) tan olinadi — 180,000 ning hammasi emas. Receivables'ni derecognise qoldirish xato.

(2) On 1 June 20X8, Moravia Co factored trade receivables of $1,200,000. The factor advanced 85% of the receivables immediately and charges 1% per month on the amount advanced. Any receivables not recovered within four months are transferred back to Moravia Co.
