What is the main reason why a regulatory framework for financial reporting is needed?
opt: To ensure that users receive at least a minimum level of relevant and reliable information on which to base their decisions
To guarantee that all entities in the same industry report the same profit
To allow the tax authorities to choose the accounting policies of each entity
To remove the need for an external audit of the financial statements
ex: Regulatory framework maqsadi — foydalanuvchilar (shareholders, lenders va boshqalar) qaror qabul qilishi uchun minimal hajmdagi relevant va reliable ma'lumot olishini ta'minlash. U hamma bir xil foyda ko'rsatishini kafolatlamaydi, soliq organlariga siyosat tanlatmaydi va auditni bekor qilmaydi. Javob: A.

q: IFRS Standards on their own provide a complete regulatory framework for a listed company, so national company law and stock exchange rules are not needed.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Accounting standards o'zi yetarli emas: moliyaviy hisobotni tayyorlash va direktorlar majburiyatlarini to'liq tartibga solish uchun national company law, (EU'da) directives va securities exchange rules ham kerak. IFRS — regulatory framework'ning faqat bir qismi.

q: Which THREE of the following are advantages of the global harmonisation of accounting standards?
opt: Multinational groups find it easier to raise finance on international capital markets
Consolidating overseas subsidiaries is simpler because all group entities use the same basis
Investors can compare entities based in different countries more easily
Every country's legal system will automatically accept the same accounting practices
National company law will no longer be required
ex: Harmonisation afzalliklari: (A) multinational kompaniyalar uchun xalqaro moliyaga kirish osonlashadi; (B) consolidation oson — hamma subsidiary bir xil asosda hisobot beradi; (C) investorlar turli mamlakatlardagi entity'larni solishtira oladi. (D) aksincha — turli legal systems ba'zi amaliyotlarni cheklashi harmonisation'ning kamchiligi. (E) noto'g'ri — company law baribir kerak. Javob: A, B, C.

q: The International Accounting Standards Board has the legal power to force companies in any country to comply with IFRS Standards.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Na IFRS Foundation, na Board (IASB), na buxgalteriya kasbi IFRS'ga rioya qilishni majburlash (enforce) huquqiga ega emas. Shuning uchun Board national standard setters bilan hamkorlik qiladi; IFRS'ning kuchi 'persuasive force' va mamlakatlar uni qonun orqali qabul qilishidan keladi.

q: Which body acts as the overall supervisory body responsible for the governance and funding of the International Accounting Standards Board?
opt: IFRS Interpretations Committee
IFRS Advisory Council
IFRS Foundation
International Sustainability Standards Board
ex: IFRS Foundation — Board (IASB) ustidan nazorat qiluvchi (supervisory) organ: governance masalalari va har bir organning moliyalashtirilishi uchun javobgar. Interpretations Committee — talqinlar; Advisory Council — maslahat; ISSB — sustainability standartlari. Javob: C.

q: Divergent practice has developed in how entities apply an IFRS Standard to a newly common type of transaction. Which body would normally issue guidance on this, subject to approval by the Board?
opt: IFRS Foundation Trustees
A national standard setter
IFRS Advisory Council
IFRS Interpretations Committee
ex: IFRS Interpretations Committee (IFRIC) — IFRS'ni turlicha talqin qilish holatlarida yoki standartda aniq ko'rsatilmagan yangi masalalarda tezkor ko'rsatma (Interpretation) chiqaradi. Interpretation'lar Board tomonidan tasdiqlanishi kerak. Javob: B.

q: What is the minimum number of votes of Board members needed to publish an IFRS Standard, an exposure draft or an IFRIC Interpretation?
opt: Six of the 12 members
Eight of the 15 members
Ten of the 15 members
A simple majority of the IFRS Foundation Trustees
ex: IFRS Standard, exposure draft yoki IFRIC Interpretation chop etish uchun Board'ning 15 a'zosidan kamida 8 tasi ovoz berishi kerak. Trustees standart chiqarmaydi. Javob: B.

q: Which of the following shows the correct order of the main stages in developing a new IFRS Standard?
opt: Exposure draft → discussion paper → advisory committee → final Standard
Advisory committee → exposure draft → final Standard → discussion paper
Discussion paper → final Standard → exposure draft → advisory committee
Advisory committee → discussion paper → exposure draft → final Standard
ex: Jarayon: (1) Board mavzuni aniqlab advisory committee tayinlaydi; (2) fikr to'plash uchun discussion paper chiqarishi mumkin; (3) standartning qoralama versiyasi — exposure draft; (4) izohlar ko'rib chiqilgach — final IFRS Standard. Javob: B.

q: Which THREE of the following are objectives of the IFRS Foundation?
opt: To develop a single set of high quality, understandable and enforceable global accounting standards
To impose fines on listed companies that fail to comply with IFRS Standards
To promote the use and rigorous application of those standards
To approve the accounting policies chosen by each reporting entity
To bring about convergence of national accounting standards and IFRS Standards
ex: IFRS Foundation maqsadlari: (1) yuqori sifatli, tushunarli va enforceable global standartlar ishlab chiqish; (2) ularni qo'llashni targ'ib qilish; (3) national va international standartlarni convergence qilish. Foundation jarima sololmaydi (enforce huquqi yo'q) va har bir entity siyosatini tasdiqlamaydi. Javob: A, C, E.

q: IFRS S1 General Requirements for Disclosure of Sustainability-related Financial Information requires disclosures to be grouped into four core content areas. Which of the following is NOT one of those areas?
opt: Governance
Stakeholder engagement
Metrics and targets
Strategy
ex: IFRS S1 bo'yicha core content 4 soha: Governance, Strategy, Risk management, Metrics (and targets). 'Stakeholder engagement' alohida core content sohasi emas. Javob: D.

q: Under IFRS S1, sustainability-related disclosures are provided as part of the entity's general purpose financial reports and cover the same reporting period as the financial statements.
ex: To'g'ri. IFRS S1 sustainability disclosure'larni general purpose financial reports tarkibida, moliyaviy hisobot bilan bir xil davr uchun berishni talab qiladi.

q: Which THREE of the following are advantages of a principles-based (conceptual framework) approach to standard setting compared with a rules-based approach?
opt: It gives a detailed rule for every possible situation
It reduces 'fire-fighting', where standards are written piecemeal in response to specific abuses
It helps preparers and auditors deal with complex transactions not covered by any Standard
It removes the need for any professional judgement
Standards based on principles are thought to be harder to circumvent
ex: Principles-based yondashuv afzalliklari: fire-fightingdan qochadi (B), standartda yo'q murakkab operatsiyalarga yo'l ko'rsatadi (C), aylanib o'tish (circumvent) qiyinroq (E). (A) — bu rules-based ('cookbook') xususiyati; (D) noto'g'ri — principles aksincha ko'proq judgement talab qiladi. Javob: B, C, E.

q: The Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting appears to conflict with the requirements of a specific IFRS Standard. How should a preparer account for the transaction?
opt: Follow the Conceptual Framework, because it sets out the underlying principles
Choose whichever treatment gives the higher profit
Follow the IFRS Standard, because the Framework does not override any Standard
Refer the matter to the national standard setter before preparing the financial statements
ex: Conceptual Framework IFRS Standard emas va hech qaysi standartni override qilmaydi. Ziddiyat bo'lsa, IFRS Standard talabi ustun. Javob: B.

q: Which THREE of the following are stated purposes of the Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting?
opt: To assist the Board to develop IFRS Standards based on consistent concepts
To allow preparers to depart from an IFRS Standard where the Framework gives a fairer result
To assist preparers to develop consistent accounting policies where no Standard applies or a Standard allows a choice
To assist all parties to understand and interpret IFRS Standards
To replace IAS 1 as the source of presentation requirements
ex: Framework maqsadlari: (1) Board'ga izchil konsepsiyalarga asoslangan standartlar yaratishda yordam; (2) standart yo'q yoki tanlov bor bo'lganda preparer'larga izchil siyosat ishlab chiqishda yordam; (3) hamma tomonlarga standartlarni tushunish va talqin qilishda yordam. Framework standartdan chetga chiqishga ruxsat bermaydi va IAS 1 o'rnini bosmaydi. Javob: A, C, D.

q: According to the Conceptual Framework, what is the objective of general purpose financial reporting?
opt: To provide financial information about the reporting entity that is useful to existing and potential investors, lenders and other creditors in making decisions about providing resources to the entity
To provide all of the information that every user group, including government, could need
To report the market value of the reporting entity to its shareholders
To demonstrate that the directors have complied with company law
ex: Framework bo'yicha maqsad: mavjud va potentsial investors, lenders and other creditors (primary users) uchun entity'ga resurs berish bo'yicha qaror qabul qilishda foydali (useful) moliyaviy ma'lumot berish. Hisobot entity qiymatini ko'rsatmaydi va barcha foydalanuvchilarning barcha ehtiyojini qondira olmaydi. Javob: C.

q: Which of the following are the two FUNDAMENTAL qualitative characteristics of useful financial information?
opt: Relevance and comparability
Faithful representation and verifiability
Understandability and timeliness
Relevance and faithful representation
ex: Fundamental qualitative characteristics: Relevance va Faithful representation. Qolgan to'rttasi — comparability, verifiability, timeliness, understandability — enhancing characteristics. Javob: C.

q: Which THREE of the following are ENHANCING qualitative characteristics in the Conceptual Framework?
opt: Comparability
Relevance
Timeliness
Neutrality
Verifiability
ex: Enhancing: Comparability, Verifiability, Timeliness, Understandability. Relevance — fundamental. Neutrality — faithful representation'ning tarkibiy qismi (complete, neutral, free from error). Javob: A, C, E.

q: How does the Conceptual Framework describe materiality?
opt: As a separate fundamental qualitative characteristic
As an enhancing qualitative characteristic linked to comparability
As an entity-specific aspect of relevance, based on the nature or size of the item
As a fixed percentage of profit before tax set by the Board
ex: Materiality — relevance'ning entity-specific jihati (nature yoki size'ga bog'liq). U 'threshold quality': ma'lumot material bo'lmasa, uni boshqa jihatdan tahlil qilishga hojat yo'q. Board hech qanday qat'iy foiz belgilamagan. Ma'lumot material — agar uni tushirib qoldirish, noto'g'ri ko'rsatish yoki yashirish (obscuring) foydalanuvchi qaroriga ta'sir qilsa. Javob: B.

q: For information to be a perfectly faithful representation, which three characteristics should it have?
opt: Complete, neutral and free from error
Relevant, material and timely
Comparable, verifiable and understandable
Prudent, consistent and accrual-based
ex: Faithful representation uchun ma'lumot: Complete (barcha kerakli tavsif va izohlar), Neutral (bias yo'q), Free from error (materiality chegarasida xatosiz). Javob: A.

q: 'Free from error' means that financial statements must be perfectly accurate in every respect, so amounts based on estimates cannot be included.
ex: Noto'g'ri. 'Free from error' mutlaq aniqlik degani emas. Estimate'lar kiritilishi mumkin, faqat ular estimate ekani aniq tasvirlangan va hisoblash jarayoni xatosiz bo'lsa kifoya. Xato materiality chegarasida baholanadi.

q: Lumen Co publishes a forecast of revenue of $42 million for 20X6. When the 20X6 financial statements show actual revenue of $39.5 million, analysts use them to revise how they assess management's forecasts. Which quality of relevant information is being demonstrated by the 20X6 financial statements?
opt: Predictive value
Confirmatory value
Verifiability
Timeliness
ex: Relevant ma'lumot predictive va/yoki confirmatory valuega ega. Bu yerda haqiqiy natija ($39.5m) oldingi baholarni (forecast $42m) tasdiqlash yoki tuzatish uchun ishlatilmoqda — bu confirmatory value. Javob: B.

q: Which of the following would NOT enhance the comparability of an entity's financial statements?
opt: Presenting comparative figures for the previous period
Disclosing the accounting policies used
Restating prior period figures retrospectively after a change in accounting policy
Changing the depreciation method each year to whichever method gives the most favourable profit
ex: Comparability uchun consistency va disclosure kerak: comparatives (A), siyosatlarni ochish (B), siyosat o'zgarsa retrospective restatement (C) — barchasi comparability'ni oshiradi. Har yili qulay natija uchun usulni o'zgartirish consistency'ni buzadi va neutrality'ga ham zid. Javob: D.

q: Which of the following treatments best applies the principle of faithful representation (substance over legal form)?
opt: Treating the 'sale' of a property, which the seller must buy back two years later at a fixed price above the sale price, as a loan secured on the property
Derecognising receivables that have been factored with full recourse to the seller
Classifying the entire proceeds of a loan note that the holder may convert into equity shares as a liability
Leaving a loss-making subsidiary out of the consolidated financial statements because its trade differs from the rest of the group
ex: Faithful representation — operatsiyani iqtisodiy mohiyati (substance) bo'yicha ko'rsatish. Sotuv narxidan yuqori qat'iy narxda qayta sotib olish majburiyati bilan sotish — mohiyatan garovli qarz, shuning uchun aktiv SOFP'da qoladi va olingan pul liability bo'ladi (A). Full recourse bilan factoring — risk qolgan, derecognition yo'q (B noto'g'ri). Convertible loan liability + equity ga bo'linadi (C noto'g'ri). Subsidiary faoliyati farqli bo'lsa ham consolidation qilinadi (D noto'g'ri). Javob: A.

q: Which of the following is the Conceptual Framework definition of a liability?
opt: A probable future sacrifice of economic benefits arising from future transactions
A present obligation of the entity to transfer an economic resource as a result of past events
The residual interest in the assets of the entity after deducting all its assets
An obligation that can be measured reliably and is expected to be settled within 12 months
ex: Liability = present obligation + transfer an economic resource + as a result of past events. Kelajakdagi operatsiyalar liability yaratmaydi; 'residual interest' — equity ta'rifi; reliable measurement va 12 oy — ta'rifning qismi emas. Javob: A.

q: Which of the following transactions gives rise to INCOME as defined in the Conceptual Framework?
opt: Issuing 200,000 new equity shares for $300,000 cash
Receiving a $500,000 bank loan
A supplier formally agreeing to waive $18,000 owed to it by the entity
Paying a dividend of $40,000 to shareholders
ex: Income = aktivlarning oshishi yoki liability'larning kamayishi, natijada equity oshadi, equity egalari hissasidan (contributions) tashqari. (A) — egalar hissasi, income emas; (B) — aktiv ham, liability ham oshadi, equity o'zgarmaydi; (C) — liability $18,000 ga kamayadi, equity oshadi → income; (D) — distribution. Javob: C.

q: Vireo Co is reviewing items at its year end. Which THREE of the following meet the Conceptual Framework definition of an asset of Vireo Co?
opt: A software licence purchased last year giving Vireo Co the exclusive right to use the software for three more years
A highly skilled workforce which Vireo Co spent $250,000 training; staff can resign at one month's notice
A contract signed with a customer for goods to be delivered next year; no goods have been delivered and nothing has been paid
The right to use a machine for four years under a lease signed during the year
An amount of $35,000 owed by a customer for goods delivered before the year end
ex: Asset = entity nazorat qiladigan (controlled), o'tgan voqealar natijasidagi present economic resource. (A) litsenziya — huquq nazorat qilinadi ✔; (B) xodimlar ketishi mumkin — nazorat yo'q ✘; (C) hech bir tomon bajarmagan (executory) shartnoma — hali tan olinadigan aktiv yo'q ✘; (D) right-of-use — huquq nazorat ostida ✔; (E) receivable — o'tgan sotuv natijasidagi huquq ✔. Javob: A, D, E.

q: A constructive obligation, such as one arising from an entity's published policy of cleaning up any land it contaminates, can meet the definition of a liability even where no law requires the clean-up.
ex: To'g'ri. Obligation legal yoki constructive bo'lishi mumkin. E'lon qilingan siyosat yoki odatiy amaliyot boshqalarda asosli kutilma yaratsa, bu constructive obligation — qonun talab qilmasa ham liability ta'rifiga mos keladi.

q: Under the Conceptual Framework, when should an item that meets the definition of an element be recognised in the financial statements?
opt: Only when it has a quoted market price
Only when it is certain that economic benefits will flow to or from the entity
When recognition provides users with relevant information and a faithful representation of the item
Whenever the directors believe recognition would improve the entity's ratios
ex: Recognition: (1) item element ta'rifiga mos keladi; (2) recognition relevant ma'lumot beradi; (3) faithful representation beradi. Bozor narxi yoki mutlaq ishonch talab qilinmaydi. Javob: B.

q: Talon Co has an item that meets the definition of a liability. However, the amount could be anywhere between $50,000 and $4 million and no reasonable estimate can be made. Which reason given in the Conceptual Framework could justify not recognising it?
opt: The item is not a present obligation
Recognition would reduce Talon Co's reported profit
Liabilities are only recognised when they are due within 12 months
A very high level of measurement uncertainty may mean recognition would not give a faithful representation
ex: Framework bo'yicha recognition faithful representation bermasligi mumkin, agar measurement uncertainty juda yuqori bo'lsa ($50k – $4m, ishonchli taxmin yo'q). Bunday holatda item tan olinmaydi, lekin disclosure kerak bo'lishi mumkin. Foydaga ta'sir recognition sababi bo'la olmaydi. Javob: B.

q: On 1 July 20X5 Heron Co sold a warehouse with a carrying amount of $2.8 million to a finance house for $2.5 million. Heron Co has an option to repurchase the warehouse for $2.9 million on 30 June 20X7. The warehouse's fair value on 1 July 20X5 was $5.2 million and property prices are expected to rise. How should Heron Co account for the transaction on 1 July 20X5?
opt: Derecognise the warehouse and recognise a loss on disposal of $300,000
Continue to recognise the warehouse and recognise the $2.5 million received as a financial liability
Derecognise the warehouse and recognise a gain of $2.4 million
Continue to recognise the warehouse and recognise the $2.5 million received as revenue
ex: Heron Co warehouse'ni fair value'dan ($5.2m) ancha past narxda ($2.9m) qaytarib sotib olishi mumkin — narxlar oshishidan foyda olish imkoniyati (control) unda qoladi. Demak derecognition yo'q: warehouse SOFP'da qoladi, olingan $2.5m — loan (financial liability): Dr Cash 2.5m / Cr Loan 2.5m. Farq ($2.9m − $2.5m = $0.4m) 2 yil davomida finance cost bo'ladi. Javob: C.

q:
On 1 January 20X6 Osprey Co 'sold' its head office building to a bank for $5,000,000 and is required to buy it back on 31 December 20X7 for $6,050,000. The building remains in Osprey Co's use and its fair value is well above $6,050,000. The implicit interest rate in the arrangement is 10% per annum.

What is the carrying amount of the liability in Osprey Co's statement of financial position at 31 December 20X6? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Majburiy qayta sotib olish — mohiyatan garovli qarz: bino derecognise qilinmaydi, olingan pul liability.
1.1.20X6: liability = 5,000
Finance cost 20X6 = 5,000 × 10% = 500 (Dr Finance cost / Cr Liability)
31.12.20X6: 5,000 + 500 = 5,500 ($000)
Tekshiruv: 20X7 da 5,500 × 10% = 550 → 6,050 = repurchase price ✔

q: Which TWO of the following would result in the derecognition of an asset or liability by the entity?
opt: Trade receivables are sold to a factor with full recourse to the entity for any bad debts
A bank loan is repaid in full
Trade receivables are sold to a factor without recourse; the factor bears all bad debt risk
Land is pledged to a bank as security for a loan
A building is sold but the entity retains an option to buy it back at well below its expected future value
ex: Derecognition: entity asset ustidan control'ni yo'qotganda yoki liability bo'yicha present obligation qolmaganda. (B) qarz to'liq to'landi — obligation yo'q ✔; (C) recourse'siz factoring — risk va benefit'lar o'tdi ✔. (A) full recourse — risk qolgan, receivable qoladi; (D) garov — aktiv hali entity'niki; (E) arzon qayta sotib olish opsiyasi — control saqlangan. Javob: B, C.

q: Under the Conceptual Framework, income and expenses are defined in terms of changes in assets and liabilities, which is described as a statement of financial position approach to recognition.
ex: To'g'ri. Income = aktivlar oshishi / liability kamayishi; expense = aktivlar kamayishi / liability oshishi (equity hissasi va distribution'dan tashqari). Income va expense'lar aktiv/liability o'zgarishi asosida tan olingani uchun bu financial position (balance sheet) approach deyiladi.

q: Which of the following lists only measurement bases that are described in the Conceptual Framework?
opt: Historical cost, fair value, value in use (fulfilment value for liabilities), current cost
Historical cost, residual value, fair value, future value
Fair value, replacement value, break-up value, future value
Current cost, residual value, net present value, market capitalisation
ex: Framework measurement bases: historical cost va current value — ya'ni fair value, value in use (aktivlar uchun) / fulfilment value (liability'lar uchun), current cost. Residual value, future value — measurement basis emas. Javob: B.

q:
Gannet Co bought a machine on 1 January 20X1 for $360,000. It has a useful life of eight years, nil residual value, and is depreciated on a straight-line basis.

What is the carrying amount of the machine under historical cost at 31 December 20X3? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Yillik depreciation = 360,000 ÷ 8 = 45,000
20X1–20X3 = 3 yil → accumulated depreciation = 3 × 45,000 = 135,000
Carrying amount = 360,000 − 135,000 = $225,000

q:
Gannet Co bought a machine on 1 January 20X1 for $360,000. It has a useful life of eight years, nil residual value, and is depreciated on a straight-line basis. At 31 December 20X3 the current price of an equivalent new machine is $440,000.

What is the value of the machine at 31 December 20X3 using current cost (net replacement cost)? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Net replacement cost = yangi aktivning joriy narxi − yoshi va holatini aks ettiruvchi depreciation.
Yillik depreciation (current cost) = 440,000 ÷ 8 = 55,000
3 yil → 3 × 55,000 = 165,000
Net replacement cost = 440,000 − 165,000 = $275,000 (yoki 440,000 × 5/8)

q:
Plover Co acquired an item of plant on 1 April 20X5 for $800,000. It is depreciated on a straight-line basis over four years to a residual value of 12.5% of its historical cost or current cost, as appropriate. At 31 March 20X7 the supplier still sells the same plant, now priced at $960,000.

What is the carrying amount of the plant at 31 March 20X7 under current cost? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Current cost asosida: yangi narx = 960,000
Residual value = 12.5% × 960,000 = 120,000
Depreciable amount = 960,000 − 120,000 = 840,000
Yillik depreciation = 840,000 ÷ 4 = 210,000; 2 yil (1.4.X5–31.3.X7) = 420,000
Carrying amount = 960,000 − 420,000 = $540,000
(Solishtirish: historical cost bo'yicha = 800,000 − 2 × (700,000 ÷ 4) = 450,000)

q:
Stilt Co owns a packing machine that could be sold for $72,000. Dismantling and removal costs would be $4,500 and the selling agent would charge commission of 5% of the selling price.

What is the net realisable value (fair value less costs to sell) of the machine? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
NRV = sotuv narxi − sotish xarajatlari
Commission = 5% × 72,000 = 3,600
NRV = 72,000 − 4,500 − 3,600 = $63,900

q:
Avocet Co expects a machine to generate net cash inflows of $30,000 in year 1, $30,000 in year 2 and $18,000 in year 3, after which it will be scrapped for nil proceeds. The relevant discount rate is 8% and the discount factors are: year 1 0.926, year 2 0.857, year 3 0.794.

What is the value in use (economic value) of the machine? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Value in use = kelajakdagi cash flow'larning present value'si
Yil 1: 30,000 × 0.926 = 27,780
Yil 2: 30,000 × 0.857 = 25,710
Yil 3: 18,000 × 0.794 = 14,292
Jami = $67,782

q:
Crake Co's machine is expected to generate net cash inflows of $40,000 in each of the next two years and then $25,000 in each of the following three years. The discount rate is 10%. Discount factors: year 1 0.909, year 2 0.826; the annuity factor for years 3 to 5 inclusive is 2.055.

What is the economic value (value in use) of the machine? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
In a period of rising prices, which of the following is a criticism of financial statements prepared under historical cost accounting?
opt: Profits are understated and assets are overstated
Unrealised gains on assets are recognised too early
Depreciation charges are overstated
Profits are overstated and assets are understated
ex: Narxlar oshganda HC'da aktivlar eski narxda qoladi → assets understated; depreciation va cost of sales eski (arzon) narxda → xarajatlar kam → profit overstated. Depreciation understated (C noto'g'ri); HC realise bo'lmagan gain'ni tan olmaydi (D noto'g'ri). Javob: B.

q: Which THREE of the following are advantages of historical cost accounting?
opt: Figures are objective and can be checked to original invoices
It is easy to understand and straightforward to produce
Assets are shown at their current value to the business
Gains are not recognised until they are realised
It allows a meaningful return on capital employed to be calculated in times of inflation
ex: HC afzalliklari: objective va hujjatlar (invoice) bilan tasdiqlanadi (A); tushunish va tayyorlash oson (B); gain'lar realise bo'lgunicha tan olinmaydi (D). (C) va (E) — aksincha, HC'ning kamchiliklari: aktivlar eskirgan qiymatda, inflation'da ROCE ma'nosiz bo'ladi. Javob: A, B, D.

q: Which of the following statements correctly describes constant purchasing power (CPP) accounting?
opt: Non-monetary assets are restated to their specific replacement cost
All figures are restated using a general price index so that they are expressed in units of the same purchasing power
Only monetary items such as cash and receivables are adjusted
Assets are measured at the present value of their future cash flows
ex: CPP — general price index (umumiy inflation) yordamida barcha summalarni bir xil xarid qobiliyati birligiga keltiradi. CPP factor = hisobot sanasidagi indeks ÷ tan olingan sanadagi indeks. (A) — bu CCA (deprival value / replacement cost); (D) — value in use. Javob: B.

q:
Egret Co bought land for $500,000 when the general price index stood at 125. At the reporting date the general price index is 160.

What is the value of the land in Egret Co's constant purchasing power (CPP) statement of financial position? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
CPP factor = reporting date indeksi ÷ sotib olingan sanadagi indeks = 160 ÷ 125 = 1.28
CPP qiymati = 500,000 × 1.28 = $640,000
(Land — non-monetary item, shuning uchun indekslanadi.)

q:
Throughout 20X6 Ibis Co held cash of $200,000 in a non-interest-bearing account. The general price index rose from 150 at 1 January 20X6 to 165 at 31 December 20X6.

Under constant purchasing power (CPP) accounting, what is Ibis Co's loss on holding this monetary asset for the year? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Monetary aktiv (cash) summasi o'zgarmaydi, lekin xarid qobiliyati tushadi.
Xarid qobiliyatini saqlash uchun kerak edi: 200,000 × 165/150 = 220,000
Haqiqatda bor: 200,000
Purchasing power loss = 220,000 − 200,000 = $20,000

q:
Jacana Co bought plant on 1 January 20X1 for $600,000, with a useful life of 10 years and nil residual value. Under current cost accounting, depreciation is based on the replacement cost of an equivalent new asset at the year end, which at 31 December 20X3 is $750,000.

What additional depreciation charge (the current cost depreciation adjustment) is required for 20X3 compared with historical cost depreciation? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
HC depreciation = 600,000 ÷ 10 = 60,000
Current cost depreciation = 750,000 ÷ 10 = 75,000
Qo'shimcha charge (depreciation adjustment) = 75,000 − 60,000 = $15,000
Bu CCA SPL'da iste'mol qilingan aktivning value to the businessini aks ettiradi.

q: Under current cost accounting (CCA), monetary items such as cash, receivables and payables are restated to their replacement cost.
ex: Noto'g'ri. CCA faqat non-monetary aktivlarni (inventory, non-current assets) deprival value (odatda replacement cost) bo'yicha qayta o'lchaydi. Monetary items (cash, receivables, payables, loans) tuzatilmaydi — bu CCA'ning kamchiliklaridan biri.

q: Under the physical capital maintenance concept, when does an entity earn a profit for the period?
opt: When the money amount of net assets at the end exceeds the money amount at the start, after owner contributions and distributions
When the physical productive capacity (operating capability) at the end of the period exceeds that at the start, after owner contributions and distributions
When cash receipts exceed cash payments for the period
When the market value of the entity's shares increases
ex: Physical capital maintenance: foyda faqat davr oxiridagi ishlab chiqarish quvvati (operating capability) boshidagidan oshsa (egalar hissasi va distribution'lardan tashqari) yuzaga keladi — shu sababli current cost asosi kerak. (A) — financial (money) capital maintenance ta'rifi. Javob: B.

q:
Kite Co had net assets of $500,000 at 1 January 20X6 and $620,000 at 31 December 20X6. During the year shareholders subscribed $30,000 for new shares and Kite Co paid dividends of $20,000.

Using the financial (money) capital maintenance concept, what is Kite Co's profit for 20X6? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Profit = yopilish net assets − ochilish net assets − egalar hissasi + distribution'lar
= 620,000 − 500,000 − 30,000 + 20,000 = $110,000
Dividend qo'shiladi (foydadan to'langan), share issue ayriladi (foyda emas).

q:
Kite Co had net assets of $500,000 at 1 January 20X6 and $620,000 at 31 December 20X6. On 31 December 20X6 shareholders subscribed $30,000 for new shares and Kite Co paid dividends of $20,000. General inflation for 20X6 was 8%.

Using the REAL financial capital maintenance concept (opening capital adjusted for general inflation), what is Kite Co's profit for 20X6? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Real financial capital: ochilish kapitali xarid qobiliyatini saqlash uchun indekslanadi.
Saqlanishi kerak kapital = 500,000 × 1.08 = 540,000
Profit = 620,000 − 540,000 − 30,000 + 20,000 = $70,000
(Money capital bo'yicha 110,000 edi; farq 40,000 = inflation uchun saqlangan 'capital maintenance reserve'.)

q:
Rook Co was formed on 1 January 20X6 with $50,000 cash and immediately bought 1,000 units of inventory at $50 each. On 31 December 20X6 it sold all 1,000 units for $80,000 cash. At that date the cost of replacing each unit had risen to $62.

Using the PHYSICAL capital maintenance concept, what is Rook Co's profit for 20X6? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Physical capital = 1,000 dona inventory'ni saqlash qobiliyati.
Davr oxirida 1,000 donani qayta sotib olish uchun kerak: 1,000 × 62 = 62,000
Profit = 80,000 − 62,000 = $18,000
(Money capital bo'yicha profit = 80,000 − 50,000 = 30,000; 12,000 farq — holding gain, physical concept bo'yicha kapitalni saqlash uchun kerak.)

q: How does IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement define fair value?
opt: The price that would be paid to acquire an asset in an orderly transaction at the measurement date (an entry price)
The price that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date (an exit price)
The present value of the future cash flows the entity expects from using an asset
The estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business less costs to complete and sell
ex: IFRS 13: fair value — o'lchash sanasida market participants o'rtasidagi orderly transaction'da aktivni sotganda olinadigan yoki liability'ni o'tkazganda to'lanadigan narx — exit price. (C) — value in use (IAS 36); (D) — NRV (IAS 2); ikkalasi IFRS 13 doirasidan tashqarida. Javob: B.

q: Heath Co holds shares in an unlisted company. It measures their fair value using a discounted cash flow model based on its own forecasts of the investee's future cash flows, as no market data is available. Within which level of the IFRS 13 fair value hierarchy do these inputs fall?
opt: Level 3
Level 2
Level 1
Outside the hierarchy, because the shares are unlisted
ex: Level 1 — faol bozorda bir xil aktiv uchun quoted price. Level 2 — boshqa kuzatiladigan (observable) inputlar (o'xshash aktiv narxi, nofaol bozor). Level 3 — kuzatib bo'lmaydigan (unobservable) inputlar, masalan entity'ning o'z prognozlari. Bu yerda o'z cash flow prognozlari → Level 3. Javob: C.

q:
Marten Co holds 10,000 units of a commodity. In the principal market for the commodity the quoted price at the reporting date is $95 per unit. Selling in that market would incur transaction costs of $3 per unit, and it would cost $2 per unit to transport the commodity to the market.

In accordance with IFRS 13, what is the fair value of Marten Co's holding? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
IFRS 13: fair value transaction costs uchun tuzatilmaydi (ular aktivning xususiyati emas), lekin location — aktivning xususiyati, shuning uchun transport costs ayriladi.
Birlik uchun FV = 95 − 2 = 93
Jami = 93 × 10,000 = $930,000
(Transaction cost $3 ayirilmaydi.)

q: Which TWO of the following would be classified as Level 2 inputs under the IFRS 13 fair value hierarchy?
opt: The quoted price in an active market for an identical asset
The quoted price in an active market for a similar (but not identical) asset
The quoted price for an identical asset in a market that is not active
Management's own projections of future cash flows from the asset
Entity-specific synergies that only the reporting entity could obtain
ex: Level 2 — Level 1 dan tashqari, bevosita yoki bilvosita observable inputlar: o'xshash aktivning faol bozordagi narxi (B), bir xil aktivning nofaol bozordagi narxi (C). (A) — Level 1; (D) — Level 3 (unobservable). (E) — entity-specific synergiya market participant nuqtai nazari emas, fair value'da hisobga olinmaydi. Javob: B, C.

q:
Pelican Co is considering how to measure one of its machines at 30 June 20X8. The machine was bought exactly four years earlier for $240,000 and is depreciated on a straight-line basis over ten years with nil residual value. The following information is available at 30 June 20X8:
  • The machine could be sold today for $130,000, but dismantling and removal costs of $6,000 would be incurred.
  • A new equivalent machine would cost $300,000.
  • The machine is expected to generate net cash inflows of $28,000 a year for its remaining six years. The 6-year annuity factor at Pelican Co's discount rate of 9% is 4.486.
What is the carrying amount of the machine under historical cost at 30 June 20X8? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Yillik depreciation = 240,000 ÷ 10 = 24,000
4 yil → 96,000
Carrying amount = 240,000 − 96,000 = $144,000

q:
Pelican Co is considering how to measure one of its machines at 30 June 20X8. The machine was bought exactly four years earlier for $240,000 and is depreciated on a straight-line basis over ten years with nil residual value. The following information is available at 30 June 20X8:
  • The machine could be sold today for $130,000, but dismantling and removal costs of $6,000 would be incurred.
  • A new equivalent machine would cost $300,000.
  • The machine is expected to generate net cash inflows of $28,000 a year for its remaining six years. The 6-year annuity factor at Pelican Co's discount rate of 9% is 4.486.
What is the net realisable value (fair value less costs to sell) of the machine at 30 June 20X8? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex: NRV = 130,000 − 6,000 (dismantling va removal) = $124,000

q:
Pelican Co is considering how to measure one of its machines at 30 June 20X8. The machine was bought exactly four years earlier for $240,000 and is depreciated on a straight-line basis over ten years with nil residual value. The following information is available at 30 June 20X8:
  • The machine could be sold today for $130,000, but dismantling and removal costs of $6,000 would be incurred.
  • A new equivalent machine would cost $300,000.
  • The machine is expected to generate net cash inflows of $28,000 a year for its remaining six years. The 6-year annuity factor at Pelican Co's discount rate of 9% is 4.486.
What is the current cost (net replacement cost) of the machine at 30 June 20X8? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Yangi ekvivalent narxi = 300,000; 10 yillik umrning 4 yili o'tgan.
Current cost depreciation = 300,000 × 4/10 = 120,000
Net replacement cost = 300,000 − 120,000 = $180,000

q:
Pelican Co is considering how to measure one of its machines at 30 June 20X8. The machine was bought exactly four years earlier for $240,000 and is depreciated on a straight-line basis over ten years with nil residual value. The following information is available at 30 June 20X8:
  • The machine could be sold today for $130,000, but dismantling and removal costs of $6,000 would be incurred.
  • A new equivalent machine would cost $300,000.
  • The machine is expected to generate net cash inflows of $28,000 a year for its remaining six years. The 6-year annuity factor at Pelican Co's discount rate of 9% is 4.486.
What is the value in use (economic value) of the machine at 30 June 20X8? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.

Pelican Co is considering how to measure one of its machines at 30 June 20X8. The machine was bought exactly four years earlier for $240,000 and is depreciated on a straight-line basis over ten years with nil residual value. The following information is available at 30 June 20X8:
  • The machine could be sold today for $130,000, but dismantling and removal costs of $6,000 would be incurred.
  • A new equivalent machine would cost $300,000.
  • The machine is expected to generate net cash inflows of $28,000 a year for its remaining six years. The 6-year annuity factor at Pelican Co's discount rate of 9% is 4.486.
IAS 36 Impairment of Assets requires an asset to be carried at no more than its recoverable amount (the higher of fair value less costs of disposal and value in use). What impairment loss, if any, should Pelican Co recognise at 30 June 20X8?
opt: Nil
ex:
Carrying amount (HC) = 144,000
Recoverable amount = higher of FVLCD 124,000 va VIU 125,608 = 125,608
Impairment loss = 144,000 − 125,608 = $18,392
($20,000 = 144,000 − 124,000 — faqat FVLCD bilan solishtirish xatosi; current cost 180,000 recoverable amount'ga aloqasi yo'q.) Javob: B.

q:
Kestrel Co prepares financial statements to 31 March 20X7. The finance director has listed the following matters:
  • (1) Kestrel Co has a widely published policy of restoring any land it damages. At 31 March 20X7 it had damaged land at one site, although local law does not require restoration. Restoration is estimated to cost $420,000.
  • (2) In March 20X7 Kestrel Co signed a contract to buy raw materials for $150,000, for delivery and payment in May 20X7. The contract is at market price.
  • (3) On 1 February 20X7 Kestrel Co sold receivables of $90,000 to a factor for $85,000. The factor has full recourse to Kestrel Co for any amounts not collected.
  • (4) Kestrel Co spent $60,000 on a staff development programme during the year.
Matter (1) gives rise to a liability of Kestrel Co at 31 March 20X7, even though there is no legal requirement to restore the land.
ex: To'g'ri. E'lon qilingan siyosat — constructive obligation; yer allaqachon buzilgan (past event); resurs chiqib ketishi kutiladi. Demak liability (IAS 37 provision) $420,000: Dr Profit or loss (yoki asset, agar tegishli) / Cr Provision.

q:
Kestrel Co prepares financial statements to 31 March 20X7. The finance director has listed the following matters:
  • (1) Kestrel Co has a widely published policy of restoring any land it damages. At 31 March 20X7 it had damaged land at one site, although local law does not require restoration. Restoration is estimated to cost $420,000.
  • (2) In March 20X7 Kestrel Co signed a contract to buy raw materials for $150,000, for delivery and payment in May 20X7. The contract is at market price.
  • (3) On 1 February 20X7 Kestrel Co sold receivables of $90,000 to a factor for $85,000. The factor has full recourse to Kestrel Co for any amounts not collected.
  • (4) Kestrel Co spent $60,000 on a staff development programme during the year.
How should matter (2) be treated in the statement of financial position at 31 March 20X7?
opt: Recognise inventory of $150,000 and a payable of $150,000
Recognise a liability of $150,000 only
No asset or liability is recognised, as neither party has yet performed under the contract
Recognise a prepayment of $150,000
ex: Bu executory contract — hali hech bir tomon bajarmagan (tovar yetkazilmagan, pul to'lanmagan) va shartnoma bozor narxida (onerous emas). Hisobot sanasida o'tgan voqea natijasidagi aktiv yoki liability yo'q. Javob: C.

q:
Kestrel Co prepares financial statements to 31 March 20X7. The finance director has listed the following matters:
  • (1) Kestrel Co has a widely published policy of restoring any land it damages. At 31 March 20X7 it had damaged land at one site, although local law does not require restoration. Restoration is estimated to cost $420,000.
  • (2) In March 20X7 Kestrel Co signed a contract to buy raw materials for $150,000, for delivery and payment in May 20X7. The contract is at market price.
  • (3) On 1 February 20X7 Kestrel Co sold receivables of $90,000 to a factor for $85,000. The factor has full recourse to Kestrel Co for any amounts not collected.
  • (4) Kestrel Co spent $60,000 on a staff development programme during the year.
How should Kestrel Co account for matter (3) on 1 February 20X7?
opt: Derecognise receivables of $90,000 and recognise a loss of $5,000
Continue to recognise receivables of $90,000 and credit $85,000 to revenue
Derecognise receivables of $90,000 and recognise revenue of $85,000
Continue to recognise receivables of $90,000 and recognise a liability of $85,000 for the cash received
ex: Full recourse — bad debt riski Kestrel Co'da qoladi, ya'ni receivable'lar bo'yicha o'zgaruvchanlikka exposure saqlangan. Derecognition yo'q; olingan $85,000 — qarz (liability): Dr Cash 85,000 / Cr Loan 85,000. Receivable $90,000 SOFP'da qoladi; $5,000 farq finance cost sifatida tan olinadi. Javob: B.

q:
Kestrel Co prepares financial statements to 31 March 20X7. The finance director has listed the following matters:
  • (1) Kestrel Co has a widely published policy of restoring any land it damages. At 31 March 20X7 it had damaged land at one site, although local law does not require restoration. Restoration is estimated to cost $420,000.
  • (2) In March 20X7 Kestrel Co signed a contract to buy raw materials for $150,000, for delivery and payment in May 20X7. The contract is at market price.
  • (3) On 1 February 20X7 Kestrel Co sold receivables of $90,000 to a factor for $85,000. The factor has full recourse to Kestrel Co for any amounts not collected.
  • (4) Kestrel Co spent $60,000 on a staff development programme during the year.
The $60,000 spent on the staff development programme in matter (4) should be recognised as an intangible asset, because the trained staff will generate future economic benefits.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Kestrel Co xodimlarni nazorat qilmaydi (no control) — ular ishdan ketishi mumkin. Asset ta'rifi bajarilmaydi, shuning uchun $60,000 expense sifatida P/L'ga yoziladi.

q:
Kestrel Co prepares financial statements to 31 March 20X7. The finance director has listed the following matters:
  • (1) Kestrel Co has a widely published policy of restoring any land it damages. At 31 March 20X7 it had damaged land at one site, although local law does not require restoration. Restoration is estimated to cost $420,000.
  • (2) In March 20X7 Kestrel Co signed a contract to buy raw materials for $150,000, for delivery and payment in May 20X7. The contract is at market price.
  • (3) On 1 February 20X7 Kestrel Co sold receivables of $90,000 to a factor for $85,000. The factor has full recourse to Kestrel Co for any amounts not collected.
  • (4) Kestrel Co spent $60,000 on a staff development programme during the year.
Which TWO qualitative characteristics or concepts from the Conceptual Framework most directly support Kestrel Co's treatment of matter (3)?
opt: Faithful representation, reporting the substance rather than the legal form
Timeliness
The derecognition principle that an asset is not removed if exposure to variations in its economic benefits is retained
Understandability
Historical cost measurement
ex: Matter (3) — huquqiy jihatdan 'sotuv', lekin mohiyatan garovli qarz. Faithful representation (substance over form) va Framework'ning derecognition qoidasi (entity iqtisodiy natijalar o'zgaruvchanligiga exposure'ni saqlasa, derecognition noto'g'ri) bu treatment'ni asoslaydi. Timeliness, understandability, historical cost bu yerga bevosita aloqasi yo'q. Javob: A, C.

q: Under IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates, which of the following best describes an entity's presentation currency?
opt: The currency in which the financial statements are presented, which may be different from the functional currency
The currency of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates
The currency in which the entity's share capital was originally issued
The currency in which the majority of the entity's loans are denominated
ex: Presentation currency — moliyaviy hisobotlar taqdim etiladigan valyuta (IAS 21 para 8). U functional currency bilan bir xil bo'lishi shart emas. 'Primary economic environment' valyutasi — bu functional currency ta'rifi. Share capital yoki qarzlar valyutasi o'z-o'zidan presentation currency'ni belgilamaydi.

q: Which TWO of the following are primary factors that IAS 21 requires an entity to consider when determining its functional currency?
opt: The currency that mainly influences the sales prices of its goods and services
The currency that mainly influences labour, material and other costs of providing its goods and services
The currency in which funds from financing activities (debt and equity) are generated
The currency in which receipts from operating activities are usually retained
The currency of the country in which the entity's head office is legally registered
ex:
IAS 21 bo'yicha primary factors: (1) sotuv narxlariga asosan ta'sir qiladigan valyuta (va raqobat hamda regulyatsiya sotuv narxini belgilaydigan mamlakat valyutasi); (2) mehnat, material va boshqa xarajatlarga asosan ta'sir qiladigan valyuta.
Financing activities valyutasi va operating receipts saqlanadigan valyuta — secondary factors (primary factors aniq javob bermasa ko'riladi). Ro'yxatdan o'tgan mamlakat valyutasi umuman faktor emas.

q: Chust Co is incorporated in Zedland, whose currency is the Zed. Chust Co sells almost all of its output in dollars at prices set by competition in the US market, and most of its raw material and labour costs are also paid in dollars. Its long-term bank loan was raised in Zeds. What is Chust Co's functional currency?
opt: The Zed, because Chust Co is incorporated in Zedland
The dollar, because it mainly influences both selling prices and operating costs
The Zed, because its financing is raised in Zeds
Either currency, as IAS 21 allows management a free choice of functional currency
ex:
Functional currency — entity faoliyat yuritadigan asosiy iqtisodiy muhit valyutasi. Primary factors: sotuv narxlari dollarda va AQSh bozori raqobati bilan belgilanadi; xarajatlar ham asosan dollarda → functional currency = dollar.
Financing (Zed'dagi kredit) — faqat secondary factor, primary factors aniq bo'lgani uchun hal qiluvchi emas. Ro'yxatdan o'tgan mamlakat ahamiyatsiz. Functional currency faktlar asosida aniqlanadi, erkin tanlanmaydi.

q: An entity may present its financial statements in any currency it chooses, but its functional currency is determined by the facts of its economic environment rather than by management choice.
ex: To'g'ri. IAS 21 entity'ga istalgan presentation currency'ni tanlashga ruxsat beradi. Functional currency esa tanlanmaydi — u primary va secondary factors asosida, entity'ning real iqtisodiy muhitidan kelib chiqib aniqlanadi.

q: Which TWO of the following statements explain why adjustments for foreign currency transactions are necessary in the financial statements of an individual entity?
opt: Transactions denominated in a foreign currency must be recorded in the entity's functional currency
The functional currency amount needed to settle a foreign currency receivable or payable changes as exchange rates move
IAS 21 requires all assets of an entity to be restated to current exchange rates at each reporting date
Foreign currency transactions must be kept in a separate set of books in the foreign currency until settled
ex:
Entity o'z buxgalteriyasini functional currency'da yuritadi, shuning uchun xorijiy valyutadagi har bir operatsiya tarjima qilinishi kerak. Bundan tashqari, kurs o'zgarsa, receivable/payable'ni yopish uchun kerak bo'ladigan functional currency summasi o'zgaradi — shu farq (exchange difference) hisobda aks etishi kerak.
Barcha aktivlar qayta tarjima qilinmaydi (non-monetary items tarixiy kursda qoladi). Alohida valyuta daftari talab qilinmaydi.

q: At what rate should a foreign currency purchase of goods be translated when it is first recognised under IAS 21?
opt: The closing rate at the reporting date
The exchange rate on the date the supplier is paid
The opening rate at the start of the accounting period
The spot exchange rate at the date of the transaction
ex: IAS 21: xorijiy valyutadagi operatsiya dastlab operatsiya sanasidagi spot rate (historic rate) bo'yicha functional currency'ga tarjima qilinadi. Agar kurslar sezilarli o'zgarmasa, amaliy yondashuv sifatida average rate ham ishlatilishi mumkin. Closing rate — faqat yil oxirida monetary items uchun; to'lov sanasidagi kurs — faqat settlement'ni yozish uchun.

q:
Denov Co has the dollar ($) as its functional currency. On 1 March 20X4 it bought goods on credit from an overseas supplier for Kr 84,000 when the exchange rate was Kr 2.4 : $1. At what amount should the purchase be recorded on 1 March 20X4?

Enter the amount in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Dastlabki tan olish — operatsiya sanasidagi spot rate bo'yicha.
Kr 84,000 ÷ 2.4 = $35,000
Provodka: Dr Purchases $35,000 / Cr Trade payables $35,000.

q: Which TWO of the following statements about the initial recognition of foreign currency transactions are correct under IAS 21?
opt: A sale is translated at the spot rate on the date the transaction first qualifies for recognition
An average rate for a week or month may be used as an approximation if exchange rates do not fluctuate significantly
Sales must be translated at the closing rate so that revenue agrees with the year-end receivables balance
Purchases are translated at the rate on the date the supplier is paid
The rate used for inventory purchases is updated to the month-end rate every month
ex:
Dastlabki tan olish: operatsiya sanasidagi spot rate. Amaliy yengillik sifatida, agar kurs sezilarli o'zgarmasa, hafta yoki oy uchun average rate ishlatish mumkin.
Revenue closing rate'da tarjima qilinmaydi (faqat monetary balans qayta tarjima qilinadi). To'lov sanasidagi kurs faqat settlement'ni yozish uchun. Inventory — non-monetary, kursi yangilanmaydi.

q:
Buxoro Co (functional currency: $) sold goods on credit for 150,000 dinars on 1 February 20X5 when the rate was 6.0 dinars : $1. The customer paid in full on 15 April 20X5 when the rate was 6.25 dinars : $1. What exchange loss should Buxoro Co recognise in profit or loss?

Enter the loss in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
1) Sotuv (1 fevral): 150,000 ÷ 6.0 = $25,000 → Dr Receivables / Cr Revenue.
2) To'lov (15 aprel): 150,000 ÷ 6.25 = $24,000 naqd olindi.
3) Receivable $25,000 yopilishi kerak, lekin faqat $24,000 keldi → exchange loss $1,000.
Provodka: Dr Cash 24,000, Dr P/L (exchange loss) 1,000, Cr Receivables 25,000. Revenue o'zgarmaydi.

q: Kogon Co (functional currency: $) bought inventory for €48,000 on 10 May 20X6 when €1 = $1.15. It paid the supplier in full on 20 June 20X6 when €1 = $1.10. What exchange difference arises on settlement?
opt: Loss of $2,400
Loss of $1,897
Gain of $2,400
No exchange difference; the inventory is reduced to $52,800
ex:
Kurs '€1 = $x' ko'rinishida berilgan → ko'paytiramiz.
Payable dastlab: 48,000 × 1.15 = $55,200.
To'langan pul: 48,000 × 1.10 = $52,800.
Kamroq dollar to'landi → gain $2,400 (P/L).
Inventory — non-monetary, $55,200 da qoladi, settlement uni o'zgartirmaydi. $1,897 — kursni noto'g'ri bo'lish natijasi.

q: Where should an exchange difference arising on the settlement of a foreign currency trade payable be recognised?
opt: In profit or loss for the period in which it arises
In other comprehensive income
As an adjustment to the cost of the inventory originally purchased
Directly in retained earnings
ex: Monetary items'ni settle qilish yoki qayta tarjima qilishdan kelib chiqqan exchange differences — o'sha davrning profit or loss'ida tan olinadi. Inventory cost'i o'zgartirilmaydi (u tarixiy kursda qoladi), OCI yoki retained earnings'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozilmaydi.

q:
Termiz Co (functional currency: $, year end 31 December 20X5) bought goods on credit for Kr 90,000 on 1 October 20X5 (rate Kr 4.5 : $1). It paid Kr 45,000 on 1 November 20X5 (rate Kr 5.0 : $1). The remaining Kr 45,000 was still unpaid at 31 December 20X5 (rate Kr 4.0 : $1). What is the net exchange loss recognised in profit or loss for the year?

Enter the net loss in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Dastlab: 90,000 ÷ 4.5 = $20,000 (har yarmi $10,000).
1) To'langan yarmi: 45,000 ÷ 5.0 = $9,000; balans $10,000 → gain $1,000.
2) To'lanmagan yarmi (monetary, closing rate): 45,000 ÷ 4.0 = $11,250; balans $10,000 → loss $1,250.
Net: 1,250 − 1,000 = loss $250.

q: If a foreign currency purchase is paid for before the reporting date, no exchange difference arises, because the transaction is complete before the financial statements are prepared.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Agar operatsiya sanasi va to'lov sanasi orasida kurs o'zgargan bo'lsa, settlement paytida exchange difference paydo bo'ladi: payable tarixiy kursda yozilgan, lekin to'lov to'lov sanasidagi kursda amalga oshadi. Farq — P/L'da gain yoki loss.

q: Which THREE of the following are monetary items under IAS 21?
opt: A trade receivable due in euros
A bank loan repayable in dinars
Inventory purchased from an overseas supplier
Land bought overseas
Cash held in a foreign currency bank account
ex:
Monetary items — qo'ldagi valyuta birliklari va belgilangan (fixed or determinable) miqdordagi valyuta birliklarida olinadigan yoki to'lanadigan aktiv/majburiyatlar: receivables, loans, cash.
Inventory va land — pul olish yoki berish huquqini bermaydi → non-monetary.

q: Which of the following is a non-monetary item under IAS 21?
opt: A trade payable due to a supplier in euros
Interest accrued on a foreign currency loan and payable next month
A loan repayable in dinars
Rent paid in advance to an overseas landlord for the next six months
ex:
Oldindan to'langan xarajat (prepayment) — non-monetary: entity kelajakda pul emas, xizmat (ijara foydalanishi) oladi. Shuning uchun u tarixiy kursda qoladi.
Trade payable, loan va accrued interest — belgilangan miqdordagi valyutada to'lanadi → monetary, closing rate'da qayta tarjima qilinadi.

q: A purchased software licence (an intangible asset) paid for in a foreign currency is a monetary item and must be retranslated at the closing rate.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Intangible asset pul olish huquqini bermaydi → non-monetary. Cost model'da u tarixiy (operatsiya sanasidagi) kursda qoladi va qayta tarjima qilinmaydi.

q: Which of the following is the IAS 21 description of monetary items?
opt: Any asset or liability that is measured at fair value at the reporting date
Units of currency held, and assets and liabilities to be received or paid in a fixed or determinable number of units of currency
Any asset that could be sold for cash within twelve months of the reporting date
Current assets and current liabilities only
ex: IAS 21 ta'rifi: monetary items — qo'ldagi valyuta birliklari hamda belgilangan yoki aniqlanadigan miqdordagi valyuta birliklarida olinadigan/to'lanadigan aktiv va majburiyatlar. Asosiy belgi — pul olish/berish huquqi yoki majburiyati. Inventory tez sotilishi mumkin, lekin baribir non-monetary; non-current loan esa monetary.

q:
Navoiy Co (functional currency: $) sold goods on credit for Kr 72,000 on 1 November 20X6 when the rate was Kr 3.6 : $1. The amount was still outstanding at the year end of 31 December 20X6, when the rate was Kr 4.0 : $1. At what amount should the trade receivable be shown in the statement of financial position at 31 December 20X6?

Enter the amount in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Dastlab: 72,000 ÷ 3.6 = $20,000 (Dr Receivables / Cr Revenue).
Receivable — monetary → closing rate: 72,000 ÷ 4.0 = $18,000.
Kamayish $2,000 — exchange loss (Dr P/L / Cr Receivables). Revenue $20,000 da qoladi.

q: Jizzax Co (functional currency: $) bought goods on credit for €30,000 on 15 November 20X7 when €1 = $1.20. The invoice was unpaid at the year end of 31 December 20X7 when €1 = $1.30. What should be recognised at 31 December 20X7 in respect of the payable?
opt: Trade payable $36,000 and no exchange difference
Trade payable $39,000 and an exchange gain of $3,000 in profit or loss
Trade payable $39,000 and an exchange loss of $3,000 in profit or loss
Trade payable $39,000 and an exchange loss of $3,000 in other comprehensive income
ex:
Dastlab: 30,000 × 1.20 = $36,000.
Yil oxiri (payable — monetary, closing rate): 30,000 × 1.30 = $39,000.
Majburiyat 3,000 ga oshdi → exchange loss $3,000, P/L'da (OCI emas).
Provodka: Dr P/L 3,000 / Cr Payables 3,000.
subtopic: Unsettled monetary items at year end
topic: Unsettled monetary items at year end

q:
Andijon Co (functional currency: $) borrowed 24 million dinars on 1 January 20X4 when the rate was 4.0 dinars : $1. It repaid 6 million dinars on 30 September 20X4 when the rate was 3.0 dinars : $1. The rate at the year end of 31 December 20X4 was 3.2 dinars : $1. Ignoring interest, what is the total exchange loss on the loan for the year ended 31 December 20X4?

Enter the loss in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Dastlab: 24m ÷ 4.0 = $6,000,000.
1) To'lov: 6m ÷ 3.0 = $2,000,000 to'landi; shu qismning balansi 6m ÷ 4.0 = $1,500,000 → loss $500,000.
2) Qolgan 18m (monetary, closing rate): 18m ÷ 3.2 = $5,625,000; balans 18m ÷ 4.0 = $4,500,000 → loss $1,125,000.
Jami loss = 500,000 + 1,125,000 = $1,625,000 ≈ 1,625 ($000). Loan bilan bog'liq bo'lgani uchun finance costs'da ko'rsatiladi.

q: Namangan Co (functional currency: $) borrowed €8 million on 1 January 20X5 when €1 = $1.10. The loan is repayable in full in 20X9. Rates were €1 = $1.25 at 31 December 20X5 and €1 = $1.15 at 31 December 20X6. Ignoring interest, what exchange difference should be recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X6?
opt: Loss of $400,000
Gain of $800,000
Gain of $400,000
ex:
Har yil oxirida loan oldingi balansdan yangi closing rate'ga qayta tarjima qilinadi.
31.12.X5: 8m × 1.25 = $10,000,000 (20X5 da loss 1,200,000).
31.12.X6: 8m × 1.15 = $9,200,000.
20X6 farqi: 10,000,000 − 9,200,000 = majburiyat kamaydi → gain $800,000.
Tuzoq: asl $8,800,000 bilan solishtirish (loss 400,000) noto'g'ri — 20X5 farqi allaqachon tan olingan.

q: Qarshi Co (functional currency: $) sold goods on credit for Kr 45,000 on 15 December 20X3 when the rate was Kr 9.0 : $1. At the year end of 31 December 20X3 the receivable was unpaid and the rate was Kr 7.5 : $1. What exchange difference should Qarshi Co recognise for the year ended 31 December 20X3?
opt: Loss of $1,000
Gain of $1,000
Nil, because the receivable is not yet settled
Gain of $67,500
ex:
Dastlab: 45,000 ÷ 9.0 = $5,000.
Yil oxiri: 45,000 ÷ 7.5 = $6,000.
Kr qimmatlashdi (bir dollarga kamroq Kr) → receivable dollarda oshdi → gain $1,000.
Settle bo'lmagan monetary item ham closing rate'da qayta tarjima qilinadi, shuning uchun 'nil' noto'g'ri. Kursga ko'paytirish esa ma'nosiz katta son beradi.
subtopic: Unsettled monetary items at year end
topic: Unsettled monetary items at year end

q: A trade payable denominated in a foreign currency that is still outstanding at the reporting date is translated using the closing rate.
ex: To'g'ri. Trade payable — monetary item, shuning uchun reporting date'da closing rate'da qayta tarjima qilinadi, farq P/L'ga.
subtopic: Unsettled monetary items at year end
topic: Unsettled monetary items at year end

q:
Guliston Co (functional currency: $) bought inventory for Kr 60,000 on 1 December 20X5 when the rate was Kr 2.5 : $1. The goods were unsold at the year end of 31 December 20X5, when the rate was Kr 3.0 : $1. Net realisable value is well above cost. At what amount should the inventory be measured at 31 December 20X5?

Enter the amount in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Inventory — non-monetary, cost'da o'lchanadi → tarixiy kursda qoladi.
60,000 ÷ 2.5 = $24,000.
Closing rate (60,000 ÷ 3.0 = $20,000) ishlatilmaydi. (Payable esa agar to'lanmagan bo'lsa, closing rate'da qayta tarjima qilinadi.)

q: Olmaliq Co (functional currency: $) bought land overseas for 45 million dinars on 1 July 20X6 when the rate was 5.0 dinars : $1. The land is held under the cost model. At the year end of 31 December 20X6 the rate was 4.0 dinars : $1 and the fair value of the land was 50 million dinars. What is the carrying amount of the land at 31 December 20X6?
ex:
Land — non-monetary, cost model → tarixiy kursda qoladi, qayta tarjima qilinmaydi va fair value e'tiborga olinmaydi.
45m ÷ 5.0 = $9,000,000.

q: Yunusobod Co (functional currency: $) bought land overseas for 45 million dinars when the rate was 5.0 dinars : $1. It uses the revaluation model and revalues the land to its fair value of 50 million dinars at the year end, when the rate is 4.0 dinars : $1. How should the land and the related gain be reported?
opt: Land $12,500,000; revaluation gain of $3,500,000 recognised in other comprehensive income
Land $11,250,000; exchange gain of $2,250,000 in profit or loss
Land $10,000,000; revaluation gain of $1,000,000 in other comprehensive income
Land $12,500,000; exchange gain of $2,250,000 in profit or loss and revaluation gain of $1,250,000 in other comprehensive income
ex:
Revaluation model'da fair value qayta baholash sanasidagi kursda tarjima qilinadi: 50m ÷ 4.0 = $12,500,000.
Cost: 45m ÷ 5.0 = $9,000,000. Umumiy o'sish = 12,500,000 − 9,000,000 = $3,500,000.
Exchange komponenti alohida P/L'ga ajratilmaydi: gain OCI'ga tushgani uchun uning exchange qismi ham OCI'ga tushadi.

q:
Zarafshon Co (functional currency: $) bought a machine for Kr 36 million on 1 January 20X6 when the rate was Kr 4.0 : $1. The machine is held under the cost model and is depreciated straight-line over 10 years with no residual value. At the year end of 31 December 20X6 the rate was Kr 3.0 : $1 and the average rate for the year was Kr 3.5 : $1. What is the carrying amount of the machine at 31 December 20X6?

Enter the amount in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Machine — non-monetary, cost model → tarixiy kursda: 36m ÷ 4.0 = $9,000,000.
Depreciation shu dollar cost'dan: 9,000,000 ÷ 10 = $900,000.
Carrying amount = 9,000,000 − 900,000 = $8,100,000 = 8,100 ($000).
Closing va average rate'lar ishlatilmaydi.

q: No exchange difference arises at the reporting date on a non-monetary asset carried at historical cost, because it is not retranslated.
ex: To'g'ri. Historical cost'dagi non-monetary items (inventory, PPE cost model, intangibles) tarixiy kursda qoladi va qayta tarjima qilinmaydi → exchange difference paydo bo'lmaydi. Farqlar faqat monetary items'da (yoki qayta baholangan non-monetary items'ning fair value'si ichida) yuzaga keladi.

q: Asaka Co (functional currency: $) bought inventory for Kr 50,000 when the rate was Kr 5 : $1. At the year end the goods are unsold, their net realisable value is Kr 48,000, and the closing rate is Kr 6 : $1. At what amount should the inventory be measured?
ex:
IAS 2: lower of cost va NRV. IAS 21 bo'yicha xorijiy valyutadagi inventory uchun: cost — tarixiy kursda, NRV — NRV aniqlangan sanadagi kursda (closing rate).
Cost = 50,000 ÷ 5 = $10,000.
NRV = 48,000 ÷ 6 = $8,000.
Pastrog'i = $8,000 → write-down $2,000 P/L'ga. Bu kurs o'zgarishi natijasida ham write-down kelib chiqishi mumkinligini ko'rsatadi.

q: Chimyon Co (functional currency: $) bought land on credit for 200,000 Zeds when Z1 = $0.40. At the year end the supplier had not been paid and Z1 = $0.45. The land is held under the cost model. Which THREE amounts would appear in Chimyon Co's financial statements for the year?
opt: Land of $80,000
Trade payable of $90,000
Exchange loss of $10,000 in profit or loss
Land of $90,000
Exchange gain of $10,000 in profit or loss
ex:
Dastlab: 200,000 × 0.40 = $80,000 (Dr Land / Cr Payables).
Land — non-monetary, cost model → $80,000 da qoladi.
Payable — monetary → 200,000 × 0.45 = $90,000.
Majburiyat oshdi → exchange loss $10,000 P/L'da.

q: Where should an exchange loss arising on the retranslation of a foreign currency bank loan normally be presented in the statement of profit or loss?
opt: Within finance costs
Within cost of sales
Within other comprehensive income
As a deduction from revenue
ex:
Exchange differences P/L'da, ammo qaysi qatorda — operatsiya turiga bog'liq:
• Trading (receivables, payables) → other operating income / operating expenses.
• Non-trading (loans) → finance costs yoki interest/investment income.
Bank loan — financing → finance costs.

q: Exchange gains arising on foreign currency trade receivables should be added to revenue for the year.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Revenue operatsiya sanasidagi kursda bir marta yoziladi va o'zgarmaydi. Trade receivables bo'yicha exchange gains — trading operatsiyasi bilan bog'liq, shuning uchun other operating income (yoki operating expenses'dan ayirish) sifatida ko'rsatiladi, revenue'ga qo'shilmaydi.

q: Under IAS 21, where are exchange differences arising on the retranslation of monetary items at the reporting date recognised in an individual entity's financial statements?
opt: In other comprehensive income
In profit or loss
Directly in retained earnings
Deferred in the statement of financial position until the item is settled
ex: Monetary items'ni settle qilish yoki closing rate'da qayta tarjima qilishdan kelib chiqqan exchange differences — profit or loss'da, ular yuzaga kelgan davrda tan olinadi. Ular kechiktirilmaydi (deferred) va OCI'ga yozilmaydi.

q: Which TWO of the following correctly describe the presentation of exchange differences in the statement of profit or loss?
opt: A gain on retranslating a trade payable is shown within other operating income (or netted against operating expenses)
A loss on retranslating a foreign currency loan is shown within finance costs
A gain on retranslating a trade receivable is added to revenue
A loss on retranslating a foreign currency loan is shown in other comprehensive income
A gain on settling a trade payable is deducted from the cost of the inventory purchased
ex:
Trading (receivables/payables) exchange differences → operating qatorlar (other operating income / operating expenses). Non-trading (loans) → finance costs / finance income.
Revenue va inventory cost'i o'zgartirilmaydi; loan farqlari OCI'ga emas, P/L'ga.

q:
Kosonsoy Co (functional currency: $) sold goods for €64,000 on 1 March 20X7 when €1 = $1.25. The customer paid on 30 April 20X7 when €1 = $1.20. What amount of revenue should be recognised for this sale?

Enter the amount in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Revenue — operatsiya sanasidagi kursda: 64,000 × 1.25 = $80,000. Keyin o'zgarmaydi.
To'lov: 64,000 × 1.20 = $76,800 → receivable bo'yicha exchange loss $3,200 alohida P/L'ga (operating expenses), revenue'dan ayirilmaydi.

q: Rishton Co (functional currency: $) bought inventory on credit for Kr 120,000 on 1 November 20X8 when the rate was Kr 6 : $1. Half of the goods were sold before the year end of 31 December 20X8. The supplier was unpaid at the year end, when the rate was Kr 5 : $1. Which of the following is correct for the year-end financial statements?
opt: Closing inventory $12,000; trade payable $24,000; exchange loss $4,000
Closing inventory $10,000; trade payable $20,000; no exchange difference
Closing inventory $12,000; trade payable $24,000; exchange loss $2,000
Closing inventory $10,000; trade payable $24,000; exchange loss $4,000
ex:
Xarid: 120,000 ÷ 6 = $20,000. Yarmi sotildi → closing inventory = $10,000 (tarixiy kursda, non-monetary).
Payable — monetary: 120,000 ÷ 5 = $24,000 → exchange loss 24,000 − 20,000 = $4,000.
Inventory closing rate'da qayta tarjima qilinmaydi; payable'ning hammasi (sotilgan qism uchun ham) qayta tarjima qilinadi.
subtopic: Unsettled monetary items at year end
topic: Unsettled monetary items at year end

q:
Marg'ilon Co (functional currency: $, year end 31 December 20X2) bought goods for 96,000 dinars on 1 October 20X2 (rate 8.0 dinars : $1). It paid 48,000 dinars on 1 November 20X2 (rate 7.5 dinars : $1). The balance was unpaid at 31 December 20X2 (rate 6.4 dinars : $1). What is the total exchange loss recognised for the year?

Enter the loss in $, to the nearest whole number.

Angren Co (functional currency: $) bought equipment for 500,000 riyals when 1 riyal = $0.26. At the year end, 1 riyal = $0.27. The equipment is held under the cost model. At what cost should the equipment be recorded?
ex:
Kurs '1 riyal = $x' ko'rinishida → ko'paytiramiz: 500,000 × 0.26 = $130,000.
Equipment — non-monetary, cost model → year-end kursi (0.27) ishlatilmaydi. Bo'lish esa kurs yo'nalishini chalkashtirish natijasi.

q:
Quvasoy Co (functional currency: $) has a €2 million loan carrying interest at 5% a year, payable annually in arrears on 31 December. Interest accrues evenly over the year and exchange rates did not fluctuate significantly, so Quvasoy Co translates the interest expense at the average rate for the year, as IAS 21 permits. The average rate for 20X4 was €1 = $1.18, and the interest was paid on 31 December 20X4 when €1 = $1.20. What interest expense should be recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X4?

Enter the amount in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Interest = 2,000,000 × 5% = €100,000.
Interest yil davomida bir tekis hisoblanadi (accrue) va kurs barqaror → IAS 21 bo'yicha average rate ishlatiladi: 100,000 × 1.18 = $118,000 (finance costs).
To'lov 31 dekabrda: 100,000 × 1.20 = $120,000 naqd to'landi. Accrual ($118,000) bilan farq $2,000 — interest expense emas, alohida exchange loss (finance costs ichida). Loan'ning o'zi ham alohida closing rate'da qayta tarjima qilinadi.

q: Olot Co (functional currency: $) paid a non-refundable deposit of Kr 40,000 to an overseas supplier on 1 December 20X5 (rate Kr 8 : $1) for goods to be delivered in February 20X6. At the year end of 31 December 20X5 the rate was Kr 10 : $1. How should the deposit be reported at 31 December 20X5?
opt: As a prepayment of $4,000, with an exchange loss of $1,000 in profit or loss
As a prepayment of $5,000, with no exchange difference
As a prepayment of $4,000, with an exchange loss of $1,000 in other comprehensive income
As a receivable of $4,000, with an exchange loss of $1,000 in profit or loss
ex:
Qaytarilmaydigan oldindan to'lov — entity pul emas, tovar oladi → non-monetary. Shuning uchun u to'lov sanasidagi kursda qoladi: 40,000 ÷ 8 = $5,000, qayta tarjima qilinmaydi, exchange difference yo'q.
Tovar kelganda inventory ham shu $5,000 ga (deposit qismi uchun) yoziladi.

q: When an item of property, plant and equipment denominated in a foreign currency is revalued, the exchange component of the revaluation gain is recognised separately in profit or loss, while the change in fair value is recognised in other comprehensive income.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Qayta baholanganda fair value qayta baholash sanasidagi kursda tarjima qilinadi va exchange komponenti alohida ajratilmaydi. Gain qayerga tushsa (revaluation surplus → OCI), uning exchange qismi ham o'sha yerga tushadi.

q:
Urgut Co (functional currency: $) sold goods for Kr 30,000 on 1 November 20X2 when the rate was Kr 5.0 : $1. At its year end of 31 December 20X2 the receivable was unpaid and the rate was Kr 6.0 : $1. The customer paid in full on 31 January 20X3 when the rate was Kr 4.8 : $1. What exchange gain should be recognised in the year ended 31 December 20X3?

Enter the gain in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
20X2: sotuv 30,000 ÷ 5.0 = $6,000; yil oxiri 30,000 ÷ 6.0 = $5,000 → 20X2 da loss $1,000.
20X3: receivable balansi endi $5,000. Olingan pul: 30,000 ÷ 4.8 = $6,250.
20X3 gain = 6,250 − 5,000 = $1,250.
Tuzoq: asl $6,000 bilan solishtirish (gain 250) — 20X2 farqini ikki marta hisoblash.

topic: Unsettled monetary items at year end

q: At the year end, a foreign currency trade payable is retranslated at the closing rate and its dollar amount increases. Which journal entry records this?
opt: Dr Profit or loss (exchange loss); Cr Trade payables
Dr Inventory; Cr Trade payables
Dr Trade payables; Cr Profit or loss (exchange gain)
Dr Other comprehensive income; Cr Trade payables
ex: Majburiyat oshdi → Cr Trade payables. Qarshi tomon — xarajat: Dr P/L (exchange loss). Inventory non-monetary, uning qiymati o'zgartirilmaydi; OCI ishlatilmaydi.
subtopic: Unsettled monetary items at year end
topic: Unsettled monetary items at year end

q: Nukus Co has the dollar as its functional currency. It buys goods from a supplier invoicing in Kromits and pays two months later. Why might the dollar amount paid differ from the dollar amount originally recorded for the purchase?
opt: IAS 21 requires the purchase to be recorded at the closing rate
The purchase must be recorded in Kromits, the supplier's functional currency
Settlement is always translated at the average rate for the year
The Kromit : dollar exchange rate changed between the transaction date and the payment date
ex: Xarid operatsiya sanasidagi kursda yoziladi, to'lov esa to'lov sanasidagi kursda amalga oshadi. Ikki sana orasida kurs o'zgarsa, to'langan dollar summasi yozilgan payable'dan farq qiladi → exchange difference (P/L). Xarid Nukus Co'ning functional currency'sida (dollar) yoziladi, supplier valyutasida emas.

q: Which THREE of the following statements are correct in respect of an individual entity's foreign currency transactions under IAS 21?
opt: Monetary items outstanding at the reporting date are retranslated at the closing rate
Non-monetary items measured at historical cost are not retranslated at the reporting date
Exchange differences on monetary items are recognised in profit or loss
Inventory on hand at the reporting date is retranslated at the closing rate
Exchange differences on settled sales are adjusted against revenue
ex:
IAS 21 asosiy qoidalari: monetary → closing rate; historical cost'dagi non-monetary → tarixiy kurs, qayta tarjima yo'q; monetary exchange differences → P/L.
Inventory — non-monetary, closing rate'da tarjima qilinmaydi. Revenue exchange difference bilan tuzatilmaydi.

q:
Boysun Co (functional currency: $) bought goods for Kr 18,000 when the rate was Kr 1.5 : $1 and paid the supplier a month later when the rate was Kr 1.6 : $1. What exchange gain arises on settlement?

Enter the gain in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:

To'langan: 18,000 ÷ 1.6 = $11,250.
Kamroq dollar to'landi → gain $750.
Provodka: Dr Payables 12,000 / Cr Cash 11,250 / Cr P/L 750.

q: Nurota Co (functional currency: $) made export sales of €1.2 million evenly during the year. Exchange rates did not fluctuate significantly and the average rate for the year was €1 = $1.08. At the year end, receivables of €150,000 were outstanding and the closing rate was €1 = $1.12. What amounts should be reported for revenue and year-end receivables from these sales?
opt: Revenue $1,296,000; receivables $162,000
Revenue $1,344,000; receivables $168,000
Revenue $1,296,000; receivables $168,000
Revenue $1,344,000; receivables $162,000
ex:
Kurs sezilarli o'zgarmagani uchun revenue'ni average rateda tarjima qilish mumkin: 1,200,000 × 1.08 = $1,296,000.
Receivables — monetary → closing rate: 150,000 × 1.12 = $168,000.
Farq P/L'da exchange difference sifatida tan olinadi; revenue closing rate'da qayta hisoblanmaydi.

The historic (spot) rate is the rate at the date the transaction takes place

The closing rate is the rate on the date a foreign currency invoice is paid
ex: Closing rate — reporting date'dagi spot rate. Historic (spot) rate — operatsiya sanasidagi kurs. Average rate — davr bo'yicha o'rtacha kurs, settlement sanasidagi kurs emas. To'lov sanasidagi kurs — shunchaki o'sha kundagi spot rate.

q: Pop Co (functional currency: $, year end 31 December) bought a machine for 5.4 million Zeds on 1 April 20X3 when Z1.8 = $1. It is depreciated straight-line over 5 years with no residual value, and held under the cost model. The rate at 31 December 20X3 was Z2.0 = $1 and the average rate for the year was Z1.9 = $1. What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 31 December 20X3?
ex:
Cost — tarixiy kursda: 5.4m ÷ 1.8 = $3,000,000.
