Depreciation non-monetary aktivning tarixiy dollar cost'idan hisoblanadi; closing yoki average rate ishlatilmaydi.

q:
Uchqo'rg'on Co (functional currency: $) sold goods that had cost $14,000 to an overseas customer for 90,000 dinars on 1 June 20X4, when the rate was 4.5 dinars : $1. The customer paid on 1 August 20X4 when the rate was 5.0 dinars : $1. What gross profit should be recognised on this sale?

Enter the amount in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Revenue — operatsiya sanasidagi kursda: 90,000 ÷ 4.5 = $20,000.
Gross profit = 20,000 − 14,000 = $6,000.
To'lovdagi exchange loss (20,000 − 18,000 = $2,000) gross profit'ga ta'sir qilmaydi — u alohida operating expenses'da ko'rsatiladi.

q: Which exchange rate should be used to report a foreign currency trade receivable that is still outstanding at the reporting date?
opt: The rate on the date of the sale
The closing rate
The average rate for the year
The rate expected on the date the customer will pay
ex: Trade receivable — monetary item → reporting date'dagi closing rate. Kelajakdagi (kutilayotgan) kurs ishlatilmaydi; tarixiy kurs faqat dastlabki tan olishda.

Land bought in dinars and held under the cost model

q:

  • Bought a machine for €600,000, paid immediately in cash. It is held under the cost model and depreciated straight-line over 8 years with no residual value.
  • Bought land for €1.5 million, paid immediately. The land is held under the revaluation model; its fair value at 31 March 20X6 was €1.6 million.
  • Borrowed €2 million, repayable in four equal annual instalments of €500,000 on 31 March each year, starting on 31 March 20X6 (ignore interest).
Exchange rates: 1 April 20X5 €1 = $1.10; 31 March 20X6 €1 = $1.20; average for the year €1 = $1.15.

What is the carrying amount of the machine at 31 March 20X6?

Enter the amount in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Cost (tarixiy kurs): 600,000 × 1.10 = $660,000.
Depreciation: 660,000 ÷ 8 = $82,500.
Carrying amount = 660,000 − 82,500 = $577,500. Closing va average rate ishlatilmaydi.

q:
Sirdaryo Co (functional currency: $; year end 31 March 20X6) entered into the following euro transactions on 1 April 20X5:
  • Bought a machine for €600,000, paid immediately in cash. It is held under the cost model and depreciated straight-line over 8 years with no residual value.
  • Bought land for €1.5 million, paid immediately. The land is held under the revaluation model; its fair value at 31 March 20X6 was €1.6 million.

How should the land be reported in the financial statements for the year ended 31 March 20X6?

ex: Noto'g'ri. Machine — non-monetary, cost model → tarixiy kursda: 600,000 × 1.10 = $660,000; depreciation = $82,500. Closing rate bo'yicha (90,000) hisoblash noto'g'ri.

q: Which of the following assets held by Orzu Co would NOT be classified as property, plant and equipment under IAS 16 Property, Plant and Equipment?
opt: Major spare parts expected to be used over more than one accounting period
Forklift trucks used in Orzu Co's own warehouse
Computers used by Orzu Co's accounts department
An office block owned solely to earn rental income from unrelated tenants
ex: PPE — ishlab chiqarish, xizmat ko'rsatish, ijaraga berish yoki administrativ maqsadlarda entity o'zi foydalanadigan, bir davrdan ko'p ishlatiladigan tangible aktivlar. Faqat ijara daromadi uchun ushlab turilgan bino — investment property (IAS 40), PPE emas. Forklift, kompyuterlar va bir yildan ko'p ishlatiladigan major spare parts — PPE. Javob: faqat ijara uchun ushlangan ofis binosi.

q: Sayram Co purchased a new packaging machine. Which THREE of the following costs should be included in the initial cost of the machine under IAS 16?
opt: Non-refundable import duties
Fees paid to an engineer to install the machine
Staff training on how to operate the machine
Recoverable sales tax charged by the supplier
Cost of delivery to Sayram Co's factory
ex: Cost = purchase price (trade discount'dan keyin) + qaytarilmaydigan import duties + aktivni ishlaydigan holatga keltirish uchun directly attributable xarajatlar (delivery, installation, professional fees). Staff training — expense (aktivni emas, xodimni rivojlantiradi). Qaytariladigan (recoverable) sales tax — soliq organidan qaytib keladi, cost emas. Javob: import duties, delivery, installation.

q:
On 1 March 20X6 Tandir Co bought a cutting machine. The following costs were incurred:
List price$480,000
Trade discount given5% of list price
Sales tax (fully recoverable)20% of the discounted price
Non-refundable import duty$12,000
Delivery$6,500
Installation$18,000
Testing that the machine works properly$4,000
Training of operators$9,000
One-year maintenance contract$7,200
What is the cost of the machine to be recognised under IAS 16? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Purchase price: 480,000 × 95% = 456,000. Recoverable sales tax — kiritilmaydi. Qo'shiladi: import duty 12,000 + delivery 6,500 + installation 18,000 + testing 4,000.
Jami = 456,000 + 12,000 + 6,500 + 18,000 + 4,000 = 496,500.
Training (9,000) va maintenance contract (7,200) — P/L expense.

q:
Bekobod Co constructed a new distribution centre for its own use. Costs incurred ($000):
Land3,200
Legal fees on land purchase85
Site clearance140
Materials (including $180,000 of materials destroyed in a flood)2,600
Labour (including $150,000 paid during a strike when no work was done)1,900
Architect and engineer fees210
Allocated general administration overheads320
Opening ceremony40
What amount should be included in property, plant and equipment? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Faqat normal, directly attributable xarajatlar kiritiladi.
Land 3,200 + legal fees 85 + site clearance 140 + materials (2,600 − 180 abnormal) 2,420 + labour (1,900 − 150 strike) 1,750 + architect 210 = 7,805 ($000).
General admin overheads (320) va opening ceremony (40) — expense. Toshqinda yo'qolgan material va ish to'xtagan davrdagi labour — abnormal cost, P/L'ga.

q: Which of the following costs can be included in the cost of a new production line under IAS 16?
opt: Initial operating losses incurred while demand for the output builds up
Costs of relocating staff to work on the new production line
Costs of testing whether the production line is functioning properly
Advertising costs to promote products made on the new line
ex: IAS 16 bo'yicha aktivni ishlaydigan holatga keltirish uchun zarur xarajatlar kiritiladi — to'g'ri ishlashini tekshirish (testing) shu jumlasiga kiradi. Boshlang'ich operating losses, xodimlarni ko'chirish va reklama — aktivni ishga tayyorlash bilan bog'liq emas, P/L expense. Javob: testing xarajatlari.

q: During testing of a new bottling plant, Chimyon Co produced and sold some bottled water for $15,000. Under IAS 16 (as amended), these sale proceeds should be deducted from the cost of the plant.
ex: Amended IAS 16 (Proceeds before Intended Use) bo'yicha test paytida ishlab chiqarilgan mahsulotni sotishdan tushgan pul va shu mahsulotning cost'i P/L'da tan olinadi — PPE cost'idan ayirilmaydi. Testing xarajatining o'zi esa cost'ga kiradi. Javob: False.

q: IAS 16 states that an item of property, plant and equipment should be recognised as an asset when which of the following conditions are met?
opt: It is probable that future economic benefits will flow to the entity and the cost can be measured reliably
The entity has legal title to the item and has paid for it in full
The item has a useful life of more than five years and a cost above a materiality limit
The item has a fair value that can be determined by reference to an active market
ex: IAS 16 recognition criteria (para 7): (1) kelajakdagi iqtisodiy foyda entity'ga probable ravishda keladi; (2) cost reliably o'lchanadi. Legal title, to'liq to'lov, active market yoki muddat talab qilinmaydi. Javob: probable benefits + reliable cost.

q: Navbahor Co has built a new factory. Which THREE of the following costs should be excluded from the cost of the factory?
opt: Materials wasted because of a design error
Allocated general administration overheads
Training costs for staff who will work in the factory
Site preparation costs
Fees paid to the structural engineer
ex: Cost'ga faqat directly attributable, normal xarajatlar kiradi: site preparation va professional (engineer) fees — kiradi. Chiqarib tashlanadi: general admin overheads (directly attributable emas), design xatosi tufayli isrof bo'lgan materiallar (abnormal), staff training (expense). Javob: admin overheads, wasted materials, training.

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Kaspiy Co completed an offshore gas platform at a construction cost of $24 million. Kaspiy Co has a legal obligation to remove the platform at the end of its 15-year life, at an estimated cost of $6 million. The appropriate discount rate is 7%.
At what amount should the platform be initially recognised (to the nearest $000)?
ex:
Dismantling cost'ning present value'si capitalise qilinadi: PV = 6,000 × 1/1.0715 = 6,000 × 0.3624 = 2,175 ($000).
Initial cost = 24,000 + 2,175 = 26,175 ($000). Undiscounted 6m qo'shish noto'g'ri; dismantling'ni umuman qo'shmaslik ham noto'g'ri; bir yillik diskont (×0.93) ham noto'g'ri.

q:
On 1 January 20X4 Zomin Mining Co opened a quarry at a cost of $9 million. It is required by law to restore the site when extraction ends in 10 years' time, at an estimated cost of $2.5 million. The quarry is depreciated straight-line over 10 years with no residual value. The discount rate is 8% and the 10-year discount factor at 8% is 0.463.
What is the total charge to profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X4 in respect of the quarry (depreciation plus finance cost)? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
Chirchiq Power Co has recognised the present value of the obligation to decommission a new plant. What is the double entry to record this obligation when the plant is constructed?
opt: Dr Profit or loss, Cr Provision
Dr Property, plant and equipment, Cr Provision
Dr Provision, Cr Property, plant and equipment
Dr Property, plant and equipment, Cr Cash
ex: Decommissioning majburiyatining PV'si aktiv cost'ining bir qismi — Dr PPE, va shu summaga majburiyat (IAS 37) — Cr Provision. Pul hali to'lanmagan, shuning uchun Cash emas; P/L'ga birdaniga ham yozilmaydi (depreciation orqali asta-sekin tushadi). Javob: Dr PPE, Cr Provision.

q: Where is the annual unwinding of the discount on a decommissioning provision recognised?
opt: As an addition to the cost of the related asset
In other comprehensive income
As a finance cost in profit or loss
As a deduction from the revaluation surplus
ex: Provision har yili diskont stavkasi bo'yicha oshadi (unwinding). Bu oshish finance cost sifatida P/L'ga yoziladi: Dr Finance costs, Cr Provision. U aktivga qo'shilmaydi va OCI'dan o'tmaydi. Javob: P/L finance cost.

q: Which THREE of the following statements about dismantling and restoration costs under IAS 16 are correct?
opt: The capitalised dismantling cost is depreciated over the useful life of the asset
The obligation is initially measured at the present value of the expected cost
The provision increases each year by the unwinding of the discount
The provision is only recognised when the dismantling work begins
The unwinding of the discount is capitalised as part of property, plant and equipment
ex: To'g'ri: provision har yili unwinding bilan oshadi; capitalise qilingan dismantling cost aktiv bilan birga useful life davomida depreciate qilinadi; majburiyat boshida PV'da o'lchanadi. Noto'g'ri: provision majburiyat paydo bo'lganda (aktiv qurilganda) tan olinadi, ish boshlanganda emas; unwinding — finance cost, PPE'ga qo'shilmaydi.

q: Termiz Foods Co incurred the following expenditure on its factory during the year. Which THREE items should be capitalised?
opt: An upgrade to a machine which increases its output by 25%
Routine monthly servicing of the conveyor belts
Repainting the factory walls in the company colours
Replacement of the factory roof, which is accounted for as a separate component
Construction of an extension which increases production capacity
ex: Capitalise: economic benefits'ni oshiradigan xarajat (kengaytma — capacity oshadi; upgrade — output 25% oshadi) va alohida componentni almashtirish (roof; eski tom derecognise qilinadi). Expense: repainting va routine servicing — faqat mavjud foydani saqlaydi (maintain).

q: Kitob Co spent $8,500 on routine repairs to its delivery vehicles during the year. How should this be accounted for?
opt: Expensed to profit or loss as incurred
Recognised as a separate component and depreciated over one year
Added to the cost of the vehicles and depreciated
Debited to the revaluation surplus
ex: Routine repairs — aktivning dastlab kutilgan foydasini saqlab turadi, oshirmaydi. Shu sababli darhol P/L'ga expense qilinadi. Javob: P/L expense.

q:
Qarshi Co bought a machine on 1 January 20X2 for $800,000. It was depreciated straight-line over 10 years with no residual value. On 1 January 20X6 the machine was upgraded at a cost of $150,000; this extended its remaining useful life from 6 years to 8 years. Qarshi Co also paid $12,000 for the annual service on the same date.
What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 31 December 20X6? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
CA at 1 Jan 20X6 = 800,000 − 4 × 80,000 = 480,000.
Upgrade life'ni uzaytiradi → capitalise: 480,000 + 150,000 = 630,000.
Depreciation = 630,000 / 8 = 78,750. Annual service 12,000 — expense (depreciation'ga kirmaydi).

q: Dengiz Shipping Co must dry-dock each of its vessels for a major inspection every four years in order to keep operating. How should the cost of the inspection be treated under IAS 16?
opt: Expensed to profit or loss as a repair when incurred
Provided for in advance by charging one quarter of the expected cost each year
Added to the cost of the hull and depreciated over the vessel's remaining life
Capitalised as a separate component and depreciated over four years until the next inspection
ex: Major inspection/overhaul — alohida component sifatida capitalise qilinadi va keyingi inspection'gacha (4 yil) depreciate qilinadi. Oldingi inspection'dan qolgan CA derecognise qilinadi. Oldindan provision qilish mumkin emas (present obligation yo'q). Javob: component, 4 yil.

q:
Yunusobod Towers Co owns an office building. Its lift system was recognised as a separate component at a cost of $300,000 with a useful life of 15 years and no residual value. After 10 years the lift system was removed and scrapped (no proceeds), and replaced by a new system costing $420,000.
What is the loss on derecognition of the old lift system? Enter the loss as a positive number in $.
ex: Eski lift CA = 300,000 − (300,000 / 15 × 10) = 300,000 − 200,000 = 100,000. Proceeds nil → loss = 100,000 P/L'ga. Yangi lift (420,000) alohida component sifatida capitalise qilinadi.

q: From which date should depreciation of a new item of plant begin under IAS 16?
opt: When the plant is available for use
When the plant is first used in production
When the invoice for the plant is paid
At the start of the next financial year
ex: IAS 16: depreciation aktiv available for use bo'lganda boshlanadi — ya'ni management ko'zlagan tarzda ishlashga tayyor bo'lganda. Haqiqatda ishlatila boshlanishini kutish kerak emas (masalan, xodimlar o'qitilayotgan bo'lsa ham). Javob: available for use.

q: If a machine is temporarily idle for three months because of low demand, depreciation should be suspended for that period.
ex: Depreciation aktiv idle bo'lsa ham to'xtamaydi (straight-line usulida). U faqat aktiv held for sale (IFRS 5) deb tasniflanganda yoki derecognise qilinganda to'xtaydi. Javob: False.

q:
Guliston Co bought a printing press on 1 January 20X3 for $360,000. It was depreciated straight-line over 8 years with an estimated residual value of $40,000. On 1 January 20X6 the directors revised the remaining useful life to 3 years; residual value is unchanged.
What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 31 December 20X6? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.

Angren Co has decided to change its depreciation method for plant from straight-line to reducing balance because this better reflects how the benefits are consumed. How should this change be accounted for?
opt: As a change in accounting policy, applied retrospectively with comparatives restated
As a prior period error, corrected against opening retained earnings
As a change in accounting estimate, applied prospectively from the current period
As a change in accounting policy, applied prospectively without restatement
ex: IAS 16: depreciation method o'zgarishi — change in accounting estimate (IAS 8). U prospective qo'llanadi: joriy CA qolgan useful life davomida yangi usulda depreciate qilinadi. Comparatives qayta hisoblanmaydi. Javob: estimate, prospective.

q:
Nurota Co bought a machine on 1 October 20X1 for $250,000. It was depreciated straight-line over 10 years with no residual value. With effect from 1 October 20X4, Nurota Co decided that the reducing balance method at 25% per annum better reflects the pattern of use.
What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 30 September 20X5? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
SL depreciation = 250,000/10 = 25,000 yiliga. 3 yil (20X2, 20X3, 20X4 yillar) → accumulated 75,000.
CA at 1 Oct 20X4 = 250,000 − 75,000 = 175,000.
Yangi usul prospective: 175,000 × 25% = 43,750.

q:
Jizzax Co bought plant for $64,000 on 1 July 20X4. Plant is depreciated at 20% per annum on the reducing balance basis, time-apportioned in the year of acquisition. The year end is 31 December.
What is the carrying amount of the plant at 31 December 20X5?

Kosonsoy Co bought a crane for $900,000. The crane has a physical life of 12 years, but Kosonsoy Co intends to use it for 5 years and then sell it. The expected residual value after 5 years, at current prices, is $300,000.
What is the annual depreciation charge?
ex:
Depreciable amount = cost − residual value = 900,000 − 300,000 = 600,000. Useful life — entity uchun foydalanish muddati (5 yil), physical life (12) emas.
Depreciation = 600,000 / 5 = 120,000.

q: Which THREE of the following statements about residual values and useful lives under IAS 16 are correct?
opt: The useful life is always the same as the asset's physical life
If the residual value is equal to or greater than the carrying amount, the depreciation charge is zero
They should be reviewed at least at each financial year end
A change in useful life requires the comparative figures to be restated
A change in estimate is accounted for prospectively
ex: To'g'ri: kamida har yil oxirida review qilinadi; o'zgarish prospective (IAS 8 estimate); residual value ≥ CA bo'lsa depreciation nolga teng. Noto'g'ri: comparatives restate qilinmaydi; useful life — entity uchun foydalanish muddati, physical life'dan qisqa bo'lishi mumkin.

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Parkent Co bought a freehold property for $2,400,000, of which $600,000 relates to the land. The building has a useful life of 40 years and no residual value.
What is the annual depreciation charge?
ex: Land odatda depreciate qilinmaydi (cheksiz foydalanish muddati). Faqat building: (2,400,000 − 600,000) / 40 = 45,000. 60,000 — land'ni ham depreciate qilish xatosi.

q: When an entity changes its depreciation method, the cumulative difference between the old and new methods is adjusted against opening retained earnings.
ex: Depreciation method o'zgarishi — change in accounting estimate, prospective qo'llanadi. Opening retained earnings'ga tuzatish faqat accounting policy o'zgarishi yoki prior period error uchun (retrospective). Javob: False.

q: Which TWO of the following statements about depreciation under IAS 16 are correct?
opt: Depreciation is not required if the fair value of the asset is higher than its carrying amount
The machine hours method is not permitted by IAS 16
The depreciation method should reflect the pattern in which the asset's economic benefits are consumed
Land normally has an unlimited useful life and is therefore not depreciated
ex: To'g'ri: method benefits'ning iste'mol qilinish tartibini aks ettiradi; land odatda depreciate qilinmaydi. Noto'g'ri: fair value CA'dan yuqori bo'lsa ham depreciation baribir hisoblanadi; machine hours (units of production) usuliga ruxsat bor.

q:
On 1 January 20X6 Samo Air Co bought an aircraft for $60 million. The cost is made up of: engines $12 million (useful life 6 years), cabin interior $8 million (useful life 5 years) and airframe $40 million (useful life 25 years). None of the parts has a residual value.
What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 31 December 20X6? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Har bir significant component alohida depreciate qilinadi:
Engines 12,000/6 = 2,000
Cabin 8,000/5 = 1,600
Airframe 40,000/25 = 1,600
Jami = 5,200 ($000). (Agar butun 60,000/25 = 2,400 desa — xato.)

q:
Orol Shipping Co bought a vessel on 1 January 20X2 for $36 million. The vessel has a 30-year life and no residual value. $3 million of the cost relates to a major dry-dock inspection required every 3 years. The next inspection was carried out on 31 December 20X4 at a cost of $3.9 million.
What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 31 December 20X5? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Vessel ikki component: inspection (3,000 / 3 yil) va qolgan qism (33,000 / 30 yil = 1,100).
31 Dec 20X4 da yangi inspection 3,900 capitalise qilinadi (eski inspection component to'liq depreciate bo'lgan).
20X5: 3,900 / 3 = 1,300 + 1,100 = 2,400 ($000).

q:
Buloq Co acquired a new office building on 1 April 20X5. The cost was made up as follows ($000): land 3,000; building structure 15,000 (useful life 50 years); heating and lift systems 5,000 (useful life 20 years). Depreciation is straight-line and time-apportioned.
What is the carrying amount of the office building at 31 December 20X5?
ex:
Land — depreciate qilinmaydi. 9 oy (Apr–Dec):
Structure: 15,000/50 × 9/12 = 225.0
Systems: 5,000/20 × 9/12 = 187.5
CA = 23,000 − 225.0 − 187.5 = 22,587.5 ($000) = $22,587,500.
Distractorlar: component'larni birlashtirib 50 yilda; to'liq yil; land'ni ham depreciate qilish.

q: Each part of an item of property, plant and equipment with a cost that is significant in relation to the total cost of the item should be depreciated separately.
ex: IAS 16 component accounting: significant qismlar (masalan, samolyot engine'i, binodagi lift) o'z useful life'i bo'yicha alohida depreciate qilinadi. Javob: True.

q: Halfway through its expected life, one of the engines of Buxoro Air Co's aircraft was damaged beyond repair and replaced with a new engine. Engines are accounted for as a separate component. What is the correct treatment?
opt: Expense the cost of the new engine as a repair and continue depreciating the old engine
Capitalise the new engine and continue depreciating the old engine over its original life
Derecognise the carrying amount of the old engine, capitalise the new engine and depreciate it over its own useful life
Add the cost of the new engine to the airframe and depreciate it over the airframe's remaining life
ex: Component almashtirilganda: eski engine'ning CA'si derecognise qilinadi (P/L'ga loss), yangi engine capitalise qilinib o'z useful life'i bo'yicha depreciate qilinadi. Uni repair deb expense qilish yoki airframe bilan qo'shib yuborish noto'g'ri. Javob: derecognise + capitalise.

q: Which THREE of the following would normally be identified as separate components of an item of property, plant and equipment for depreciation purposes?
opt: An annual maintenance contract for a production line
The cost of a major inspection of a ship required every five years
The lift system in an office building
The engines of an aircraft
ex: Component — significant, boshqa qismdan farqli useful life'ga ega bo'lgan qism: aircraft engines, binodagi lift, major inspection (keyingi inspection'gacha depreciate). Annual maintenance contract — xizmat xarajati, P/L expense, aktiv komponenti emas.

q: Which TWO of the following are requirements of IAS 16 when an entity adopts the revaluation model?
opt: Valuations must be carried out by an independent qualified valuer
Revaluations must be made with sufficient regularity so that the carrying amount does not differ materially from fair value
If one item is revalued, the entire class of assets to which it belongs must be revalued
All assets under the revaluation model must be revalued every year
ex: IAS 16 talablari: (1) butun class revalue qilinadi (tanlab revalue qilish — cherry-picking mumkin emas); (2) CA fair value'dan materially farq qilmasligi uchun sufficient regularity. Har yili revalue qilish shart emas (volatil aktivlar uchungina amalda kerak bo'lishi mumkin), independent valuer ham majburiy emas.

q:
Bo'ston Co's trial balance at 1 April 20X5 includes a property at cost of $18 million (30-year original life, nil residual value) with accumulated depreciation of $6 million. On 1 October 20X5 the property was revalued to $16.5 million. There is no change to the total useful life.
What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 31 March 20X6? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
1 Apr – 30 Sep (6 oy) eski asosda: 18,000/30 × 6/12 = 300.
1 Oct 20X5 da o'tgan muddat: 10 yil + 0.5 yil = 10.5 yil → qolgan life = 19.5 yil.
1 Oct – 31 Mar (6 oy) yangi asosda: 16,500 / 19.5 × 6/12 = 423.08.
Jami = 300 + 423.08 = 723.08 ≈ 723 ($000).

q: Under IAS 16, how is a gain on the upward revaluation of a building (with no previous revaluation loss) recognised?
opt: In profit or loss as other income
Directly in retained earnings
As a deferred income liability released over the building's remaining life
In other comprehensive income and accumulated in a revaluation surplus within equity
ex: Revaluation gain — OCI orqali, equity'dagi revaluation surplus'ga. U realised emas, shuning uchun P/L yoki retained earnings'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tmaydi. (Faqat avval P/L'ga yozilgan revaluation loss'ni reverse qilayotgan qismi P/L'ga boradi.)

q: A revaluation surplus is a distributable reserve that can be used to pay dividends to shareholders.
ex: Revaluation surplus — unrealised capital reserve, dividend uchun taqsimlanmaydi. U faqat excess depreciation transferi yoki aktiv sotilganda retained earnings'ga o'tadi. Javob: False.

q:
Uchqo'rg'on Co revalued a building at the start of the year. Before the revaluation the building had a cost of $800,000 and accumulated depreciation of $240,000. The valuation was $900,000.
Which journal records the revaluation?
opt: Dr PPE $100,000, Dr Accumulated depreciation $240,000, Cr Profit or loss $340,000
Dr PPE $100,000, Cr Revaluation surplus $100,000
Dr PPE $340,000, Cr Revaluation surplus $340,000, with accumulated depreciation unchanged
Dr PPE $100,000, Dr Accumulated depreciation $240,000, Cr Revaluation surplus $340,000
ex:
CA = 800,000 − 240,000 = 560,000; valuation 900,000 → surplus = 340,000.
Qadamlar: (1) cost'ni valuation'ga olib chiqish: Dr PPE 100,000 (900,000 − 800,000); (2) accumulated depreciation'ni yo'qotish: Dr Acc. depreciation 240,000; (3) Cr Revaluation surplus (OCI) 340,000. P/L'ga emas.

q:
Yakkabog' Co's warehouse has a carrying amount of $1,200,000 and is revalued to $950,000. The revaluation surplus contains $150,000 relating to this warehouse from an earlier revaluation.
How should the revaluation loss be recognised?
opt: $250,000 in profit or loss
$250,000 in other comprehensive income
$150,000 in other comprehensive income and $100,000 in profit or loss
$100,000 in other comprehensive income and $150,000 in profit or loss
ex: Loss = 1,200,000 − 950,000 = 250,000. Avval shu aktivga tegishli surplus'ga (OCI orqali) qarshi: 150,000. Qolgani 100,000 — P/L (impairment expense).

q:
Boysun Co's head office, which has never previously been revalued, is revalued downwards by $80,000 at the year end. The company has a revaluation surplus of $200,000 relating to a different property in the same class.
How should the $80,000 decrease be recognised?
opt: As an expense in profit or loss
In other comprehensive income, reducing retained earnings
As a reduction in the revaluation surplus relating to the other property
As a deferred debit to be offset against future revaluation gains
ex: Revaluation loss faqat o'sha aktivga tegishli surplus bilan qoplanishi mumkin. Boshqa bino surplus'i bilan offset qilish taqiqlangan. Bu bino uchun surplus yo'q → 80,000 to'liq P/L. Javob: P/L expense.

q:
Kattaqo'rg'on Co bought land for $700,000 on 1 January 20X2 and uses the revaluation model. At 31 December 20X3 the land was revalued to $560,000 and the loss was correctly charged to profit or loss. At 31 December 20X5 the land was revalued to $820,000.
What amount should be recognised in other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 December 20X5? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Jami oshish = 820,000 − 560,000 = 260,000.
Avval P/L'ga yozilgan loss 140,000 — reversal sifatida P/L'ga (income).
Qolgani OCI'ga: 260,000 − 140,000 = 120,000.

q: Under IAS 16, a revaluation loss on one building may be offset against a revaluation surplus on another building in the same class of assets.
ex: Gains va losses aktiv bo'yicha alohida hisoblanadi. Boshqa aktivning surplus'i bilan offset qilish mumkin emas. Javob: False.

q:
On 1 April 20X5 the fair value of Xiva Co's property was $250,000 with a remaining useful life of 25 years. At that date the revaluation surplus relating to the property was $30,000. Xiva Co revalues the property at each year end and does not transfer excess depreciation. At 31 March 20X6 the property was valued at $205,000.
What is the total charge to profit or loss for the year ended 31 March 20X6, and the loss recognised in other comprehensive income?
opt: Profit or loss $10,000; OCI loss $35,000
Profit or loss $15,000; OCI loss $30,000
Profit or loss $5,000; OCI loss $30,000
Profit or loss $45,000; OCI loss nil

q: Which TWO of the following statements about revaluation decreases under IAS 16 are correct?
opt: A decrease is recognised in other comprehensive income to the extent of any credit balance in the revaluation surplus for that asset
A decrease on an asset that has never been revalued upwards is recognised in retained earnings directly
A decrease in excess of the surplus for that asset is recognised in profit or loss
All revaluation decreases must be recognised in other comprehensive income
ex: Pasayish avval shu aktivning surplus'iga (OCI) qarshi, ortig'i P/L'ga. Hamma pasayish OCI'ga ketmaydi; surplus'i bo'lmagan aktivning pasayishi retained earnings'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, P/L orqali ketadi.

q:
Chust Co bought a building for $4,000,000 with a useful life of 40 years and no residual value. After 10 years the building was revalued to $4,500,000, with the remaining useful life unchanged at 30 years. Chust Co transfers the excess depreciation from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings each year.
What is the annual transfer? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Yangi depreciation = 4,500,000 / 30 = 150,000.
Historical cost depreciation = 4,000,000 / 40 = 100,000.
Excess depreciation transfer = 50,000 (Dr Revaluation surplus, Cr Retained earnings).

q: Where is the annual transfer of excess depreciation from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings presented?
opt: In profit or loss as a reduction of the depreciation charge
In other comprehensive income as a reclassification adjustment
In the statement of changes in equity only
In the statement of cash flows as a non-cash adjustment
ex: Transfer — equity ichidagi ko'chirish (Dr Revaluation surplus, Cr Retained earnings). U faqat SOCIE'da ko'rsatiladi, OCI yoki P/L'dan o'tmaydi. P/L'dagi depreciation to'liq revalued summa bo'yicha qoladi.

q:
Denov Co bought a building on 1 January 20X1 for $2.4 million with a useful life of 30 years and no residual value. On 1 January 20X7 it was revalued to $3.0 million, with no change in the remaining useful life. Denov Co makes an annual transfer of excess depreciation to retained earnings.
What is the balance on the revaluation surplus at 31 December 20X8? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
IAS 16 requires an entity using the revaluation model to transfer excess depreciation from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings each year.
ex: Transfer IAS 16 bo'yicha permitted (ruxsat etilgan), majburiy emas. Imtihonda savol entity transfer qilish-qilmasligini aytadi. Javob: False.

q:
Shahrisabz Co's building (original cost $1,200,000) was revalued to $1,500,000 on 1 January 20X4, when its remaining useful life was 20 years (no residual value). The building was sold on 31 December 20X6 for $1,380,000.
What is the gain on disposal recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X6?
ex:
Gain = proceeds − revalued CA.
CA = 1,500,000 − 3 × (1,500,000/20) = 1,500,000 − 225,000 = 1,275,000.
Gain = 1,380,000 − 1,275,000 = 105,000. Original cost bilan solishtirish noto'g'ri. Surplus alohida retained earnings'ga o'tkaziladi.

q: Under IAS 16, which of the following is the permitted treatment of any remaining balance on the revaluation surplus relating to a revalued asset when that asset is sold?
opt: Reclassified to profit or loss as part of the gain on disposal
Transferred to the revaluation surplus of another asset in the same class
Reported as other comprehensive income in the year of disposal
Transferred directly to retained earnings through the statement of changes in equity
ex: IAS 16 bo'yicha aktiv derecognise qilinganda qolgan surplus realised bo'ladi va uni SOCIE orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri retained earnings'ga o'tkazish ruxsat etiladi (Dr Revaluation surplus, Cr Retained earnings). IAS 16 surplus'ni P/L'ga recycle qilishga ruxsat bermaydi, u OCI'da ham qayta ko'rsatilmaydi, boshqa aktivning surplus'iga ham o'tkazilmaydi (surplus aktiv bo'yicha alohida yuritiladi). Javob: retained earnings'ga, SOCIE orqali.

q:
Mo'ynoq Co bought a property on 1 January 20X2 for $9 million (land $2 million; building $7 million, useful life 35 years). On 31 December 20X4 the property was revalued to $10.4 million (land $2.6 million; building $7.8 million), with the remaining life of the building estimated at 32 years. The property was sold on 31 December 20X7 for $9.9 million.
What is the gain on disposal recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X7? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Revaluation'dan keyin building depreciation = 7,800/32 = 243.750 ($000) yiliga; 3 yil (20X5–20X7) = 731.250.
Building CA = 7,800 − 731.250 = 7,068.750; land 2,600 (depreciate qilinmaydi).
Jami CA = 9,668.750.
Gain = 9,900 − 9,668.750 = 231.250 ($000) = $231,250.

q: Under IAS 16, when should an item of property, plant and equipment be derecognised?
opt: On disposal, or when no future economic benefits are expected from its use or disposal
When it has been fully depreciated
When its fair value falls below its carrying amount
Only when it is sold for cash
ex: Derecognition: (1) disposal (sotish, almashish, hadya) yoki (2) foydalanishdan ham, sotishdan ham future economic benefits kutilmaganda. To'liq depreciate bo'lgan aktiv hali ishlatilayotgan bo'lsa, balansda qoladi. FV pasayishi — impairment masalasi.

q: Which TWO of the following statements about the disposal of a previously revalued building are correct?
opt: The gain on disposal is presented as revenue
The remaining revaluation surplus is added to the gain on disposal in profit or loss
Any remaining revaluation surplus for the building may be transferred to retained earnings
The gain or loss is the difference between the net sale proceeds and the carrying amount based on the revalued amount
ex: To'g'ri: gain/loss = net proceeds − revalued CA; qolgan surplus retained earnings'ga o'tkaziladi (SOCIE). Noto'g'ri: surplus P/L'ga recycle qilinmaydi; disposal gain — revenue emas (odatda other income).

q:
Almaz Co prepares financial statements to 31 December. It bought its head office on 1 January 20X1 for $6,000,000 (land $1,500,000; building $4,500,000 with a useful life of 45 years and no residual value). Almaz Co adopted the revaluation model and on 1 January 20X6 the head office was valued at $7,000,000 (land $2,000,000; building $5,000,000). The remaining useful life of the building was 40 years at that date. Almaz Co transfers excess depreciation from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings each year. On 31 December 20X8 the head office was sold for $6,700,000.
Which TWO of the following statements about the revaluation on 1 January 20X6 are correct?
opt: Accumulated depreciation of $500,000 on the building is eliminated
A gain of $1,500,000 is recognised in other comprehensive income
A gain of $1,000,000 is recognised in profit or loss
The land is not revalued because it is not depreciated
ex:
Building CA at 1 Jan 20X6 = 4,500 − 5 × (4,500/45) = 4,500 − 500 = 4,000 ($000); land 1,500. Jami CA = 5,500.
Surplus = 7,000 − 5,500 = 1,500 ($000) → OCI. Accumulated depreciation 500 yo'qotiladi. Gain P/L'ga bormaydi; land ham (butun class) revalue qilinadi.

q:
Almaz Co prepares financial statements to 31 December. It bought its head office on 1 January 20X1 for $6,000,000 (land $1,500,000; building $4,500,000 with a useful life of 45 years and no residual value). Almaz Co adopted the revaluation model and on 1 January 20X6 the head office was valued at $7,000,000 (land $2,000,000; building $5,000,000). The remaining useful life of the building was 40 years at that date. Almaz Co transfers excess depreciation from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings each year. On 31 December 20X8 the head office was sold for $6,700,000.
What is the depreciation charge on the head office for the year ended 31 December 20X6?
ex: Revaluation'dan keyin faqat building depreciate qilinadi, qolgan life bo'yicha: 5,000,000 / 40 = 125,000. Land'ni qo'shish (7,000,000/40) yoki eski 45 yillik life'ni ishlatish noto'g'ri.

q:
Almaz Co prepares financial statements to 31 December. It bought its head office on 1 January 20X1 for $6,000,000 (land $1,500,000; building $4,500,000 with a useful life of 45 years and no residual value). Almaz Co adopted the revaluation model and on 1 January 20X6 the head office was valued at $7,000,000 (land $2,000,000; building $5,000,000). The remaining useful life of the building was 40 years at that date. Almaz Co transfers excess depreciation from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings each year. On 31 December 20X8 the head office was sold for $6,700,000.
What is the annual transfer of excess depreciation from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Revalued depreciation 5,000,000/40 = 125,000; historical cost depreciation 4,500,000/45 = 100,000.
Transfer = 25,000 yiliga (SOCIE'da).

q:
Almaz Co prepares financial statements to 31 December. It bought its head office on 1 January 20X1 for $6,000,000 (land $1,500,000; building $4,500,000 with a useful life of 45 years and no residual value). Almaz Co adopted the revaluation model and on 1 January 20X6 the head office was valued at $7,000,000 (land $2,000,000; building $5,000,000). The remaining useful life of the building was 40 years at that date. Almaz Co transfers excess depreciation from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings each year. On 31 December 20X8 the head office was sold for $6,700,000.
What is the gain on disposal recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X8? Enter your answer in $.

Almaz Co prepares financial statements to 31 December. It bought its head office on 1 January 20X1 for $6,000,000 (land $1,500,000; building $4,500,000 with a useful life of 45 years and no residual value). Almaz Co adopted the revaluation model and on 1 January 20X6 the head office was valued at $7,000,000 (land $2,000,000; building $5,000,000). The remaining useful life of the building was 40 years at that date. Almaz Co transfers excess depreciation from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings each year. On 31 December 20X8 the head office was sold for $6,700,000.
What amount will be transferred from the revaluation surplus to retained earnings as a result of the disposal on 31 December 20X8?
ex:
Surplus 1 Jan 20X6: 1,500,000. 20X6–20X8 yillarda har yili 25,000 transfer qilingan: 3 × 25,000 = 75,000.
Disposal'da qolgan balans = 1,500,000 − 75,000 = 1,425,000 → retained earnings'ga.

q:
Kamalak Co prepares financial statements to 31 March. During the year to 31 March 20X6 it constructed a chemical processing plant for its own use. Costs incurred ($000):
Materials2,600
Direct labour (including $120,000 paid during a 3-week stoppage caused by a dispute)1,800
Production overheads directly attributable to the construction1,080
Allocated head office administration costs90
Kamalak Co normally adds a 25% mark-up on cost when selling similar plant to customers. The plant was completed and available for use on 1 October 20X5 but did not start production until 1 January 20X6. Kamalak Co is legally required to dismantle the plant at the end of its 10-year life at an estimated cost of $1,000,000; the discount rate is 8% and the 10-year discount factor at 8% is 0.463. Depreciation is straight-line, time-apportioned, with no residual value.
What is the initial cost of the plant to be recognised in property, plant and equipment at 1 October 20X5? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Materials 2,600 + labour (1,800 − 120 abnormal) 1,680 + production overheads 1,080 + dismantling PV (1,000 × 0.463) 463 = 5,823 ($000).
Head office admin (90) va mark-up kiritilmaydi.

q:
Kamalak Co prepares financial statements to 31 March. During the year to 31 March 20X6 it constructed a chemical processing plant for its own use. Costs incurred ($000):
Materials2,600
Direct labour (including $120,000 paid during a 3-week stoppage caused by a dispute)1,800
Production overheads directly attributable to the construction1,080
Allocated head office administration costs90

Depreciation is straight-line, time-apportioned, with no residual value.
How should Kamalak Co's normal 25% mark-up be treated in measuring the cost of the plant?
opt: It is included, because the plant has a fair value equal to its selling price
It is included and credited to other comprehensive income
It is excluded, because the plant is measured at cost and an entity cannot make a profit by selling to itself
It is included and credited to profit or loss as revenue
ex: Self-constructed aktiv cost'da o'lchanadi — xuddi tashqariga sotiladigan mahsulotni ishlab chiqarish cost'i kabi. Mark-up (ichki foyda) cost emas: entity o'zi-o'ziga sotib foyda ko'ra olmaydi. Javob: kiritilmaydi.

q:
Kamalak Co prepares financial statements to 31 March. During the year to 31 March 20X6 it constructed a chemical processing plant for its own use. Costs incurred ($000):
Materials2,600
Direct labour (including $120,000 paid during a 3-week stoppage caused by a dispute)1,800
Production overheads directly attributable to the construction1,080
Allocated head office administration costs90
Kamalak Co normally adds a 25% mark-up on cost when selling similar plant to customers. The plant was completed and available for use on 1 October 20X5 but did not start production until 1 January 20X6. Kamalak Co is legally required to dismantle the plant at the end of its 10-year life at an estimated cost of $1,000,000; the discount rate is 8% and the 10-year discount factor at 8% is 0.463. Depreciation is straight-line, time-apportioned, with no residual value.
What is the depreciation charge for the plant for the year ended 31 March 20X6? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Depreciation available for use sanasidan (1 Oct 20X5) boshlanadi → 6 oy.
5,823 / 10 × 6/12 = 291.15 ≈ 291 ($000).

Kamalak Co prepares financial statements to 31 March. During the year to 31 March 20X6 it constructed a chemical processing plant for its own use. Costs incurred ($000):
Materials2,600
Direct labour (including $120,000 paid during a 3-week stoppage caused by a dispute)1,800
Production overheads directly attributable to the construction1,080
Allocated head office administration costs90
Kamalak Co normally adds a 25% mark-up on cost when selling similar plant to customers. The plant was completed and available for use on 1 October 20X5 but did not start production until 1 January 20X6. Kamalak Co is legally required to dismantle the plant at the end of its 10-year life at an estimated cost of $1,000,000; the discount rate is 8% and the 10-year discount factor at 8% is 0.463. Depreciation is straight-line, time-apportioned, with no residual value.
What finance cost should be recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 March 20X6 in respect of the dismantling provision? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Provision 1 Oct 20X5 da tan olinadi: 463,000.
Unwinding 6 oy: 463,000 × 8% × 6/12 = 18,520 (Dr Finance costs, Cr Provision).

q:
Kamalak Co prepares financial statements to 31 March. During the year to 31 March 20X6 it constructed a chemical processing plant for its own use. Costs incurred ($000):
Materials2,600
Direct labour (including $120,000 paid during a 3-week stoppage caused by a dispute)1,800
Production overheads directly attributable to the construction1,080
Allocated head office administration costs90
Kamalak Co normally adds a 25% mark-up on cost when selling similar plant to customers. The plant was completed and available for use on 1 October 20X5 but did not start production until 1 January 20X6. Kamalak Co is legally required to dismantle the plant at the end of its 10-year life at an estimated cost of $1,000,000; the discount rate is 8% and the 10-year discount factor at 8% is 0.463. Depreciation is straight-line, time-apportioned, with no residual value.
True or false: depreciation of the plant should start on 1 January 20X6, when production began.
ex: Depreciation aktiv available for use bo'lganda boshlanadi — 1 Oct 20X5. Ishlab chiqarish keyinroq boshlangani ahamiyatsiz. Javob: False.

q: Which of the following is a government grant as defined by IAS 20 Accounting for Government Grants and Disclosure of Government Assistance?
opt: A government ministry buying office furniture from Bekobod Co at normal commercial prices
Free export-market advice given to Bekobod Co by a government trade department, which cannot reasonably be valued
A new public motorway built by the government next to Bekobod Co's factory and available to all road users
Cash of $500,000 paid to Bekobod Co by a regional development agency on condition that it creates 50 new jobs in the region
ex:
Government grant = hukumatning entity'ga resurs o'tkazishi (transfer of resources), buning evaziga entity operating faoliyatiga oid shartlarni bajaradi (o'tgan yoki kelajakda). Ish o'rinlari yaratish sharti bilan to'langan $500,000 — aynan shu.
Qolganlari grant emas: qiymatini ishonchli baholab bo'lmaydigan bepul maslahat — faqat government assistance (grant ta'rifidan chiqarilgan); hamma foydalanadigan umumiy infratuzilma (motorway) — bitta entity'ga xos (specific) emas; hukumatning oddiy savdo shartlarida xarid qilishi — oddiy trading transaction.

q: Free marketing advice provided to Chirchiq Co by a government agency, which cannot reasonably have a value placed on it, falls within the IAS 20 definition of a government grant.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Qiymatini oqilona baholab bo'lmaydigan yordam (bepul texnik yoki marketing maslahat, kafolatlar) grant ta'rifidan chiqarib tashlangan. Bu — government assistance; u moliyaviy hisobotlarda tan olinmaydi, faqat ahamiyatli bo'lsa, izohlarda (notes) ochib beriladi.

q: For the purposes of IAS 20, which THREE of the following bodies are regarded as 'government'?
opt: An international intergovernmental body that funds regional projects
A national export-promotion agency owned by the state
A privately owned commercial bank offering low-interest loans
A trade association funded by its member companies
A city council in the region where the entity operates
ex:
IAS 20 ta'rifi: government — hukumat, hukumat agentliklari va shunga o'xshash organlar, ular mahalliy (local), milliy (national) yoki xalqaro (international) bo'lishidan qat'i nazar. Shuning uchun city council, xalqaro hukumatlararo tashkilot va davlat eksport agentligi — government.
Xususiy tijorat banki va a'zolar mablag'i bilan ishlaydigan trade association — hukumat emas.

q: How does IAS 20 define 'grants related to assets'?
opt: Grants whose primary condition is that the entity should purchase, construct or otherwise acquire long-term assets
Any grant that is received in cash rather than in the form of goods or services
Grants that compensate the entity for expenses or losses already incurred
Grants that must be repaid if the entity sells the related asset within a specified period
ex:
IAS 20: grants related to assets (capital grants) — asosiy sharti entity'ning uzoq muddatli (long-term) aktivlarni sotib olishi, qurishi yoki boshqacha yo'l bilan olishi bo'lgan grantlar. Boshqa barcha grantlar — grants related to income (revenue grants).
Naqd shaklda olinishi grant turini aniqlamaydi; o'tgan xarajatlarni qoplaydigan grant — income grant; qaytarish sharti esa faqat recognition'ga ta'sir qiladi, ta'rifga emas.

q: Gazli Co has been awarded $200,000 by the government to subsidise the wages of apprentices it employs over the next two years. How should this grant be classified under IAS 20?
opt: A grant related to assets
A grant related to income
Government assistance which is not a grant
A capital contribution to be credited to equity
ex:
Grant ish haqi (wages) xarajatlarini qoplash uchun berilgan — asosiy sharti long-term aktiv sotib olish emas. Demak bu grant related to income (revenue grant) — ikki yil davomida tegishli ish haqi xarajatlari bilan moslab (matching) P/L'ga olinadi.
Grant hech qachon equity'ga (capital contribution) kiritilmaydi; bu resurs o'tkazish bo'lgani uchun oddiy 'assistance' ham emas.

q: Which TWO of the following are examples of government assistance which would not be recognised as a government grant in the financial statements?
opt: Cash received from the government for each unemployed person the entity hires
A transfer of land by a local authority to the entity at nil cost, to be used for a factory
A government guarantee of the entity's bank loan, which cannot reasonably be valued
Free technical advice from a government research laboratory
Cash received from the government towards the cost of a new wind turbine
ex:
Qiymatini oqilona baholab bo'lmaydigan yordam — kafolat (guarantee), bepul texnik yoki marketing maslahat — government assistance: tan olinmaydi, faqat izohda ochiladi.
Turbina uchun pul — grant related to assets; ishga olingan har bir kishi uchun pul — grant related to income; bepul yer — non-monetary grant (odatda fair value bo'yicha baholanadi). Bular grant sifatida hisobga olinadi.

q: Under IAS 20, when should a government grant be recognised?
opt: Only when the grant has been received in cash
When the government formally approves the entity's application, regardless of any conditions
When there is reasonable assurance that the entity will comply with the conditions attached to it and that the grant will be received
Only when all conditions attached to the grant have expired and it can no longer be repaid
ex:
IAS 20 recognition sharti: reasonable assurance (oqilona ishonch) bo'lishi kerak — (1) entity shartlarni bajaradi va (2) grant olinadi. Bu prudence tamoyili.
Naqd pul olinganligining o'zi yetarli emas (shartlar bajarilmasligi mumkin), va shartlar butunlay tugashini kutish ham shart emas — aks holda deyarli hech bir grant vaqtida tan olinmas edi.

q: A government grant that becomes receivable as compensation for expenses already incurred, with no future related costs, should be recognised in profit or loss in the period in which it becomes receivable.
ex: To'g'ri. Agar grant allaqachon qilingan xarajatlar yoki zararlarni qoplasa va kelajakda bog'liq xarajat bo'lmasa, uni moslaydigan (matching) kelajak davr yo'q. Shuning uchun u receivable bo'lgan davrda darhol P/L'ga tan olinadi.

q: On 1 March 20X6 Kogon Co received $400,000 from the government on condition that it would employ at least 80 people at a new site by 31 December 20X6, otherwise the full amount must be repaid. At 31 December 20X6 (the year end), Kogon Co employs only 30 people at the site and does not expect to meet the condition. How should the $400,000 be treated in the financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X6?
opt: Recognise the $400,000 as a liability, with no income recognised
Recognise the full $400,000 as other income
Recognise income of $333,333 (10/12 of the grant) and a liability for the balance
Disclose the grant in the notes only, with no amounts recognised
ex:
Grant faqat shartlar bajarilishiga reasonable assurance bo'lsa tan olinadi. Kogon Co shartni bajara olmasligini kutmoqda, demak pulni qaytarish kerak bo'ladi. Olingan naqd pul — hukumat oldidagi liability: Dr Cash 400,000 / Cr Liability 400,000.
Income tan olinmaydi (na to'liq, na 10/12 = 400,000 × 10/12 = 333,333). Pul olinganligi sababli faqat disclosure yetarli emas.

q: Which TWO accounting principles underlie the IAS 20 requirements for recognising government grants?
opt: Accruals — grants are matched with the costs they are intended to compensate
Prudence — grants are not recognised until there is reasonable assurance that conditions will be met and the grant received
Going concern — grants are recognised only if the entity will continue trading for twelve months
Cash basis — grants are recognised in profit or loss when the cash is received
Historical cost — grants are always recognised at the amount originally applied for
ex:
IAS 20 ikki umumiy tamoyilga tayanadi:
1) Prudence — shartlar bajarilishi va grant olinishiga reasonable assurance bo'lmaguncha tan olinmaydi.
2) Accruals (matching) — grant u qoplashi kerak bo'lgan xarajatlar bilan bir davrda P/L'ga olinadi.
Cash basis IAS 20 ga zid; going concern va 'so'ralgan summa' recognition mezoni emas.

q: Government grants should be recognised in profit or loss on a systematic basis over the periods in which the entity recognises as expenses the related costs that the grants are intended to compensate.
ex: To'g'ri. Bu IAS 20 ning asosiy matching (accruals) qoidasi. Capital grant uchun 'related cost' — depreciation, shuning uchun grant aktivning useful life davomida olinadi; revenue grant uchun — tegishli xarajatlar (masalan, ish haqi) tan olingan davrlarda.

q: Muynoq Co received a grant towards a machine with a useful life of eight years. The grant is repayable if the machine is sold within three years, which Muynoq Co has no intention of doing. The grant should therefore be released to profit or loss over three years.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Grant u qoplaydigan xarajat — ya'ni depreciation bilan moslab olinadi, shuning uchun aktivning useful life (8 yil) davomida release qilinadi. 3 yillik qaytarish sharti faqat recognition'ga ta'sir qiladi (reasonable assurance bor, chunki sotish niyati yo'q) — release muddatini o'zgartirmaydi.

q:
On 1 October 20X5 Muynoq Co received a government grant of $2.4 million towards the purchase of a machine, which was bought and brought into use on that date. The grant is repayable if the machine is sold within three years, which Muynoq Co does not intend to do. The machine has a useful life of eight years. Muynoq Co uses the deferred income method.
What is the total deferred income balance (current and non-current) at Muynoq Co's year end of 31 March 20X6? Enter your answer in $000.
ex:
Grant useful life (8 yil) bo'yicha release qilinadi, qaytarish muddati (3 yil) bo'yicha emas.
Yillik release = 2,400,000 / 8 = 300,000
1 oktyabr – 31 mart = 6 oy: 300,000 × 6/12 = 150,000
Deferred income = 2,400,000 − 150,000 = $2,250,000 → 2,250 ($000).

q: On 1 November 20X7 Yangiyer Co received a grant of $900,000 towards the construction of a new factory building. Construction will start in February 20X8 and the building will be depreciated over 30 years once it is brought into use. There is reasonable assurance that all conditions will be met, and Yangiyer Co uses the deferred income method for grants related to assets. How should the grant be presented at Yangiyer Co's year end of 31 December 20X7?
opt: As other income of $900,000 in profit or loss
As a credit to a capital reserve within equity
As deferred income of $895,000, after releasing $5,000 (2/12 of one year's release)
As deferred income of $900,000, with no amount released to profit or loss
ex:
Capital grant bog'liq xarajat — ya'ni binoning depreciation'i bilan moslab olinadi. Bino hali qurilmagan va foydalanishga topshirilmagan, depreciation boshlanmagan, demak release ham boshlanmaydi. 31 dekabrda to'liq summa deferred income: $900,000.
900,000 / 30 × 2/12 = 5,000 ni release qilish noto'g'ri, chunki depreciation hali yo'q. Grant hech qachon equity'ga olinmaydi.

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Jizzax Co received a government grant of $360,000 on condition that it makes no redundancies at its rural call centre for the next three years. At 31 December 20X5 no redundancies had been made and none are planned.
How much grant income should Jizzax Co recognise in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X5? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Bu revenue grant — 3 yillik shart davriga tekis taqsimlanadi (matching).
Yillik income = 360,000 / 3 = $120,000.
Qolgan $240,000 deferred income'da qoladi ($120,000 current, $120,000 non-current).

q:
On 1 May 20X6 Denov Co received a government grant of $84,000. The grant requires Denov Co to employ a trainee engineer on a full-time contract for seven years, which it expects to do.
What is the non-current deferred income balance in Denov Co's statement of financial position at 31 December 20X6? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Grant davri = 7 yil = 84 oy → oyiga 84,000 / 84 = $1,000.
1 may – 31 dekabr 20X6 = 8 oy → income 1,000 × 8 = $8,000.
Jami deferred income = 84,000 − 8,000 = $76,000.
Current qismi (keyingi 12 oy) = 1,000 × 12 = $12,000.
Non-current = 76,000 − 12,000 = $64,000.

q: On 1 July 20X7 Urgut Co received a government grant of $150,000 to fund a staff-training programme which will run for 30 months from that date. The accountant credited the full $150,000 to other income for the year ended 31 December 20X7. What adjustment is required?
opt: Dr Deferred income $30,000, Cr Other income $30,000
Dr Other income $120,000, Cr Deferred income $120,000
Dr Other income $30,000, Cr Deferred income $30,000
Dr Bank $120,000, Cr Deferred income $120,000
ex:
Grant 30 oyga taqsimlanadi: oyiga 150,000 / 30 = $5,000.
20X7 da 6 oy (iyul–dekabr) → to'g'ri income = 5,000 × 6 = $30,000.
Hozir income'da 150,000 turibdi → ortiqcha = 150,000 − 30,000 = $120,000.
Tuzatish: Dr Other income 120,000 / Cr Deferred income 120,000. Bank'ga tegilmaydi — naqd pul to'g'ri yozilgan.

q: IAS 20 permits grants related to income to be presented in the statement of profit or loss in which of the following ways?
opt: Only as a separate credit under 'other income'
Only as a deduction from the related expense
Either as a separate credit (for example 'other income') or as a deduction from the related expense
Either as a separate credit in profit or loss or as a credit to other comprehensive income
ex: IAS 20 revenue grant uchun ikki taqdimot variantini ruxsat beradi: (1) P/L'da alohida credit (masalan, 'other income'), yoki (2) bog'liq xarajatdan ayirish (masalan, staff costs'dan). Grant hech qachon OCI yoki equity orqali o'tmaydi.

q: Olmos Co receives a government grant to cover part of its payroll costs for the next year. Which TWO of the following are acceptable ways to present the grant income in profit or loss under IAS 20?
opt: As a gain in other comprehensive income
As a direct credit to retained earnings
As a deduction from the carrying amount of property, plant and equipment
As 'other income' in profit or loss
As a deduction from staff costs
ex: Revenue grant: yoki other income sifatida alohida, yoki bog'liq xarajat (staff costs) dan ayirilgan holda. OCI va retained earnings'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tkazish mumkin emas. PPE'dan ayirish (netting off) faqat grants related to assets uchun variant — bu grant esa payroll uchun.

q: Which of the following arguments supports presenting a grant related to income as a separate credit in profit or loss rather than deducting it from the related expense?
opt: Deducting the grant from the expense is required by law in most countries
The expense might not have been incurred at all if the grant had not been available
Presenting the expense without offsetting the grant might be misleading
Showing the grant separately makes it easier to compare the expense with other expenses not affected by a grant
ex:
IAS 20 (para 30) ikki tomonning dalillarini keltiradi:
• Alohida credit tarafdorlari: daromad va xarajatni o'zaro netting qilish noto'g'ri; alohida ko'rsatish grant ta'sir qilmagan boshqa xarajatlar bilan solishtirishni osonlashtiradi.
• Xarajatdan ayirish tarafdorlari: grant bo'lmaganida xarajat umuman qilinmagan bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun uni grantsiz ko'rsatish chalg'itishi mumkin.
Qonun talabi haqidagi variant noto'g'ri — ikkala usul ham ruxsat etilgan.

q:
On 1 January 20X4 Chust Co was awarded a non-repayable grant of $450,000 for creating 100 new jobs in a deprived area. The identifiable costs of achieving this objective (recruitment and training) are expected to be $240,000 in 20X4, $360,000 in 20X5 and $200,000 in 20X6, and were incurred as expected.
How much grant income should Chust Co recognise for the year ended 31 December 20X5? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Grant nomoliyaviy maqsad (ish o'rinlari yaratish) uchun berilgan — IAS 20 bo'yicha u shu maqsadga erishishning identifiable costs'i bilan moslanadi.
Jami xarajat = 240,000 + 360,000 + 200,000 = $800,000.
20X5 ulushi = 360,000 / 800,000 = 45%.
20X5 income = 450,000 × 360,000 / 800,000 = $202,500.

q:
On 1 January 20X4 Termiz Co bought a machine for $500,000 and received a government grant of 30% of its cost. The machine has a useful life of ten years and nil residual value. Termiz Co uses the deferred income method for capital grants.
How much grant income should be recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X4? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Grant = 500,000 × 30% = $150,000.
Deferred income method: grant aktivning useful life (10 yil) davomida release qilinadi.
Yillik release = 150,000 / 10 = $15,000 (Dr Deferred income / Cr P/L).
Depreciation esa to'liq cost bo'yicha: 500,000 / 10 = $50,000.

q:
Nurota Co prepares financial statements to 30 June. On 1 October 20X4 it received a grant of $720,000 towards plant which was bought and brought into use that day. The plant has a useful life of six years. Nurota Co uses the deferred income method and time-apportions depreciation and grant releases.
What is the total deferred income balance at 30 June 20X5? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Yillik release = 720,000 / 6 = $120,000.
1 oktyabr 20X4 – 30 iyun 20X5 = 9 oy → 120,000 × 9/12 = $90,000.
Jami deferred income = 720,000 − 90,000 = $630,000 (bundan $120,000 current, $510,000 non-current).

q: On 1 January 20X8 Qumqo'rg'on Co bought plant for $800,000 and received a government grant of $200,000 towards it. The plant has an eight-year useful life and nil residual value. Qumqo'rg'on Co uses the deferred income method. Which of the following correctly shows the amounts in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X8?
opt: Depreciation $75,000; grant income nil
Depreciation $100,000; grant income $25,000
Depreciation $100,000; grant income $200,000
Depreciation $75,000; grant income $25,000
ex:
Deferred income method: PPE to'liq cost'da qoladi → depreciation = 800,000 / 8 = $100,000.
Grant alohida deferred income sifatida yozilib, useful life davomida release qilinadi: 200,000 / 8 = $25,000.
Sof P/L ta'siri = 100,000 − 25,000 = $75,000 — bu netting off method natijasi (600,000 / 8 = 75,000) bilan bir xil. Depreciation 75,000 va grant income bir vaqtda — ikki marta hisoblash.

q: Karmana Co bought equipment for $900,000 on 1 January 20X3 and received a government grant of $240,000 towards it. The equipment has a six-year useful life and nil residual value. Karmana Co uses the deferred income method. What is the carrying amount of the equipment in the statement of financial position at 31 December 20X4?
ex:
Deferred income method'da grant aktivdan ayirilmaydi — u alohida liability.
Depreciation = 900,000 / 6 = $150,000 yiliga; 2 yil = $300,000.
Carrying amount = 900,000 − 300,000 = $600,000.
$440,000 — netting off method natijasi ((900,000 − 240,000) × 4/6). Deferred income balansi (240,000 − 80,000 = 160,000) SOFP'da alohida liability sifatida chiqadi.

q:
On 1 January 20X1 Pop Co bought a machine for $400,000 and received a government grant of $100,000 towards it. The machine is depreciated at 25% per annum on the reducing balance basis, and the grant is released to profit or loss in the same proportion as the depreciation charge (deferred income method).
How much grant income should be recognised for the year ended 31 December 20X2? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Grant depreciation bilan bir xil nisbatda release qilinadi.
20X1 depreciation = 400,000 × 25% = $100,000.
20X2 depreciation = (400,000 − 100,000) × 25% = $75,000.
20X2 release = 100,000 × 75,000 / 400,000 = $18,750
(yoki grant'ga ham reducing balance: 100,000 × 75% × 25% = 18,750).

q: On 1 January 20X2 Xiva Co received a government grant of $360,000 towards equipment costing $1,200,000 with a six-year useful life. The accountant credited the whole grant to profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X2. By how much is Xiva Co's profit for the year overstated, assuming the deferred income method should have been applied?
ex:
To'g'ri grant income = 360,000 / 6 = $60,000.
Yozilgan income = $360,000.
Profit ortiqcha = 360,000 − 60,000 = $300,000.
Tuzatish: Dr P/L 300,000 / Cr Deferred income 300,000 (shundan 60,000 current, 240,000 non-current).

q:
On 1 April 20X1 Zarafshon Co bought a machine for $3.6 million and received a government grant of 40% of the cost. The machine has a nine-year useful life and nil residual value. Depreciation and grant releases are time-apportioned. Zarafshon Co's year end is 31 December.
What is the net charge to profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X1 in respect of the machine and the grant (depreciation less any grant income)? Enter your answer in $000.
Which of the following is an advantage of the deferred income method over deducting the grant from the cost of the asset?
opt: It results in higher total profit over the life of the asset
It results in a lower depreciation charge in profit or loss
It is simpler to operate because no separate liability needs to be tracked
Assets acquired at different times and locations are recorded on a uniform basis, regardless of changes in government grant policy
ex:
Deferred income method'ning afzalligi: PPE doim to'liq cost'da ko'rsatiladi, shuning uchun turli vaqtda va joyda olingan aktivlar hukumat siyosati o'zgarishidan qat'i nazar bir xil asosda yoziladi.
Pastroq depreciation va soddalik — netting off method xususiyatlari. Umumiy foyda ikkala usulda ham bir xil.

q:
On 1 January 20X6 Qarshi Co bought a delivery van for $250,000 and received a government grant of $50,000 towards it. The van has a useful life of five years and nil residual value. Qarshi Co deducts capital grants from the cost of the related asset.
What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 31 December 20X6? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Netting off method: grant cost'dan ayiriladi → net cost = 250,000 − 50,000 = $200,000.
Depreciation = 200,000 / 5 = $40,000.
Alohida grant income yo'q — grant kamaytirilgan depreciation orqali P/L'ga kiradi.

q: Sirdaryo Co has a 31 March year end. On 1 October 20X5 it bought machinery for $1,200,000 and received a government grant of $300,000 towards it. The machinery has a six-year useful life, and Sirdaryo Co deducts capital grants from the cost of the asset and time-apportions depreciation. What is the carrying amount of the machinery at 31 March 20X7?

Kosonsoy Co bought plant for $750,000 on 1 January 20X3 and received a grant of $150,000 towards it. The plant has a five-year life and nil residual value. Kosonsoy Co uses the netting off method for capital grants. What is the carrying amount of the plant at 31 December 20X4?
ex:
Net cost = 750,000 − 150,000 = $600,000.
Depreciation = 600,000 / 5 = $120,000 yiliga; 2 yil = $240,000.
Carrying amount = 600,000 − 240,000 = $360,000.
$450,000 — deferred income method'dagi carrying amount (u holda qolgan grant 90,000 alohida liability bo'ladi).

q: Which THREE of the following statements about the netting off (deduction from cost) method for grants related to assets are correct?
opt: The net effect on profit or loss each year is the same as under the deferred income method
No deferred income liability is recognised for the grant
The depreciation charge is based on the cost of the asset net of the grant
Total profit recognised each year is higher than under the deferred income method
The asset is presented at its gross cost in the statement of financial position
ex:
Netting off: grant aktiv cost'idan ayiriladi → deferred income liability yo'q, depreciation net cost bo'yicha hisoblanadi.
Har yilgi sof P/L ta'siri ikkala usulda bir xil: deferred income'da (to'liq depreciation − grant release) = netting'da (net cost depreciation).
Aktiv gross cost'da faqat deferred income method'da ko'rsatiladi; profit yuqori bo'lmaydi.

q: Compared with the deferred income method, how does the netting off method affect Surxon Co's statement of financial position in the years after receiving a grant related to an asset?
opt: Property, plant and equipment is higher and liabilities are lower
Property, plant and equipment is lower, liabilities are the same, and retained earnings are lower
Property, plant and equipment and total liabilities are both lower; retained earnings are the same
Property, plant and equipment and liabilities are the same, but depreciation is higher
ex: Netting off: PPE grant'ning release qilinmagan qismiga kamroq; deferred income liability yo'q, shuning uchun liabilities ham xuddi shu summaga kamroq. Har yilgi sof P/L ta'siri bir xil bo'lgani uchun retained earnings bir xil. Depreciation esa netting'da kamroq (lekin grant income yo'q).

q: Which of the following is NOT an acceptable accounting treatment for a government grant related to an asset under IAS 20?
opt: Recognising the grant in profit or loss on a systematic basis over the useful life of the asset
Deducting the grant from the carrying amount of the asset
Recognising the grant as deferred income and releasing it over the asset's useful life
Crediting the grant directly to a capital reserve within equity
ex: IAS 20 capital grant uchun ikki usulni ruxsat beradi: (1) aktiv cost'idan ayirish (netting off) va (2) deferred income sifatida yozib, useful life davomida release qilish. Ikkalasida ham grant P/L'ga useful life davomida tizimli ravishda kiradi. Equity'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri credit qilish ruxsat etilmaydi — grant egalar (owners) tomonidan kiritilgan kapital emas.

q: Which TWO of the following statements about accounting for grants related to assets under IAS 20 are true?
opt: The grant is recognised in profit or loss over the useful life of the related asset
The deferred income method must be used if the grant could become repayable
Any grant related to an asset must be deducted from the carrying amount of the asset
The grant must be recognised in full in profit or loss when it is received
The deferred income method and the netting off method are equally acceptable
ex:
IAS 20: ikki usul (deferred income va netting off) teng darajada qabul qilinadi va ikkalasi ham grant'ni aktivning useful life davomida P/L'ga olib keladi.
Qaytarilishi mumkinligi usul tanlashga ta'sir qilmaydi; netting majburiy emas; to'liq darhol tan olish accruals tamoyiliga zid.

q:
On 1 July 20X3 Guliston Co received a government grant of $1.8 million towards plant with a six-year useful life, bought on that date. Guliston Co uses the deferred income method and has a 31 December year end.
What is the non-current liability for deferred income at 31 December 20X3? Enter your answer in $000.

On 1 April 20X8 Zomin Co received a government grant of $960,000 towards equipment with a four-year useful life, bought on that date. Zomin Co uses the deferred income method and prepares financial statements to 30 September. What is the non-current liability for the grant at 30 September 20X8?
ex:
Yillik release = 960,000 / 4 = $240,000.
1 aprel – 30 sentyabr = 6 oy → $120,000.
Jami balans = 960,000 − 120,000 = $840,000.
Current = keyingi yil release = $240,000.
Non-current = 840,000 − 240,000 = $600,000.
$840,000 — split qilinmagan jami; $720,000 — to'liq yil release qilingan va split qilinmagan.

q:
Angren Co uses the deferred income method and has a 31 December year end. It has received two grants:
  • Grant A: $480,000 received on 1 January 20X4 towards machinery with an eight-year life.
  • Grant B: $270,000 received on 1 October 20X6 towards equipment with a three-year life.
Both assets were bought on the day the grant was received. What is the total non-current deferred income balance at 31 December 20X6? Enter your answer in $.
Which TWO of the following statements about the presentation of deferred income from government grants are correct?
opt: Deferred income is presented as a deduction from current assets
Deferred income is always presented as a single non-current liability
The amount to be released to profit or loss within the next 12 months is a current liability
The amount to be released after more than 12 months is a non-current liability
The entire deferred income balance is shown within equity
ex: Deferred income — liability. Keyingi 12 oyda P/L'ga release qilinadigan qism — current liability, qolgani — non-current liability. Equity'da yoki current assets'dan ayirilgan holda ko'rsatilmaydi.

q: On 1 January 20X1 Pishkent Co received a grant of $300,000 towards equipment with a three-year useful life. It uses the deferred income method. How should the remaining deferred income be presented at 31 December 20X2?
opt: $100,000 as a non-current liability only
$100,000 current liability and $100,000 non-current liability
$100,000 as a current liability only
$100,000 deducted from the carrying amount of the equipment
ex:
Yillik release = 300,000 / 3 = $100,000. 2 yil release qilingan → balans = 300,000 − 200,000 = $100,000.
Bu qolgan summa to'liq 20X3 da (keyingi 12 oy ichida) release qilinadi, shuning uchun hammasi current liability. Non-current qism yo'q. Deferred income method'da grant aktivdan ayirilmaydi.

q: On 1 January 20X4 Asaka Co received a grant of $900,000 on condition that it maintained its workforce at current levels for three years. On 1 January 20X5, following a fall in demand, Asaka Co made significant redundancies and the full grant became repayable immediately. Which journal records the repayment on 1 January 20X5?
opt: Dr Deferred income $600,000, Dr Profit or loss $300,000, Cr Liability to government $900,000
Dr Deferred income $600,000, Cr Liability to government $600,000
Dr Deferred income $600,000, Dr Retained earnings (prior period adjustment) $300,000, Cr Liability to government $900,000
Dr Deferred income $900,000, Cr Liability to government $900,000
ex:
20X4 da release: 900,000 / 3 = $300,000 → 1 yanvar 20X5 da deferred income = $600,000.
Qaytariladigan summa = $900,000. Avval qolgan deferred income ishlatiladi (600,000), ortiqcha qism (300,000) darhol P/L'ga expense.
Repayment — change in accounting estimate, prior period adjustment emas, shuning uchun retained earnings'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozilmaydi.

q: Tashkent Co accounts for grants related to assets using the deferred income method. Two years after receiving a grant towards a machine, Tashkent Co fails to meet one of the grant conditions and the government demands repayment of the whole grant. Which TWO of the following form part of the accounting required under IAS 20?
opt: The remaining deferred income balance is eliminated against the repayment
Any excess of the repayment over the deferred income balance is recognised as an expense immediately
The cost of the related asset is increased by the amount repaid
The prior year financial statements are restated
The whole repayment is debited to the revaluation surplus
ex:
IAS 20: deferred income method'da qaytarilgan summa avval qolgan deferred income'ga qarshi yoziladi; ortiqcha qismi darhol P/L'ga expense.
Aktiv cost'ini oshirish — faqat netting off method'da. Repayment — accounting estimate o'zgarishi, prior year restatement emas. Revaluation surplus'ga aloqasi yo'q.

q:
On 1 January 20X1 Marg'ilon Co bought a machine for $600,000 and received a government grant of $150,000 towards it. The machine has a five-year life and nil residual value. Marg'ilon Co deducts grants from the cost of the asset. On 31 December 20X2, after charging depreciation for 20X2, the full grant became repayable.
What is the carrying amount of the machine immediately after the repayment has been recorded? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Netting off method'da repayment: aktiv carrying amount'i qaytarilgan summaga oshiriladi, va grant bo'lmaganida tan olinadigan qo'shimcha cumulative depreciation darhol P/L'ga yoziladi.
Repayment'dan oldin CA = (600,000 − 150,000) − 90,000 × 2 = 270,000.
+ Grant qaytarildi (cost oshadi) = 150,000.
− Qo'shimcha depreciation = 150,000 × 2/5 = 60,000 (P/L expense).
CA = 270,000 + 150,000 − 60,000 = $360,000 — ya'ni 600,000 − 2 × 120,000, grant hech qachon olinmagandek.

q: Boysun Co deducts capital grants from the cost of the related asset. On 1 January 20X4 it bought plant for $2.4 million (eight-year life, nil residual value) and received a grant of $600,000. On 31 December 20X6, after depreciation for 20X6 had been charged, Boysun Co breached the grant conditions and must repay the full grant. What additional expense should be recognised in profit or loss for 20X6 as a result of the repayment?
ex:
Netting off method'da repayment: Dr PPE (cost) 600,000 / Cr Liability 600,000. So'ng grant bo'lmaganida tan olinadigan qo'shimcha cumulative depreciation darhol P/L'ga: 600,000 / 8 × 3 yil = $225,000 (Dr P/L / Cr Accumulated depreciation).
To'liq 600,000 expense emas — uning qolgan qismi (375,000) aktiv cost'iga qo'shiladi va kelajakda depreciation orqali P/L'ga kiradi.

q:
Samarqand Co received a grant of $500,000 on 1 January 20X5 towards equipment with a five-year useful life and uses the deferred income method. On 31 December 20X6, after releasing the grant for 20X6, it was agreed that Samarqand Co had partly breached the conditions and must repay 80% of the grant.
What expense should be recognised in profit or loss as a result of the repayment? Enter your answer in $.
ex:
Deferred income 31.12.20X6 = 500,000 − 500,000/5 × 2 = $300,000.
Qaytariladigan summa = 500,000 × 80% = $400,000.
Avval deferred income ishlatiladi: 300,000.
Ortiqcha = 400,000 − 300,000 = $100,000 → darhol P/L'ga expense.
Journal: Dr Deferred income 300,000, Dr P/L 100,000, Cr Liability 400,000.

q: When a government grant becomes repayable, IAS 20 requires the repayment to be accounted for as a prior period adjustment under IAS 8.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Grant'ning qaytarilishi — change in accounting estimate (IAS 20 para 32). U joriy davrda prospective tarzda hisobga olinadi: deferred income yoki aktiv cost'i to'g'rilanadi, ortiqcha qismi darhol P/L'ga expense. O'tgan yillar restate qilinmaydi.
