q:
Chimgan Engineering Co has a year end of 30 June 20X5. It built a new manufacturing facility between 1 July 20X4 and 31 March 20X5, funding it entirely from general borrowings. The facility was available for use on 1 April 20X5 and has a useful life of 25 years with nil residual value. Expenditure on the facility was: $3,000,000 on 1 July 20X4, $4,000,000 on 1 October 20X4 and $2,000,000 on 1 January 20X5. Chimgan's general borrowings, all outstanding for the whole year, were: $10,000,000 bank loan at 7%, $6,000,000 bonds at 9% and $4,000,000 loan notes at 10%.

What finance cost in respect of its general borrowings should Chimgan Engineering Co recognise in profit or loss for the year ended 30 June 20X5?
ex: Jami borrowing costs $1,640,000 − capitalise qilingan $389,500 = $1,250,500 P/L'ga finance cost.

q: Which of the following assets falls within the scope of IAS 36 Impairment of Assets?
opt: A non-current asset classified as held for sale
Inventories held for resale
Investment property measured under the fair value model
Property, plant and equipment measured under the cost model
ex: IAS 36 ko'p aktivlarga qo'llanadi, lekin quyidagilar scope'dan tashqari: inventories (IAS 2), deferred tax assets (IAS 12), IFRS 9 dagi financial assets, fair value modeldagi investment property (IAS 40), held for sale aktivlar (IFRS 5) va IFRS 15 dagi contract aktivlari. Cost model'dagi PPE esa IAS 36 ga to'liq bo'ysunadi. To'g'ri javob: cost model'dagi PPE.

q: Which TWO of the following are excluded from the scope of IAS 36 Impairment of Assets?
opt: Goodwill acquired in a business combination
Inventories
Capitalised development costs
Deferred tax assets
Investment property measured under the cost model
ex: Inventories IAS 2 bo'yicha (lower of cost and NRV), deferred tax assets esa IAS 12 bo'yicha o'lchanadi — ular IAS 36 dan tashqari. Goodwill, capitalised development costs (IAS 38) va cost modeldagi investment property IAS 36 doirasida impairment test qilinadi. Javob: Inventories va Deferred tax assets.

q: The objective of IAS 36 is to ensure that an entity's assets are carried at no more than their recoverable amount.
ex: To'g'ri. IAS 36 ning maqsadi: aktivlar SOFP'da recoverable amountdan yuqori summada ko'rsatilmasligi kerak. Agar carrying amount > recoverable amount bo'lsa, farq impairment loss sifatida tan olinadi.

q: Which of the following is an internal indicator of impairment under IAS 36?
opt: Physical damage to a machine caused by a flood at the factory
A fall in the market value of the asset that is significantly greater than expected from normal use
A significant increase in market interest rates during the year
New legislation that adversely affects the market in which the entity operates
ex: Internal (ichki) manbalar: aktivning shikastlanishi yoki eskirishi (obsolescence/damage), foydalanish usulidagi o'zgarishlar (restructuring, idle), iqtisodiy natijaning kutilganidan yomonligi. Foiz stavkalari o'sishi, bozor qiymatining tushishi va qonunchilik o'zgarishi — external (tashqi) indikatorlar. Javob: toshqin sabab mashina shikastlangani.

q: Which of the following would NOT be an indicator that an asset may be impaired?
opt: The carrying amount of the entity's net assets exceeds its market capitalisation
Management plans to discontinue the operation to which the asset belongs
A decrease in market interest rates during the year
Cash flows generated by the asset are significantly below budget
ex: Foiz stavkalari pasayishi discount rate'ni kamaytiradi, bu esa value in use'ni oshiradi — demak impairment emas, aksincha, reversal indikatori bo'lishi mumkin. Qolgan uchtasi: net assets > market capitalisation (external), operatsiyani to'xtatish rejasi (internal), cash flow'lar budjetdan past (internal) — hammasi impairment indikatorlari.

q: Which THREE of the following are external indicators of impairment under IAS 36?
opt: The asset has become idle and management plans to dispose of it early
Market interest rates have increased, raising the discount rate used in value in use calculations
The carrying amount of the entity's net assets is more than its market capitalisation
An adverse change in the legal environment in which the entity operates
Operating profit from the asset is worse than budgeted
ex: External indikatorlar tashqi bozordan keladi: foiz stavkalari o'sishi (discount rate oshadi → VIU tushadi), net assets > market capitalisation (bozor kompaniyani aktivlaridan arzon baholaydi), texnologik/bozor/iqtisodiy/legal muhitdagi salbiy o'zgarishlar. Aktivning idle bo'lishi va natijaning budjetdan yomonligi — internal indikatorlar.

q: If there is no indication of impairment at the reporting date, an entity must still carry out a full impairment review of all its property, plant and equipment every year.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Har reporting date'da faqat indikator bormi-yo'qmi baholanadi. Indikator bo'lmasa, PPE uchun recoverable amount hisoblanmaydi. Har yili majburiy test faqat: (1) business combination'dagi goodwill, (2) indefinite useful lifeli intangible, (3) hali foydalanishga tayyor bo'lmagan intangible uchun.

q: Which TWO of the following must be tested for impairment annually, even if there is no indication of impairment?
opt: A patent with a remaining finite useful life of 10 years
Goodwill acquired in a business combination
Land measured under the cost model
An intangible asset that is not yet available for use
Capitalised development costs being amortised over 5 years
ex: IAS 36 bo'yicha indikatorsiz ham har yili test qilinadi: business combination'dagi goodwill, indefinite useful life'li intangible va hali foydalanishga tayyor bo'lmagan intangible. Finite life'li patent, yer va amortise qilinayotgan development costs faqat indikator bo'lsa test qilinadi. Javob: goodwill va hali foydalanishga tayyor bo'lmagan intangible.

q: Why is an increase in market interest rates regarded as an indicator of impairment?
opt: It increases the entity's finance costs, which are deducted in calculating value in use
It is likely to increase the discount rate used, reducing the asset's value in use
It increases the carrying amount of the asset through capitalised borrowing costs
It automatically reduces the asset's fair value less costs of disposal to nil
ex: VIU = kelajakdagi cash flow'larning present value'si. Bozor foiz stavkasi oshsa, discount rate oshadi → PV (VIU) kamayadi → recoverable amount carrying amount'dan past bo'lib qolishi mumkin. Finance costs VIU hisobiga kiritilmaydi, shuning uchun birinchi variant (finance costs) noto'g'ri. Interest oshishi FVLCD'ni avtomatik nolga tushirmaydi va capitalised borrowing costs bilan bog'liq emas.

q: At its year end, Chirchiq Co is reviewing its bottling plant. Which ONE of the following situations would NOT, on its own, require Chirchiq Co to estimate the plant's recoverable amount?
opt: The plant's fair value less costs of disposal has risen by 5% over the year
Management has approved a plan to mothball the plant from next year
A competitor has launched new technology that makes the plant's output less competitive
Actual net cash inflows from the plant were 30% below budget for the year
ex: Fair value'ning oshishi impairment emas, aksincha, qiymat yaxshilanayotganini ko'rsatadi. Raqobatchining yangi texnologiyasi (external — technological environment), plantni to'xtatib qo'yish rejasi (internal — foydalanish usulining o'zgarishi) va cash flow'larning budjetdan 30% past bo'lishi (internal — economic performance) — hammasi indikator va recoverable amount hisoblashni talab qiladi.

q: How does IAS 36 define the recoverable amount of an asset?
opt: The lower of fair value less costs of disposal and value in use
The higher of fair value less costs of disposal and value in use
The higher of carrying amount and fair value less costs of disposal
Value in use less costs of disposal
ex: Recoverable amount = higher of (FVLCD, VIU). Mantiq: oqilona menejer aktivni yo sotadi, yo ishlatadi — qaysi biri ko'proq pul keltirsa, o'shani tanlaydi. Impairment = carrying amount − recoverable amount (agar musbat bo'lsa).

q:
An item of equipment has a carrying amount of $85,000. Its fair value less costs of disposal is $62,000 and its value in use is $71,500.
What is the impairment loss to be recognised? (Enter in $, to the nearest whole number)
ex:
Recoverable amount = higher of FVLCD $62,000 va VIU $71,500 = $71,500.
Impairment = CA $85,000 − RA $71,500 = $13,500.

q:
Kosonsoy Co holds the following three assets at its year end ($000):
AssetCarrying amountFV less costs of disposalValue in use
P240210195
Q13090150
R754852
What is the total impairment loss to be recognised? (Enter in $000)
ex:
Har bir aktiv alohida baholanadi:
P: RA = max(210, 195) = 210; impairment = max(0, 240 − 210) = 30
Q: RA = max(90, 150) = 150; impairment = max(0, 130 − 150) = 0
R: RA = max(48, 52) = 52; impairment = max(0, 75 − 52) = 23
Q aktivi impairment emas (RA 150 > CA 130), va uning 'ortiqcha' qiymati boshqa aktivlar zararini qoplamaydi.
Jami = $53k.

q:
Denov Co is estimating the fair value less costs of disposal of a packaging machine. An independent buyer would pay $80,000. Disposal would involve legal costs of $1,500 and removal costs of $2,500. Following the sale, Denov Co would incur $3,000 of staff reorganisation costs.
What is the machine's fair value less costs of disposal?
ex:
Costs of disposal = aktivni sotish bilan bevosita bog'liq incremental xarajatlar (legal costs, removal costs, transaction taxes). Sotuvdan keyingi reorganisation xarajatlari va finance costs kiritilmaydi.
FVLCD = 80,000 − 1,500 − 2,500 = $76,000.

q: Which TWO of the following cash flows should be excluded when estimating the value in use of an asset?
opt: Cash inflows from continuing use of the asset
Interest payments on a loan used to finance the asset
Net cash expected on ultimate disposal of the asset
Income tax payments relating to the asset's profits
Cash outflows for the day-to-day servicing of the asset
ex: VIU hisobida faqat aktivni ishlatish va oxirida sotishdan keladigan operating cash flow'lar olinadi. Financing cash flow'lar (foiz to'lovlari) va income tax to'lovlari chiqarib tashlanadi. Continuing use'dan inflow'lar, day-to-day servicing outflow'lari va ultimate disposal'dan net cash kiritiladi. Javob: foiz to'lovlari va income tax.

q:
Angren Co owns a specialised press with a carrying amount of $110,000 at 31 December 20X5. Its fair value less costs of disposal is $88,000. Net cash inflows from using the press are expected to be $40,000 in 20X6, $35,000 in 20X7 and $30,000 in 20X8, when the press will also be sold for $5,000. The appropriate pre-tax discount rate is 10% (discount factors: year 1 0.909, year 2 0.826, year 3 0.751).
What impairment loss should be recognised at 31 December 20X5? (Enter in $, to the nearest whole number)

Gulistan Co bought an asset on 1 January 20X1 for $240,000. It had a useful life of 12 years and nil residual value. On 31 December 20X6 the asset was damaged and an impairment review was performed. At that date its fair value less costs of disposal was $70,000 and it was expected to generate net cash inflows of $22,000 per year for the next six years. The pre-tax discount rate is 8% and the six-year annuity factor at 8% is 4.623.
What impairment loss should be charged to profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X6? (Enter in $)

On 31 March 20X6 Yangiyer Co's cutting machine (carrying amount $60,000) was damaged. A buyer has offered to pay 75% of the carrying amount, provided the machine is repaired first at a cost of $3,200. Yangiyer Co would also pay delivery costs of $1,300. Alternatively, if repaired and kept, the present value of the machine's future net cash flows (after the repair cost) is $39,500.
What is the impairment loss at 31 March 20X6?
ex:
FVLCD = sotuv narxi (75% × 60,000 = 45,000) − repair 3,200 − delivery 1,300 = $40,500.
VIU = $39,500.
RA = higher = $40,500.
Impairment = 60,000 − 40,500 = $19,500. Faqat VIU'ni olish yoki sotish xarajatlarini unutish — tipik xato.

q: If an asset's fair value less costs of disposal exceeds its carrying amount, the asset is not impaired and there is no need to estimate its value in use.
ex: To'g'ri. RA = higher of FVLCD va VIU. Agar FVLCD allaqachon CA dan yuqori bo'lsa, RA ham albatta CA dan yuqori → impairment yo'q. VIU hisoblash shart emas (xuddi shunday, VIU > CA bo'lsa FVLCD kerak emas).

q: Which of the following provides the best evidence of an asset's fair value less costs of disposal?
opt: The asset's depreciated replacement cost
A price in a binding sale agreement in an arm's length transaction, adjusted for incremental disposal costs
The present value of the future cash flows expected from the asset
The original cost of the asset less accumulated depreciation
ex: Eng yaxshi dalil — mustaqil tomonlar o'rtasidagi binding sale agreementdagi narx (disposal xarajatlari ayirilgan holda). U bo'lmasa — active market'dagi joriy narx minus costs of disposal. Future cash flow'larning PV'si — bu VIU, FVLCD emas. Replacement cost va carrying amount recoverable amount o'lchovi emas.

q:
A building has a carrying amount of $520,000. Its fair value less costs of disposal is $540,000 and its value in use is $480,000.
What impairment loss should be recognised? (Enter in $; enter 0 if none)
ex: RA = higher of FVLCD 540,000 va VIU 480,000 = $540,000. RA (540,000) > CA (520,000) → impairment 0. VIU'ning CA dan pastligi muhim emas, chunki RA — ikkalasining kattasi.

q: An asset has a carrying amount of $70,000, fair value less costs of disposal of $52,000 and value in use of $61,000. At what amount should the asset be shown in the statement of financial position after the impairment review?
ex: RA = higher of 52,000 va 61,000 = $61,000. CA 70,000 > RA → aktiv RA gacha tushiriladi: impairment = 9,000, SOFP'da $61,000.

q: Which of the following would NOT be deducted in arriving at an asset's fair value less costs of disposal?
opt: Legal costs of the sale
Costs of removing the asset from the site
Finance costs on a loan secured on the asset
Transaction taxes payable on the sale
ex: Costs of disposal — aktivni sotishga bevosita tegishli incremental xarajatlar: legal costs, stamp duty kabi transaction taxes, aktivni olib chiqib ketish (removal) xarajatlari. Finance costs va income tax expense costs of disposal emas.

q: Which TWO of the following statements about value in use are correct?
opt: Cash flows should include those from future financing of the asset
The discount rate should be a pre-tax rate reflecting the time value of money and the risks specific to the asset
Cash flows should be estimated for the asset in its current condition, excluding uncommitted future enhancements
A post-tax discount rate should be applied to post-tax cash flows
Income tax payments should be deducted from the cash flows
ex: VIU: (1) aktivning hozirgi holati uchun cash flow'lar (hali majburiyat olinmagan kengaytirish/restructuring kiritilmaydi); (2) pre-tax discount rate — pulning vaqt qiymati va aktivga xos riskni aks ettiradi. Financing va income tax cash flow'lar chiqarib tashlanadi, shuning uchun post-tax rate ham ishlatilmaydi.

q:
Kattakurgan Co's warehouse is being reviewed for impairment. Similar properties are advertised at around $5,000k, but recent transactions show that actual sale prices are 8% below the advertised price. Costs of disposal would be $150k.
What is the warehouse's fair value less costs of disposal? (Enter in $000)
ex:
Haqiqiy kutilayotgan sotuv narxi = 5,000 × (1 − 8%) = 4,600.
FVLCD = 4,600 − 150 = $4,450k. E'lon qilingan narx emas, bozorda haqiqatda erishiladigan narx olinadi.

q:
Termez Co has a 31 December year end. At 1 January 20X7 its delivery van had a carrying amount of $36,000 and a remaining useful life of 6 years (nil residual value). On 30 September 20X7 the van was involved in an accident. After the accident, its value in use was $14,000 and its fair value less costs of disposal was $17,500.
What is the impairment loss on 30 September 20X7? (Enter in $)
ex:
Avval accident sanasigacha depreciation: 36,000/6 × 9/12 = 4,500.
CA 30.09.20X7 = 36,000 − 4,500 = $31,500.
RA = higher of VIU 14,000 va FVLCD 17,500 = $17,500.
Impairment = 31,500 − 17,500 = $14,000.

q:
Nurota Co has a 31 December year end. At 1 January 20X8 a machine had a carrying amount of $36,000 and a remaining useful life of 6 years (nil residual value). On 30 September 20X8 the machine was damaged. After the damage its value in use was $14,000, its fair value less costs of disposal was $17,500 and its remaining useful life was reassessed as 3 years.
What is the total amount charged to profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X8 in respect of the machine (depreciation plus impairment)? (Enter in $, to the nearest whole number)
An item of plant measured under the cost model is found to be impaired. What is the correct accounting entry for the impairment loss?
opt: Dr Revaluation surplus; Cr Plant
Dr Plant; Cr Profit or loss
Dr Retained earnings directly; Cr Plant
Dr Profit or loss; Cr Plant (accumulated depreciation and impairment)
ex: Cost model'da revaluation surplus yo'q, shuning uchun impairment loss darhol P/Lga expense sifatida olinadi: Dr Impairment expense (P/L), Cr Accumulated depreciation and impairment (aktivni kamaytiradi). Retained earnings'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozish noto'g'ri — u P/L orqali o'tadi.

q:
At 1 January 20X5 Zomin Co's plant had a carrying amount of $320,000. It is depreciated at 20% per annum on the reducing balance basis. Due to falling demand, an impairment review was carried out at 31 December 20X5. The present value of the plant's future net cash flows is $238,000. On 31 December 20X5, a rival offered to buy the plant for $250,000; selling costs would be $6,000.
At what amount should the plant be shown in the statement of financial position at 31 December 20X5?

On 31 December 20X3 an asset was written down to its recoverable amount of $48,000. Its remaining useful life at that date was 4 years with nil residual value.
What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 31 December 20X4? (Enter in $)
ex: Impairment'dan keyin depreciation yangi carrying amount asosida qolgan muddat bo'yicha hisoblanadi: 48,000 / 4 = $12,000.

q:
Kogon Co's head office is measured under the revaluation model. At 31 March 20X6 it has a carrying amount of $620,000 and a balance of $150,000 on the revaluation surplus relating to it. An impairment review shows a recoverable amount of $400,000.
How should the impairment loss be recognised?
opt: $220,000 in other comprehensive income
$220,000 in profit or loss
$150,000 in other comprehensive income and $70,000 in profit or loss
$70,000 in other comprehensive income and $150,000 in profit or loss
ex:
Impairment = 620,000 − 400,000 = 220,000.
Revalued aktivda loss avval shu aktivning revaluation surplusiga (OCI) qarshi yoziladi — surplus tugaguncha: 150,000.
Qolgan 220,000 − 150,000 = 70,000 P/L ga.

q:
Bekobod Co bought a building on 1 January 20X1 for $900,000 with a useful life of 30 years. On 1 January 20X4 the building was revalued to $1,080,000; its remaining life was unchanged. Bekobod Co does not make a reserve transfer for excess depreciation. On 31 December 20X6 an impairment review showed a recoverable amount of $600,000.
What impairment loss should be charged to profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X6? (Enter in $)
An impairment loss on a revalued asset is always recognised in full in other comprehensive income.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Revalued aktivning impairment loss'i avval shu aktiv bo'yicha revaluation surplus doirasida OCI ga olinadi. Surplus'dan oshgan qism P/Lga yoziladi. Masalan, surplus 30 va loss 50 bo'lsa: 30 OCI, 20 P/L.

q: A property measured under the revaluation model has a revaluation surplus of $90,000. It suffers an impairment loss of $130,000. Which journal entry correctly records the impairment?
opt: Dr Profit or loss $130,000, Cr Property $130,000
Dr Revaluation surplus $130,000, Cr Property $130,000
Dr Profit or loss $90,000, Dr Revaluation surplus $40,000, Cr Property $130,000
Dr Revaluation surplus $90,000, Dr Profit or loss $40,000, Cr Property $130,000
ex: Loss avval surplus'ni yo'q qiladi: Dr Revaluation surplus 90,000 (OCI orqali). Qolgan 130,000 − 90,000 = 40,000 → Dr P/L. Cr Property 130,000.

q:
Sherobod Co's machine is carried under the revaluation model with a related revaluation surplus of $40,000. An impairment review identifies an impairment loss of $25,000.
What is the balance on the revaluation surplus for this machine after the impairment has been recorded? (Enter in $)
ex:
Loss (25,000) surplus'dan (40,000) kichik → to'liq OCI orqali surplus'ga yoziladi, P/L ga hech narsa ketmaydi.
Qolgan surplus = 40,000 − 25,000 = $15,000.

q: Which of the following is the IAS 36 definition of a cash-generating unit?
opt: The smallest identifiable group of assets that generates cash inflows that are largely independent of the cash inflows from other assets or groups of assets
Any subsidiary of a parent entity that prepares its own financial statements
The largest group of assets that generates cash inflows for the entity
A group of assets under common management that share the same useful life
ex: CGU — eng kichik aniqlanadigan aktivlar guruhi bo'lib, boshqa aktivlardan mustaqil cash inflow keltiradi. CGU subsidiary bo'lishi shart emas, 'eng katta' guruh ham emas.

q: Samarqand Grill operates a chain of 40 restaurants. Each restaurant has its own customers and generates its own cash inflows. For impairment testing, which of the following is most likely to be a cash-generating unit?
opt: Each individual restaurant
Each oven in a restaurant kitchen
The whole chain of 40 restaurants
The head office building
ex: Pech alohida cash inflow keltirmaydi. Butun zanjir — 'eng kichik' guruh emas. Head office mustaqil inflow keltirmaydi (corporate asset). Har bir restoran o'z mijozlaridan mustaqil pul oladi → har bir restoran — CGU. (Kon kompaniyasida esa butun kompaniya bitta CGU bo'lishi mumkin.)

q: Goodwill does not generate cash flows independently of other assets, so for impairment testing it is allocated to the cash-generating units expected to benefit from the business combination.
ex: To'g'ri. Goodwill o'z-o'zidan cash flow keltirmaydi, shuning uchun uning recoverable amount'ini alohida hisoblab bo'lmaydi. U sinergiyadan foyda ko'radigan CGU(lar)ga taqsimlanadi va o'sha CGU har yili test qilinadi.

q: Which TWO of the following statements about cash-generating units (CGUs) are correct under IAS 36?
opt: A CGU must be a separate legal entity such as a subsidiary
An entity may change the way it identifies CGUs from period to period as it chooses
A CGU to which goodwill has been allocated must be tested for impairment annually
An impairment loss on a CGU is allocated pro rata to all assets in the CGU, including goodwill
No asset in a CGU should be written down below its own recoverable amount
ex: To'g'ri: (1) goodwill'li CGU har yili test qilinadi; (2) hech bir aktiv o'z recoverable amount'idan pastga tushirilmaydi. Noto'g'ri: CGU yuridik shaxs bo'lishi shart emas; CGU'lar davrdan davrga izchil (consistent) aniqlanadi; loss avval goodwillga, keyin qolgan aktivlarga pro rata — goodwill pro rata emas.

q: An impairment loss has been identified for a cash-generating unit. No asset in the unit is specifically impaired. In what order should the loss be allocated?
opt: Pro rata to all assets including goodwill, based on carrying amounts
First to current assets, then to property, plant and equipment, then to goodwill
First to intangible assets other than goodwill, then to goodwill
First to goodwill allocated to the unit, then to the other assets pro rata to their carrying amounts
ex: IAS 36 tartibi: (0) aniq shikastlangan aktiv bo'lsa — avval o'shani; (1) goodwill; (2) qolgan aktivlar carrying amount'lari nisbatida pro rata — lekin hech biri o'z RA'sidan pastga tushmaydi (shuning uchun RA'dagi current assets odatda tegilmaydi).

q:
Qarshi Co's subsidiary, treated as one cash-generating unit, has the following carrying amounts ($000):
Goodwill300
Brand400
Property, plant and equipment1200
Net current assets (at recoverable amount)500
The recoverable amount of the unit is $1,700k.
What is the carrying amount of property, plant and equipment after the impairment loss is allocated? (Enter in $000)
ex:
CA jami = 2400; loss = 2400 − 1700 = 700.
Goodwill avval: 300 → qoldiq 400.
Pro rata brand + PPE (1600): PPE = 400 × 1200/1600 = 300; brand = 100.
Net current assets RA'da → tegilmaydi.
PPE = 1200 − 300 = $900k.

q:
Fergana Mills Co is a cash-generating unit with the following carrying amounts ($000):
Goodwill50
Patent30
Property, plant and equipment400
Licence100
Receivables (at recoverable amount)70
The unit's recoverable amount is $420k. The patent has become worthless following a competitor's legal challenge.
What is the carrying amount of the licence after the impairment loss is allocated?
ex:
CA = 650; loss = 650 − 420 = 230.
1) Aniq shikastlangan patent avval nolga: 30 → qoldiq 200.
2) Goodwill: 50 → qoldiq 150.
3) Pro rata PPE + licence (500): licence = 150 × 100/500 = 30; PPE = 120.
Receivables RA'da → tegilmaydi.
Licence = 100 − 30 = $70k.

q:
Jizzakh Co has a division treated as a cash-generating unit, with the following carrying amounts ($000):
Goodwill400
Building1500
Plant900
Intangible assets600
Other net assets (at recoverable amount)300
The recoverable amount of the division is $2,800k. A recent valuation shows the building's fair value less costs of disposal is $1,650k. Jizzakh Co uses the cost model for all non-current assets.
What is the carrying amount of plant after the impairment review? (Enter in $000)
ex:
CA = 3,700; loss = 3,700 − 2,800 = 900.
Goodwill: 400 → qoldiq 500.
Building FVLCD (1,650) > CA (1,500) → building'ni tushirib bo'lmaydi. Other net assets ham RA'da.
Pro rata plant + intangibles (1500): plant = 500 × 900/1500 = 300.
Plant = 900 − 300 = $600k.

q:
Urgut Co has a cash-generating unit with the following carrying amounts ($000):
Goodwill80
Property, plant and equipment500
Brand200
Receivables (at recoverable amount)120
The recoverable amount of the unit is $560k. The brand could be sold separately for $180k net of disposal costs.
What is the carrying amount of property, plant and equipment after the impairment loss is allocated? (Enter in $000)
ex:
CA = 900; loss = 900 − 560 = 340. Goodwill: 80 → qoldiq 260.
Oddiy pro rata bo'yicha brand ulushi = 260 × 200/700 = 74.29 → brand 125.71 bo'lib qolardi, bu uning RA'si (180) dan past.
Shuning uchun brand faqat 200 − 180 = 20 ga kamaytiriladi, qolgan 260 − 20 = 240 PPE ga.
PPE = 500 − 240 = $260k.

q:
Andijan Textiles is a cash-generating unit with the following carrying amounts ($000):
Goodwill60
Property, plant and equipment240
Patent60
Net current assets (at net realisable value)40
Its recoverable amount is $310k.
What is the carrying amount of property, plant and equipment after the impairment loss is allocated?
ex:
CA = 400; loss = 400 − 310 = 90.
Goodwill avval: 60 → qoldiq 30.
Pro rata PPE + patent (300): PPE = 30 × 240/300 = 24.
PPE = 240 − 24 = $216k. Net current assets NRV'da — tegilmaydi.

q: When an impairment loss of a cash-generating unit is allocated, the carrying amount of an asset is not reduced below the highest of its fair value less costs of disposal, its value in use (if determinable) and zero.
ex: To'g'ri. Bu IAS 36 dagi 'floor' qoidasi: pro rata taqsimlashda biror aktiv o'z RA'sidan (FVLCD, VIU va noldan eng kattasi) pastga tushsa, unga faqat RA gacha bo'lgan summa beriladi, ortiqchasi qolgan aktivlarga pro rata qayta taqsimlanadi.

q: Three years ago Buxoro Co recognised an impairment loss on goodwill of a subsidiary. The subsidiary's recoverable amount has now increased significantly. How should this be treated?
opt: Reverse the impairment loss in profit or loss in full
The goodwill impairment loss cannot be reversed
Reverse the impairment loss in other comprehensive income
Reverse the impairment loss, limited to the original cost of the goodwill
ex: Goodwill impairment hech qachon reverse qilinmaydi. Sababi: keyingi qiymat o'sishi ehtimol ichkarida yaratilgan (internally generated) goodwill'dir, IAS 38 esa uni tan olishni taqiqlaydi.

q:
Olmaliq Co bought a machine on 1 January 20X1 for $200,000 with a useful life of 10 years and nil residual value. It uses the cost model. At 31 December 20X2 the machine was impaired to its recoverable amount of $120,000. At 31 December 20X5 the conditions that caused the impairment have reversed and the recoverable amount is now $130,000.
What amount should be credited to profit or loss for the reversal of the impairment at 31 December 20X5? (Enter in $)
ex:
20X2: CA = 200,000 − 20,000 × 2 = 160,000; impairment = 160,000 − 120,000 = 40,000.
Keyin depreciation = 120,000/8 = 15,000 p.a.
CA 31.12.20X5 = 120,000 − 15,000 × 3 = 75,000.
Limit — impairment bo'lmaganda bo'ladigan CA (depreciated historical cost) = 200,000 − 20,000 × 5 = 100,000.
RA 130,000 > limit → faqat 100,000 gacha: reversal = 100,000 − 75,000 = $25,000 (P/L da income).

q: An asset carried under the cost model was impaired in a previous year, with the loss charged to profit or loss. This year the impairment has partly reversed. Where should the reversal be recognised?
opt: Directly in retained earnings
In other comprehensive income as a revaluation gain
In profit or loss as income
It cannot be recognised until the asset is sold
ex: Reversal asl impairment qayerga yozilgan bo'lsa, o'sha yerga qaytadi. Cost model — asl loss P/L da → reversal ham P/Lda income. (Revalued aktivda asl loss surplus'ga yozilgan bo'lsa → reversal OCI da.)

q: An impairment loss recognised for goodwill may be reversed in a later period if the recoverable amount of the cash-generating unit increases.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Goodwill impairment loss'i hech qachon reverse qilinmaydi — keyingi o'sish internally generated goodwill hisoblanadi va uni tan olish mumkin emas.

q: Which TWO of the following could indicate that a previously recognised impairment loss may have reversed?
opt: A decrease in market interest rates
The asset has become idle
A significant improvement in the economic performance of the asset
A competitor has introduced a superior product
The entity's market capitalisation has fallen below its net assets
ex: Reversal indikatorlari impairment indikatorlarining teskarisi: foiz stavkalari pasayishi (VIU oshadi), aktiv natijasining yaxshilanishi, bozor qiymatining oshishi, qulay texnologik/bozor/legal o'zgarishlar. Idle aktiv, raqobatchining yaxshi mahsuloti va market cap'ning net assets'dan pastligi — aksincha, impairment indikatorlari.

q:
Xiva Co bought a machine on 1 January 20X2 for $96,000 with a useful life of 8 years and nil residual value (cost model). At 31 December 20X3 it was impaired to its recoverable amount of $54,000. At 31 December 20X5 the impairment reversed and the recoverable amount was estimated at $70,000. The remaining useful life is unchanged.
What is the depreciation charge for the year ended 31 December 20X6? (Enter in $)
ex:
20X3: CA = 96,000 − 12,000 × 2 = 72,000 → RA 54,000 gacha tushirildi. Keyingi depreciation = 54,000/6 = 9,000.
CA 31.12.20X5 = 54,000 − 9,000 × 2 = 36,000.
Limit (depreciated historical cost) = 96,000 × 4/8 = 48,000. RA 70,000 > limit → yangi CA = 48,000 (reversal 12,000).
20X6 depreciation = 48,000 / 4 yil = $12,000.

q: A building carried under the revaluation model suffered an impairment loss of $50,000 two years ago: $30,000 was debited to the revaluation surplus (eliminating it) and $20,000 was charged to profit or loss. This year the impairment reverses by $45,000 (within the permitted limit). How should the reversal be recognised?
opt: $45,000 in other comprehensive income
$45,000 in profit or loss
$30,000 in other comprehensive income and $15,000 in profit or loss
$20,000 in profit or loss and $25,000 in other comprehensive income
ex:
Revalued aktivda reversal odatda OCI (revaluation surplus)ga yoziladi, lekin avval P/L ga olingan impairment qismi bo'yicha reversal P/L ga qaytadi (xuddi revaluation gain avvalgi P/L loss'ni qoplagandek).
P/L: 20,000 (avval P/L ga olingan summa); OCI: 45,000 − 20,000 = 25,000.

q:
Pap Co holds 70% of Nukus Co and measures non-controlling interest at fair value. Goodwill on acquisition was $800k. At the year end goodwill is found to be impaired by 20%.
By how much does the impairment reduce consolidated retained earnings?
opt: Nil
ex:
Impairment = 800 × 20% = 160.
NCI fair value usulida → impairment parent va NCI o'rtasida ulush bo'yicha bo'linadi: NCI 30% × 160 = 48; group retained earnings 70% × 160 = 112. (Proportionate usulda esa to'liq parent'ga tushardi.)

q: Goodwill acquired in a business combination must be tested for impairment annually, even if there is no indication that it may be impaired.
ex: To'g'ri. Goodwill amortise qilinmaydi, shuning uchun IAS 36 uni (u taqsimlangan CGU orqali) indikator bo'lmasa ham har yili test qilishni talab qiladi.

q:
Scenario: Termiz Holdings Co acquired 100% of Surxon Textiles Co on 1 January 20X7. At 31 December 20X7, following the loss of a major customer, Surxon Textiles Co (a cash-generating unit) had the following carrying amounts in the consolidated financial statements ($000):
Goodwill1800
Brand1200
Property, plant and equipment7200
Production software400
Current assets (at recoverable amount)2400
The recoverable amount of Surxon Textiles Co is estimated at $9,500k. The production software has become obsolete and is now worthless. Termiz Holdings Co measures all non-current assets under the cost model.

What is the total impairment loss for Surxon Textiles Co at 31 December 20X7? (Enter in $000)

What is the carrying amount of the brand after the impairment loss has been allocated (to the nearest $000)?

1) Software aniq shikastlangan → avval nolga: 400. Qoldiq 3,100.

What is the carrying amount of property, plant and equipment after the impairment loss has been allocated? (Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number)

Which TWO of the following statements about this impairment are correct?
opt: The impairment loss is recognised in profit or loss
Part of the loss should be allocated to current assets pro rata to their carrying amount
The goodwill impairment may be reversed if Surxon Textiles Co later regains the lost customer
The current assets are not impaired because they are already carried at recoverable amount
The software write-off is included in the pro rata allocation with the brand and PPE

Scenario: Termiz Holdings Co acquired 100% of Surxon Textiles Co on 1 January 20X7. At 31 December 20X7, following the loss of a major customer, Surxon Textiles Co (a cash-generating unit) had the following carrying amounts in the consolidated financial statements ($000):

Even if the customer had not been lost, why would Termiz Holdings Co still have been required to test Surxon Textiles Co for impairment at 31 December 20X7?
opt: Because goodwill acquired in a business combination has been allocated to the unit
Because the brand has a finite useful life
Because all subsidiaries must be tested for impairment in their first year
Because current assets must be tested for impairment annually
ex: Goodwill (business combination orqali olingan) taqsimlangan CGU har yili, indikatorsiz ham test qilinadi. Subsidiary bo'lgani uchun avtomatik test yo'q; finite life'li brand faqat indikator bo'lsa test qilinadi; current assets IAS 36 bo'yicha har yili test qilinmaydi.

q:
Scenario: Navoiy Metals Co has a 31 December year end. It bought a machine on 1 January 20X4 for $150,000 with a useful life of 10 years and nil residual value (straight-line, time-apportioned). On 1 January 20X6 the machine was revalued to $136,000, with no change to its remaining useful life. Navoiy Metals Co does not transfer excess depreciation to retained earnings.
On 30 June 20X8 a flood damaged the machine. At that date:
  • the machine could be sold for $64,000, with dismantling costs of $3,000
  • its value in use is $58,500
  • a new equivalent machine would cost $170,000
What is the depreciation charge for the machine for the year ended 31 December 20X6?
ex:
Revaluation'dan keyin depreciation = revalued amount / qolgan muddat: 1.1.20X6 da 10 − 2 = 8 yil qolgan.
136,000 / 8 = $17,000.

q:
Scenario: Navoiy Metals Co has a 31 December year end. It bought a machine on 1 January 20X4 for $150,000 with a useful life of 10 years and nil residual value (straight-line, time-apportioned). On 1 January 20X6 the machine was revalued to $136,000, with no change to its remaining useful life. Navoiy Metals Co does not transfer excess depreciation to retained earnings.
On 30 June 20X8 a flood damaged the machine. At that date:
  • the machine could be sold for $64,000, with dismantling costs of $3,000
  • its value in use is $58,500
  • a new equivalent machine would cost $170,000
What is the recoverable amount of the machine at 30 June 20X8? (Enter in $)
ex:
FVLCD = 64,000 − 3,000 = 61,000; VIU = 58,500.
RA = higher = $61,000. Replacement cost (170,000) recoverable amount'ga aloqasi yo'q.

q:
Scenario: Navoiy Metals Co has a 31 December year end. It bought a machine on 1 January 20X4 for $150,000 with a useful life of 10 years and nil residual value (straight-line, time-apportioned). On 1 January 20X6 the machine was revalued to $136,000, with no change to its remaining useful life. Navoiy Metals Co does not transfer excess depreciation to retained earnings.

  • its value in use is $58,500

What impairment loss should be charged to profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X8? (Enter in $)

Scenario: Navoiy Metals Co has a 31 December year end. It bought a machine on 1 January 20X4 for $150,000 with a useful life of 10 years and nil residual value (straight-line, time-apportioned). On 1 January 20X6 the machine was revalued to $136,000, with no change to its remaining useful life. Navoiy Metals Co does not transfer excess depreciation to retained earnings.
On 30 June 20X8 a flood damaged the machine. At that date:
  • the machine could be sold for $64,000, with dismantling costs of $3,000
  • its value in use is $58,500
  • a new equivalent machine would cost $170,000
The cost of a new equivalent machine is relevant in determining the recoverable amount of the damaged machine.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Recoverable amount = higher of FVLCD va VIU. Replacement cost ikkalasiga ham kirmaydi — bu imtihondagi 'chalg'ituvchi' ma'lumot.

q:
Scenario: Navoiy Metals Co has a 31 December year end. It bought a machine on 1 January 20X4 for $150,000 with a useful life of 10 years and nil residual value (straight-line, time-apportioned). On 1 January 20X6 the machine was revalued to $136,000, with no change to its remaining useful life. Navoiy Metals Co does not transfer excess depreciation to retained earnings.
On 30 June 20X8 a flood damaged the machine. At that date:
  • the machine could be sold for $64,000, with dismantling costs of $3,000
  • its value in use is $58,500
  • a new equivalent machine would cost $170,000
Which journal entry correctly records the impairment of the machine at 30 June 20X8?
opt: Dr Profit or loss $32,500, Cr Machine $32,500
Dr Revaluation surplus $32,500, Cr Machine $32,500
Dr Revaluation surplus $16,000, Dr Profit or loss $19,000, Cr Machine $35,000
Dr Revaluation surplus $16,000, Dr Profit or loss $16,500, Cr Machine $32,500
ex: Impairment = 93,500 − 61,000 = 32,500. Avval surplus (16,000) OCI orqali ishlatiladi, qolgan 16,500 P/L ga. Cr Machine 32,500. VIU (58,500) ni RA sifatida olish noto'g'ri, chunki FVLCD (61,000) yuqoriroq.

q: IAS 38 Intangible Assets defines an intangible asset. Which of the following is NOT part of that definition?
opt: It must have a finite useful life
It must be non-monetary
It must have no physical substance
It must be identifiable
ex: IAS 38 ta'rifi: intangible asset — identifiable, non-monetary, without physical substance bo'lgan aktiv. Finite useful life ta'rifning qismi emas — ba'zi intangible'lar indefinite useful lifega ega bo'lishi mumkin (ular amortise qilinmaydi, har yili impairment test qilinadi). Javob: D.

q: Under IAS 38, an intangible asset is identifiable if it meets either of two conditions. Which TWO of the following are those conditions?
opt: It is capable of being sold separately from the rest of the business
It arises from contractual or other legal rights
It is traded in an active market
It has an indefinite useful life
ex: Identifiable bo'lish uchun aktiv quyidagilardan biriga mos kelishi kerak: (1) separable — biznesdan alohida sotilishi/berilishi mumkin; yoki (2) contractual yoki legal rightsdan kelib chiqadi. Active market faqat revaluation model uchun kerak, indefinite life esa amortisation masalasi — identifiability bilan bog'liq emas. Javob: A va B.

q: Pellam Co has spent $180,000 training a team of software engineers who are expected to stay with the company for at least four years. The directors want to recognise the cost as an intangible asset. Why is this NOT permitted by IAS 38?
opt: Training is not expected to produce any future economic benefits
The entity cannot control the future economic benefits from the trained staff
Training costs cannot be measured reliably
Training costs are always treated as research
ex: Aktiv bo'lishi uchun entity kelajakdagi foydani control qilishi kerak. Xodimlar istalgan vaqtda ishdan ketishi mumkin — kompaniya ularning bilimi va malakasidan keladigan foydaga boshqalarning kirishini cheklay olmaydi. Shuning uchun training xarajatlari darhol P/L'ga expense qilinadi. Foyda kelishi mumkin (A noto'g'ri), xarajat aniq o'lchanadi (C noto'g'ri). Javob: B.

q: To recognise an intangible asset, an entity must show both that future economic benefits attributable to the asset are probable and that the cost of the asset can be measured reliably.
ex: To'g'ri. IAS 38 bo'yicha recognition uchun ikkita shart: (1) ta'rifga mos kelishi (identifiable, control, future economic benefits) va (2) recognition criteria — foyda kelishi probable va cost reliably measurable. Shartlar bajarilsa, aktiv dastlab costda tan olinadi.

q: Which of the following would be classified as an intangible asset in the statement of financial position of Rowan Co?
opt: Amounts owed by credit customers
Stocks of printed textbooks held for resale
A purchased five-year fishing licence
Cash held in a foreign currency bank account
ex: Intangible — jismoniy shakli yo'q, non-monetary va identifiable aktiv. Trade receivables va bank — monetary aktivlar (pul yoki pul olish huquqi). Inventory — jismoniy (tangible) aktiv. Sotib olingan fishing licence (baliq ovlash litsenziyasi) — legal rightdan kelib chiqadi, jismsiz, non-monetary. Javob: C.

q: Brixton Co purchased a computer-controlled cutting machine for $240,000. The price included the operating software, without which the machine cannot function. How should the software element be classified?
opt: As inventory until the machine is first used
As a separate intangible asset
As an expense in profit or loss
As part of property, plant and equipment, together with the machine
ex: Agar software hardware'ning ajralmas qismi (integral part) bo'lsa — ya'ni u'siz mashina ishlamasa — u PPE (IAS 16) sifatida mashina bilan birga hisobga olinadi. Agar software alohida (masalan, buxgalteriya dasturi) bo'lsa — intangible asset bo'ladi. Bu yerda dastursiz mashina ishlamaydi, demak butun $240,000 PPE. Javob: A.

q: Tamsin Co incurred the following costs during the year. Which of them could be recognised as intangible assets?
opt: An import quota purchased from another company
Legal and registration fees on the successful registration of a patent
A television advertising campaign for a new product
Training staff to use a new customer database
A ten-year restaurant franchise purchased from the franchisor
ex: A: sotib olingan import quota — legal right, alohida sotib olingan → capitalise. B: muvaffaqiyatli ro'yxatdan o'tgan patent uchun to'lovlar — patent qiymatiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tegishli → capitalise. C: reklama kampaniyasi — IAS 38 advertising va promotional xarajatlarni har doim expense qiladi. D: xodimlar training'i — control yo'q → expense. E: sotib olingan franchise — contractual right, cost ma'lum → capitalise. Javob: A, B, E.

q:
Galway Co bought the patent for a water-filtration process on 1 March 20X6. The following costs were incurred:
Item$
Purchase price of the patent320,000
Legal fees for transferring the patent18,000
Testing that the process works properly before use7,000
Advertising the new filtered-water product25,000
Training staff to operate the process12,000
Allocation of general head office overheads9,000
What is the initial cost of the patent to be recognised as an intangible asset? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Alohida sotib olingan intangible cost = purchase price + to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tegishli (directly attributable) xarajatlar (professional/legal fees, aktiv to'g'ri ishlashini tekshirish).
Cost = 320,000 + 18,000 + 7,000 = $345,000.
Kiritilmaydi: advertising (25,000), training (12,000), general overheads (9,000) — bular P/L'ga expense.

q: How should a separately purchased trademark be measured on initial recognition under IAS 38?
opt: At cost
At fair value determined by an independent valuer
At the present value of expected future cash flows
At nil, as trademarks cannot be recognised
ex: Alohida sotib olingan intangible asset dastlab costda tan olinadi (purchase price + directly attributable costs). Keyinchalik cost model yoki (active market bo'lsa) revaluation model tanlanadi. Javob: B.

q: Marlow Co paid $175,000 for the rights to a well-known brand name. At the year end an independent brand consultant estimated that the brand was worth $240,000. Marlow Co may remeasure the brand to $240,000 using the IAS 38 revaluation model.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Revaluation model faqat active market mavjud bo'lsa ishlatiladi. Brand'lar noyob (unique, homogeneous emas) — active market yo'q, va IAS 38 brand name, patent, trademark, publishing rights revaluation'ini aniq taqiqlaydi. Mutaxassis bahosi active market narxi emas. Brand cost modelda qoladi: $175,000 less amortisation/impairment.

q: Why is internally generated (inherent) goodwill NOT recognised in the financial statements?
opt: Because it does not exist until the business is sold
Because it generates no future economic benefits
Because it must be written off to retained earnings immediately
Because its value cannot be measured reliably and it is not identifiable
ex: Inherent goodwill albatta mavjud (reputatsiya, xodimlar, mijozlar), lekin uning cost'ini ishonchli o'lchab bo'lmaydi va u alohida identifiable resurs emas — shuning uchun recognition criteria bajarilmaydi. Purchased goodwill esa sotib olish paytida aniq summa to'langani uchun tan olinadi. Javob: C.

q: On 1 January 20X7 Oakfield Co acquired the whole of the trade and net assets of an unincorporated business for $1,800,000 in cash. The fair value of the identifiable tangible net assets acquired was $1,200,000. In addition, the business owned an internally generated brand that it had never recognised; Oakfield Co can measure the fair value of this brand reliably at $250,000. What amount of goodwill should Oakfield Co recognise? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Biznes sotib olinganda sotib oluvchi (acquirer) uchun target'ning internally generated brand'i endi sotib olingan aktiv hisoblanadi — fair value ishonchli o'lchansa, alohida intangible sifatida tan olinadi (goodwill ichiga kirmaydi).
Identifiable net assets = 1,200,000 + 250,000 = 1,450,000
Goodwill = 1,800,000 − 1,450,000 = $350,000.

q: An acquirer pays less than the fair value of the identifiable net assets of the business it acquires. After reassessing the values, how should the difference be treated?
opt: Deducted from positive goodwill elsewhere in the group
Held as a liability and released over five years
Recognised immediately as a gain in profit or loss
Credited directly to retained earnings
ex: Bu negative goodwill (gain on a bargain purchase). IFRS 3 bo'yicha avval qiymatlar qayta tekshiriladi; farq baribir qolsa, u darhol profit or loss'da income sifatida tan olinadi. Javob: D.

q: Which of the following factors may contribute to the goodwill of a business?
opt: A reputation for reliable after-sales service
A skilled and experienced management team
Favourable long-term supply contracts
A separately purchased patent
Trade receivables
ex: Goodwill — alohida aniqlanmaydigan omillar natijasi: reputatsiya, malakali xodimlar/management, foydali shartnomalar va joylashuv. Sotib olingan patent va trade receivables — identifiable aktivlar, ular goodwill ichida emas, alohida tan olinadi. Javob: A, B, C.

q: Castell Co acquired 100% of Dunmore Co during the year. Dunmore Co had an internally generated customer list that Castell Co cannot value reliably, and an internally generated publishing title that Castell Co has valued reliably at $420,000. How should these items be treated in Castell Co's consolidated financial statements?
opt: Both items are included within goodwill
The publishing title is recognised separately; the customer list is included within goodwill
Both items are recognised as separate intangible assets
Neither item is recognised because both were internally generated by Dunmore Co
ex: Business combination'da target'ning aktivlari acquirer nuqtai nazaridan sotib olingan hisoblanadi. Fair value ishonchli o'lchansa — alohida intangible (publishing title $420,000). Ishonchli o'lchanmasa — alohida tan olinmaydi va goodwill ichiga subsumed bo'ladi (customer list). Javob: B.

q: Under IFRS, purchased goodwill arising on a business combination is amortised on a straight-line basis over a maximum of ten years.
ex: Noto'g'ri. IFRS 3 / IAS 36 bo'yicha goodwill amortise qilinmaydi. Uning o'rniga har yili (va impairment belgisi bo'lsa tez-tez) impairment test qilinadi. Amortisation — UK GAAP/IFRS for SMEs xususiyati, F7 (full IFRS) uchun emas.

q: Which of the following internally generated items can NEVER be recognised as intangible assets under IAS 38?
opt: Brands
Mastheads
Publishing titles
Customer lists
Development costs meeting all the IAS 38 criteria
ex: IAS 38 quyidagi internally generated narsalarni hech qachon tan olishga ruxsat bermaydi: brands, mastheads, publishing titles, customer lists (va inherent goodwill). Ularning xarajatini biznesni rivojlantirish xarajatidan ajratib bo'lmaydi. Development costs esa PIRATE mezonlari bajarilsa albatta capitalise qilinadi. Javob: A, B, C, D.

q: Linford Co spent $350,000 on a television campaign to build its own brand. A consultant now values the brand at $1.1 million. How should Linford Co account for the brand?
opt: Recognise an intangible asset of $1.1 million with the gain in other comprehensive income
Expense the $350,000 to profit or loss and recognise no asset
Recognise an intangible asset at its cost of $350,000
Disclose the brand as a contingent asset
ex: Bu internally generated brand — IAS 38 bo'yicha hech qachon tan olinmaydi. Reklama xarajati biznesni umumiy rivojlantirish xarajatidan ajratilmaydi, shuning uchun $350,000 darhol P/L'ga expense. Konsultant bahosi (fair value) ahamiyatsiz. Javob: C.

q: As part of building its own corporate brand, Harcourt Co paid a design agency $90,000 to create a new logo and visual identity for the whole business. What is the correct treatment of the $90,000?
opt: Capitalise as a development cost and amortise over five years
Capitalise as an intangible asset with an indefinite life
Capitalise and revalue annually
Expense to profit or loss as incurred
ex: Yangi logo va korporativ imidj — bu internally generated brand qurishga o'xshash xarajat; u alohida identifiable aktiv yaratmaydi va biznesning umumiy imidjidan ajratib bo'lmaydi. Demak P/L'ga expense. Javob: D.

q: Internally generated goodwill may be recognised if the directors obtain a valuation of the business from an independent professional valuer.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Inherent (internally generated) goodwill hech qachon tan olinmaydi — mustaqil baholash ham recognition criteria'ni qondirmaydi, chunki goodwill identifiable emas va uning cost'i ishonchli o'lchanmaydi. Faqat business combination'dan kelgan purchased goodwill tan olinadi.

q: Which of the following best describes research as defined by IAS 38?
opt: Original and planned investigation undertaken with the prospect of gaining new scientific or technical knowledge and understanding
The application of research findings to a plan or design for new or substantially improved products before commercial production
Any expenditure on a project that has not yet reached commercial production
Expenditure incurred after a project has been approved by the board
ex: IAS 38: research — yangi ilmiy yoki texnik bilim va tushuncha olish maqsadida o'tkaziladigan original va rejalashtirilgan tadqiqot. B — bu development ta'rifi (research natijalarini reja/dizaynga qo'llash). Javob: A.

q: Which of the following activities is most likely to be classified as development?
opt: Laboratory work to discover the properties of a newly identified polymer
Routine quality improvements to a product already in commercial production
Building and testing a pre-production prototype of a new electric scooter
Searching for possible alternative materials for use in packaging
ex: Development — research natijalarini ishlab chiqarishdan oldin ma'lum mahsulot/jarayon dizayniga qo'llash. Pre-production prototype qurish va sinash — klassik development misoli. A va D — yangi bilim izlash (research). B — tijorat ishlab chiqarishi boshlangandan keyingi oddiy takomillashtirish (development ham emas, oddiy operating cost). Javob: C.

q: Which TWO of the following are examples of research activities under IAS 38?
opt: Activities aimed at obtaining new knowledge about battery chemistry
The search for alternative processes that might be used in production
The design of tools and moulds involving new technology
The operation of a pilot plant that is not of a scale for commercial production
ex: Research: yangi bilim izlash, muqobil variantlarni qidirish (A, B). C (yangi texnologiyali instrumentlar dizayni) va D (tijorat miqyosida bo'lmagan pilot zavodni ishga tushirish) — development faoliyati, chunki ular aniq mahsulot/jarayonga yo'naltirilgan. Javob: A va B.

q: Which of the following is NOT one of the conditions in IAS 38 that must be demonstrated before development expenditure is capitalised?
opt: Technical feasibility of completing the asset
Availability of adequate technical, financial and other resources to complete the project
The asset will generate revenue from sales to external customers
Ability to measure reliably the expenditure attributable to the asset
ex: PIRATE: Probable future economic benefits, Intention to complete and use/sell, Resources adequate to complete, Ability to use or sell, Technical feasibility, Expenditure reliably measured. Tashqi sotuvdan revenue shart emas — foyda ichki xarajat tejash (cost savings) orqali ham kelishi mumkin. Javob: D.

q: Which TWO of the following must be demonstrated before development expenditure can be recognised as an intangible asset?
opt: Adequate financial resources are available to complete the project
The entity intends to complete the asset and use or sell it
The project has been approved by shareholders in general meeting
The product will achieve at least a 10% market share
ex: PIRATE mezonlaridan: adequate resources (R) va intention to complete (I). Aksiyadorlar tasdig'i va bozor ulushi talab qilinmaydi — ular IAS 38 mezonlari emas. Javob: A va B.

q: If a development project meets all of the IAS 38 recognition criteria, the entity may choose either to capitalise the expenditure or to expense it, provided the policy is applied consistently.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Barcha mezonlar bajarilsa, development expenditure majburan capitalise qilinadi (IAS 38 'must' deydi). Tanlov yo'q — bu imtihonda eng ko'p uchraydigan tuzoq.

q: Which of the following projects of Norland Co should be capitalised as development expenditure at 31 December 20X5?
opt: $95,000 on a prototype engine; engineers have not yet been able to make it run reliably
$140,000 on a new automated packing process that has been proven to work, is fully funded and will cut packing costs by $50,000 a year
$60,000 paid to a university to research new lightweight alloys
$80,000 on a new product which is technically complete but is forecast to be sold at a loss throughout its life
ex: A: texnik jihatdan hali mumkin emas — T (technical feasibility) bajarilmagan → expense. B: universitetga pure research uchun to'lov → research → expense. C: jarayon texnik jihatdan isbotlangan, moliyalash ta'minlangan, foyda cost savings ko'rinishida — barcha mezonlar bajarilgan → capitalise. D: mahsulot zarar keltiradi — P (probable economic benefits) bajarilmagan → expense. Javob: C.

q: Quarry Co has spent $210,000 developing a new garden tool. Midway through the year a competitor launched a cheaper rival product, and at the year end Quarry Co's board has suspended further funding while it reconsiders whether to continue. How should the $210,000 be treated at the year end?
opt: Expense to profit or loss, because intention and resources to complete cannot be demonstrated
Capitalise, because the product is technically feasible
Capitalise and amortise immediately over the expected product life
Treat as a contingent asset and disclose in the notes
ex: Capitalise qilish uchun barcha PIRATE mezonlari yil oxirida bajarilgan bo'lishi kerak. Board moliyalashni to'xtatgan — Intention va Resources isbotlanmagan, raqobatchi tufayli Probable benefits ham shubhali. Demak $210,000 expense. Javob: B.

q: Development of a new internal process that will not increase sales revenue, but is expected to reduce production costs significantly, may be recognised as an intangible asset if the IAS 38 criteria are met.
ex: To'g'ri. Probable future economic benefits revenue orqali ham, ichki xarajatlarni tejash (cost savings) orqali ham bo'lishi mumkin. Boshqa mezonlar bajarilsa — capitalise.

q: Kestrel Co began a development project on 1 February 20X6 and spent $30,000 per month on it until the project was completed on 31 August 20X6. The project met all of the IAS 38 capitalisation criteria from 1 May 20X6. What amount should be capitalised as a development asset? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Faqat mezonlar bajarilgan sanadan keyingi xarajat capitalise qilinadi.
Jami: fevral–avgust = 7 oy × 30,000 = 210,000.
Capitalise: may, iyun, iyul, avgust = 4 oy × 30,000 = $120,000.
Qolgan 3 oy (fevral–aprel) = 90,000 → P/L expense (keyin qayta tiklanmaydi).

q: Kestrel Co capitalised $120,000 of development costs on a project completed on 31 August 20X6. Commercial production and sales of the product began on 1 October 20X6. The product is expected to have a useful life of four years, and Kestrel Co time-apportions amortisation. What is the carrying amount of the development asset at 31 December 20X6? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Amortisation tijorat ishlab chiqarishi boshlanganda (1 oktyabr) boshlanadi, loyiha tugagan sanadan emas.
Amortisation = 120,000 / 4 × 3/12 = 7,500
Carrying amount = 120,000 − 7,500 = $112,500.

q: During the year ended 31 December 20X8 Lorne Co incurred $260,000 of development costs on a new product; all IAS 38 criteria were met throughout. On 1 April 20X8 it bought a machine for $90,000 which was used exclusively on the development project for the rest of the year. The machine has a useful life of 5 years and no residual value. Lorne Co also spent $35,000 building a brand identity for the product. Commercial production will start in 20X9. What amount should be included in intangible assets at 31 December 20X8? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Development loyihasida ishlatilgan mashinaning depreciation'i loyiha davrida development cost'ga qo'shiladi (mashina esa PPE'da qoladi).
Depreciation = 90,000 / 5 × 9/12 = 13,500
Intangible = 260,000 + 13,500 = $273,500.
Brand identity (35,000) — internally generated brand → expense. Amortisation yo'q, chunki production 20X9'da boshlanadi.

q:
Selwyn Co has the following projects at 31 December 20X6:
  • Project P: $60,000 spent this year on the research phase.
  • Project Q: development costs of $150,000 were capitalised in previous years (not yet amortised, as production had not started) and a further $45,000 was spent this year. At the year end the board decided to abandon the project.
  • Project R: $210,000 was spent this year; the project meets all the IAS 38 criteria. Production will start in 20X7.
What is the total charge to profit or loss for the year in respect of these projects? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
P: research → expense 60,000.
Q: loyiha tashlab yuborildi — endi probable economic benefits yo'q. Oldin capitalise qilingan 150,000 ham, bu yilgi 45,000 ham P/L'ga yoziladi = 195,000.
R: capitalise 210,000, amortisation yo'q (production hali boshlanmagan).
Jami P/L = 60,000 + 195,000 = $255,000.

q: In 20X4 Ferris Co expensed $75,000 on a project because the IAS 38 criteria were not yet met. In 20X5 the criteria were met and a further $120,000 was spent. What amount should be carried as a development asset at the end of 20X5, before any amortisation?
ex: IAS 38: bir marta expense qilingan xarajat keyinroq qayta aktivga tiklanmaydi (cannot be reinstated). Faqat mezonlar bajarilgandan keyingi $120,000 capitalise qilinadi. Javob: A.

q: Which of the following costs is NOT directly attributable to creating an internally generated intangible asset and so cannot be capitalised?
opt: Salaries of engineers working directly on the project
Fees to register the resulting legal right
Amortisation of a licence used to generate the asset
Selling and general administrative overheads
ex: Directly attributable: materiallar va xizmatlar, loyihada ishlovchi xodimlar maoshi, legal right ro'yxatdan o'tkazish to'lovi, loyihada ishlatilgan patent/aktivlar amortisation'i. Selling, administrative va general overheads, xodimlar training'i va aktiv tayyor bo'lgunga qadar yuzaga kelgan zararlar kiritilmaydi. Javob: D.

q: Pembury Co is developing a new medical sensor and all IAS 38 criteria have been met. Which of the following costs should be capitalised as part of the development asset?
opt: Salaries of the technicians working full time on the sensor
Fees paid to register a patent for the sensor
Depreciation of test equipment used solely on the project
An allocation of head office administration costs
Training the sales force to sell the sensor
ex: A — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlaydigan xodimlar maoshi ✔. B — patent ro'yxatdan o'tkazish to'lovi ✔. C — loyihada ishlatilgan asbob-uskunaning depreciation'i ✔. D — umumiy admin overheads ✘ (directly attributable emas). E — sotuv xodimlarini o'qitish ✘ (training har doim expense). Javob: A, B, C.

q: When should amortisation of capitalised development expenditure begin?
opt: From the date the first expenditure is capitalised
From the start of the following financial year
From the date the asset is available for use, usually when commercial production begins
Only when the product first makes a profit
ex: Development asset foydalanish uchun tayyor bo'lganda — amalda commercial production boshlanganda amortise qilina boshlaydi. Loyiha tugagan sana yoki capitalise qilingan sana emas. Javob: B.

q: Brampton Co has capitalised development costs of $840,000 for a new product that went into production on 1 January 20X4. Expected unit sales are: 20X4 150,000; 20X5 250,000; 20X6 300,000; 20X7 100,000. Brampton Co amortises development costs on the basis of expected units sold, as this reflects the pattern of benefits. What is the amortisation charge for 20X4? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Amortisation usuli foyda iste'mol qilinish tartibini aks ettirishi kerak — bu yerda units-of-sales usuli.
Jami kutilgan sotuv = 150,000 + 250,000 + 300,000 + 100,000 = 800,000 dona
20X4 amortisation = 840,000 × 150,000/800,000 = $157,500.

q: Ashgrove Co completed a development project on 30 June 20X5 at a capitalised cost of $540,000. The product was launched and commercial sales began on 1 August 20X5. The product's useful life is six years. Ashgrove Co's year end is 31 December and it time-apportions amortisation. What is the amortisation charge for the year ended 31 December 20X5? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Amortisation 1 avgustdan (sotuv boshlangan sanadan) boshlanadi — avgust–dekabr = 5 oy.
Amortisation = 540,000 / 6 × 5/12 = $37,500.

q: On 1 July 20X4 Carrick Co bought an operating licence for $600,000. The licence has a legal life of eight years, but Carrick Co expects to use it for only 5 years, after which the technology will be obsolete. Carrick Co's year end is 31 December and amortisation is time-apportioned. What is the carrying amount of the licence at 31 December 20X5? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Useful life = legal life va kutilgan foydalanish muddatining qisqarog'i → 5 yil.
20X4: 600,000 / 5 × 6/12 = 60,000
20X5: 600,000 / 5 = 120,000
Carrying amount = 600,000 − 60,000 − 120,000 = $420,000.

q: Denby Co acquired a broadcasting licence that is renewable every ten years at negligible cost. Denby Co intends to renew it indefinitely and has the ability to do so. How should the licence be accounted for after initial recognition?
opt: Do not amortise, but test for impairment at least annually
Amortise over a maximum of 20 years
Amortise over ten years
Write off immediately to profit or loss
ex: Yangilash cheksiz va arzon bo'lsa, foyda keltirish muddatining aniq chegarasi yo'q → indefinite useful life. Bunday intangible amortise qilinmaydi, lekin har yili (va belgi bo'lsa tez-tez) impairment test qilinadi. Indefinite ≠ infinite; har yili muddat qayta ko'rib chiqiladi. Javob: C.

q: What residual value should normally be assumed for an intangible asset with a finite useful life?
opt: 10% of cost
Zero
Its expected market value at the end of its life, in all cases
The same as its original cost
ex: IAS 38: finite useful life'li intangible'ning residual value'si odatda nol deb olinadi (agar uchinchi tomon uni sotib olish majburiyatini olmagan yoki active market bo'lmasa). Odatda straight-line usuli ishlatiladi. Javob: A.

q: The useful life of an intangible asset arising from a legal right may be shorter than the legal life of that right.
ex: To'g'ri. Useful life — legal (shartnoma) muddati va entity aktivdan foydalanishni kutgan muddatning qisqarog'i. Masalan, 10 yillik patent, lekin texnologiya 6 yilda eskiradi → 6 yil amortise.

q: Wexford Co bought a patent for $480,000 and began amortising it over eight years on a straight-line basis. At the start of year 4, following the release of a competing technology, Wexford Co estimates that the patent's remaining useful life is only 2 years. What is the amortisation charge for year 4?
ex:
Useful life o'zgarishi — change in accounting estimate (IAS 8), prospective qo'llanadi: qolgan carrying amount qolgan muddatga bo'linadi.
3 yil amortisation = 480,000 / 8 × 3 = 180,000
Carrying amount = 480,000 − 180,000 = 300,000
Year 4 amortisation = 300,000 / 2 = $150,000. Javob: B.

q: Under IAS 38, in what circumstance may an entity use the revaluation model for an intangible asset?
opt: When an independent valuer has valued the asset
When fair value can be determined by reference to an active market
When the asset was internally generated
When the asset has an indefinite useful life
ex: Revaluation model faqat fair value active marketga asoslanib aniqlanishi mumkin bo'lsa ruxsat etiladi. Active market — tranzaksiyalar yetarli tez-tez va hajmda bo'lib, narx doimiy mavjud bo'lgan bozor. Javob: D.

q: IAS 38 states that active markets cannot exist for certain intangible assets, so they cannot be revalued. Which of the following fall into this category?
opt: Brand names
Patents
Publishing rights
Freely transferable taxi licences with published trading prices
Freely transferable fishing quotas
ex: IAS 38 brand names, patents, trademarks, publishing rights uchun active market bo'lmaydi deydi — ular noyob (homogeneous emas). Taxi litsenziyalari va ba'zi fishing/production kvotalari esa bir xil (homogeneous) va ochiq narxda savdo qilinishi mumkin → revaluation mumkin. Javob: A, B, C.

q: On 1 January 20X1 Mirren Co bought a fishing quota for $2,400,000. The quota has a useful life of 12 years and is traded in an active market. Mirren Co uses the revaluation model. On 1 January 20X3 the quota's fair value was $2,500,000. What revaluation surplus arises on 1 January 20X3? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Yillik amortisation = 2,400,000 / 12 = 200,000
1 Jan 20X3 carrying amount = 2,400,000 − 200,000 × 2 = 2,000,000
Revaluation surplus = 2,500,000 − 2,000,000 = $500,000 → OCI / revaluation surplus (equity).

q: Mirren Co revalued its fishing quota to $2,500,000 on 1 January 20X3, when its remaining useful life was 10 years. What amortisation charge should be recognised in profit or loss for 20X3? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Revaluation'dan keyin amortisation yangi (revalued) qiymat asosida, qolgan muddat bo'yicha hisoblanadi.
Amortisation = 2,500,000 / 10 = $250,000.

q: Following the revaluation of its fishing quota, Mirren Co's annual amortisation is $250,000. Amortisation based on the original cost would have been $200,000. Mirren Co transfers the excess amortisation each year. Which entry records this transfer?
opt: Dr Revaluation surplus $50,000, Cr Retained earnings $50,000
Dr Revaluation surplus $250,000, Cr Retained earnings $250,000
Dr Profit or loss $50,000, Cr Revaluation surplus $50,000
Dr Retained earnings $50,000, Cr Revaluation surplus $50,000
ex:
Revaluation surplus realisation qilinayotgani sayin excess amortisation revaluation surplus'dan retained earnings'ga ko'chiriladi (equity ichida, P/L orqali emas).
Excess = 250,000 − 200,000 = 50,000
Dr Revaluation surplus 50,000 / Cr Retained earnings 50,000. Javob: C.

q: Mirren Co's fishing quota was revalued upwards on 1 January 20X3, creating a revaluation surplus of $500,000; Mirren Co does not make an annual reserve transfer for excess amortisation. The revalued amount was $2,500,000 and amortisation of $250,000 was charged in 20X3. On 31 December 20X3 the quota's fair value in the active market fell to $1,600,000. What amount should be recognised as an expense in profit or loss for the revaluation decrease? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
31 Dec 20X3 carrying amount = 2,500,000 − 250,000 = 2,250,000
Revaluation decrease = 2,250,000 − 1,600,000 = 650,000
Avval shu aktiv bo'yicha surplus'ga qarshi (OCI): 500,000
Qolgan qismi P/L'ga: 650,000 − 500,000 = $150,000.

q: Which of the following is a feature of an active market as described in IAS 38 and IFRS 13?
opt: Each item traded is unique
The items traded are homogeneous and prices are available to the public
Prices are negotiated privately between buyer and seller
Transactions happen only occasionally
ex: Active market belgilari: savdo qilinadigan narsalar bir xil (homogeneous), xaridor va sotuvchi doim topiladi, narxlar ommaga ochiq. Noyoblik (A) aynan active market yo'qligini ko'rsatadi. Javob: B.

q: At 31 December 20X5 a patent held by Fenwick Co has a carrying amount of $450,000. There are indications of impairment. The patent's fair value less costs of disposal is $380,000 and its value in use is $410,000. What impairment loss should be recognised? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
IAS 36: recoverable amount = fair value less costs of disposal va value in usening kattasi.
Recoverable amount = max(380,000, 410,000) = 410,000
Impairment loss = 450,000 − 410,000 = $40,000 (cost model → P/L).

q: Tolland Co bought a licence for $900,000 on 1 January 20X1 and amortises it over 10 years on a straight-line basis. At 31 December 20X3 an impairment review showed the licence's recoverable amount to be $455,000; the remaining useful life was unchanged. What is the carrying amount of the licence at 31 December 20X4? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
31 Dec 20X3 carrying amount = 900,000 − 90,000 × 3 = 630,000
Impairment loss = 630,000 − 455,000 = 175,000 → carrying amount 455,000 ga tushiriladi
20X4 amortisation = 455,000 / 7 qolgan yil = 65,000
31 Dec 20X4 carrying amount = 455,000 − 65,000 = $390,000.

q: Capitalised development costs for a project that is not yet complete (and so not yet being amortised) must be tested for impairment:
opt: Only when commercial production begins
At least annually, whether or not there is an indication of impairment
Every five years
Only if there is an indication of impairment
ex: IAS 36: hali foydalanishga tayyor bo'lmagan intangible (masalan, tugallanmagan development) va indefinite life'li intangible'lar, hamda goodwill — impairment belgisi bo'lmasa ham har yili test qilinadi. Javob: D.

q: Ivel Co has $320,000 of capitalised development costs for a product that is no longer expected to be completed because a key supplier has gone out of business. How should Ivel Co account for the $320,000?
opt: Write it off immediately to profit or loss
Continue to amortise it over the original expected life
Transfer it to property, plant and equipment
Debit it directly to retained earnings as a prior year adjustment
ex: Loyiha tugatilmaydi → kelajakdagi iqtisodiy foyda kutilmaydi. Aktiv derecognise qilinadi va butun carrying amount darhol P/L'ga yoziladi (impairment/write-off). Revaluation surplus'ga yoki retained earnings'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas. Javob: A.

q:
Vireo Co prepares financial statements to 31 December 20X5. It is working on Project Lumen, a new diagnostic device.
  • 1 January – 31 March 20X5: laboratory investigation into new sensor materials, costing $45,000 per month.
  • 1 April – 30 September 20X5: design and testing of a pre-production prototype, costing $60,000 per month. All the IAS 38 capitalisation criteria were met from 1 June 20X5.
  • On 1 June 20X5 Vireo Co bought test equipment for $72,000 (useful life 4 years, nil residual value), used solely on Project Lumen until 30 September 20X5, and afterwards on the production line.
  • Commercial production began on 1 October 20X5. The device is expected to generate benefits for five years. Vireo Co amortises on a straight-line, time-apportioned basis.
How should the costs incurred from 1 January to 31 March 20X5 be treated?
opt: Capitalise as development costs, as the project later met the criteria
Capitalise as research costs and amortise from 1 October 20X5
Expense to profit or loss as research costs
Include in the cost of the test equipment
ex: Yanvar–mart — yangi material xususiyatlarini o'rganish = research. Research har doim P/L'ga expense: 3 × 45,000 = 135,000. Javob: C.

q:
Vireo Co prepares financial statements to 31 December 20X5. It is working on Project Lumen, a new diagnostic device.
  • 1 January – 31 March 20X5: laboratory investigation into new sensor materials, costing $45,000 per month.
  • 1 April – 30 September 20X5: design and testing of a pre-production prototype, costing $60,000 per month. All the IAS 38 capitalisation criteria were met from 1 June 20X5.
  • On 1 June 20X5 Vireo Co bought test equipment for $72,000 (useful life 4 years, nil residual value), used solely on Project Lumen until 30 September 20X5, and afterwards on the production line.
  • Commercial production began on 1 October 20X5. The device is expected to generate benefits for five years. Vireo Co amortises on a straight-line, time-apportioned basis.
What is the total amount capitalised as a development asset in respect of Project Lumen by 30 September 20X5 (before amortisation)? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Mezonlar 1 iyundan bajarilgan → iyun–sentyabr 4 oy × 60,000 = 240,000
Test equipment depreciation (iyun–sentyabr, 4 oy) = 72,000 / 4 × 4/12 = 6,000 → development cost'ga qo'shiladi
Jami capitalised = 240,000 + 6,000 = $246,000.
Aprel–may (2 × 60,000 = 120,000) — mezonlar bajarilmagan → expense.

q:
Vireo Co prepares financial statements to 31 December 20X5. It is working on Project Lumen, a new diagnostic device.
  • 1 January – 31 March 20X5: laboratory investigation into new sensor materials, costing $45,000 per month.
  • 1 April – 30 September 20X5: design and testing of a pre-production prototype, costing $60,000 per month. All the IAS 38 capitalisation criteria were met from 1 June 20X5.
  • On 1 June 20X5 Vireo Co bought test equipment for $72,000 (useful life 4 years, nil residual value), used solely on Project Lumen until 30 September 20X5, and afterwards on the production line.
  • Commercial production began on 1 October 20X5. The device is expected to generate benefits for five years. Vireo Co amortises on a straight-line, time-apportioned basis.
What is the carrying amount of the development asset at 31 December 20X5? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Capitalised = 246,000
Amortisation 1 oktyabrdan (3 oy): 246,000 / 5 × 3/12 = 12,300
Carrying amount = 246,000 − 12,300 = $233,700.

q:
Vireo Co prepares financial statements to 31 December 20X5. It is working on Project Lumen, a new diagnostic device.
  • 1 January – 31 March 20X5: laboratory investigation into new sensor materials, costing $45,000 per month.
  • 1 April – 30 September 20X5: design and testing of a pre-production prototype, costing $60,000 per month. All the IAS 38 capitalisation criteria were met from 1 June 20X5.
  • On 1 June 20X5 Vireo Co bought test equipment for $72,000 (useful life 4 years, nil residual value), used solely on Project Lumen until 30 September 20X5, and afterwards on the production line.
  • Commercial production began on 1 October 20X5. The device is expected to generate benefits for five years. Vireo Co amortises on a straight-line, time-apportioned basis.
What is the total amount charged to profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X5 for research costs, development costs expensed and amortisation of Project Lumen? (Ignore depreciation of the test equipment after 30 September 20X5.) Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Research: 3 × 45,000 = 135,000
Development (aprel–may, mezonlardan oldin): 2 × 60,000 = 120,000
Amortisation: 12,300
Jami = 135,000 + 120,000 + 12,300 = $267,300.

q:
Vireo Co prepares financial statements to 31 December 20X5. It is working on Project Lumen, a new diagnostic device.
  • 1 January – 31 March 20X5: laboratory investigation into new sensor materials, costing $45,000 per month.
  • 1 April – 30 September 20X5: design and testing of a pre-production prototype, costing $60,000 per month. All the IAS 38 capitalisation criteria were met from 1 June 20X5.
  • On 1 June 20X5 Vireo Co bought test equipment for $72,000 (useful life 4 years, nil residual value), used solely on Project Lumen until 30 September 20X5, and afterwards on the production line.
  • Commercial production began on 1 October 20X5. The device is expected to generate benefits for five years. Vireo Co amortises on a straight-line, time-apportioned basis.
In 20X6, now that Project Lumen is a commercial success, Vireo Co may reinstate the $120,000 of April and May 20X5 development costs as part of the intangible asset.
ex: Noto'g'ri. IAS 38: expense sifatida tan olingan xarajat keyinchalik aktivga qayta tiklanmaydi. 120,000 P/L'da qoladi.

q:
Harlow Co, a media company, prepares financial statements to 30 June 20X7. During the year:
