q:
Tamarind Co prepares financial statements to 31 December 20X7 and uses the fair value model for investment property. It has an 80% subsidiary, Lotus Co.
Property X: Tamarind Co's head office had a carrying amount of $6,300,000 at 1 January 20X7 and a remaining useful life of 35 years. On 1 May 20X7 Tamarind Co moved its staff out and let the building to an unrelated tenant. Its fair value was $6,900,000 at 1 May 20X7 and $7,050,000 at 31 December 20X7.
Property Y: A warehouse let to Lotus Co, which uses it to store its inventory. Its fair value was $2,400,000 at 1 January 20X7 and $2,280,000 at 31 December 20X7.
Property Z: Land purchased on 1 March 20X7 for $1,500,000 plus legal fees of $30,000. The directors have not yet decided how the land will be used. Its fair value at 31 December 20X7 was $1,620,000.

How should Property Z be classified in Tamarind Co's financial statements at 31 December 20X7?
opt: Property, plant and equipment, because no rental income is being earned
Investment property, because it is land held for a currently undetermined future use
Inventory, because it may be sold in the future
It is not recognised until the directors decide on its use
ex: IAS 40: kelajakdagi foydalanishi hali aniqlanmagan yer — investment property (capital appreciation uchun ushlab turilgan deb qaraladi). Ijara daromadi bo'lmasligi IP bo'lishiga to'sqinlik qilmaydi.

q:
Tamarind Co prepares financial statements to 31 December 20X7 and uses the fair value model for investment property. It has an 80% subsidiary, Lotus Co.
Property X: Tamarind Co's head office had a carrying amount of $6,300,000 at 1 January 20X7 and a remaining useful life of 35 years. On 1 May 20X7 Tamarind Co moved its staff out and let the building to an unrelated tenant. Its fair value was $6,900,000 at 1 May 20X7 and $7,050,000 at 31 December 20X7.
Property Y: A warehouse let to Lotus Co, which uses it to store its inventory. Its fair value was $2,400,000 at 1 January 20X7 and $2,280,000 at 31 December 20X7.
Property Z: Land purchased on 1 March 20X7 for $1,500,000 plus legal fees of $30,000. The directors have not yet decided how the land will be used. Its fair value at 31 December 20X7 was $1,620,000.

If Tamarind Co had used the cost model for investment property, what would be the carrying amount of Property X at 31 December 20X7?
ex:
Cost model: transfer carrying amount'da, fair value e'tiborga olinmaydi, depreciation butun yil davom etadi (4 oy PPE + 8 oy IP).
Depreciation = 6,300,000/35 = 180,000
CA = 6,300,000 − 180,000 = 6,120,000.

q:
Brookvale Co prepares financial statements to 30 June 20X8. It develops and sells residential property and also holds investment properties, which it measures using the fair value model.
Property P: An investment property with a fair value of $8,400,000 at 1 July 20X7. On 1 January 20X8 Brookvale Co began using it as its own regional office. Its fair value at that date was $8,850,000 and its remaining useful life was 25 years.
Property Q: An investment property with a fair value of $3,200,000 at 1 July 20X7. It was sold on 1 April 20X8 for $3,450,000, with selling costs of $50,000. Its fair value did not change between 1 July 20X7 and the date of sale.
Property R: A completed house held in inventory at a cost of $1,900,000. On 1 March 20X8 Brookvale Co let it to a tenant under an operating lease and now holds it to earn rentals. Its fair value was $2,250,000 at 1 March 20X8 and $2,310,000 at 30 June 20X8.

What is the depreciation charge for Property P for the year ended 30 June 20X8? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole dollar.
ex:
1 Jan 20X8 dan PPE, deemed cost = FV 8,850,000. 1 Jan–30 Jun = 6 oy.
Depreciation = 8,850,000/25 × 6/12 = 177,000. 1 Jul–31 Dec davomida IP (FV model) — depreciation yo'q.

q:
Brookvale Co prepares financial statements to 30 June 20X8. It develops and sells residential property and also holds investment properties, which it measures using the fair value model.
Property P: An investment property with a fair value of $8,400,000 at 1 July 20X7. On 1 January 20X8 Brookvale Co began using it as its own regional office. Its fair value at that date was $8,850,000 and its remaining useful life was 25 years.
Property Q: An investment property with a fair value of $3,200,000 at 1 July 20X7. It was sold on 1 April 20X8 for $3,450,000, with selling costs of $50,000. Its fair value did not change between 1 July 20X7 and the date of sale.
Property R: A completed house held in inventory at a cost of $1,900,000. On 1 March 20X8 Brookvale Co let it to a tenant under an operating lease and now holds it to earn rentals. Its fair value was $2,250,000 at 1 March 20X8 and $2,310,000 at 30 June 20X8.

What is the gain on disposal of Property Q? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole dollar.

Brookvale Co prepares financial statements to 30 June 20X8. It develops and sells residential property and also holds investment properties, which it measures using the fair value model.
Property P: An investment property with a fair value of $8,400,000 at 1 July 20X7. On 1 January 20X8 Brookvale Co began using it as its own regional office. Its fair value at that date was $8,850,000 and its remaining useful life was 25 years.
Property Q: An investment property with a fair value of $3,200,000 at 1 July 20X7. It was sold on 1 April 20X8 for $3,450,000, with selling costs of $50,000. Its fair value did not change between 1 July 20X7 and the date of sale.
Property R: A completed house held in inventory at a cost of $1,900,000. On 1 March 20X8 Brookvale Co let it to a tenant under an operating lease and now holds it to earn rentals. Its fair value was $2,250,000 at 1 March 20X8 and $2,310,000 at 30 June 20X8.

How should the change in use of Property P on 1 January 20X8 be accounted for?
opt: Remeasure to $8,850,000 with a gain of $450,000 in other comprehensive income, then transfer to property, plant and equipment
Transfer to property, plant and equipment at $8,400,000 with no gain recognised
Remeasure to $8,850,000 with a gain of $450,000 in profit or loss, then transfer to property, plant and equipment with $8,850,000 as deemed cost
Transfer to property, plant and equipment at $8,850,000 with the gain of $450,000 credited directly to retained earnings
ex: IP → PPE (FV model): o'tkazish sanasigacha aktiv IP, shuning uchun FV'ga qayta o'lchanadi: 8,850,000 − 8,400,000 = 450,000 gain P/Lga. 8,850,000 — IAS 16 uchun deemed cost.

q:
Brookvale Co prepares financial statements to 30 June 20X8. It develops and sells residential property and also holds investment properties, which it measures using the fair value model.
Property P: An investment property with a fair value of $8,400,000 at 1 July 20X7. On 1 January 20X8 Brookvale Co began using it as its own regional office. Its fair value at that date was $8,850,000 and its remaining useful life was 25 years.
Property Q: An investment property with a fair value of $3,200,000 at 1 July 20X7. It was sold on 1 April 20X8 for $3,450,000, with selling costs of $50,000. Its fair value did not change between 1 July 20X7 and the date of sale.
Property R: A completed house held in inventory at a cost of $1,900,000. On 1 March 20X8 Brookvale Co let it to a tenant under an operating lease and now holds it to earn rentals. Its fair value was $2,250,000 at 1 March 20X8 and $2,310,000 at 30 June 20X8.

What is the total gain recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 30 June 20X8 in respect of Property R? Enter your answer in $000, to the nearest whole number.

Brookvale Co prepares financial statements to 30 June 20X8. It develops and sells residential property and also holds investment properties, which it measures using the fair value model.
Property P: An investment property with a fair value of $8,400,000 at 1 July 20X7. On 1 January 20X8 Brookvale Co began using it as its own regional office. Its fair value at that date was $8,850,000 and its remaining useful life was 25 years.
Property Q: An investment property with a fair value of $3,200,000 at 1 July 20X7. It was sold on 1 April 20X8 for $3,450,000, with selling costs of $50,000. Its fair value did not change between 1 July 20X7 and the date of sale.
Property R: A completed house held in inventory at a cost of $1,900,000. On 1 March 20X8 Brookvale Co let it to a tenant under an operating lease and now holds it to earn rentals. Its fair value was $2,250,000 at 1 March 20X8 and $2,310,000 at 30 June 20X8.

Which TWO of the following statements about Brookvale Co's statement of financial position at 30 June 20X8 are correct?
opt: Property P is included in property, plant and equipment at $8,673,000
Property Q is included in investment property at $3,200,000
Property R is included in inventories at $1,900,000
Property R is included in investment property at $2,310,000
Property P is included in investment property at $8,850,000
ex:
P: PPE, 8,850,000 − 177,000 = 8,673,000.
Q: sotilgan (derecognised) — SOFP'da yo'q.
R: endi IP, FV 2,310,000; inventory emas.
P endi IP emas.

q:
Cardew Co purchased a building for its investment potential on 1 January 20X4 for $9,600,000. The building has a 48-year life (ignore land). At 31 December 20X4 its fair value was $9,950,000. Cardew Co uses the cost model.
What amount is recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X4 in respect of the building? Enter the expense in $000 as a positive number, to the nearest whole number.
ex: Cost model: FV o'zgarishi tan olinmaydi (faqat notes'da oshkor qilinadi). Faqat depreciation: 9,600,000 / 48 = 200,000 → 200 ($000) xarajat.

q:
Brynmor Co bought an investment property on 1 April 20X6 for $2,750,000 plus legal fees of $55,000. It uses the fair value model. At 31 December 20X6 (its year end) the fair value of the property was $2,980,000.
What fair value gain should be recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X6? Enter your answer in $, to the nearest whole dollar.
ex:
Initial cost = 2,750,000 + 55,000 (legal fees) = 2,805,000.
Gain = 2,980,000 − 2,805,000 = 175,000. Diqqat: legal fees cost'ga kiradi, shuning uchun gain kamayadi.

q: Tenby Co owns an office building held as investment property under the fair value model. Tenby Co provides security and maintenance services to the tenants, which are a minor part of the arrangement as a whole. How should the building be classified?
opt: As property, plant and equipment, because Tenby Co provides services to the occupants
As inventory, because it is held to generate income
Split between investment property and property, plant and equipment in proportion to revenue
As investment property, because the ancillary services are insignificant
ex: Agar egasi ko'rsatadigan xizmatlar (security, maintenance) umumiy kelishuvga nisbatan insignificant bo'lsa, bino IP bo'lib qoladi. Xizmatlar significant bo'lsa (masalan, egasi boshqaradigan mehmonxona) — owner-occupied, IAS 16.

q: Which of the following is NOT one of the criteria in IFRS 5 Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations for classifying a non-current asset as held for sale?
opt: The asset represents a separate major line of business
The sale is highly probable
The sale is expected to be completed within one year of classification
The asset is available for immediate sale in its present condition
ex: IFRS 5 held for sale mezonlari: (1) aktiv hozirgi holatida darhol sotishga tayyor; (2) sotuv highly probable (management plan, active programme, reasonable price, plan o'zgarmasligi); (3) sotuv 12 oy ichida yakunlanishi kutiladi. 'Separate major line of business' — bu discontinued operation ta'rifi, held for sale mezoni emas. Javob: D.

q: Which THREE of the following are required for the sale of a non-current asset to be regarded as highly probable under IFRS 5?
opt: Management at the appropriate level is committed to a plan to sell
An active programme to locate a buyer has been initiated
The asset is being actively marketed at a price that is reasonable in relation to its current fair value
A binding sale agreement has been signed with a buyer
The asset has been fully depreciated
ex: Highly probable uchun: management plan'ga sodiq (committed), xaridor qidirish dasturi boshlangan (active programme), aktiv adolatli narxda faol reklama qilinmoqda, va plan bekor bo'lishi ehtimoldan yiroq. Binding contract shart emas — u bo'lsa ham yaxshi dalil, lekin talab emas. To'liq amortizatsiya qilinganlik aloqasiz. Javob: A, B, C.

q: A non-current asset that an entity intends to abandon (scrap) rather than sell should be classified as held for sale.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Held for sale — carrying amount asosan sotuv orqali qaytariladi degani. Tashlab yuboriladigan (abandoned) aktiv sotilmaydi, shuning uchun u held for sale emas; u ishlatilishda davom etadi va amortizatsiya qilinadi (IAS 16 / IAS 36).

q:
On 20 November 20X4 the board of Tern Co decided to sell its head office building. Tern Co will continue to occupy the building until its new offices are completed in August 20X5; only then will the building be put on the market. Tern Co's year end is 31 December 20X4.
How should the building be treated at 31 December 20X4?
opt: Held for sale, measured at the lower of carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell, with depreciation stopped from 20 November 20X4
Not held for sale, as it is not available for immediate sale in its present condition; it remains in property, plant and equipment and continues to be depreciated
Held for sale, but depreciation continues until Tern Co vacates the building
Not held for sale, but it must be presented within current assets because a sale is planned
ex: Bino hali ham ishlatilmoqda va faqat Avgust 20X5 da bozorga chiqariladi — demak u available for immediate sale emas. Shuning uchun 31.12.20X4 da held for sale mezonlari bajarilmagan: bino PPE'da qoladi va amortizatsiya davom etadi. Javob: C.

q:
Quartz Co has a year end of 31 March 20X6. On 20 April 20X6, before the financial statements were authorised for issue, all the IFRS 5 held for sale criteria were met for one of its factories for the first time.
How should the factory be treated in the financial statements for the year ended 31 March 20X6?
opt: Classified as held for sale at 31 March 20X6, as this is an adjusting event
Classified as held for sale at 31 March 20X6 and also disclosed as a discontinued operation
Not classified as held for sale at 31 March 20X6; details are disclosed in the notes as a non-adjusting event
Not classified as held for sale and no disclosure is required
ex: Mezonlar hisobot sanasidan keyin bajarilgan bo'lsa, aktiv o'sha yil oxirida held for sale deb tasniflanmaydi. IFRS 5 bu holatni IAS 10 bo'yicha non-adjusting event sifatida notes'da oshkor qilishni talab qiladi (aktiv tavsifi, faktlar, kutilayotgan sotish sanasi). Javob: B.

q:
Sable Co classified a ship as held for sale on 1 July 20X5 and signed a sale contract with a buyer in September 20X5. At 30 June 20X6 the sale had not completed because the buyer's government unexpectedly delayed an import licence. Sable Co remains committed to the sale and expects completion within three months.
How should the ship be treated at 30 June 20X6?
opt: It must be reclassified to property, plant and equipment because 12 months have passed
It must be written off as the sale is no longer highly probable
It continues to be classified as held for sale only if its fair value has not fallen
It continues to be classified as held for sale, as the delay is caused by events beyond Sable Co's control
ex: 12 oylik muddat, kechikish kompaniya nazoratidan tashqaridagi voqealar (bu yerda xaridor davlatining litsenziya kechikishi) sabab bo'lsa va kompaniya sotishga sodiq qolsa, uzaytirilishi mumkin. Demak kema held for sale bo'lib qoladi (amortizatsiyasiz, lower of CA and FVLCS). Javob: B.

q: An asset that is being marketed at a price well above its current fair value can still be classified as held for sale, provided management is committed to selling it.
ex: Noto'g'ri. 'Highly probable' shartlaridan biri — aktiv joriy fair value'ga nisbatan reasonable narxda reklama qilinishi. Narx bozordan ancha yuqori bo'lsa, sotuv 12 oy ichida ehtimoli past — held for sale emas.

q:
On 1 March 20X7 Harbin Co acquired 100% of Lark Co exclusively with a view to reselling it. A sale within 12 months is expected and the remaining held for sale criteria are highly likely to be met within three months of acquisition.
How should Harbin Co account for Lark Co in its consolidated financial statements?
opt: Consolidate Lark Co line by line in the normal way
Classify Lark Co as held for sale at the acquisition date and present it as a discontinued operation
Treat Lark Co as an associate using the equity method
Record Lark Co as a financial asset at fair value through profit or loss
ex: Faqat qayta sotish maqsadida sotib olingan subsidiary IFRS 5 bo'yicha (1) 12 oylik mezon bajarilsa va (2) qolgan mezonlar sotib olishdan keyin qisqa muddatda (odatda 3 oy) bajarilishi ehtimoli yuqori bo'lsa, sotib olingan kundayoq held for sale deb tasniflanadi. Discontinued operation ta'rifi ham 'subsidiary acquired exclusively with a view to resale' ni o'z ichiga oladi. Javob: B.

q: Delmar Co has a year end of 31 December 20X7. Which TWO of the following assets should be classified as held for sale at that date?
opt: A warehouse being actively marketed at a reasonable price, with a sale expected within eight months
A machine that will be scrapped in January 20X8
An office building that will be put on the market after a refurbishment to be completed in May 20X8

A vessel classified as held for sale since March 20X7 under a signed sale contract, where completion has been delayed until May 20X8 by a regulatory approval outside Delmar Co's control, and Delmar Co remains committed to the sale
Land which the board intends to discuss selling at its meeting in February 20X8
ex: A — barcha mezonlar bajarilgan (reasonable price, 12 oy ichida) → HFS. B — scrap = abandoned, sotuv emas → HFS emas. C — hozirgi holatida darhol sotishga tayyor emas (ta'mirdan keyin) → HFS emas. D — Mart 20X7 dan HFS; sotuv May 20X8 gacha (14 oy) cho'zildi, lekin kechikish nazoratdan tashqarida va kompaniya sotishga sodiq → 12 oylik muddat uzaytiriladi, HFS bo'lib qoladi. E — management hali plan'ga sodiq emas → HFS emas. Javob: A va D.

q: According to IFRS 5, at what amount should a non-current asset classified as held for sale be measured?
opt: The higher of carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell
The lower of carrying amount and fair value
The lower of carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell
The higher of fair value less costs to sell and value in use
ex: Qoida: lower of carrying amount and fair value less costs to sell (FVLCS). Bu prudence: zarar darhol tan olinadi, foyda esa faqat sotilganda. D varianti — IAS 36 recoverable amount ta'rifi, IFRS 5 emas. Javob: C.

q:
Opal Co classified a machine as held for sale at its year end. The machine's carrying amount was $540,000, its fair value was $520,000 and the estimated costs to sell were $12,000.
At what amount should the machine be measured in Opal Co's statement of financial position? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
FVLCS = 520,000 − 12,000 = 508,000.
Carrying amount = 540,000.
Lower of the two = $508,000. Farq 32,000 impairment loss sifatida P/L ga yoziladi.

q:
Wren Co bought a machine on 1 January 20X2 for $360,000. It had a useful life of 8 years and nil residual value, and is depreciated on a straight-line basis. On 1 October 20X4 the machine met the criteria to be classified as held for sale. Its fair value was $230,000 and costs to sell were estimated at $6,000. Wren Co's year end is 31 December.
What impairment loss should be recognised on classification as held for sale? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.

Fennel Co classified a building as held for sale on 31 December 20X5. At that date its carrying amount was $410,000, its fair value was $470,000 and costs to sell were $15,000.
How should the building be measured and what gain, if any, is recognised at 31 December 20X5?
opt: $410,000, with no gain recognised
$470,000, with a gain of $60,000 in other comprehensive income
$455,000, with a gain of $45,000 in profit or loss
$455,000, with a gain of $45,000 in other comprehensive income
ex: FVLCS = 470,000 − 15,000 = 455,000. CA = 410,000. Lower of = 410,000. FVLCS CA dan yuqori bo'lsa hech qanday gain tan olinmaydi — foyda faqat aktiv haqiqatda sotilganda (disposal) tan olinadi. Javob: C.

q:
Rook Co purchased plant on 1 April 20X1 for $1,200,000, with a useful life of 10 years and nil residual value. On 1 January 20X4 the plant met the criteria to be classified as held for sale, when its fair value was $855,000 and costs to sell were $15,000. Rook Co's year end is 31 March.
What is the TOTAL amount charged to profit or loss in respect of the plant for the year ended 31 March 20X4? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
Under IFRS 5, which of the following best describes 'costs to sell'?
opt: All costs of maintaining the asset until it is sold, including insurance and security
The difference between the asset's carrying amount and its fair value
Any costs incurred in the year of sale, including finance costs on loans secured on the asset
Incremental costs directly attributable to the disposal of the asset, excluding finance costs and income tax expense
ex: IFRS 5 ta'rifi: costs to sell — aktivni sotish bilan bevosita bog'liq qo'shimcha (incremental) xarajatlar (masalan, agent komissiyasi, yuridik xarajat, demontaj), finance costs va income tax bundan mustasno. Sug'urta/qo'riqlash — sotuvsiz ham bo'ladigan xarajatlar, kirmaydi. Javob: B.

q: Which THREE of the following assets, if included in a disposal group held for sale, are EXCLUDED from the IFRS 5 measurement rules and continue to be measured under their own standard?
opt: Deferred tax assets
Financial assets within the scope of IFRS 9 Financial Instruments
Investment property measured under the fair value model
Property, plant and equipment measured under the cost model
Intangible assets measured under the cost model
ex: IFRS 5 o'lchov (measurement) talablaridan istisno: deferred tax assets (IAS 12), employee benefit assets (IAS 19), IFRS 9 financial assets, fair value modelidagi investment property (IAS 40), biological assets (IAS 41) va insurance contracts. Ular held for sale guruhida bo'lsa ham o'z standarti bo'yicha o'lchanadi (lekin presentation IFRS 5 bo'yicha). Cost modelidagi PPE va intangibles IFRS 5 bo'yicha o'lchanadi. Javob: A, B, C.

q:
Linden Co classified a plot of land as held for sale. The land's carrying amount was $750,000 and its fair value was $735,000. Agent's fees and legal costs to sell are estimated at 2% of fair value.
What impairment loss should Linden Co recognise? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
If fair value less costs to sell of an asset classified as held for sale is higher than its carrying amount, the difference is recognised immediately as a gain in profit or loss.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Held for sale aktiv lower of CA va FVLCS da o'lchanadi. FVLCS yuqori bo'lsa, aktiv CA da qoladi va gain faqat sotilganda tan olinadi.

q: What happens to the depreciation of a non-current asset once it is classified as held for sale?
opt: Depreciation ceases from the date of classification as held for sale
Depreciation continues at the same rate until the asset is sold
Depreciation continues but is presented in discontinued operations
Depreciation is charged for a full year in the year of classification
ex: IFRS 5: held for sale deb tasniflangan kundan boshlab aktiv amortizatsiya qilinmaydi. Sababi — uning qiymati endi foydalanish orqali emas, sotuv orqali qaytariladi. Javob: B.

q:
Marlow Co has a year end of 31 December. At 1 January 20X6 an item of machinery had a carrying amount of $960,000 and a remaining useful life of 12 years. On 31 May 20X6 the machinery met the criteria to be classified as held for sale.
What depreciation charge should be recognised for the machinery in the year ended 31 December 20X6? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Yillik amortizatsiya = 960,000 / 12 = 80,000.
Amortizatsiya faqat 1 Yanvar – 31 May (5 oy) uchun: 80,000 × 5/12 = 33,333.33 ≈ $33,333.
31 Maydan keyin amortizatsiya to'xtaydi.

q:
Pike Co has a year end of 30 June. At 1 July 20X5 a property had a carrying amount of $1,440,000 and a remaining useful life of 24 years (cost model). On 1 January 20X6 the property was correctly classified as held for sale. Its fair value less costs to sell was $1,425,000 at 1 January 20X6 and $1,395,000 at 30 June 20X6.
What is the carrying amount of the property in Pike Co's statement of financial position at 30 June 20X6? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
6 oylik amortizatsiya (1.7.20X5–1.1.20X6) = 1,440,000 / 24 × 6/12 = 30,000.
1.1.20X6 dagi CA = 1,440,000 − 30,000 = 1,410,000.
FVLCS 1,425,000 > CA, demak HFS aktiv 1,410,000 da o'lchanadi (gain yo'q).
30.6.20X6 da qayta o'lchov: lower of 1,410,000 va 1,395,000 = $1,395,000 (qo'shimcha impairment 15,000 P/L ga).

q: Interest and other expenses attributable to the liabilities of a disposal group classified as held for sale continue to be recognised.
ex: To'g'ri. Faqat non-current assets amortizatsiyasi to'xtaydi. Disposal group majburiyatlari bo'yicha foiz va boshqa xarajatlar odatdagidek tan olinishda davom etadi.

q:
On 1 April 20X8 Juniper Co classified a machine as held for sale and wrote it down to its fair value less costs to sell of $402,000. On 30 September 20X8 the machine was sold for $395,000, and Juniper Co paid selling costs of $5,000.
What loss on disposal should be recognised? Enter the loss as a positive number in $.
ex:
Sof tushum = 395,000 − 5,000 = 390,000.
CA (HFS) = 402,000 (classificationdan keyin amortizatsiya yo'q).
Loss on disposal = 402,000 − 390,000 = $12,000.

q:
Holt Co has a year end of 30 September. At 1 October 20X6 a building (cost model) had a carrying amount of $630,000 and a remaining useful life of 14 years. On 1 April 20X7 the building was correctly classified as held for sale. Its fair value less costs to sell was $612,000 at 1 April 20X7 and was unchanged at 30 September 20X7.
At what amount should the building be shown at 30 September 20X7?
ex:
6 oylik amortizatsiya = 630,000/14 × 6/12 = 22,500.
1.4.20X7 dagi CA = 630,000 − 22,500 = 607,500.
Lower of 607,500 va 612,000 = $607,500. Keyin amortizatsiya yo'q, FVLCS o'zgarmagan. Javob: A. (C — yil bo'yi amortizatsiya qilish xatosi.)

q:
Garnet Co uses the revaluation model for its properties. On 1 January 20X8 a property with a carrying amount of $540,000 was classified as held for sale. Its fair value was $690,000 and costs to sell were $9,000.
What amounts should be recognised on classification?
opt: Gain of $141,000 in profit or loss
Revaluation gain of $141,000 in other comprehensive income only
Revaluation gain of $150,000 in other comprehensive income and impairment loss of $9,000 in profit or loss
No gain; the property remains at $540,000
ex:
Revaluation modelidagi aktiv avval IAS 16 bo'yicha fair value'ga qayta baholanadi: 690,000 − 540,000 = 150,000 → OCI / revaluation surplus.
Keyin lower of CA (690,000) va FVLCS (690,000 − 9,000 = 681,000) → 681,000. Costs to sell 9,000 — P/L ga impairment. Javob: B.

q:
Birch Co uses the revaluation model. A property with a carrying amount of $2,300,000 was classified as held for sale on 31 December 20X6. At that date its fair value was $2,150,000 and costs to sell were $40,000. The revaluation surplus relating to this property was $120,000.
What is the total amount charged to profit or loss on classification? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
1-qadam: fair value'ga qayta baholash. Pasayish = 2,300,000 − 2,150,000 = 150,000.
Avval shu aktivga tegishli revaluation surplus'ga (OCI): 120,000; qolgani P/L: 150,000 − 120,000 = 30,000.
2-qadam: costs to sell 40,000 — P/L ga impairment.
Jami P/L = 30,000 + 40,000 = $70,000.

q: A property carried under the revaluation model is classified as held for sale. Where is the write-down for costs to sell recognised?
opt: In the revaluation surplus, through other comprehensive income
Directly in retained earnings
It is not recognised until the property is sold
In profit or loss
ex: Revalued aktiv avval FV ga qayta baholanadi (farq OCI yoki P/L — IAS 16 qoidasiga ko'ra). Undan keyin FV dan FVLCS ga tushirish (costs to sell) doim P/L ga impairment sifatida yoziladi, revaluation surplus balansi bo'lsa ham. Javob: C.

q:
Cedar Co uses the revaluation model. On 30 June 20X9 it classified an office building as held for sale. The building's carrying amount was $1,900,000, its fair value was $2,080,000 and costs to sell were $52,000.
What amount should be recognised in other comprehensive income on classification? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Held for sale'ga o'tkazishdan oldin bino FV ga qayta baholanadi: 2,080,000 − 1,900,000 = $180,000 → OCI (revaluation surplus).
Keyin FVLCS = 2,080,000 − 52,000 = 2,028,000; costs to sell 52,000 P/L ga yoziladi (OCI ga emas).

q:
Ember Co classified a machine as held for sale on 1 July 20X5, when its carrying amount was $800,000 and its fair value less costs to sell was $740,000. At the year end, 31 December 20X5, the machine had not been sold and its fair value less costs to sell had risen to $820,000. The machine had never previously been impaired.
What gain should Ember Co recognise in profit or loss at 31 December 20X5? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
1.7.20X5: impairment = 800,000 − 740,000 = 60,000 (P/L).
31.12.20X5: FVLCS 820,000 ga ko'tarildi (+80,000), lekin gain faqat ilgari tan olingan cumulative impairment miqdorigacha tan olinadi: max 60,000.
Yangi CA = 740,000 + 60,000 = 800,000.
Gain = $60,000.

q:
An asset had been impaired by $25,000 under IAS 36 in a prior year, reducing its carrying amount to $500,000. It was then classified as held for sale, when its fair value less costs to sell was $460,000. At the year end its fair value less costs to sell had increased to $550,000.
At what amount should the asset be measured at the year end?
ex:
Classificationdagi impairment = 500,000 − 460,000 = 40,000.
Cumulative impairment (IAS 36 + IFRS 5) = 25,000 + 40,000 = 65,000.
Gain shu 65,000 bilan cheklanadi: 460,000 + 65,000 = 525,000 (FVLCS 550,000 dan past, demak cheklov ishlaydi). Javob: B.

q: An entity changes its plan so that an asset previously classified as held for sale no longer meets the criteria. Which TWO of the following statements are correct?
opt: The asset is measured at the lower of (i) its carrying amount before classification, adjusted for depreciation that would have been charged had it not been classified as held for sale, and (ii) its recoverable amount
The asset stays at fair value less costs to sell until it is eventually sold
Any adjustment to the carrying amount is recognised in profit or loss from continuing operations
The depreciation not charged while held for sale is ignored permanently
The asset remains in current assets until the next year end
ex: Aktiv held for sale bo'lishdan to'xtasa: lower of (a) classificationgacha bo'lgan CA − o'sha davr uchun hisoblanishi kerak bo'lgan amortizatsiya, va (b) recoverable amount. Tuzatish continuing operations P/L ga yoziladi. Aktiv yana non-current'ga qaytadi. Javob: A va C.

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Fable Co classified equipment as held for sale. Its carrying amount was $600,000 (remaining useful life 10 years, nil residual value) and its fair value less costs to sell was $570,000. On 31 December 20X5 Fable Co abandoned the sale plan and the equipment ceased to be held for sale. The recoverable amount of the equipment at that date was $560,000.
At what amount should the equipment be measured at 31 December 20X5? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
1.1.20X5 da HFS: lower of 600,000 va 570,000 = 570,000 (impairment 30,000).
31.12.20X5 da plan bekor qilindi. O'lchov = lower of:
(a) HFS bo'lmaganda bo'ladigan CA = 600,000 − 600,000/10 = 540,000
(b) recoverable amount = 560,000
Natija = $540,000. 570,000 dan 30,000 ga tushirish P/L (continuing operations) ga.

q: Where should a non-current asset classified as held for sale be presented in the statement of financial position?
opt: Separately, as a line item within current assets
Within property, plant and equipment, with a note
As a deduction from equity
Separately, as a line item within non-current assets
ex: IFRS 5: held for sale aktivlar SOFP'da alohida qator sifatida, current assets ichida ko'rsatiladi (12 oy ichida sotilishi kutiladi). Javob: B.

q: When an asset is classified as held for sale in the current year, the comparative statement of financial position must be re-presented to show that asset as held for sale in the prior year as well.
ex: Noto'g'ri. SOFP comparatives qayta ko'rsatilmaydi (not re-presented). Qayta ko'rsatish faqat SPL uchun — discontinued operations natijalari o'tgan yil uchun ham discontinued sifatida ko'rsatiladi.

q: A disposal group held for sale contains assets of $900,000 and liabilities of $250,000. How should these be presented in the statement of financial position?
opt: As a single net asset of $650,000 within current assets
Assets of $900,000 separately within current assets and liabilities of $250,000 separately within liabilities
Assets and liabilities left in their original line items, with a note
As a single net amount of $650,000 within non-current assets
ex: Disposal group aktivlari 'Assets held for sale' sifatida current assets ichida, majburiyatlari esa 'Liabilities held for sale' sifatida liabilities ichida alohida ko'rsatiladi. Ular offset qilinmaydi (sof qilib ko'rsatilmaydi). Javob: B.

q: Which TWO of the following statements about the presentation of held for sale items are correct?
opt: Assets held for sale are presented separately from other assets in the statement of financial position
Liabilities of a disposal group may be offset against its assets and shown as one net figure
Cumulative income or expense recognised in other comprehensive income relating to the held for sale item is presented separately within equity
A held for sale asset continues to be shown within property, plant and equipment
Held for sale assets are shown at fair value in all cases
ex: A — to'g'ri, alohida qator. B — noto'g'ri, offset taqiqlangan. C — to'g'ri, OCI da to'plangan summalar (masalan, revaluation surplus) equity ichida alohida ko'rsatiladi. D — noto'g'ri, current assets ga ko'chadi. E — noto'g'ri, lower of CA and FVLCS. Javob: A va C.

q: Which heading best describes where Moss Co should present a factory that met the held for sale criteria at the year end?
opt: Non-current assets: property, plant and equipment
Current liabilities
Current assets: non-current assets held for sale
Non-current assets: investment property
ex: Held for sale aktiv current assets ichida 'Non-current assets held for sale' deb nomlangan alohida qatorda ko'rsatiladi. Javob: B.

q: According to IFRS 5, a discontinued operation is a component of an entity that has been disposed of, or is classified as held for sale, and which:
opt: Has made a loss in each of the last two years
Is expected to be sold within three months of the reporting date
Contributes less than 10% of group revenue
Represents a separate major line of business or geographical area of operations, is part of a single co-ordinated plan to dispose of one, or is a subsidiary acquired exclusively with a view to resale
ex: Discontinued operation — component (operatsiyalari va pul oqimlari aniq ajratiladigan qism) bo'lib, sotilgan yoki HFS va: (1) separate major line of business yoki geographical area; (2) shuni sotish bo'yicha yagona muvofiqlashtirilgan plan qismi; yoki (3) faqat qayta sotish uchun olingan subsidiary. Zarar ko'rish yoki foiz chegarasi mezon emas. Javob: B.

q: Which THREE of the following would qualify as discontinued operations, assuming they have been disposed of or classified as held for sale?
opt: The sale of an entity's entire hotel division, which is one of its three major business lines
The closure of one of an entity's 40 retail stores in the same country
A subsidiary acquired exclusively with a view to resale
The sale of all of an entity's operations in South America, a separate major geographical area
The replacement of an old production line with a new one
ex: A — separate major line of business → Ha. B — 40 do'kondan bittasi: major line emas, oddiy qisqartirish → Yo'q. C — faqat sotish uchun olingan subsidiary → Ha. D — separate major geographical area → Ha. E — oddiy asset replacement → Yo'q. Javob: A, C, D.

q:
Nimbus Co's year end is 31 December 20X4. On 15 February 20X5 the board decided to sell its separate aviation division, and the division met all the held for sale criteria on that date. The financial statements were authorised on 20 March 20X5.
How should the aviation division be presented in the financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X4?
opt: As a discontinued operation, as the decision was made before the financial statements were authorised
As a continuing operation, with disclosure of the post year-end decision as a non-adjusting event
As a discontinued operation with its assets shown as held for sale
It should be excluded from the financial statements
ex: Discontinued operation hisobot sanasida sotilgan yoki HFS bo'lishi kerak. Qaror 20X5 da qabul qilingan → 20X4 da division continuing. Voqea IAS 10 bo'yicha non-adjusting — notes'da oshkor qilinadi. Javob: B.

q: A major line of business that is to be closed (abandoned) rather than sold can be presented as a discontinued operation once it has actually ceased operating.
ex: To'g'ri. Abandoned aktivlar held for sale deb tasniflanmaydi, lekin major line of business haqiqatan yopilgan (abandoned) kundan boshlab u discontinued operation sifatida ko'rsatiladi. Yopish faqat reja bo'lsa (hali ishlayotgan bo'lsa) — hali continuing.

q:
Tamaris Co manufactures garden tools. During the year it stopped producing three of its ten tool ranges, all sold through the same distribution channels to the same customers, and reallocated the related staff and machinery to the remaining ranges.
How should the three ranges be treated under IFRS 5?
opt: As a continuing operation, as this is a reduction in the scale of an existing line of business rather than a separate major line of business
As a discontinued operation, because production has ceased
As a discontinued operation only if the ranges made losses
As assets held for sale
ex: Discontinued operation uchun separate major line of business kerak (alohida operatsiyalar va pul oqimlari). Bir xil kanal, bir xil mijozlar, aktivlar qayta taqsimlangan → bu faqat mavjud biznesning kichrayishi (restructuring). Aktivlar sotilmayapti, shuning uchun HFS ham emas. Javob: B.

q:
Arden Co operates in three geographical regions: Europe (45% of revenue), Asia (40%) and Africa (15%), each managed separately with its own assets. At the year end Arden Co's entire African operation met the held for sale criteria.
How should the African operation be presented?
opt: As a continuing operation, because it provides less than 20% of revenue
As a discontinued operation only once the sale is completed
As a discontinued operation, as it is a separate major geographical area of operations classified as held for sale
Its results should be removed from the statement of profit or loss entirely
ex: IFRS 5 da foiz chegarasi yo'q. Afrika — alohida boshqariladigan, o'z aktivlari bor separate major geographical area, hisobot sanasida HFS → discontinued operation. Sotuv tugashini kutish shart emas. Javob: B.

q: Which amount must be presented on the face of the statement of profit or loss in respect of a discontinued operation?
opt: The revenue and gross profit of the discontinued operation
The pre-tax profit of the discontinued operation only
A single amount comprising the post-tax profit or loss of the discontinued operation and the post-tax gain or loss on remeasurement to fair value less costs to sell or on disposal
The operating profit of the discontinued operation and its tax charge separately
ex: SPL yuzida bitta summa talab qilinadi: discontinued operation'ning post-tax profit/loss + FVLCS ga qayta o'lchov yoki disposal'dan post-tax gain/loss. Tahlil (revenue, expenses, pre-tax, tax) notes'da yoki SPL yuzida. Javob: B.

q:
Onyx Co's electronics division was classified as a discontinued operation during the year. The division's results were: revenue $820,000, cost of sales $510,000, operating expenses $260,000, and income tax on its trading profit $12,000. On classification as held for sale, the division's net assets were written down by $90,000 to fair value less costs to sell, with a related tax credit of $18,000.
What single amount should be shown for discontinued operations in the statement of profit or loss? Enter in $000; enter a loss as a negative number.
ex:
Trading: 820 − 510 − 260 = 50; tax (12) → post-tax profit = 38.
Remeasurement: (90) + tax credit 18 = (72).
Single amount = 38 − 72 = -34 ($000), ya'ni $34,000 loss.

q: Which THREE of the following must be disclosed, either on the face of the statement of profit or loss or in the notes, for a discontinued operation?
opt: Its revenue, expenses and pre-tax profit or loss
The related income tax expense
The net cash flows attributable to its operating, investing and financing activities
The fair value of the entire reporting entity
The names of prospective buyers
ex: IFRS 5 tahlil talabi: revenue, expenses, pre-tax profit/loss; tegishli income tax; FVLCS ga qayta o'lchov/disposal gain yoki loss. Bundan tashqari discontinued operation'ning operating, investing, financing pul oqimlari oshkor qilinadi. D va E talab qilinmaydi. Javob: A, B, C.

q: Vale Co classified its shipping division as a discontinued operation in the year ended 31 December 20X6. How should the comparative figures for 20X5 in the statement of profit or loss be presented?
opt: They are not changed; the shipping division remains in continuing operations for 20X5
They are re-presented so that the shipping division's 20X5 results are also shown within discontinued operations
The 20X5 comparatives are omitted for the shipping division
The 20X5 results are adjusted through opening retained earnings as a prior period error
ex: IFRS 5: SPL comparatives re-presented — o'tgan yil ham discontinued sifatida ko'rsatiladi, shunda continuing operations ikki yil taqqoslanadi. Bu prior period error emas. (SOFP comparatives esa o'zgarmaydi.) Javob: B.

q:
Orchid Co has two divisions: Flowers and Gifts. q: What is the main reason IFRS 5 requires discontinued operations to be presented separately?
opt: To show the market value of the business
To comply with tax legislation
To reduce the reported loss of the entity
To improve the predictive value of the financial statements by separating results that will not continue
ex: Discontinued natijalar kelajakda davom etmaydi. Ularni ajratish foydalanuvchilarga continuing operations asosida kelajakdagi foydani bashorat qilish (predictive value) imkonini beradi. Javob: B.

q: Under IFRS 5, what is a disposal group?
opt: A group of assets, possibly with directly associated liabilities, to be disposed of together as a group in a single transaction
Any group of assets that has been fully depreciated
All the non-current assets of an entity that is being liquidated
A group of subsidiaries that are to be sold to different buyers over several years
ex: Disposal group — birgalikda, bitta tranzaksiyada sotiladigan (yoki boshqa yo'l bilan chiqariladigan) aktivlar guruhi va ular bilan bevosita bog'liq majburiyatlar. Unga goodwill ham kirishi mumkin. Javob: B.

q:
Kestrel Co has classified a disposal group as held for sale. Immediately before classification, the carrying amounts (all measured under the relevant standards) were: goodwill $50,000; property, plant and equipment $400,000; patents $100,000; inventory $80,000; trade receivables $70,000. The disposal group's fair value less costs to sell is $560,000.
What is the carrying amount of the patents after the impairment loss has been allocated? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
CA jami = 50 + 400 + 100 + 80 + 70 = 700 ($000).
Impairment = 700 − 560 = 140.
1) Goodwill: 50 → 0. Qoldiq = 90.
2) Qoldiq faqat IFRS 5 o'lchov doirasidagi non-current assets ga pro rata: PPE 400 va patents 100 (jami 500). Inventory va receivables'ga taqsimlanmaydi.
Patents ulushi = 90 × 100/500 = 18.
Patents CA = 100 − 18 = 82 ($000) = $82,000.

q: In what order is an impairment loss on a disposal group allocated?
opt: First to goodwill, then pro rata to the non-current assets within the scope of the IFRS 5 measurement requirements
Pro rata to all assets in the group, including inventories
First to inventories, then to goodwill
First to property, plant and equipment, then to goodwill
ex: IFRS 5 IAS 36 tartibiga ergashadi: avval goodwill, keyin IFRS 5 o'lchov doirasidagi non-current assets ga pro rata. Current assets (inventory, receivables) va istisno qilingan aktivlar (IFRS 9 financial assets, deferred tax va h.k.) kamaytirilmaydi. Javob: B.

q: Where an impairment loss on a disposal group exceeds the goodwill in the group, the excess is allocated pro rata to all the assets in the group, including inventories and trade receivables.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Goodwill'dan ortgan qism faqat IFRS 5 o'lchov doirasidagi non-current assets ga (masalan, PPE, intangibles) pro rata taqsimlanadi. Inventory (IAS 2) va receivables (IFRS 9) o'z standartlari bo'yicha o'lchanadi va kamaytirilmaydi.

q: Immediately before a disposal group is first classified as held for sale, what must happen to the carrying amounts of the individual assets and liabilities in the group?
opt: Nothing; the group is measured at fair value less costs to sell only
They are all restated to fair value
They are measured in accordance with their applicable IFRSs (for example, inventory at the lower of cost and net realisable value)
They are all written down to nil
ex: IFRS 5 tartibi: (1) classificationdan oldin har bir aktiv/majburiyat o'z standarti bo'yicha qayta o'lchanadi (IAS 2, IAS 16, IAS 36 va h.k.); (2) keyin butun guruh lower of CA va FVLCS da o'lchanadi. Javob: B.

q:
Norvik Co has a year end of 31 December 20X5. At 1 January 20X5 its warehouse (cost model) had a carrying amount of $1,800,000 and a remaining useful life of 15 years. On 1 July 20X5 the board approved a plan to sell the warehouse. It was vacated immediately, an estate agent was appointed and the warehouse was advertised at a price close to its fair value. A sale is expected in April 20X6. At 1 July 20X5 the warehouse's fair value was $1,720,000 and costs to sell were estimated at $30,000. At 31 December 20X5 the fair value was $1,700,000 and costs to sell were still $30,000.
Separately, on 20 December 20X5 Norvik Co's board decided to close its small repair workshop, one of 15 similar workshops in the same country, in March 20X6.
Which THREE facts in the scenario support classifying the warehouse as held for sale at 1 July 20X5?
opt: The warehouse was vacated and is available for immediate sale
An estate agent was appointed to find a buyer
The warehouse is advertised at a price close to its fair value
The warehouse's fair value is lower than its carrying amount
The workshop is to be closed in March 20X6
ex: HFS mezonlari: darhol sotishga tayyor (vacated) — A; active programme to locate a buyer (agent) — B; reasonable narxda reklama — C. Sotuv 12 oy ichida (April 20X6) kutiladi. FV ning CA dan pastligi — mezon emas (o'lchovga ta'sir qiladi). Workshop — alohida masala. Javob: A, B, C.

ex: Amortizatsiya faqat 1.1–1.7.20X5 (6 oy): 1,800,000 / 15 × 6/12 = $60,000. HFS bo'lgandan keyin amortizatsiya to'xtaydi.

How should the repair workshop closure be treated in the financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X5?

As a discontinued operation, with comparatives re-presented
Its assets should be classified as held for sale
As a continuing operation: it is not a separate major line of business or geographical area and it has not yet been closed

q:

How should the disposal group be presented in Harlow Co's statement of financial position at 30 September 20X6 (in $000)?

As a single post-tax amount under discontinued operations, including the impairment loss on remeasurement to fair value less costs to sell, with comparatives re-presented
In other comprehensive income
ex: Packaging — separate major line of business va yil oxirida HFS → discontinued operation. SPL'da bitta post-tax summa: trading natija + FVLCS ga qayta o'lchov zarari (impairment). Comparatives qayta ko'rsatiladi. Javob: B.

q: According to IFRS 16 Leases, which of the following best describes a lease?
opt: A contract under which legal title to an asset passes to the customer at the end of an agreed period
A contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration
Any agreement under which an entity pays for the use of services provided by another entity
A contract that transfers substantially all of the risks and rewards of ownership of an asset to the customer
ex: IFRS 16 ta'rifi: lease — bu underlying asset'dan ma'lum muddat foydalanish huquqini (right to use) consideration (to'lov) evaziga beradigan shartnoma yoki uning bir qismi. Legal title o'tishi shart emas. Oddiy xizmat shartnomasi (asset ustidan huquq bermasa) lease emas. 'Risks and rewards' mezoni eski IAS 17 dagi finance lease ta'rifi edi — IFRS 16 lessee uchun bu farqni olib tashlagan.

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Toshkent Freight Co leased a warehouse crane. The lease has a non-cancellable period of 4 years and gives Toshkent Freight Co an option to extend for a further 2 years. Because of the significant cost of installing the crane, the directors are reasonably certain that the option will be exercised. The crane has a useful life of 10 years.
What is the lease term under IFRS 16?
opt: 2 years
4 years
10 years
6 years
ex: Lease term = non-cancellable davr + reasonably certain bo'lgan extension option davri. 4 yil + 2 yil = 6 yil. Useful life (10 yil) lease term emas — u faqat depreciation davrini tanlashda (shorter of) solishtiriladi.

q: IFRS 16 requires a lessee to discount lease payments using the interest rate implicit in the lease if that rate can be readily determined; otherwise the lessee's incremental borrowing rate is used.
ex: To'g'ri. Birinchi tanlov — rate implicit in the lease. Uni aniqlab bo'lmasa — lessee'ning incremental borrowing rate (shunga o'xshash aktivni sotib olish uchun qarz olsa to'laydigan stavka).

q: Which THREE of the following are included in the lease payments used to measure a lessee's lease liability at commencement?
opt: Fixed lease payments not yet paid
Amounts expected to be payable under a residual value guarantee
The exercise price of a purchase option that the lessee is reasonably certain to exercise
Initial direct costs incurred by the lessee to arrange the lease
The estimated cost of dismantling the asset at the end of the lease
ex: Lease liability = hali to'lanmagan lease payments'ning PV'si. Unga kiradi: fixed payments, residual value guarantee bo'yicha to'lanishi kutilgan summa, reasonably certain purchase option narxi, (va kutilgan termination penalty). Initial direct costs va dismantling costs liability'ga emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri right-of-use asset cost'iga qo'shiladi.

q:
Andijon Motors Co signed an 8-year lease of a showroom. The contract allows Andijon Motors Co to terminate the lease at the end of year 5, but doing so would trigger a very large penalty, so management is reasonably certain that it will not terminate early. The showroom has a remaining useful life of 30 years.
What lease term should Andijon Motors Co use?
opt: 3 years
30 years
8 years
5 years
ex: Lease term'ga termination option qamragan davr ham kiradi, agar option reasonably certain NOT to be exercised bo'lsa. Kompaniya 5-yil oxirida to'xtatmasligi deyarli aniq, demak lease term = to'liq 8 yil. 30 yil — useful life, lease term emas.

q:
On 1 January 20X4 Qo'qon Packaging Co leased a machine for 3 years. Three annual payments of $50,000 are due on 31 December each year (in arrears). The interest rate implicit in the lease is 6%.
What is the initial lease liability? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Payments in arrears — birinchi to'lov 1 yildan keyin, shuning uchun hammasi diskontlanadi:
$50,000/1.06 + $50,000/1.06² + $50,000/1.06³
= $50,000 × (0.9434 + 0.89 + 0.8396) = $133,651.

q:
On 1 April 20X5 Farg'ona Print Co leased a printing press. Four annual payments of $30,000 are payable on 1 April each year, starting on 1 April 20X5 (in advance). The rate implicit in the lease is 8%.
What is the present value of the lease payments at 1 April 20X5? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Payments in advance — birinchi to'lov bugun (diskont yo'q), qolgan 3 tasi 1, 2, 3 yil keyin:
$30,000 + $30,000/1.08 + $30,000/1.08² + $30,000/1.08³ = $107,313.
Eslatma: lease liability 1 aprelda bu summadan birinchi to'lov ayirilgandan keyin qoladi ($107,313 − $30,000 = $77,313), chunki birinchi to'lov darhol naqd to'lanadi (u right-of-use asset cost'iga kiradi).

q:
On 1 January 20X6 Namangan Haulage Co leased a lorry for 2 years at $12,000 per year payable in arrears. The contract includes an option to extend for a third year at $18,000, which Namangan Haulage Co is reasonably certain to exercise. The rate implicit in the lease cannot be determined; the company's incremental borrowing rate is 6%. Initial direct costs of $2,000 were paid.
What is the initial lease liability?
ex:
Extension reasonably certain → lease term = 3 yil, uchinchi yil to'lovi ham kiradi. Implicit rate yo'q → IBR 6%.
$12,000/1.06 + $12,000/1.06² + $18,000/1.06³ = $37,114.
$22,001 — option yilini unutish xatosi; $39,114 — IDC'ni liability'ga qo'shish xatosi (IDC right-of-use asset'ga boradi); $42,000 — diskontlanmagan summa.

q: Which discount rate should a lessee use to measure its lease liability if the interest rate implicit in the lease cannot be readily determined?
opt: The central bank base rate
The lessor's cost of capital
The lessee's incremental borrowing rate
The lessee's weighted average cost of capital including equity
ex: Implicit rate aniqlanmasa, lessee o'zining incremental borrowing rate'idan foydalanadi — shunga o'xshash muddat va ta'minot bilan shunga o'xshash aktiv uchun qarz olsa to'laydigan stavka.

q:
Jizzax Agro Co leased a harvester on 1 July 20X5 for 3 years with payments of $40,000 on 30 June each year in arrears. Jizzax Agro Co has guaranteed that the harvester will be worth at least $25,000 at the end of the lease and expects to pay $10,000 under this residual value guarantee at the end of year 3. The rate implicit in the lease is 7%.
What is the initial lease liability? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Residual value guarantee bo'yicha to'lanishi kutilgan summa ($10,000) lease payments'ga kiradi (butun $25,000 emas). 3-yil oxiridagi pul oqimi = $40,000 + $10,000 = $50,000.
$40,000/1.07 + $40,000/1.07² + $50,000/1.07³ = $113,136.

q:
Buxoro Ceramics Co entered into a lease of a kiln. The following information is available at commencement:
Initial lease liability$180,000
Lease payment made to the lessor before commencement$20,000
Legal fees to arrange the lease (initial direct costs)$5,000
Present value of dismantling costs required by the lease$12,000
Lease incentive received from the lessor$8,000
What is the initial cost of the right-of-use asset? Enter in $.
ex:
Right-of-use asset cost = lease liability + oldindan to'lovlar + initial direct costs + dismantling PV − incentives:
$180,000 + $20,000 + $5,000 + $12,000 − $8,000 = $209,000.

q: Which THREE of the following are included in the initial cost of a lessee's right-of-use asset?
opt: The initial measurement of the lease liability
Initial direct costs incurred by the lessee
Lease incentives received from the lessor
The estimated cost of restoring the site as required by the lease
An allocation of the lessee's general administrative overheads
ex: ROU asset cost = lease liability + commencement'da yoki undan oldin to'langan payments + initial direct costs + dismantling/restoration costs − incentives received. Incentives qo'shilmaydi, balki ayiriladi. General overheads hech qachon kapitallashtirilmaydi.

q: Xiva Hotels Co received a cash incentive of $15,000 from the lessor for agreeing to sign a new 10-year lease. How should the incentive be treated by Xiva Hotels Co at commencement?
opt: Recognised immediately as income in profit or loss
Deducted from the initial cost of the right-of-use asset
Recognised as deferred income and released over 10 years
Deducted from the initial lease liability
ex: IFRS 16: lessee olgan lease incentives right-of-use asset'ning boshlang'ich cost'idan ayiriladi. Natijada foyda darhol emas, balki kamroq depreciation orqali lease davomida tan olinadi.

q: Initial direct costs incurred by a lessee are added to the lease liability at commencement.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Initial direct costs (masalan, lease'ni tuzish uchun yuridik to'lovlar) right-of-use asset cost'iga qo'shiladi: Dr Right-of-use asset, Cr Cash. Lease liability faqat to'lanmagan lease payments'ning PV'si.

q:
On 1 January 20X7 Termiz Cold Stores Co leased a refrigeration unit for 4 years at $25,000 per year payable in arrears. The rate implicit in the lease is 5%. Termiz Cold Stores Co paid $3,000 of initial direct costs and must remove the unit at the end of the lease, at an estimated cost whose present value is $4,000.
What is the initial cost of the right-of-use asset?
ex:
1) Lease liability = $25,000 × 4 yillik 5% annuity factor = $88,649.
2) ROU asset = $88,649 + IDC $3,000 + dismantling PV $4,000 = $95,649.
$107,000 — diskontlanmagan to'lovlar ($100,000) + $7,000; bu xato.

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Nukus Tools Co recognised a lease liability of $250,000. Annual payments of $70,000 are made on 31 December each year. The rate implicit in the lease is 9%.
What is the finance cost for the year ended 31 December 20X5? Enter in $.
ex: Arrears: yil davomida qarz to'liq $250,000 ga teng, to'lov faqat yil oxirida. Interest = $250,000 × 9% = $22,500.

q:
Using the same facts as before: Nukus Tools Co recognised a lease liability of $250,000 on 1 January 20X5, pays $70,000 on 31 December each year, and the implicit rate is 9%.
What is the total lease liability at 31 December 20X5? Enter in $.
ex: Arrears jadvali: b/f $250,000 + interest $22,500 − payment $70,000 = $202,500.

q:
Samarqand Bakers Co leased an oven for 6 years with annual payments of $90,000 in arrears. The present value of the lease payments at commencement was $412,000.
What is the total finance charge that will be recognised over the whole lease?
ex: Umumiy finance charge = jami to'lovlar − boshlang'ich liability = (6 × $90,000) − $412,000 = $540,000 − $412,000 = $128,000. U lease liability jadvali orqali yillarga bo'linadi (birinchi yillarda ko'proq, chunki qarz katta). $21,333 — teng bo'lish (straight-line) xatosi.

q:
On 1 October 20X4 Guliston Foods Co leased a packing line for 5 years at $80,000 per year payable on 30 September (in arrears). The lease liability at commencement was $328,016 and the implicit rate is 7%.
What is the finance cost for the year ended 30 September 20X6 (the second year)? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Arrears jadvali (7%):
Yilb/fInterestPaymentc/f
1$328,016$22,961($80,000)$270,977
2$270,977$18,968($80,000)$209,945
2-yil interest = $270,977 × 7% = $18,968.

q: When lease payments are made in arrears, the interest charge for the first year is calculated on the full initial lease liability.
ex: To'g'ri. Arrears'da birinchi to'lov yil oxirida bo'ladi, shuning uchun butun yil davomida qarz boshlang'ich summaga teng: interest = initial liability × rate. Advance'da esa avval to'lov ayiriladi.

q:
On 1 January 20X6 Qarshi Textiles Co leased a loom for 4 years. Four payments of $40,000 are due on 1 January each year, starting on 1 January 20X6. The present value of all four payments is $139,474 and the implicit rate is 10%.
What is the finance cost for the year ended 31 December 20X6? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Advance: avval to'lov ayiriladi, keyin interest.
$139,474 − $40,000 = $99,474
Interest = $99,474 × 10% = $9,947.

q: Using the Qarshi Textiles Co lease (present value $139,474, four payments of $40,000 on 1 January each year from 1 January 20X6, 10% implicit rate): what is the total lease liability at 31 December 20X6?
ex:
($139,474 − $40,000) = $99,474; + interest $9,947 = $109,421.
$99,474 — interest unutilgan; $69,421 — bu keyingi yil to'lovidan keyingi (non-current) qism; $113,421 — arrears formulasini noto'g'ri ishlatish.

q: Using the Qarshi Textiles Co lease (present value $139,474, four payments of $40,000 on 1 January each year from 1 January 20X6, 10% implicit rate): what is the finance cost for the year ended 31 December 20X7?
ex:
20X7: b/f $109,421 − to'lov $40,000 = $69,421; interest = $69,421 × 10% = $6,942.
$10,942 — to'lovni ayirmasdan hisoblash xatosi (advance'da to'lov yil boshida).

q: If lease payments are made annually in advance, no finance cost arises in the first year of the lease.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Advance'da birinchi to'lov darhol to'lanadi, lekin qolgan qarz (PV − birinchi to'lov) butun yil davomida turadi va unga interest hisoblanadi. Faqat oxirgi yilda (oxirgi to'lovdan keyin qarz 0) interest bo'lmaydi.

q:
Olmaliq Metals Co recognised a lease liability of $300,000 on 1 January 20X5. Payments of $75,000 are made on 31 December each year and the implicit rate is 8%.
What amounts should be shown for the lease liability at 31 December 20X5?
opt: Non-current $193,920; current $55,080
Non-current $174,000; current $75,000
Non-current $249,000; current $75,000
Non-current $193,920; current $24,000

q:
On 1 January 20X8 Chirchiq Plastics Co leased a moulding machine. Five payments of $60,000 are due on 1 January each year, starting on 1 January 20X8. The present value of the payments is $254,383 and the implicit rate is 9%.
What is the non-current lease liability at 31 December 20X8? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Advance jadvali:
$254,383 − $60,000 = $194,383; interest 9% = $17,494; c/f = $211,877 (jami liability).
Non-current = 1 yanvar 20X9 to'lovidan keyingi qoldiq = $211,877 − $60,000 = $151,877.
Current = $60,000 (advance'da keyingi to'lovning to'liq summasi, chunki u 20X8 interest'ini ham qoplaydi).

q: Which TWO of the following statements about splitting a lease liability between current and non-current are correct?
opt: The non-current liability is the balance outstanding immediately after the payment made in the following year
For payments in advance, the current liability at the year end equals the next payment due
For payments in arrears, the current liability equals the full next payment
The non-current liability is always the closing balance of the following year in the liability table
The current liability is always equal to next year's interest charge
ex: Qoida: non-current = keyingi yil to'lovi amalga oshirilgandan keyingi qoldiq. Advance'da keyingi to'lov keyingi yil boshida bo'ladi va u hali interest hisoblanmagan, shuning uchun current = keyingi to'lov. Arrears'da current = keyingi to'lov − keyingi yil interest'i (chunki keyingi yil interest'i hali accrue bo'lmagan). Advance'da keyingi yilning c/f qoldig'i keyingi yil interest'ini ham o'z ichiga oladi, shuning uchun uni NCL sifatida olish xato.

q:
Surxon Glass Co has a lease liability of $150,000 at 1 January 20X9, with payments of $40,000 due on 31 December each year and an implicit rate of 6%.
What is the current liability at 31 December 20X9?
For a lease with payments made annually in advance, the non-current liability at the end of year 1 is the closing balance at the end of year 2 in the lease liability table.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Advance'da 2-yil oxiridagi qoldiq 2-yil interest'ini ham o'z ichiga oladi, u esa hali yuzaga kelmagan. NCL = 1-yil oxiridagi jami qoldiq − 2-yil boshidagi to'lov (ya'ni 2-yil to'lovidan keyingi subtotal).

q:
Kokand Tech Co leases a server for 3 years. Legal title passes to Kokand Tech Co at the end of the lease. Servers have a useful life of 5 years.
Over what period should the right-of-use asset be depreciated?
opt: 5 years
8 years
3 years
4 years
ex: Ownership lease oxirida lessee'ga o'tsa, aktiv undan keyin ham ishlatiladi → depreciation useful life (5 yil) bo'yicha. Aks holda — shorter of lease term va useful life.

q:
Angren Coal Co leases a conveyor for 5 years. Ownership does not transfer and there is no purchase option. The conveyor has a useful life of 8 years.
Over what period should the right-of-use asset be depreciated?
opt: 3 years
8 years
5 years
6.5 years
ex: Ownership o'tmaydi → depreciation shorter of lease term (5) va useful life (8) = 5 yil.

q:
Denov Dairy Co recognised a right-of-use asset at a cost of $96,000 on 1 January 20X5. The lease term is 4 years, the asset's useful life is 6 years and ownership does not transfer.
What is the carrying amount of the right-of-use asset at 31 December 20X6? Enter in $.
ex:
Depreciation davri = shorter of 4 va 6 = 4 yil. Yillik = $96,000 / 4 = $24,000.
2 yildan keyin: $96,000 − (2 × $24,000) = $48,000.

q: Zarafshon Gold Co leases a crusher for 6 years; the crusher has a useful life of 9 years. In which TWO of the following situations should the right-of-use asset be depreciated over 9 years?
opt: Legal ownership of the crusher passes to Zarafshon Gold Co at the end of the lease
Zarafshon Gold Co has an option to buy the crusher for a nominal amount and is reasonably certain to exercise it
Zarafshon Gold Co depreciates its owned crushers over 9 years
Zarafshon Gold Co may extend the lease for 1 year at market rent, but is not reasonably certain to do so
The lessor has agreed to maintain the crusher throughout the lease
ex: Useful life bo'yicha depreciation faqat aktiv lessee'ga o'tishi kutilganda: ownership transfer yoki reasonably certain purchase option. Lessee'ning o'z aktivlari bo'yicha siyosati, reasonably certain bo'lmagan extension yoki maintenance sharti ahamiyatsiz → 6 yil.

q:
Kattaqo'rg'on Mills Co leased a turbine with a useful life of 7 years. The primary lease period is 5 years, followed by an optional secondary period of 3 years at a nominal rent which Kattaqo'rg'on Mills Co is reasonably certain to take up. The initial cost of the right-of-use asset is $91,000. Ownership does not transfer.
What is the carrying amount of the right-of-use asset at the end of the second year? Enter in $.
ex:
Nominal rent'dagi secondary period reasonably certain → lease term = 5 + 3 = 8 yil. Depreciation = shorter of lease term (8) va useful life (7) = 7 yil.
Yillik = $91,000 / 7 = $13,000. 2 yildan keyin: $91,000 − $26,000 = $65,000.

q:
On 1 January 20X6 Marg'ilon Silk Co leased equipment. The initial lease liability and right-of-use asset were both $200,000. Payments of $50,000 are made annually in arrears, the implicit rate is 8%, the lease term is 5 years and the useful life is 7 years.
What is the total expense recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X6?
ex:
Depreciation = $200,000 / 5 (shorter of 5 va 7) = $40,000.
Interest (arrears) = $200,000 × 8% = $16,000.
Jami = $56,000. $50,000 — IFRS 16 dan oldingi 'rent expense' yondashuvi (xato).

q: IFRS 16 gives examples of assets that may be treated as low-value. Which of the following is most likely to qualify?
opt: A floor of an office building
Tablet computers issued to sales staff
A second-hand lorry now worth $3,000
A delivery van
ex: Low-value misollari: tablets, small personal computers, telephones, small items of furniture (basis for conclusions ~$5,000 yangi holatdagi qiymat). Baholash aktivning yangi paytdagi qiymatiga asoslanadi, shuning uchun eski lorry ham low-value emas.

q: Which THREE of the following leases could be accounted for using the IFRS 16 simplified treatment (expense on a straight-line basis)?
opt: A car leased for 11 months with no extension option
Tablets for field staff leased for 3 years
A used lorry with an original cost of $60,000 and a current value of $3,000, leased for 2 years
A factory leased for 5 years
Desk telephones leased for 2 years
ex: Simplified treatment: short-term (12 oy yoki kam) YOKI low-value (yangi holatda). 11 oylik car — short-term. Tablets va telefonlar — low-value. Eski lorry: yangi qiymati $60,000 → low-value emas, muddati 2 yil → short-term ham emas. Factory 5 yil — to'liq IFRS 16.

q:
On 1 July 20X6 Chust Retail Co leased mobile phones for its staff under a 2-year lease. An initial payment of $3,000 was made on 1 July 20X6, followed by two payments of $9,000 on 30 June 20X7 and 30 June 20X8. Chust Retail Co applies the low-value exemption.
What expense should be recognised in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X6? Enter in $.
ex:
Jami to'lov = $3,000 + $9,000 + $9,000 = $21,000; yillik straight-line = $21,000 / 2 = $10,500.
20X6 (6 oy): $10,500 × 6/12 = $5,250.
SOFP: to'langan $3,000, expense $5,250 → accrual $2,250 (current liability).

q: Using the Chust Retail Co phone lease above (expense of $5,250 for 20X6 against a payment of $3,000), which TWO of the following will appear in Chust Retail Co's financial statements for the year ended 31 December 20X6?
opt: A lease rental expense of $5,250 in profit or loss
An accrual of $2,250 within current liabilities
A right-of-use asset for the phones
A prepayment of $2,250 within current assets
A finance cost on the phone lease
ex: Low-value exemption qo'llansa ROU asset ham, lease liability ham, finance cost ham yo'q. Faqat accruals asosida expense: $5,250. To'langan $3,000 expense'dan kam, demak farq $2,250 — accrual (prepayment emas).

q: Whether a leased asset is of low value is assessed based on the value of the asset when it is new, regardless of its age at the start of the lease.
ex: To'g'ri. Low-value baholash aktivning yangi paytdagi qiymatiga asoslanadi. Shuning uchun eski, arzonlashgan avtomobil ham low-value hisoblanmaydi.

q: A lessee must apply the short-term lease exemption to every lease with a term of 12 months or less.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Exemption ixtiyoriy (lessee 'can choose'). Lessee xohlasa short-term lease'ni ham to'liq ROU asset/lease liability bilan hisobga olishi mumkin.

q:
During the year ended 30 September 20X5 Sirdaryo Power Co entered into two leases:
  • On 1 October 20X4 it paid $100,000, the first of five equal annual payments in advance for a turbine. The present value of all five payments was $431,213 and the implicit rate is 8%. The turbine's useful life is 5 years.
  • On 1 January 20X5 it paid $15,000 for a 12-month lease of a generator, applying the short-term exemption.
What is the total charge to profit or loss for the year ended 30 September 20X5 in respect of these leases?
ex:
Turbine (advance): depreciation = $431,213 / 5 = $86,243; interest = ($431,213 − $100,000) × 8% = $331,213 × 8% = $26,497.
Generator (short-term): $15,000 × 9/12 (1 yanvar – 30 sentyabr) = $11,250.
Jami = $86,243 + $26,497 + $11,250 = $123,990.
$131,990 — interest'ni to'lov ayirilmagan to'liq PV'ga hisoblash (arrears xatosi: $431,213 × 8% = $34,497); $127,740 — generator'ning to'liq $15,000 ini expense qilish (faqat 9 oy tegishli); $112,740 — short-term lease expense'ini unutish.

q:
On 1 July 20X7 Karmana Steel Co leased a press requiring five annual payments of $150,000 in advance, the first on 1 July 20X7. The present value of the payments is $635,958 and the implicit rate is 9%. Karmana Steel Co's year end is 31 December.
What is the finance cost for the year ended 31 December 20X7? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.

Using the Karmana Steel Co lease (right-of-use asset of $635,958 recognised on 1 July 20X7, 5-year lease term, useful life 6 years, ownership does not transfer, year end 31 December): what depreciation charge arises for the year ended 31 December 20X7?
ex:
Depreciation davri = shorter of 5 va 6 = 5 yil. Mid-year → time-apportion:
$635,958 / 5 × 6/12 = $63,596.

q: Using the Karmana Steel Co lease (present value $635,958, five payments of $150,000 in advance from 1 July 20X7, 9% implicit rate, year end 31 December): what is the current lease liability at 31 December 20X7? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
SanaSumma
1.7.X7 PV − to'lov$485,958
+ interest 6 oy$21,868
31.12.X7 jami$507,826
+ interest keyingi 6 oy$21,868
− to'lov 1.7.X8(150,000)
1.7.X8 dan keyin (NCL)$379,694
Current = $507,826 − $379,694 = $128,132.

q: Quva Foods Co sold its factory to a bank and leased it back for 25 years. The transfer does not satisfy the IFRS 15 requirements to be treated as a sale. How should Quva Foods Co account for the cash received?
opt: Continue to recognise the factory and recognise the proceeds as revenue
Derecognise the factory, recognise a gain and a right-of-use asset
Continue to recognise the factory and recognise a financial liability equal to the proceeds
Derecognise the factory and recognise the whole gain over 25 years as deferred income
ex: IFRS 15 bo'yicha control o'tmasa — bu sotuv emas. Seller-lessee aktivni hisobda qoldiradi (depreciation davom etadi) va olingan pulni financial liability (qarz) sifatida tan oladi — mohiyatan aktiv garovidagi kredit.

q:
On 1 January 20X6 Yangiyer Glassworks Co sold a building to Asia Finance for its fair value of $3,000,000 and leased it back for 10 years. The sale satisfies IFRS 15. The carrying amount of the building was $2,100,000 and the present value of the lease payments is $1,200,000.
What gain on disposal should Yangiyer Glassworks Co recognise? Enter in $.
ex:
ROU asset = (lease liability / proceeds) × CA = ($1,200,000 / $3,000,000) × $2,100,000 = $840,000.
Gain faqat transfer qilingan huquqlar uchun:
Proceeds (disposed) $3,000,000 − $1,200,000 = $1,800,000
CA (disposed) $2,100,000 − $840,000 = $1,260,000
Gain = $540,000.
Tekshiruv (journal balansi): Dr Cash 3,000,000 + Dr ROU 840,000 = Cr Building 2,100,000 + Cr Lease liability 1,200,000 + Cr Gain 540,000.

q:
Uchqo'rg'on Paper Co sold a warehouse for its fair value of $2,500,000 and leased it back for 6 years. The sale meets the IFRS 15 criteria. The carrying amount immediately before the sale was $1,600,000 and the present value of the lease payments is $750,000.
At what amount should the right-of-use asset be recognised?
ex:
ROU = (PV lease payments / sale proceeds) × oldingi CA = ($750,000 / $2,500,000) × $1,600,000 = $480,000.
Ya'ni aktivning 30% ga huquq saqlab qolingan, shuning uchun CA'ning 30% i ROU asset bo'lib qoladi.

q: Beshariq Cement Co sells a plant for its fair value and leases it back; the transfer qualifies as a sale under IFRS 15. Which THREE of the following form part of the entry made on the date of sale?
opt: Credit the plant with its carrying amount
Debit right-of-use asset with a proportion of the plant's previous carrying amount
Credit lease liability with the present value of the lease payments
Credit deferred income with the whole difference between proceeds and carrying amount
Debit profit or loss with the present value of the lease payments
ex: Sotuv bo'lsa: Dr Cash (proceeds), Dr ROU asset (PV/proceeds × CA), Cr PPE (CA), Cr Lease liability (PV), Cr/Dr P/L (balancing gain — faqat transfer qilingan qism). Deferred income IFRS 16 da ishlatilmaydi; lease PV P/L'ga debet qilinmaydi.

q: In a sale and leaseback that qualifies as a sale at fair value, the seller-lessee recognises the full difference between the sale proceeds and the carrying amount as a gain.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Gain faqat buyer-lessor'ga o'tkazilgan huquqlar bo'yicha tan olinadi. Saqlab qolingan qism (right-of-use) CA'ning ulushi sifatida qoladi, shuning uchun gain < (proceeds − CA).

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Bekobod Engineering Co sold its head office for its fair value of $5,000,000, when its carrying amount was $4,000,000 and its remaining useful life was 8 years. It leased the building back for 8 years at $700,000 payable on 31 December each year. The present value of the lease payments is $4,346,856 and the implicit rate is 6%. The sale satisfies IFRS 15.
What is the total of depreciation and finance cost recognised for the year ended 31 December 20X5?

Shahrisabz Wine Co sold a bottling plant for its fair value of $4,500,000 and immediately leased it back. The carrying amount was $3,000,000 and the present value of the lease payments is $1,800,000. The transfer is a sale under IFRS 15.
What gain should be recognised in profit or loss? Enter in $.
Why does IFRS 16 require lessees to recognise most leases on the statement of financial position?
opt: Because it reduces the lessee's reported gearing
Because legal title to leased assets always passes to the lessee
Because the lessee controls a right to use an asset and has an obligation to make payments, so omitting them would not faithfully represent its position
Because the lessor has derecognised the asset
ex: Mohiyat: lessee aktivdan foydalanish huquqini control qiladi (asset ta'rifi) va to'lov majburiyatiga ega (liability ta'rifi). Ularni SOFP'dan tashqarida qoldirish faithful representation'ni buzadi (off-balance-sheet finance). Aslida gearing oshadi, kamaymaydi.

q: In the lessee's statement of profit or loss, where is the interest on a lease liability presented?
opt: Cost of sales
Administrative expenses
Other comprehensive income
Finance costs
ex: Lease liability interest'i — Dr Finance costs (SPL), Cr Lease liability. ROU asset depreciation esa aktiv qayerda ishlatilsa (cost of sales yoki admin) o'sha yerga boradi.

q: Compared with expensing lease rentals, which TWO effects does recognising a lease under IFRS 16 have on a lessee's financial statements in the first year of a typical lease?
opt: Gearing increases because a lease liability is recognised
Total expense in profit or loss is usually higher than the cash paid, because interest is highest in early years
Current ratio improves because the lease liability is non-current
Operating cash flows are lower because all lease payments are operating cash flows
Non-current assets decrease
ex: Liability SOFP'ga chiqadi → gearing oshadi. Front-loaded interest + straight-line depreciation → dastlabki yillarda expense naqd to'lovdan ko'p bo'ladi. Lease liability'ning current qismi current liabilities'ni oshiradi (current ratio yomonlashadi). Non-current assets (ROU) oshadi.

q:
Buxoro Textiles Co (year end 31 December) leased a weaving machine on 1 January 20X5. The lease has a non-cancellable term of 3 years with payments of $60,000 on 31 December each year. It contains an option to extend for 2 further years at $45,000 per year (payable 31 December), which Buxoro Textiles Co is reasonably certain to exercise. The rate implicit in the lease cannot be determined; Buxoro Textiles Co's incremental borrowing rate is 7%. Initial direct costs of $4,000 were paid on 1 January 20X5. True or false: the lease term that Buxoro Textiles Co should use is 3 years.
