  • On 1 April 20X6 it sold its administration building to Silk Road Bank for its fair value of $6,000,000 and leased it back for 10 years at $500,000 payable on 31 March each year. The carrying amount of the building was $4,200,000 and its remaining useful life was 15 years. The present value of the lease payments is $3,355,041 and the implicit rate is 8%. Control of the building passed to Silk Road Bank, satisfying IFRS 15.
  • On 1 October 20X6 it leased tablets for its engineers for 2 years, paying $2,000 on 1 October 20X6 and $7,000 on each of 30 September 20X7 and 30 September 20X8. Navoi Mining Co applies the low-value exemption.
What expense should be recognised for the tablet lease in the year ended 31 March 20X7? Enter in $.
According to IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers, which of the following is the third step of the five-step model for recognising revenue?
opt: Identify the separate performance obligations in the contract
Determine the transaction price
Allocate the transaction price to the performance obligations
Identify the contract with the customer
ex: IFRS 15 ning 5 bosqichi tartibi: (1) Identify the contract → (2) Identify the performance obligations → (3) Determine the transaction price → (4) Allocate the transaction price → (5) Recognise revenue when (or as) each obligation is satisfied. Demak 3-bosqich — transaction price'ni aniqlash. Qolgan javoblar 1-, 2- va 4-bosqichlardir.

q: Which THREE of the following are criteria that must be met before an entity can account for a contract with a customer under IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers?
opt: The parties have approved the contract and are committed to perform their obligations
The contract has commercial substance
It is probable that the entity will collect the consideration to which it is entitled
The contract is in writing and has been signed by both parties
The customer has paid a deposit of at least 10% of the price
ex:
IFRS 15 para 9 bo'yicha shartlar: tomonlar shartnomani tasdiqlagan va majburiyatlarni bajarishga sodiq; har bir tomonning huquqlari va to'lov shartlari aniqlanadi; shartnoma commercial substance'ga ega; kompaniya to'lovni olishi probable.
Shartnoma yozma bo'lishi shart emas — og'zaki yoki odatiy biznes amaliyoti orqali ham tuzilishi mumkin. Oldindan deposit olish ham shart emas.

q:
On 1 February 20X6 Termiz Co agreed to deliver specialised equipment to a customer on 31 March 20X6 in exchange for $450,000 payable on 30 September 20X6. Control of the equipment passed to the customer on 31 March 20X6. By 31 March 20X6 (Termiz Co's year end), the customer had entered financial difficulties and Termiz Co concluded that it was not probable that it would collect the consideration.
How should Termiz Co account for this transaction in its financial statements for the year ended 31 March 20X6?
opt: Revenue of $450,000 with disclosure of the uncertainty in the notes
Revenue of $450,000 with a loss allowance for expected credit losses
Revenue of $225,000, reflecting a 50% probability of collection
No revenue should be recognised, because the contract does not meet the IFRS 15 criteria
ex:
IFRS 15 ning 1-bosqichi (identify the contract) shartlaridan biri — kompaniya to'lovni olishi probable bo'lishi kerak. Bu shart bajarilmagani uchun IFRS 15 bo'yicha contract mavjud emas va revenue tan olinmaydi (hatto control o'tgan bo'lsa ham).
Revenue tan olib, keyin ECL allowance qilish — noto'g'ri, chunki bu contract'ni hisobga olish shartlari bajarilgan holatlar uchun. Ehtimolga ko'ra 50% revenue tan olish IFRS 15 da yo'q usul.

q: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers requires an entity to consider certain effects when determining the transaction price. Which FOUR of the following should be considered?
opt: Variable consideration
The existence of a significant financing component
The entity's expected cost of fulfilling the contract
Non-cash consideration
Consideration payable to the customer
ex:
IFRS 15 para 48 bo'yicha transaction price aniqlashda 4 ta narsa hisobga olinadi: variable consideration, significant financing component, non-cash consideration va consideration payable to a customer.
Kompaniyaning shartnomani bajarish xarajatlari (cost of fulfilling) transaction price'ga ta'sir qilmaydi — ular cost of sales'ga tegishli.

q: Which of the following best describes a performance obligation under IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers?
opt: An obligation of the entity to invoice the customer on agreed dates
An obligation of the customer to pay the agreed consideration
A promise in a contract to transfer to the customer a distinct good or service
Any cost the entity must incur to fulfil the contract
ex:
Performance obligation — mijozga distinct (alohida ajratiladigan) tovar yoki xizmatni (yoki ular to'plamini) o'tkazish haqidagi va'da. Bu va'da faqat shartnomada yozilgani bilan cheklanmaydi — odatiy amaliyot ham kutilma yaratishi mumkin.
Mijozning to'lov majburiyati — bu customer'ning majburiyati; xarajatlarni qoplash yoki invoice chiqarish — performance obligation ta'rifi emas.

q:
On 1 October 20X5 Navoiy Co sold a laptop together with two years of technical support to a customer for a total price of $1,440. The stand-alone selling price of the laptop is $1,200 and Navoiy Co sells two years of technical support separately for $360. The laptop was delivered on 1 October 20X5.
What revenue should Navoiy Co recognise from this contract in its statement of profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X5?
Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Ikki performance obligation: laptop (point in time) va support (over time).
Jami SSP = 1,200 + 360 = 1,560.
Laptop'ga ajratiladi: 1,440 × 1,200/1,560 = 1,107.69.
Support'ga: 1,440 × 360/1,560 = 332.31.
Support 24 oy davomida bajariladi; 1-okt – 31-dek = 3 oy: 332.31 × 3/24 = 41.54.
Jami revenue = 1,107.69 + 41.54 = $1,149. Qolgan 290.77 — contract liability (deferred income).

q:
On 1 July 20X4 Fargona Co sold a machine together with one year's maintenance for a total of $96,000. The machine is regularly sold on its own for $90,000. Maintenance for this machine is not sold separately; Fargona Co expects the maintenance to cost $20,000 and it earns a gross margin of 20% on its other service contracts. The machine was delivered on 1 July 20X4.
What revenue should Fargona Co recognise for the year ended 31 December 20X4?
Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Maintenance SSP kuzatilmaydi → expected cost plus margin usulida baholanadi. Diqqat: 20% — margin (sotuv narxidan), mark-up emas.
SSP = 20,000 × 100/80 = 25,000.
Jami SSP = 90,000 + 25,000 = 115,000; bundle narxi 96,000 → discount butun bundle'ga taqsimlanadi.
Machine: 96,000 × 90,000/115,000 = 75,130.43 (1-iyulda to'liq).
Maintenance: 96,000 × 25,000/115,000 = 20,869.57; 6/12 qismi = 10,434.78.
Jami revenue = 75,130.43 + 10,434.78 = $85,565.

q:
Andijon Co sells three products: a pump (stand-alone selling price $400), a filter ($250) and a valve ($150). It regularly sells each item separately at these prices, and also regularly sells the filter and valve together as a pair for $300. A customer buys all three items as a bundle for $700.
How much of the transaction price should be allocated to the pump?
ex:
Jami SSP = 400 + 250 + 150 = 800; bundle narxi 700 → discount = 100.
Odatda discount barcha komponentlarga proporsional taqsimlanadi. Lekin filter+valve muntazam ravishda 300 ga (ya'ni 100 chegirma bilan) alohida sotiladi → discount to'liq shu ikkisiga tegishli ekanligiga kuzatiladigan dalil bor.
Pump = 700 − 300 = $400 (to'liq SSP).
Proporsional usul 700 × 400/800 = 350 bo'lardi — bu holatda noto'g'ri.

q: Which THREE of the following are likely to be separate performance obligations in a contract with a customer?
opt: A two-year extended service plan sold with a machine, which customers can also buy separately
A standard warranty that only assures the product meets agreed specifications
Software updates to be provided over 12 months after the sale of a software licence
Delivery of goods by the seller's own trucks, before control of the goods passes to the customer
Free training sessions that the entity's published policies lead customers to expect
ex:
Distinct bo'lsa — alohida performance obligation:
• Mijoz alohida sotib olishi mumkin bo'lgan extended service plan — service-type, alohida PO.
• Dasturiy ta'minot litsenziyasi bilan kelgusi update'lar — alohida xizmat, alohida PO.
• Kompaniyaning odatiy amaliyoti mijozda bepul training kutilmasini yaratsa — shartnomada yozilmagan bo'lsa ham, PO (implied promise).
Alohida PO emas: assurance-type warranty (mahsulot spetsifikatsiyaga mosligini kafolatlaydi — IAS 37 provision) va control o'tishidan oldin bajariladigan yetkazib berish (fulfilment activity).

q: Under IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers, the transaction price is allocated to each performance obligation in proportion to the cost to the entity of providing each good or service.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Transaction price stand-alone selling prices (SSP) nisbatida taqsimlanadi. Eng yaxshi dalil — shu tovar/xizmat alohida sotilgandagi kuzatiladigan narx. Agar SSP kuzatilmasa, u baholanadi (masalan, expected cost plus margin) — ya'ni cost faqat SSP'ni baholash vositasi bo'lishi mumkin, taqsimot asosi emas.

q:
On 1 September 20X5 Kokand Co sold specialised equipment to a customer for a total price of $5,400,000. The price covers both the equipment and a support service for three years to 31 August 20X8. The support will cost Kokand Co $250,000 per year and Kokand Co earns a gross margin of 20% on support contracts. The equipment has no observable stand-alone selling price.
What revenue should Kokand Co recognise for the year ended 31 December 20X5?
Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Ikki PO: equipment (point in time, 1-sentabr) va support (3 yil davomida over time).
Support SSP = 250,000 × 100/80 = 312,500 yiliga → 3 yil = 937,500.
Equipment SSP kuzatilmaydi → qolgan summa (residual): 5,400,000 − 937,500 = 4,462,500.
Support: 1-sen – 31-dek = 4 oy: 937,500 × 4/36 = 104,166.67.
Jami revenue = 4,462,500 + 104,166.67 = 4,566,666.67 ≈ $4,567,000.

q: Under IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers, what is the best evidence of the stand-alone selling price of a good or service?
opt: The cost to the entity of producing the good or providing the service
The price charged by the entity's main competitor for a similar item
The observable price when the entity sells that good or service separately to similar customers
The amount invoiced to the customer for that item within the bundle
ex: Eng yaxshi dalil — kompaniya shu tovar/xizmatni o'xshash sharoitda, o'xshash mijozlarga alohida sotgandagi kuzatiladigan narx. Faqat bu narx kuzatilmasa, kompaniya SSP'ni baholaydi (masalan, cost plus margin yoki raqobatchilar narxi asosida). Tarixiy cost yoki raqobatchi narxi — faqat baholash usullari.

q: Which of the following should be excluded from the transaction price under IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers?
opt: A performance bonus that it is highly probable will be received
Sales tax collected from the customer on behalf of the tax authority
Shares in the customer received as payment, measured at fair value
The fixed fee stated in the contract
ex:
Transaction price — kompaniya o'zi olishni kutayotgan summa. Uchinchi shaxslar nomidan yig'iladigan summalar (masalan, sales tax/VAT) chiqarib tashlanadi — ular soliq organiga liability.
Highly probable bo'lgan bonus (variable consideration), mijoz aksiyalari ko'rinishidagi non-cash consideration va fixed fee — barchasi transaction price'ga kiradi.

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Qarshi Co delivered machinery to a customer and control passed on that date. The contract price of $968,000 is payable in full on 31 December 20X6. The customer could borrow at 10% per annum.
What is the total income (revenue plus any finance income) that Qarshi Co should recognise in profit or loss from this contract for the year ended 31 December 20X5?
Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
To'lov 2 yildan keyin → significant financing component. Revenue = to'lovning PV'si (mijozning qarz stavkasi 10% bilan):
968,000 / 1.10² = 800,000 → revenue 1-yanvarda.
Receivable unwinding (finance income) 20X5: 800,000 × 10% = 80,000.
P/L'ga jami kredit = 800,000 + 80,000 = $880,000. (20X6 da yana 88,000 finance income bo'ladi va receivable 968,000 ga yetadi.)

q:
On 1 April 20X5 Guliston Co sold a machine to a customer, who took control on that date. The customer paid $40,000 on 1 April 20X5 and will pay a further $48,400 on 31 March 20X7. The customer can obtain finance at 10% per annum.
What is the carrying amount of the receivable in Guliston Co's statement of financial position at 31 March 20X6?
Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Kechiktirilgan qism PV'si: 48,400 / 1.10² = 40,000.
Revenue (1-aprel) = 40,000 + 40,000 = 80,000.
Receivable 1-aprel = 40,000; unwinding 10%: 40,000 × 10% = 4,000 (finance income).
31-mart 20X6 dagi receivable = 40,000 + 4,000 = $44,000.

q:
Nukus Co has agreed to build a warehouse for a customer for $5.0 million, plus a bonus of $0.5 million if the warehouse is completed by a specified date. There are only two possible outcomes: the bonus is earned in full or not at all. Nukus Co estimates an 80% probability of earning the bonus and concludes that it is highly probable that a significant reversal of revenue will not occur.
What transaction price should Nukus Co use for the contract?
opt: $5.5 million
$5.1 million
$5.4 million
$5.0 million
ex:
Bonus — variable consideration. Faqat ikki natija bo'lganda most likely amount usuli qo'llanadi (expected value emas). Eng ehtimolli natija — bonus olinadi.
Bonus kiritilishi uchun significant reversal bo'lmasligi highly probable bo'lishi kerak — shart bajarilgan.
Transaction price = 5.0 + 0.5 = $5.5m.
Expected value (5.0 + 80% × 0.5 = 5.4) ko'p o'xshash shartnomalar uchun ishlatiladi.

q:
Jizzax Co has a large number of similar contracts with retailers. For a typical contract with a list price of $200,000, Jizzax Co estimates the following retrospective rebates: 60% probability of no rebate, 30% probability of a rebate of $10,000 and 10% probability of a rebate of $25,000.
What transaction price should Jizzax Co use for such a contract?
ex:
Ko'p o'xshash shartnomalar → variable consideration expected value usulida baholanadi.
Kutilgan rebate = 60%×0 + 30%×10,000 + 10%×25,000 = 5,500.
Transaction price = 200,000 − 5,500 = $194,500.
Most likely amount (rebate yo'q, 200,000) faqat ikki natijali yakka shartnomalar uchun mos; natijalarning oddiy o'rtachasi ehtimollarni hisobga olmaydi.

q:
Urganch Co signed a contract with a supermarket chain, which commits to buy at least $12m of products over the next 12 months. Urganch Co paid the supermarket $900,000 at the start of the contract to refit its shelves for Urganch Co's products. The payment is not in exchange for any distinct good or service. By the year end Urganch Co had delivered products with a list value of $5m.
What revenue should Urganch Co recognise for the year?
Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Mijozga to'lov distinct tovar/xizmat evaziga emas → consideration payable to a customer → transaction price'ni kamaytiradi (xarajat emas).
Kamayish foizi = 900,000 / 12,000,000 = 7.5%.
Revenue = 5,000,000 × (100% − 7.5%) = 4,625,000 = $4,625,000.

q: Which THREE of the following would be accounted for as a reduction of revenue under IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers?
opt: An up-front slotting fee paid to a retailer for shelf space, for which no distinct service is received
A volume rebate that the customer is expected to earn
A fee paid to a customer, at fair value, for a distinct marketing service
Sales commission paid to the entity's own sales staff
Amounts expected to be refunded for goods sold with a right of return
ex:
Revenue'ni kamaytiradi:
• Retailer'ga shelf/slotting fee — distinct xizmat olinmaydi → consideration payable to a customer.
• Kutilayotgan volume rebate — variable consideration.
• Qaytarilishi kutilayotgan tovarlar bo'yicha summa — refund liability sifatida, revenue'ga kiritilmaydi.
Kamaytirmaydi: mijozdan fair value'da olingan distinct marketing xizmati (xarajat) va o'z xodimlariga sales commission (xarajat yoki contract cost asset).

q: Which of the following is NOT an indicator in IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers that control of an asset has passed to the customer?
opt: The customer has legal title to the asset
The contract has been signed by both parties
The customer has accepted the asset
The customer has physical possession of the asset
ex:
IFRS 15 bo'yicha control o'tish indikatorlari: kompaniyaning to'lovga present right'i bor; mijozda legal title; mijozda physical possession; mijozda significant risks and rewards; mijoz aktivni qabul qilgan (accepted).
Shartnoma imzolanganligi — 1-bosqich (contract) masalasi, control o'tganini bildirmaydi.

q: Which THREE of the following indicate that control of goods has transferred to the customer?
opt: The customer has obtained legal title to the goods
The seller retains an unrestricted right to use the goods
The customer has formally accepted the goods
The seller has a present right to payment for the goods
The customer has paid a fully refundable deposit
ex:
Control indikatorlari: mijozda legal title; mijoz aktivni accept qilgan; kompaniyaning to'lovga present right'i bor.
Agar kompaniya tovarni cheklovsiz ishlatish huquqini saqlasa — control o'tmagan. Qaytariladigan deposit to'lash ham control'ni bildirmaydi (mijoz hali foyda va risklarni olmagan).

q: Which of the following performance obligations is satisfied over time under IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers?
opt: A monthly payroll processing service, where the customer receives the benefit as each payroll is processed
The sale of standard office furniture delivered to the customer's premises
The sale of a car from a dealer's showroom stock
Building a standard house that could be sold to any buyer, with payment due only on completion
ex:
Over time mezonlari (para 35): (A) mijoz foydani bajarish jarayonida bir vaqtda oladi va iste'mol qiladi; (B) kompaniya mijoz control qiladigan aktivni yaratadi/yaxshilaydi; (C) aktivning kompaniya uchun alternative use'i yo'q va bajarilgan ish uchun enforceable right to payment bor.
Oylik payroll xizmati — (A) mezon. Standart mebel, shourumdagi mashina — point in time. Istalgan xaridorga sotilishi mumkin bo'lgan standart uy, to'lov faqat oxirida — alternative use bor va right to payment yo'q → point in time.

q: If an asset being built for a customer has no alternative use to the entity, revenue is recognised over time even if the entity has no enforceable right to payment for performance completed to date.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Para 35(c) mezonida ikkala shart birga bajarilishi kerak: (1) aktivning kompaniya uchun alternative use'i yo'q va (2) shu kungacha bajarilgan ish uchun enforceable right to payment bor. Right to payment bo'lmasa (va A/B mezonlari ham bajarilmasa), revenue point in time'da tan olinadi.

q:
Samarqand Co is constructing an office block for a customer and satisfies its performance obligation over time. The contract price is $6.0m. At the year end, costs incurred to date are $2.4m and estimated costs to complete are $1.6m. Samarqand Co measures progress using an input method based on costs incurred as a proportion of total expected costs.
What revenue should Samarqand Co recognise for the year (the first year of the contract)?
Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
1) Umumiy natija: 6,000 − 2,400 − 1,600 = 2,000 foyda (profitable).
2) Progress (input): 2,400 / (2,400 + 1,600) = 60%.
3) Revenue = 6,000 × 60% = $3,600,000. (Cost of sales = costs to date 2,400; gross profit 1,200.)

q:
Buxoro Co has a contract to build a bridge, satisfied over time. Progress is measured using an output method based on work certified as a proportion of the contract price. Details at the year end (first year of the contract):
Contract price$12.0m
Work certified to date$4.8m
Costs incurred to date$4.0m
Estimated costs to complete$5.0m
What revenue and cost of sales should Buxoro Co recognise for the year?
opt: Revenue $4.8m; cost of sales $3.6m
Revenue $4.8m; cost of sales $9.0m
Revenue $5.33m; cost of sales $4.0m
Revenue $4.8m; cost of sales $4.0m
ex:
1) Umumiy: 12.0 − 4.0 − 5.0 = 3.0m foyda.
2) Progress (output) = 4.8/12.0 = 40%.
3) Revenue = 12.0 × 40% = $4.8m; Kaplan yondashuvi bo'yicha cost of sales = costs incurred to date $4.0m; gross profit = 0.8m.
Tuzoq: input method (costs 4.0/9 = 44.4%) savol output method'ni talab qilganda ishlatilmaydi.

q:
Xiva Co has a contract to build a sports hall, satisfied over time, with a price of $8m. At 31 December 20X5 (first year), costs incurred were $3m and estimated costs to complete were $2m. Progress is measured using costs incurred as a proportion of total expected costs. The customer has been invoiced, and has paid, $5.5m.
What is the amount of the contract liability in Xiva Co's statement of financial position at 31 December 20X5?
Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Progress = 3,000 / 5,000 = 60%.
Revenue to date = 8,000 × 60% = 4,800.
Contract asset/(liability) = revenue to date − invoiced to date = 4,800 − 5,500 = (700).
Invoiced revenue'dan ko'p → contract liability $700,000 (current liabilities).

q:
Chust Co has a contract, satisfied over time, with a price of $20m. Progress is measured by work certified as a proportion of contract price. In year 1, progress was 30% and costs incurred were $5m; the correct amounts were recognised. At the end of year 2, cumulative work certified is $13m, cumulative costs incurred are $11.5m and estimated costs to complete are $4.5m.
What gross profit should Chust Co recognise on the contract in year 2?
Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Umumiy: 20,000 − 11,500 − 4,500 = 4,000 foyda.
Kumulyativ revenue = 13,000 (65%); 1-yilda tan olingan = 20,000 × 30% = 6,000 → 2-yil revenue = 13,000 − 6,000 = 7,000.
2-yil cost of sales = 11,500 − 5,000 = 6,500.
2-yil gross profit = 7,000 − 6,500 = $500,000. Esda tuting: kumulyativ summadan oldingi yil summasi ayriladi.

q:
Rishton Co started a two-year contract on 1 January 20X5 to build a stadium for $50m, satisfied over time. At 31 December 20X5 costs incurred (excluding depreciation) were $18m and estimated further costs (excluding depreciation) were $12m. Plant costing $8m was bought on 1 January 20X5 for use only on this contract; it will have no residual value after two years and is depreciated straight-line over the contract. Progress is measured by work certified, which was $27.5m at 31 December 20X5. The customer has paid $20m, equal to amounts invoiced.
What profit and contract balance should Rishton Co report for the year ended 31 December 20X5?
opt: Profit $5.5m; contract asset $7.5m
Profit $5.5m; contract liability $7.5m
Profit $9.5m; contract asset $7.5m
Profit $6.95m; contract asset $8.95m
ex:
1) Umumiy: 50 − 18 − 12 − 8 (plant) = 12m foyda.
2) Progress (output) = 27.5/50 = 55%.
3) Revenue = 27.5m; cost of sales = 18 + depreciation (8/2 = 4) = 22m → profit = $5.5m.
4) Contract asset = revenue to date 27.5 − invoiced 20 = $7.5m. Plant SOFP'da PPE sifatida 4m carrying amount'da.

q: Which THREE of the following are acceptable ways of measuring progress towards complete satisfaction of a performance obligation under IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers?
opt: Value of work certified to date as a proportion of the contract price
Costs incurred to date as a proportion of total expected costs
Cash received from the customer as a proportion of the contract price
Time elapsed, for a service provided evenly over a fixed period
Profit recognised to date as a proportion of total expected profit
ex:
IFRS 15 ikki guruh usulni beradi: output methods (work certified / surveys of performance, time elapsed) va input methods (costs incurred / total expected costs). Xizmat teng taqsimlansa — time elapsed (straight-line).
Mijozdan olingan naqd pul — bajarilgan ishni aks ettirmaydi (to'lov jadvaliga bog'liq). Profit nisbati progress o'lchovi emas.

q: For a contract satisfied over time, the contract asset or liability at the year end is calculated using cumulative revenue recognised to date less cumulative amounts invoiced to date.
ex: To'g'ri. SOFP'dagi contract asset/liability — kumulyativ ko'rsatkichlar: revenue to date − invoiced (billed) to date. Musbat bo'lsa — contract asset (current assets), manfiy bo'lsa — contract liability (current liabilities). Faqat shu yilgi revenue ishlatish — keng tarqalgan xato.

q: For a contract satisfied over time, the amounts invoiced to and paid by the customer to date exceed the cumulative revenue recognised. How should the difference be presented in the statement of financial position?
opt: As a contract asset within current assets
As a provision for an onerous contract
As a contract liability within current liabilities
As deferred income within equity
ex: Revenue to date − invoiced to date < 0 → mijoz bajarilgan ishdan ko'proq to'lagan → contract liability (deferred income), current liabilities'da. Aksincha bo'lsa — contract asset (current assets). Bu provision emas (provision faqat zararli shartnoma uchun) va equity'ga borilmaydi.

q:
Kosonsoy Co has a contract to build a hospital wing for $18m, satisfied over time. At the end of year 1, costs incurred are $12m and estimated costs to complete are $8m. Progress is measured using costs incurred as a proportion of total expected costs.
What total cost of sales should Kosonsoy Co recognise for year 1?
Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
1) Umumiy: 18,000 − 12,000 − 8,000 = (2,000) → loss-making, butun zarar darhol tan olinadi.
2) Progress = 12,000/20,000 = 60%.
3) Revenue = 18,000 × 60% = 10,800.
Costs to date = 12,000 → revenue bilan zarar = -1,200. Jami zarar (2,000) ga yetkazish uchun provision = 2,000 − 1,200 = 800 (Dr Cost of sales / Cr Provision).
Cost of sales = 12,000 + 800 = $12,800,000. Tekshiruv: 10,800 − 12,800 = (2,000) = to'liq zarar.

q:
Angren Co has a contract, satisfied over time, with a price of $30m. At the year end (first year), costs incurred are $21m and estimated costs to complete are $14m. Progress is measured on a cost basis. The customer has been invoiced and has paid $15m.
What amounts should appear in Angren Co's statement of financial position?
opt: Contract asset $3m; provision $5m
Contract asset $3m; provision $2m
Contract liability $3m; provision $2m
Contract asset $6m; provision $2m
ex:
1) Umumiy: 30 − 21 − 14 = (5)m zarar.
2) Progress = 21/35 = 60%.
3) Revenue = 30 × 60% = 18m; costs 21m → hozircha zarar 3m; provision = 5 − 3 = 2m (current liabilities).
4) Contract asset = revenue to date 18 − invoiced 15 = 3m (current assets).

q: When a contract satisfied over time is expected to make an overall loss, only the part of the loss relating to work performed to date is recognised in the current year.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Shartnoma zararli bo'lsa, butun kutilgan zarar darhol tan olinadi (prudence; IAS 37 onerous contract). Revenue progress bo'yicha tan olinadi, qolgan zarar esa provision orqali (Dr Cost of sales / Cr Provision) qo'shiladi.

q:
Zomin Co has a contract, satisfied over time, with a price of $10m. In year 1 it correctly recognised revenue of $4m and cost of sales of $3m. At the end of year 2, cumulative costs incurred are $8.4m and estimated costs to complete are $2.1m. Progress is measured on a cost basis.
What is the effect of the contract on Zomin Co's profit for year 2?
opt: Loss of $0.5m
Loss of $1.4m
Profit of $0.8m
Loss of $1.5m
ex:
1) Umumiy: 10 − 8.4 − 2.1 = (0.5)m → endi zararli.
2) Progress = 8.4/10.5 = 80%; kumulyativ revenue = 8.0; 2-yil revenue = 8.0 − 4 = 4.0.
3) 2-yil costs = 8.4 − 3 = 5.4; provision = jami zarar 0.5 − (costs 8.4 − revenue 8.0 = 0.4) = 0.1.
2-yil cost of sales = 5.4 + 0.1 = 5.5.
2-yil natija = 4.0 − 5.5 = (1.5)m zarar — 1-yildagi 1m foyda qaytariladi va jami 0.5m zarar qoladi.

q:
Paxtakor Co sells goods on behalf of a supplier and acts as the supplier's agent. During the year it collected $300,000 from customers for these goods and is entitled to commission of 12%.
What revenue should Paxtakor Co recognise from these sales?
ex: Agent revenue sifatida faqat o'z komissiyasini tan oladi: 300,000 × 12% = $36,000. Qolgan 264,000 — supplier'ga payable (liability), revenue ham, cost of sales ham emas.

q: Which THREE of the following indicate that an entity is acting as a principal rather than an agent?
opt: It is primarily responsible for fulfilling the promise to provide the goods
It bears inventory risk before the goods are transferred to the customer
It earns a fixed percentage commission on each sale
It has discretion in establishing the selling price
It never takes title to the goods and the supplier delivers directly to the customer
ex:
Principal belgilari: tovar/xizmatni mijozga o'tkazishdan oldin control qiladi — ya'ni va'dani bajarish uchun asosiy javobgar, inventory risk ko'taradi, narxni belgilashda erkin.
Agent belgilari: belgilangan foiz komissiya oladi; hech qachon title olmaydi va supplier to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yetkazadi.

q:
Nurota Co's draft revenue includes $840,000 for sales made as an agent for another company. Nurota Co is entitled to 10% commission and has paid the remaining $756,000 to the principal, recording the payment in cost of sales.
By how much should Nurota Co's draft revenue be reduced?
Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Agent sifatida revenue = komissiya: 840,000 × 10% = 84,000.
Kamaytirish = 840,000 − 84,000 = $756,000.
Provodka: Dr Revenue 756,000 / Cr Cost of sales 756,000. Gross profit o'zgarmaydi, lekin revenue va cost of sales to'g'rilanadi (GP margin o'zgaradi).

q: An entity acting as an agent should recognise as revenue the gross amount collected from the end customer, and the amount paid to the principal as cost of sales.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Agent faqat net summa — o'z komissiyasi (fee)ni revenue sifatida tan oladi. Principal'ga o'tkaziladigan summa — payable (liability), cost of sales emas. Gross summa faqat principal uchun revenue.

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Denov Co sold maturing wine inventory, which cost $2,000,000, to a bank for $3,000,000. Denov Co keeps the wine in its own cellars and has the option to repurchase it on 31 December 20X7 for $3,993,000, which reflects an effective interest rate of 10% per annum. The wine is expected to be worth far more than this at 31 December 20X7.
How should Denov Co account for the transaction in the year ended 31 December 20X5?
opt: Recognise revenue of $3,000,000 and cost of sales of $2,000,000
Recognise deferred income of $3,000,000, released over three years
Derecognise the inventory and recognise a profit on disposal of $1,000,000
Keep the inventory, recognise a loan of $3,000,000 and a finance cost of $300,000
ex:
Denov Co'da repurchase huquqi (call option) bor va qayta sotib olish narxi (3,993,000) sotuv narxidan (3,000,000) yuqori → financing arrangement (secured loan). Control bankka o'tmagan.
Inventory SOFP'da qoladi; 3,000,000 — loan (liability). 20X5 finance cost = 3,000,000 × 10% = 300,000. Tekshiruv: 3,000,000 × 1.1³ = 3,993,000.
Revenue/profit tan olish — noto'g'ri (substance over form).

q:
Sherobod Co sold a machine to a customer for $400,000 and has an obligation to repurchase it after two years for $300,000.
How should Sherobod Co account for this arrangement?
opt: As a financing arrangement, with the $400,000 recognised as a loan
As a lease in accordance with IFRS 16 Leases
As a sale, with revenue of $400,000 recognised on delivery
As a sale with a right of return, with a refund liability of $300,000
ex:
Kompaniyada repurchase majburiyati (forward) bor → mijoz control olmaydi. Qayta sotib olish narxi ($300,000) sotuv narxidan ($400,000) past → aslida mijoz 2 yil foydalanish uchun $100,000 to'layapti → IFRS 16 bo'yicha lease.
Agar repurchase narxi sotuv narxidan yuqori bo'lganda — financing arrangement bo'lardi.

q:
Quvasoy Co sold equipment for $1,000,000. The customer has the right to require Quvasoy Co to buy the equipment back after three years for $700,000. The equipment is expected to have a market value of $900,000 at that date, so the customer is not expected to exercise its right.
How should Quvasoy Co account for the transaction?
opt: As a lease, because the repurchase price is below the original selling price
As a financing arrangement, with interest on $1,000,000
As a sale of a product with a right of return
As a sale with no further accounting for the repurchase obligation
ex:
Bu — mijoz talabiga ko'ra qayta sotib olish majburiyati (put option). Repurchase narxi ($700,000) kutilayotgan bozor qiymatidan ($900,000) past → mijozda optionni ishlatish uchun iqtisodiy rag'bat yo'q. Bunday holda IFRS 15 kontraktni sale with a right of return sifatida hisoblashni talab qiladi.
Agar mijoz optionni ishlatishi ehtimoli yuqori bo'lsa va narx sotuv narxidan past bo'lsa — lease; narx sotuv narxiga teng yoki yuqori va bozor qiymatidan yuqori bo'lsa — financing.

q: Where an entity has the right to repurchase an asset it has sold, at a price higher than the original selling price, the arrangement is accounted for as a financing arrangement.
ex: To'g'ri. Kompaniyada call option (yoki forward) bor bo'lsa, mijoz control olmaydi. Repurchase narxi sotuv narxidan yuqori → financing arrangement (aktiv SOFP'da qoladi, olingan pul — loan, farq — finance cost). Past bo'lsa → lease.

q: For revenue to be recognised under a bill-and-hold arrangement, which FOUR of the following conditions must be met?
opt: The customer requested the arrangement
The product is separately identified as belonging to the customer
The customer has paid the full price in advance
The product is ready for physical transfer to the customer
The entity cannot use the product or direct it to another customer
ex:
IFRS 15 bill-and-hold shartlari: (1) arrangement'ni mijoz so'ragan (substantive reason); (2) tovar mijozga tegishli deb alohida identifikatsiya qilingan; (3) tovar jismoniy o'tkazishga tayyor; (4) kompaniya tovarni ishlata olmaydi yoki boshqa mijozga yo'naltira olmaydi.
Oldindan to'liq to'lov olish — shart emas.

q:
Uchquduq Co manufactures boats and supplies them to a dealer. The dealer can return unsold boats at any time without penalty, and Uchquduq Co can recall boats at any time and regularly does so. Uchquduq Co insures the boats, and the dealer pays Uchquduq Co the list price applying on the date the dealer sells a boat to a third party.
When should Uchquduq Co recognise revenue?
opt: When the dealer sells each boat to a third party
When the boats are delivered to the dealer
When the dealer pays a deposit on each boat
Evenly over the period the boats are held by the dealer
ex:
Barcha indikatorlar control Uchquduq Co'da qolganini ko'rsatadi: jarimasiz qaytarish huquqi, Uchquduq amalda qaytarib oladi, sug'urta Uchquduq'da, narx uchinchi shaxsga sotilgan kundagi narx (narx riski Uchquduq'da). Bu — consignment.
Uchquduq inventory'ni SOFP'da saqlaydi va revenue'ni dealer tovarni oxirgi mijozga sotganda tan oladi.

q:
On 1 October 20X5 Forish Co sold a generator to a customer together with 12 months' storage of the generator in Forish Co's warehouse, for a total price of $1,030,000. At the customer's request, the generator is kept in a separate, labelled bay, is ready for delivery at any time and cannot be used or sold by Forish Co. The stand-alone selling prices are $1,000,000 for the generator and $60,000 for 12 months' storage, which is considered significant.
What revenue should Forish Co recognise for the year ended 31 December 20X5?
Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Bill-and-hold shartlari bajarilgan → generator bo'yicha control 1-oktabrda mijozga o'tgan.
Storage — alohida PO (significant), over time.
Jami SSP = 1,060,000. Generator: 1,030,000 × 1,000,000/1,060,000 = 971,698.11. Storage: 1,030,000 × 60,000/1,060,000 = 58,301.89; 3/12 qismi = 14,575.47.
Revenue = 971,698.11 + 14,575.47 = $986,274.

q: In a bill-and-hold arrangement, revenue can be recognised even though the seller still has physical possession of the goods, provided the customer has obtained control of them.
ex: To'g'ri. Physical possession — control indikatorlaridan faqat bittasi. Bill-and-hold shartlari bajarilsa (mijoz so'ragan, tovar identifikatsiya qilingan, tayyor, sotuvchi ishlata olmaydi), control mijozga o'tgan va revenue tan olinadi.

q:
Kattakurgan Co supplies tractors to a dealer. The dealer insures and maintains the tractors, may use them as demonstration models, and pays Kattakurgan Co the price applying at the date of delivery. Unsold tractors must be bought by the dealer after 60 days. Both parties have a right of return within 60 days, but neither has ever used it in practice.
When should Kattakurgan Co recognise revenue for the tractors?
opt: When the dealer sells each tractor to a farmer
When the tractors are delivered to the dealer
When the 60-day period expires
When the dealer pays for each tractor
ex:
Control indikatorlari dealer'da: sug'urta va ta'mirlash xarajatlari, demo sifatida ishlatish, narx yetkazib berilgan kundagi narx (narx o'zgarishi riski dealer'da), 60 kundan keyin majburiy xarid. Qaytarish huquqi amalda ishlatilmaydi — substance bo'yicha e'tiborsiz.
Demak tractorlar dealer'ning aktivi; Kattakurgan revenue'ni yetkazib berganda tan oladi.

q:
On 28 December 20X5 Pop Co sold 1,000 units of a product at $150 each (cost $90 each). Customers may return unused units within 30 days for a full refund. Based on experience, Pop Co expects 4% of the units to be returned.
What revenue should Pop Co recognise for this sale in the year ended 31 December 20X5?
Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Right of return — variable consideration. Revenue faqat qaytarilmasligi kutilgan tovarlar uchun: 1,000 × 96% = 960 dona × 150 = $144,000.
Qaytarilishi kutilgan 40 dona × 150 = 6,000 → refund liability.
Qaytarib olish huquqi uchun aktiv: 40 × 90 = 3,600 (cost of sales kamayadi).

q:
Gazli Co sells televisions with a standard one-year warranty that covers manufacturing defects. Customers can also choose to buy a separately priced three-year extended warranty.
How should Gazli Co account for the extended warranty?
opt: As a provision under IAS 37, with the full price recognised as revenue at the point of sale
As revenue at the point of sale, because the television has been delivered
As a contingent liability disclosed in the notes
As a separate performance obligation, with revenue recognised over the extended warranty period
ex:
Mijoz alohida sotib oladigan (yoki spetsifikatsiyadan tashqari xizmat beradigan) warranty — service-type warranty → alohida performance obligation; transaction price'ning ulushi contract liability sifatida kechiktiriladi va warranty davri davomida revenue'ga o'tkaziladi.
Standart 1 yillik warranty esa assurance-type → IAS 37 bo'yicha provision.

q:
During the year Beruniy Co repaired faulty machines under its standard (assurance-type) warranty. It used replacement parts that cost $45,000 and would normally sell for $60,000. No warranty provision had been made.
How should the repair be reflected in Beruniy Co's statement of profit or loss?
opt: Cost of sales includes $45,000; no revenue is recognised
Revenue of $45,000 and cost of sales of $45,000
Cost of sales is reduced by $45,000
Revenue of $60,000 and cost of sales of $45,000
ex:
Assurance-type warranty bo'yicha ta'mirlash — sotuv emas, balki avvalgi sotuvni bajarish xarajati. Revenue tan olinmaydi (na $60,000, na $45,000).
Ishlatilgan ehtiyot qismlar tannarxi $45,000 cost of sales'ga kiradi (inventory'dan chiqariladi). Provision bo'lganida u ishlatilgan bo'lardi.

q:
On 1 January 20X5 Muynoq Co won a three-year service contract. It paid a sales agent a commission of $24,000, payable only because the contract was won, and incurred legal fees of $5,000 during negotiations that would have been payable whether or not the contract was won. Muynoq Co expects to recover these costs through the contract fees.
What is the carrying amount of the contract cost asset at 31 December 20X5?
Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Faqat incremental costs of obtaining a contract (shartnoma yutilmasa bo'lmaydigan) va qoplanishi kutilgan xarajatlar aktiv sifatida kapitallashtiriladi → komissiya 24,000.
Legal fees — shartnoma yutilmasa ham to'lanardi → incremental emas → darhol xarajat.
Aktiv shartnoma davomida amortizatsiya: 24,000/3 = 8,000 yiliga.
31-dek 20X5 carrying amount = 24,000 − 8,000 = $16,000.

q: For a sale with a right of return, IFRS 15 requires revenue to be recognised for all goods transferred, with a separate expense for expected returns.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Revenue faqat qaytarilmasligi kutilgan tovarlar uchun tan olinadi. Qaytarilishi kutilganlar uchun refund liability (revenue o'rniga) va mijozdan tovarni qaytarib olish huquqi uchun aktiv (cost'da, recovery xarajatlari ayirilgan holda) tan olinadi.

q: Under IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers, as applied in the FR exam, how should costs incurred to fulfil a contract with a customer, such as site labour and materials on a construction contract, be treated?
opt: Deducted from the transaction price
Capitalised as an intangible asset and amortised over the contract
Expensed to profit or loss as they are incurred
Deferred until the contract is complete and then expensed
ex: FR imtihoni uchun: shartnomani bajarish (fulfil) xarajatlari yuzaga kelganda cost of sales'ga (P/L) olib boriladi. Faqat incremental costs of obtaining (masalan, sotuv komissiyasi) qoplanishi kutilsa aktiv sifatida tan olinadi.

q:
Sayxun Co is an agent collecting ticket money for a theatre company. It collected $500,000 from customers and is entitled to 8% commission. It has not yet paid the theatre company.
What is the correct entry to record the receipt of cash?
opt: Dr Cash $500,000; Cr Revenue $500,000
Dr Cash $500,000; Cr Revenue $40,000; Cr Trade payables $460,000
Dr Cash $500,000; Cr Revenue $500,000; Dr Cost of sales $460,000; Cr Trade payables $460,000
Dr Cash $40,000; Cr Revenue $40,000
ex:
Agent: Dr Cash 500,000 (to'liq summa olindi); Cr Revenue 500,000 × 8% = 40,000 (komissiya); Cr Trade payables 460,000 (teatrga to'lanadigan qarz).
Gross summani revenue sifatida yozish yoki farqni cost of sales'ga qo'yish — principal'ga xos va noto'g'ri.

q:
Sirdaryo Co prepares financial statements to 31 December 20X6. The following transactions are relevant:
(i) On 1 March 20X6 Sirdaryo Co started a contract to build a factory for a customer, satisfied over time, for a price of $24m. At 31 December 20X6 costs incurred were $9m and estimated costs to complete were $6m. Progress is measured by work certified, which was $14.4m at 31 December 20X6. The customer has been invoiced and has paid $12m.
(ii) On 1 October 20X6 Sirdaryo Co sold a machine with a two-year service agreement for $2.1m, received in full on that date. The stand-alone selling prices are $1.95m for the machine and $0.35m for the two-year service.
(iii) Sirdaryo Co collected $3m from customers for goods sold on behalf of a supplier, for which it earns 5% commission. The supplier delivers the goods directly to the customers.

What gross profit should Sirdaryo Co recognise on contract (i) for the year ended 31 December 20X6?
Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Umumiy: 24 − 9 − 6 = 9m foyda.
Progress (output) = 14.4/24 = 60% → revenue = 14.4m.
Cost of sales = costs to date 9m.
Gross profit = 14.4 − 9 = 5.4m = $5,400,000.

What contract asset or contract liability should be recognised for contract (i) at 31 December 20X6? Enter a contract asset as a positive figure and a contract liability as a negative figure.
Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex: Revenue to date 14.4m − invoiced to date 12m = 2.4m musbat → contract asset $2,400,000 (current assets).

If, at 31 December 20X6, Sirdaryo Co had been unable to measure the progress of contract (i) but expected to recover all costs incurred, it would recognise revenue of $9m for the contract.
ex: To'g'ri. Progress o'lchab bo'lmasa, revenue qoplanadigan xarajatlar darajasida tan olinadi: revenue = costs incurred $9m, cost of sales $9m, foyda nol.

q:
Yangiyer Co prepares financial statements to 31 March 20X7. The following transactions are relevant:
(i) On 1 April 20X6 Yangiyer Co delivered goods to a customer, who obtained control on that date. The customer will pay $4,840,000 on 31 March 20X8. The customer could borrow at 10% per annum.
(ii) On 1 October 20X6 Yangiyer Co sold inventory which cost $1.2m to a bank for $2m, its obligation being to repurchase the inventory on 30 September 20X8 for $2.42m. This reflects an effective interest rate of 10% per annum. Yangiyer Co continues to store the inventory.
(iii) Yangiyer Co has a contract to build a school, satisfied over time, for a price of $6m. At 31 March 20X7 costs incurred were $4.2m and estimated costs to complete were $2.8m. Progress is measured on a cost basis.

What is the total income (revenue plus any finance income) that Yangiyer Co should recognise in profit or loss from transaction (i) for the year ended 31 March 20X7?
Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Significant financing component (2 yil). Revenue = 4,840,000 / 1.10² = 4,000,000.
Finance income 20X7 = 4,000,000 × 10% = 400,000.
Jami = 4,400,000 = $4,400,000.

q:

opt: Revenue of $2m and cost of sales of $1.2m are recognised
The transaction is treated as a lease under IFRS 16
A profit of $0.8m is recognised and the repurchase obligation disclosed
Inventory remains in the statement of financial position and $2m is recognised as a loan

Yangiyer Co prepares financial statements to 31 March 20X7. The following transactions are relevant:
(i) On 1 April 20X6 Yangiyer Co delivered goods to a customer, who obtained control on that date. The customer will pay $4,840,000 on 31 March 20X8. The customer could borrow at 10% per annum.
(ii) On 1 October 20X6 Yangiyer Co sold inventory which cost $1.2m to a bank for $2m, its obligation being to repurchase the inventory on 30 September 20X8 for $2.42m. This reflects an effective interest rate of 10% per annum. Yangiyer Co continues to store the inventory.
(iii) Yangiyer Co has a contract to build a school, satisfied over time, for a price of $6m. At 31 March 20X7 costs incurred were $4.2m and estimated costs to complete were $2.8m. Progress is measured on a cost basis.

Which THREE of the following statements about contract (iii) are correct for the year ended 31 March 20X7?
opt: Revenue of $3.6m is recognised
The full expected loss of $1m is recognised in profit or loss
Cost of sales is $4.2m
A provision is presented within current liabilities
Only the $0.6m loss on work performed to date is recognised
ex:
Revenue = 6,000 × 60% = 3,600 ($3.6m) — to'g'ri.
Butun kutilgan zarar $1m darhol tan olinadi — to'g'ri.
Cost of sales = 4,200 + provision 400 = 4,600 ($4.6m), $4.2m emas.
Provision — current liabilities'da ko'rsatiladi — to'g'ri.
Faqat $0.6m zarar tan olish — noto'g'ri (butun zarar tan olinadi).

q: Under IAS 12 Income Taxes, what does the current tax liability in the statement of financial position at the reporting date normally represent?
opt: The estimated tax payable on the taxable profit of the current year
The current year estimate plus any under-provision relating to the previous year
The total income tax expense shown in the statement of profit or loss
The current year estimate plus the closing deferred tax balance
ex: SFP'dagi current tax liability = faqat joriy yil taxable profit bo'yicha hisoblangan tax estimate. O'tgan yilning under/over-provision'i faqat P/L'dagi tax expense'ga ta'sir qiladi — liability'ga emas (o'tgan yil hisobi allaqachon to'langan). Income tax expense esa current tax + under/(over) provision + deferred tax movement'dan iborat, shuning uchun u liability'ga teng bo'lmaydi. Deferred tax alohida — non-current liability sifatida ko'rsatiladi.

q: Under IAS 12, the current tax charge for a year is calculated by applying the tax rate to the accounting profit before tax reported in the statement of profit or loss.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Current tax taxable profit (soliq hisob-kitobidagi foyda) × tax rate bo'yicha hisoblanadi, accounting profit bo'yicha emas. Ikki foyda o'rtasida permanent (masalan, disallowed entertaining) va temporary (masalan, depreciation va capital allowances farqi) farqlar bo'ladi. Aynan temporary farqlar deferred tax'ni keltirib chiqaradi.

q: Bekobod Co has estimated its income tax on the profits of the current year. Which double entry records this estimate?
opt: Dr Deferred tax (non-current liabilities); Cr Current tax payable (current liabilities)
Dr Retained earnings (equity); Cr Current tax payable (current liabilities)
Dr Current tax payable (current liabilities); Cr Income tax expense (profit or loss)
Dr Income tax expense (profit or loss); Cr Current tax payable (current liabilities)
ex: Joriy yil soliq taxmini — bu xarajat va majburiyat: Dr Income tax expense (P/L) / Cr Current tax payable (current liabilities). Soliq to'g'ridan-to'g'ri retained earnings'ga yozilmaydi (dividend emas). Deferred tax hisobi bu yozuvda ishtirok etmaydi — u faqat temporary differences movement'i uchun.

q: Which of the following statements about IAS 12 Income Taxes are correct?
opt: The income tax expense in profit or loss comprises current tax and deferred tax
Deferred tax liabilities are discounted to their present value
Deferred tax relating to an item recognised in other comprehensive income is also recognised in other comprehensive income
A current tax liability is presented within current liabilities
A deferred tax liability is presented within current liabilities
ex:
To'g'ri: (1) P/L'dagi tax expense = current tax + deferred tax (P/L qismi); (2) OCI'da tan olingan item'ga (masalan, revaluation gain) tegishli deferred tax ham OCI'da tan olinadi; (3) current tax liability — current liabilities'da.
Noto'g'ri: IAS 12 deferred tax'ni discount qilishni taqiqlaydi; deferred tax liability non-current liabilities'da ko'rsatiladi.

q:
Denov Co's tax computation for the year ended 31 December 20X7 shows taxable profit of $736,000. Its accounting profit before tax was $812,000. The income tax rate is 25%. There are no prior-year adjustments.
What is the current tax liability at 31 December 20X7? Enter in $, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Current tax taxable profit asosida hisoblanadi: $736,000 × 25% = $184,000.
Accounting profit ($812,000) ishlatilmaydi — farq permanent/temporary differences'dan kelib chiqadi.

q:
Andijon Co estimated its income tax for the year ended 30 June 20X6 at $142,000. The amount finally agreed with and paid to the tax authority for that year was $151,500. The estimated income tax on profits for the year ended 30 June 20X7 is $167,000. There is no deferred tax.
What is the income tax expense in the statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 June 20X7? Enter in $.
ex:
20X6 uchun to'langan summa taxmindan ko'p → under-provision = $151,500 − $142,000 = $9,500. Under-provision joriy yil xarajatini oshiradi.
Tax expense = joriy yil estimate $167,000 + under-provision $9,500 = $176,500.
SFP'dagi liability esa faqat $167,000 bo'ladi.

q:
Buxoro Co's trial balance at 31 December 20X5 includes a credit balance of $6,200 on the income tax account, which relates to the settlement of the previous year's tax. The current tax estimate for 20X5 is $58,000. There is no deferred tax.
What amounts will be shown for income tax in the statement of profit or loss and the statement of financial position?
opt: Expense $64,200; Liability $58,000
Expense $51,800; Liability $58,000
Expense $58,000; Liability $51,800
Expense $51,800; Liability $51,800
ex:
Income tax hisobidagi credit qoldiq = o'tgan yil over-provision (taxmin to'langandan ko'p bo'lgan). U joriy yil xarajatini kamaytiradi.
Expense = $58,000 − $6,200 = $51,800.
Liability = faqat joriy yil estimate = $58,000. Over-provision liability'ga ta'sir qilmaydi — trial balance'dagi qoldiq P/L'ga o'tkazilib, yopiladi.

q: An under-provision of income tax relating to the previous year increases the current tax liability shown in the statement of financial position at the current year end.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Under-provision faqat joriy yil income tax expense'ni oshiradi. O'tgan yil soliq hisobi to'lab bo'lingan, trial balance'dagi debit qoldiq P/L'ga o'tkaziladi. Yil oxiridagi current tax liability = faqat joriy yil taxmini.

q: Chirchiq Co's trial balance shows a debit balance of $3,400 on the income tax account after the previous year's tax liability was settled. How should this balance be treated in the current year's financial statements?
opt: It is an over-provision and is deducted from the current year's income tax expense
It is a current asset (tax recoverable) in the statement of financial position
It is an under-provision and is added to the current year's income tax expense
It is added to the current tax liability in the statement of financial position
ex: Tax hisobida yil davomida faqat ikki yozuv bo'ladi: b/f liability (credit) va to'lov (debit). To'lov taxmindan ko'p bo'lsa, debit qoldiq qoladi = under-provision. U P/L'ga xarajat sifatida o'tkaziladi (tax expense oshadi). Bu asset ham, liability ham emas.

q:
Navoiy Co's income tax estimates and settlements were as follows:
YearEstimate at year end ($)Amount paid in settlement ($)
20X130,00028,400
20X236,00037,100
20X333,000not yet paid
What is the income tax expense for 20X3? There is no deferred tax.
ex:
20X3 xarajatiga faqat 20X2 hisobining farqi ta'sir qiladi (20X1 farqi 20X2 xarajatida allaqachon hisobga olingan).
20X2: to'langan $37,100 − taxmin $36,000 = $1,100 under-provision → xarajatni oshiradi.
Tax expense 20X3 = $33,000 + $1,100 = $34,100.
20X1 over-provision'ini ($1,600) qayta qo'shish — xato.

q:
Qarshi Co had a current tax liability of $88,000 at 31 March 20X4. During the year ended 31 March 20X5 it paid $81,300 in full and final settlement of that liability. The estimated tax on profits for the year ended 31 March 20X5 is $95,000. The deferred tax balance did not change.
What is the income tax expense for the year ended 31 March 20X5? Enter in $.
ex:
O'tgan yil: taxmin $88,000, to'langan $81,300 → over-provision $6,700 (xarajatni kamaytiradi).
Tax expense = $95,000 − $6,700 = $88,300.

q: Which of the following best describes an over-provision of income tax?
opt: The tax finally agreed and paid for a prior year was more than the liability estimated for that year
The current year tax estimate is higher than the deferred tax liability
The tax finally agreed and paid for a prior year was less than the liability estimated for that year
The deferred tax liability exceeds the temporary differences multiplied by the tax rate
ex: Over-provision = o'tgan yil uchun liability ortiqcha taxmin qilingan: to'langan summa taxmindan kam. Trial balance'da credit qoldiq qoladi va u joriy yil tax expense'ni kamaytiradi. Aksincha holat (to'lov taxmindan ko'p) — under-provision.

q: Which of the following gives rise to a permanent difference between accounting profit and taxable profit?
opt: Tax allowances on plant that are given faster than accounting depreciation
Client entertaining expenses that are never deductible for tax purposes
A warranty provision whose costs are deductible for tax only when claims are paid
A revaluation gain on land where the tax base remains at original cost
ex:
Permanent difference — item hech qachon soliq uchun hisobga olinmaydi (disallowed), masalan, entertaining, jarimalar. U kelajakda qaytmaydi, shuning uchun deferred tax yaratmaydi.
Qolgan uchtasi temporary differences: accelerated capital allowances (DTL), warranty provision (DTA), revaluation (DTL) — ular turli davrlarda tan olinadi, lekin oxir-oqibat qaytadi.

q: Which of the following give rise to temporary differences under IAS 12?
opt: Tax allowances on machinery that exceed the accounting depreciation charged
Fines and penalties which are never deductible for tax purposes
A warranty provision where costs are deductible for tax only when paid
The revaluation of a property whose tax base is unaffected by the revaluation
Client entertaining costs disallowed by the tax authority
ex:
Temporary difference = aktiv yoki majburiyatning carrying amount'i va tax base'i o'rtasidagi farq, ya'ni bir xil summa soliq va buxgalteriya uchun turli davrlarda tan olinadi.
To'g'ri: accelerated tax allowances (CA > tax base → DTL); warranty provision cash asosida chegiriladi (liability tax base = 0 → DTA); revaluation (CA oshadi, tax base o'zgarmaydi → DTL).
Jarimalar va entertaining — hech qachon chegirilmaydi → permanent, deferred tax yo'q.

q: Deferred tax is recognised on permanent differences because they affect the tax charge of the current period.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Permanent differences (masalan, disallowed entertaining) hech qachon qaytmaydi, ular faqat joriy yilning current tax'iga ta'sir qiladi. Deferred tax faqat temporary differences (carrying amount va tax base farqi) bo'yicha tan olinadi.

q:
Jizzax Co reported accounting profit before tax of $500,000 for the year. This is after charging depreciation of $90,000 and client entertaining of $20,000, which is not deductible for tax. Tax allowances on non-current assets for the year were $130,000. There are no other differences.
What is Jizzax Co's taxable profit?
ex:
Taxable profit'ga o'tish (tax computation):
Accounting profit $500,000
+ disallowed entertaining $20,000 (permanent — qaytarib qo'shiladi)
+ depreciation $90,000 (soliqda chegirilmaydi, qo'shiladi)
− tax allowances $130,000 (uning o'rniga chegiriladi)
= $480,000.

q: Which of the following are valid reasons for recognising deferred tax in the financial statements?
opt: It applies the accruals concept by matching tax effects to the periods in which the related income and expenses are recognised
Ignoring deferred tax liabilities could overstate profit and lead to over-optimistic dividend payments
It makes the income tax expense equal to the tax cash paid in the year
Ignoring deferred tax could distort earnings per share and the price/earnings ratio
It reduces the amount of tax payable to the tax authority
ex:
Study Text sabablari: (1) accruals concept — soliq oqibati tegishli davrga moslanadi; (2) deferred tax'ni tan olmaslik foydani oshirib ko'rsatadi → haddan tashqari optimistik dividend to'lovlari; (3) EPS va P/E ratio buziladi, aksiyadorlar chalg'itiladi.
Noto'g'ri: deferred tax tax expense'ni to'langan pulga tenglashtirmaydi (aksincha, accruals'ga moslaydi) va soliq organiga to'lanadigan summani o'zgartirmaydi — bu faqat buxgalteriya yozuvi.

q: IAS 12 defines temporary differences as differences between which two amounts?
opt: The carrying amount of an asset or liability in the statement of financial position and its tax base
Accounting profit before tax and taxable profit for the period
The current tax estimate and the amount of tax finally paid
The fair value of an asset and its original cost
ex:
IAS 12 para 5: temporary differences = aktiv/majburiyatning SFP'dagi carrying amount'i va uning tax base'i o'rtasidagi farq. Tax base — soliq maqsadlari uchun shu aktiv/majburiyatga berilgan summa (masalan, cost − berilgan tax allowances = tax written down value).
Accounting va taxable profit farqi permanent ham bo'lishi mumkin; estimate va to'lov farqi — under/over-provision.

q:
Guliston Co owns a machine that cost $600,000. Accumulated accounting depreciation to date is $150,000, while tax allowances claimed to date total $270,000. The tax rate is 25%.
What is the deferred tax liability relating to the machine? Enter in $.
When does a taxable temporary difference (giving rise to a deferred tax liability) arise in respect of an asset?
opt: When the tax base of the asset is greater than its carrying amount
When accounting profit exceeds taxable profit because of disallowed expenses
When the carrying amount of the asset is greater than its tax base
When the asset is carried at historical cost rather than at a revalued amount
ex:
Aktiv uchun: CA > tax base → kelajakda aktivdan olinadigan foyda soliq uchun kamroq chegirishga ega → kelajakda ko'proq soliq → taxable temporary difference → DTL.
Tax base > CA bo'lsa — deductible temporary difference (DTA). Disallowed expenses — permanent difference.

q: Olmaliq Co has recognised a warranty provision of $40,000. Warranty costs are deductible for tax only when claims are paid. The tax base of this provision is nil.
ex: To'g'ri. Majburiyatning tax base'i = carrying amount − kelajakda soliqda chegiriladigan summa = $40,000 − $40,000 = nil. Majburiyatda CA ($40,000) > tax base (0) → deductible temporary difference → deferred tax asset.

q:
At 31 December 20X8 the carrying amount of Karmana Co's net assets is $18,600,000 and their tax base is $13,800,000. All differences are taxable temporary differences. The income tax rate is 20%.
What deferred tax liability should be shown in the statement of financial position? Enter in $000.
ex:
Temporary difference = $18,600k − $13,800k = $4,800k
DTL = $4,800k × 20% = $960k.
SFP'da yil oxiridagi to'liq balans ko'rsatiladi (movement emas).

q:
The following information relates to Nurota Co at 31 December 20X6:
Carrying amount ($)Tax base ($)
Plant245,000185,000
Land (revalued in the year; original cost $330,000)410,000330,000
The tax rate is 25%. The land had not been revalued before.
What deferred tax liability and revaluation surplus should Nurota Co report?
opt: Deferred tax liability $15,000; Revaluation surplus $80,000
Deferred tax liability $35,000; Revaluation surplus $80,000
Deferred tax liability $20,000; Revaluation surplus $60,000
Deferred tax liability $35,000; Revaluation surplus $60,000

q:
Muborak Co has accrued interest receivable of $30,000 in its statement of financial position at the year end. The interest will be taxed only when it is received in cash. The tax rate is 20%.
What is the deferred tax consequence?
opt: A deferred tax asset of $6,000
A deferred tax liability of $6,000
No deferred tax arises because the interest has not been received
A deferred tax liability of $30,000
ex:
Interest receivable (aktiv): CA $30,000, tax base = nil (soliq faqat pul kelganda — kelajakda to'liq soliqqa tortiladi).
Aktivda CA > tax base → taxable temporary difference $30,000 → DTL = $30,000 × 20% = $6,000.

q:
Beruniy Co bought equipment on 1 January 20X5 for $400,000. It is depreciated straight-line over 5 years with no residual value. Tax allowances are 40% of cost in the year of acquisition and 25% per annum on a reducing balance basis thereafter. The tax rate is 30%.
What is the deferred tax liability relating to the equipment at 31 December 20X6? Enter in $.

Beruniy Co bought equipment on 1 January 20X5 for $400,000. It is depreciated straight-line over 5 years with no residual value. Tax allowances are 40% of cost in the year of acquisition and 25% per annum on a reducing balance basis thereafter. The tax rate is 30%.
What is the deferred tax effect in profit or loss for the year ended 31 December 20X6?
opt: A credit of $18,000
A charge of $6,000
A charge of $18,000
A credit of $6,000
ex:
31.12.X5: CA $320,000 − tax base $240,000 = TD $80,000 → DTL $24,000
31.12.X6: CA $240,000 − tax base $180,000 = TD $60,000 → DTL $18,000
DTL kamaydi $6,000 ga → Dr Deferred tax (SFP) / Cr Income tax expense → P/L'da credit $6,000.
P/L'ga yil oxiridagi balans emas, movement o'tadi.

q: Where tax allowances on plant are given faster than the accounting depreciation, a deferred tax liability arises.
ex: To'g'ri. Accelerated capital allowances → tax base (tax WDV) carrying amount'dan tezroq kamayadi → CA > tax base → taxable temporary difference → DTL. Bu imtihonda eng ko'p uchraydigan temporary difference.

q: Paxtakor Co's deferred tax liability relating to accelerated capital allowances has increased during the year. Which double entry records the increase?
opt: Dr Deferred tax liability; Cr Income tax expense (profit or loss)
Dr Income tax expense (profit or loss); Cr Deferred tax liability
Dr Other comprehensive income; Cr Deferred tax liability
Dr Income tax expense (profit or loss); Cr Current tax payable
ex: DTL oshishi (capital allowances bilan bog'liq, ya'ni P/L item) → Dr Income tax expense / Cr Deferred tax liability. OCI faqat revaluation kabi OCI'dagi item'larga tegishli deferred tax uchun ishlatiladi. Current tax payable — faqat joriy yil soliq taxmini uchun.

q:
Urganch Co's trial balance at 30 September 20X7 includes ($000):
Income tax (credit balance — over-provision for the previous year)350
Deferred tax at 1 October 20X6 (credit)4,250
The current tax estimate for the year is $7,800,000. At 30 September 20X7 the carrying amount of property, plant and equipment is $62,400,000 and its tax base is $44,900,000. The tax rate is 25% and all deferred tax movements go to profit or loss.
What is the income tax expense for the year? Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Deferred tax: yopilish = ($62,400k − $44,900k) × 25% = $17,500k × 25% = $4,375k; ochilish $4,250k → oshish $125k.
Tax expense = estimate $7,800k − over-provision $350k + DT oshishi $125k = $7,575k.

q:
Kattaqo'rg'on Co bought its only item of plant at the start of year 1. Profit before tax for year 1 is $800,000, after charging depreciation of $150,000. Tax allowances on the plant for year 1 are $210,000. There are no other differences between accounting and taxable profit. The tax rate is 20%.
What is the total income tax expense for year 1, accounting for deferred tax?
ex:
Taxable profit = $800,000 + $150,000 − $210,000 = $740,000 → current tax = × 20% = $148,000.
Temporary difference = allowances $210,000 − depreciation $150,000 = $60,000 → DTL oshishi = $12,000.
Tax expense = $148,000 + $12,000 = $160,000 = $800,000 × 20%. Faqat temporary differences bo'lsa, deferred tax tax expense'ni accounting profit × tax rate'ga moslaydi (accruals).

q: How does IAS 12 require deferred tax liabilities to be measured?
opt: Using tax rates enacted or substantively enacted by the reporting date, without discounting
Using tax rates the directors expect to be enacted in future, without discounting
Only for the portion of the temporary difference expected to reverse within 12 months
Using the current year's tax rate, discounted to present value
ex: IAS 12: deferred tax aktiv/majburiyat realizatsiya qilinadigan davrda amal qiladigan, reporting date'gacha qabul qilingan (enacted) yoki amalda qabul qilingan (substantively enacted) stavkalar bilan o'lchanadi. DTL to'liq (full provision) tan olinadi va discount qilinmaydi.

q:
Yangiyer Co has recognised a warranty provision of $90,000 for the first time at 31 December 20X4. Warranty costs are deductible for tax only when paid. Sufficient future taxable profits are expected. The tax rate is 20%.
Which entry records the deferred tax?
opt: Dr Income tax expense $18,000; Cr Deferred tax liability $18,000
Dr Deferred tax asset $18,000; Cr Income tax expense $18,000
Dr Deferred tax asset $90,000; Cr Income tax expense $90,000
Dr Deferred tax asset $18,000; Cr Other comprehensive income $18,000
ex:
Provision (liability) CA $90,000, tax base nil → deductible temporary difference $90,000 → kelajakda soliq kamayadi → DTA = $90,000 × 20% = $18,000.
Warranty xarajati P/L'da bo'lgani uchun DT ham P/L'ga: Dr DTA / Cr Income tax expense $18,000.

q: Shahrisabz Co has unused tax losses which it can carry forward against future taxable profits. Which of the following statements are correct under IAS 12?
opt: A deferred tax asset is recognised only to the extent that it is probable that future taxable profits will be available
A history of recent losses should make management sceptical about forecasts of future profits
The deferred tax asset is measured as the losses expected to be utilised multiplied by the tax rate
A deferred tax asset must always be recognised for the full amount of the losses
The deferred tax asset is always recognised in other comprehensive income
ex:
To'g'ri: (1) DTA faqat kelajakda taxable profit bo'lishi ehtimoli yuqori (probable) bo'lgan darajada tan olinadi (IAS 12 para 34 printsipi); (2) zarar ko'rgan tarixi bor kompaniyaning kelajak prognozlariga skeptik bo'lish kerak; (3) DTA = foydalaniladigan zarar × tax rate.
Noto'g'ri: DTA har doim to'liq tan olinmaydi; tax losses'ga oid DTA P/L orqali tan olinadi (OCI emas).

q: A deductible temporary difference arises when the tax base of an asset exceeds its carrying amount.
ex: To'g'ri. Aktivda tax base > CA → kelajakda soliq uchun ko'proq chegiriladi → kelajakdagi soliq kamayadi → deductible temporary difference → DTA. Majburiyat uchun esa: tax base CA'dan kichik bo'lsa deductible (masalan, warranty provision).

q:
Kokand Co has unused tax losses of $2,400,000 at 31 December 20X9. Based on convincing evidence, management expects that only $1,500,000 of these losses will be used against future taxable profits. The tax rate is 25%.
What deferred tax asset should be recognised? Enter in $000.
ex:
DTA faqat foydalanish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan zararlar bo'yicha: $1,500k × 25% = $375k.
To'liq $2,400k × 25% = $600k — noto'g'ri, chunki $900k ishlatilishi kutilmaydi.

q: Which of the following would normally give rise to a deferred tax asset?
opt: Tax allowances on equipment given faster than accounting depreciation
A revaluation gain on a property where the tax base is unchanged
A warranty provision where the costs are deductible for tax only when paid
Interest receivable accrued in the accounts but taxed only when received
ex:
Warranty provision (liability): CA > tax base (nil) → deductible TD → DTA.
Qolganlari DTL: accelerated allowances (aktiv CA > tax base), revaluation (CA oshadi), interest receivable (aktiv CA > tax base nil).

q: Which of the following would normally give rise to a deferred tax asset under IAS 12?
opt: A warranty provision deductible for tax only when claims are paid
Unused tax losses carried forward where future taxable profits are probable
Accelerated capital allowances on plant
An asset whose tax base exceeds its carrying amount
A gain on revaluation of land
ex:
DTA manbalari: liability'da CA > tax base (warranty provision), aktivda tax base > CA, va foydalanish ehtimoli bor tax losses.
Accelerated capital allowances va revaluation gain — DTL.

q: Where is the deferred tax arising on an upward revaluation of property recognised?
opt: In other comprehensive income, reducing the revaluation surplus
Directly in retained earnings
In profit or loss as part of the income tax expense
It is not recognised unless the property is expected to be sold
ex: IAS 12: deferred tax tegishli item qayerda tan olingan bo'lsa, o'sha yerda tan olinadi. Revaluation gain → OCI → uning deferred tax'i ham OCI'da (Dr Revaluation surplus/OCI, Cr DTL). Sotish niyati bo'lmasa ham DT tan olinadi.

q:
Angren Co revalued its head office building on 1 January 20X8 from a carrying amount of $3,600,000 to its fair value of $5,000,000. The tax base of the building is unaffected by the revaluation. The tax rate is 20%.
What net revaluation gain (after deferred tax) will be reported in other comprehensive income for 20X8? Enter in $000.
ex:
Revaluation gain = $5,000k − $3,600k = $1,400k
Deferred tax = $1,400k × 20% = $280k (OCI'da)
Net OCI gain = $1,400k − $280k = $1,120k.

q: Deferred tax should not be recognised on a revaluation gain if the entity has no intention of selling the revalued asset.
ex: Noto'g'ri. Study Text: deferred tax revaluation gain'da sotish niyati bo'lmasa ham (va rollover relief mavjud bo'lsa ham) tan olinadi. Aktiv ishlatish orqali ham qiymat realizatsiya qilinadi — CA tax base'dan katta, demak taxable temporary difference bor.

q:
Oqtosh Co's trial balance at 30 June 20X5 shows a credit of $2,500 on the income tax account (over-provision for the prior year) and a deferred tax balance of $21,000. The current tax estimate for the year is $40,000. The deferred tax balance must be increased to $34,500, which includes the effect of a $30,000 gain on revaluing a property for the first time this year. The tax rate is 25%.
What is the income tax expense in profit or loss?
ex:
DT oshishi = $34,500 − $21,000 = $13,500.
Shundan revaluation'ga tegishli qismi = $30,000 × 25% = $7,500 → OCI'ga.
P/L'ga = $13,500 − $7,500 = $6,000.
Tax expense = $40,000 − $2,500 + $6,000 = $43,500.
Butun oshishni P/L'ga olish yoki over-provision'ni qo'shish — tipik xatolar.

q: Zarafshon Co revalues its land upwards for the first time. The tax base of the land remains its original cost. Which of the following statements are correct?
opt: The tax base of the land is unaffected by the revaluation
The deferred tax on the revaluation reduces the revaluation surplus
The deferred tax on the revaluation increases the income tax expense in profit or loss
The deferred tax on the revaluation is presented in other comprehensive income
The revaluation creates a deductible temporary difference
ex:
To'g'ri: revaluation tax base'ga ta'sir qilmaydi; DT revaluation surplus'ni kamaytiradi (surplus net ko'rsatiladi); DT OCI'da ko'rsatiladi.
Noto'g'ri: DT P/L'dagi income tax expense'ga kirmaydi; CA > tax base bo'lgani uchun bu taxable (DTL), deductible emas.

q:
On 1 April 20X4 Xiva Co revalued a property with a cost of $60,000,000 and accumulated depreciation of $18,000,000 to $51,000,000. This was its first revaluation, and the tax base is unaffected. At 31 March 20X5 other taxable temporary differences (excluding the property revaluation) are $14,000,000. Assume the temporary difference arising from the revaluation is still equal to the revaluation gain at 31 March 20X5. The tax rate is 25%.
What is the deferred tax liability at 31 March 20X5? Enter in $000, to the nearest whole number.
ex:
Revaluation gain = $51,000k − ($60,000k − $18,000k) = $51,000k − $42,000k = $9,000k.
Jami temporary differences = $14,000k + $9,000k = $23,000k.
DTL = $23,000k × 25% = $5,750k ($5,750k ichida $2,250k OCI orqali tan olinadi).

Within non-current liabilities
Within equity, as a separate reserve
Deducted from the carrying amount of property, plant and equipment
ex: Deferred tax — uzoq muddatli majburiyat, non-current liabilities'da alohida ko'rsatiladi. Current tax payable bilan qo'shilmaydi, aktiv qiymatidan ayirilmaydi va equity reserve emas.

q:
Chimboy Co's trial balance at 31 March 20X6 includes: income tax $900,000 debit (relating to the previous year) and deferred tax $5,600,000 credit. The current tax estimate is $4,200,000. At 31 March 20X6 the tax base of the net assets is $26,000,000 lower than their carrying amount. The tax rate is 20%.
What is the income tax expense for the year?
ex:
DT yopilish = $26,000k × 20% = $5,200k; ochilish $5,600k → kamayish $400k (credit P/L).
Tax expense = $4,200k + under-provision $900k − $400k = $4,700k.
Yopilish DT balansini to'liq qo'shish yoki under-provision'ni ayirish — xato.

q: Boysun Co is preparing its statement of financial position. Which of the following tax items will appear in it at the year end?

The prior year under-provision, as a current liability
The closing deferred tax balance, as a non-current liability
The movement in deferred tax for the year, as a non-current liability
ex:
SFP'da: (1) joriy yil current tax estimate — current liability; (2) yopilish deferred tax balansi — non-current liability.
Under-provision va DT movement faqat P/L (yoki OCI)'ga ta'sir qiladi; ular SFP'da alohida chiqmaydi.

q:
The income tax balance of $350,000 credit in Sirdaryo Co's trial balance at 30 June 20X8 relates to the under/over-provision from the previous year. The tax estimate for the year ended 30 June 20X8 is $3,600,000. Taxable temporary differences decreased by $3,200,000 during the year. The tax rate is 25% and deferred tax movements go to profit or loss.
What is the income tax expense? Enter in $000.
ex:
Credit qoldiq = over-provision (−$350k).
TD kamayishi $3,200k × 25% = DT kamayishi $800k (credit P/L).
Tax expense = $3,600k − $350k − $800k = $2,450k.

q: Which of the following correctly describes the components of income tax expense in the statement of profit or loss?
opt: Current year tax estimate, plus/minus prior year under/over-provision, plus/minus the movement in deferred tax relating to profit or loss items
Tax paid in the year plus the movement in deferred tax, including deferred tax on revaluation gains
Current year tax estimate plus the closing deferred tax balance
Current year tax estimate only; deferred tax is taken directly to equity
ex: Standart working: Tax expense = year-end estimate ± under/(over) provision ± DT movement (P/L qismi). Yopilish DT balansi SFP'ga, faqat movement P/L'ga. Revaluation DT — OCI. To'langan soliq (cash) — cash flow statement uchun.

q: If a company's deferred tax liability increases solely because of a revaluation of its property during the year, the income tax expense in profit or loss is unaffected by that increase.
ex: To'g'ri. Revaluation gain OCI'da, shuning uchun uning deferred tax'i ham OCI'da (revaluation surplus'ni kamaytiradi). P/L'dagi income tax expense o'zgarmaydi.

q: Which of the following may form part of the income tax expense in the statement of profit or loss?
opt: The current year's tax estimate
An under- or over-provision relating to the previous year
The movement in deferred tax relating to accelerated capital allowances
Deferred tax on a revaluation gain recognised in the year
Dividends paid to equity shareholders
ex:
Tax expense tarkibi: current tax estimate; o'tgan yil under/over-provision; P/L item'lariga tegishli DT movement.
Revaluation gain DT — OCI'da. Dividendlar — soliq emas, SOCIE'da taqsimot.

The deferred tax liability should be presented within current liabilities

The deferred tax asset on the warranty provision can be recognised whether or not future taxable profits are expected
